rows.translation: 安妮卡
女武神

rows.original: [var1 |Once again, the valkyrie gives you a friendly [flags.ANNIKA_HUG |hug |handshake ] and a beaming smile. "Good [var2 |morning |afternoon |evening ], Champion! All well with you?" [pc.dcb |"Eh. Surviving." |"Well enough," you say agreeably. "It's good to see you again." |"Yipyup! And super super well now that I get to see you!" ] "Likewise! Got time for that little getting-to-know-you snack I mentioned earlier? I'd love to bake you something tasty." |Annika's intent focus, not to mention the distracting cacophony of valkyries fluttering through the hall, masks the sound of your approach for a while. Inevitably, however, the seneschal's sensitive elven ears catch on before you've finished making your way to her desk. You see them twitch slightly, then she turns to look at you; as soon as she does, her gentle blue face opens in an ebullient grin. "[pc.name]! It's great to see you again!" She strides over [flags.ANNIKA_HUG |and immediately sweeps you into a big muscular hug. |toward you, all muscular confidence, and offers her hand. ] "It feels like it's been ages!" [pc.dcb |"What, they don't teach you how to count and tell time in valkyrie school?" You cough. "You took your sweet time, you know. That all thanks to seneschal stuff?" |"Mmf," you chuckle. "Not quite that long, but I have been looking forward to getting to see you again. You know, you've been awfully busy. Dealing with seneschal stuff, right?" |"It does, doesn't it?" you gush. "Way way wayyy too long, right? Gosh. Whatcha been up to? Sun-mommy-in-charge type stuff?" ] "Right!" she says, releasing you. "I am well and truly swamped. But even if I'm not used to it, it's good work, you know? Helping get everybody back on their feet, making sure everything is humming the way it used to, checking in with sisters I haven't seen in months." The rueful head-tilt Annika gives you after that comment still manages to hold all the warmth of the sun, made just a little cuter by her elven-accented 'shecking' instead of 'checking.' "It is really difficult, though. I mean, I'm used to having to be the woman with answers, but I'm not used to every one of my younger sisters coming to me for answers at basically the same time!" [pc.dcb |"Valkyries aren't self-starters? Fuck, never would've guessed." |You cast your eyes about the hall. "I'm kind of surprised that they need that much guidance. Aren't all valkyries experienced warriors even before they join?" |Your mouth drops open in shock. "They still need to talk to you about stuff? And things? Really? I thought they all were super talented cool ladies even before they joined!" ] [pc.isDK |"In a one-on-one fight, they are. Get a big group of people all together, valkyries or otherwise, and things are different. |"For the most part, yes, but in a big group," she says drily, "there are always plenty of people who need guidance. ] I don't have to worry about them accidentally stabbing each other or anything, but I do have to handle more mundane things. Plus, we're actually being a group — a big group, at least — for the first time in a long time, and not everybody's gotten used to it yet. Hence the paperwork. Organizing this many people, housing them, coming up with duties and assignments, managing their gear, feeding them... thank Lumia I don't have to do all of that, but I've got to do a lot of it! "Like I said, though: it's good work. Seeing my sisters doing normal valkyrie stuff — sparring, drilling, working out, chatting, eating — and being a big part of [silly |facilitating that |ensuring it all works properly ] makes me happy. Oh! And speaking of eating... I hope you[party.som | | two | all ] have time for a quick bite. I'd like to make you some thank-you treats." "Thank-you treats?" [pc.isDK |Even y |Y ]ou can't hide the interest bubbling up in your voice. "That's right. Didn't I promise some earlier? I like to make little tasty treats for my sisters, and [pc.swornGod lumia |you definitely qualify, sister |I think valiant [flags.ANNIKA_HUG |friends |allies ] qualify too ]! What I have in mind doesn't take too long; we can chat while I bake. I'd love to hear more about you." [var0 |She shrugs amiably, then says, "I would've felt a little guilty about not giving you the tour, but as I understand it, Eira's already done that, and she's much better at it than I would be. So treats it is! |She looks apprehensively around the hall, then confesses, "I thought about giving a tour, but honestly, Eira would be much better at it than I would. If I tried to bring you to the different parts of the Keep, I'd get dragged in a million different directions by my sisters and barely have a chance to speak to you. Talk to Eira if you'd like someone to show you around; for now, let's make some snacks. ] "That is," she adds, "if you've got the time. They don't take that long to make, but I can understand if you were just saying hi and need to dash!" ]
rows.translation: [var1 |又一次，这位女武神向您发出了友好的邀请…… [flags.ANNIKA_HUG |拥抱 |握手 ] 还带着灿烂的笑容。“太好了 [var2 |早晨 |下午 |晚上 ]冠军，你一切都好吗？ [pc.dcb |呃，就是活下来而已。 |好吧，”你愉快地说道，“能再次见到你真是太好了。 |嘻嘻！现在能见到你，真是太开心了！ ] 我也是！是不是该吃我之前提到过的那顿简单的熟悉餐了？我很乐意为你烤一些好吃的东西。 |安娜卡全神贯注地专注于手头的工作，再加上那些在大厅中飞来飞去的瓦尔基里们发出的嘈杂声响，暂时掩盖了你靠近她的声音。然而，不可避免地，在你走到她的办公桌前之前，这位年长的精灵就凭借她敏锐的听觉察觉到了你的存在。你看到她的耳朵微微一动，随后她便转过头来看着你；一看到你，她那温柔的蓝色面庞上立刻绽放出了灿烂的笑容。[pc.name]真高兴再次见到你！”她大步走过来。 [flags.ANNIKA_HUG |然后立刻将你紧紧拥入怀中。 |她充满自信地走向你，伸出了手。 ] 感觉好像已经过去很久了！ [pc.dcb |什么？在瓦尔基里学校里，他们难道不教你们怎么数数和看时间吗？”你轻咳了一声，“你可是花了很长时间才学会这些的，对吧？这一切都是因为那些繁琐的规矩和规定吧？ |嗯，”你笑着说，“其实也没那么久，但我真的很期待能再见到你。你知道的，你最近一直很忙，一直在处理各种事务，对吧？ |确实是吧？”你惊叹道，“时间长得离谱吧？天啊，你最近都在忙些什么呢？是在帮忙照顾太阳妈妈之类的工作吗？ ] 好了！”她说着，放开了你。“我现在确实忙得不可开交。但尽管我还不习惯这种状态，你的工作确实做得很好，你知道吗？你帮助大家重新恢复了正常生活，确保一切都能像以前那样运转顺畅，还去探望了那些我已经好几个月没见到的姐妹们。在听到那句话后，安妮卡那副懊恼地歪着头的样子，依然散发着满满的温暖。而她那种带着精灵口音说的‘shecking’，而不是‘checking’，反而让她显得更加可爱了。”不过，这确实是一件很困难的事情。 我的意思是，我已经习惯了总是扮演那个能够给出答案的角色，但我还不习惯这种情况。 每个 我的几个妹妹几乎同时来找我寻求答案！ [pc.dcb |女武神们不会主动采取行动吗？靠，我完全没猜到。 |你环顾了一下大厅，说道：“他们真的需要这么多指导，这让我有点惊讶。难道所有女武神在加入之前都不是经验丰富的战士吗？ |你震惊得张大了嘴巴：“他们竟然还需要和你讨论一些事情？真是…… 各种物品真的吗？在她们加入之前，我就觉得她们都是非常优秀、很酷的女士们呢！ ] [pc.isDK |在一对一的战斗中，确实是这样。但如果能召集一大群人，无论是女武神还是其他战斗力量，情况就会不同了。 |大多数情况下是的，但当人数很多的时候，”她干巴巴地说，“总是会有很多人需要指导。 ] 我不需要担心他们会不小心互相伤害之类的问题，但我确实需要处理一些更为琐碎的事情。另外，实际上我们…… 存在 很长时间以来，这是第一次有这么一大群人聚集在一起，而且并不是所有人都已经习惯了这种状况。因此才需要处理这些繁琐的文书工作。要安排这么多人，为他们提供住宿，确定他们的职责和任务，管理他们的装备，还要照顾他们的饮食……多亏了Lumia，这些事情都不用我来操心了。 所有 虽然还有其他事情要做，但我确实有很多工作要完成！ “就像我之前说的：这份工作做得很好。看到我的姐妹们做那些属于瓦尔基里们的日常事务——进行训练、练习、锻炼身体、聊天、吃饭——并且成为其中不可或缺的一部分，真的让我感到很欣慰。 [silly |促进这一进程 |确保一切都能正常运行。 ] 这让我很开心。哦！说到吃饭……我希望你……[party.som | | 两个 | 所有 ] 有时间随便吃点东西吧。我想准备一些小点心来感谢你。” “小点心？ [pc.isDK |甚至…… |Y ]你根本无法掩饰自己声音中流露出的那份兴奋。 “没错，我之前不是答应过要做的吗？我就喜欢为我的姐妹们制作一些美味的小点心。 [pc.swornGod lumia |你绝对符合条件，姐妹。 |我认为《无畏契约》非常出色。 [flags.ANNIKA_HUG |朋友们 |盟友 ] 也有资格参加 ]我所说的这个事情并不需要花费太多时间；我在烤东西的时候我们可以边聊天边讨论。我很想更多地了解你。 [var0 |她友好地耸了耸肩，然后说道：“如果我不带你参观一下的话，我会觉得有点内疚的，但据我所知，艾拉已经帮你安排好了参观事宜，而且她做得比我好多了。所以，就让她来负责这件事吧！ |她环顾大厅，显得有些忐忑，然后坦白道：“我本来想带大家参观一下，但说实话，艾拉做这个会比我做得好多了。如果我试着带你们去城堡的各个地方，我的姐妹们肯定会把我拉到各种各样的地方去，我几乎根本没有机会和你们聊天。 如果有人能带你参观一下，可以去找艾拉。; 先来准备一些零食吧。 ] 也就是说，”她补充道，“如果你有时间的话。制作这些其实并不需要太长时间，但如果你只是想打个招呼然后就得赶紧离开的话，我也能理解！ ]

rows.translation: 奖励

rows.original: [pc.dcb |"Free food. Okay," you sigh exaggeratedly, "if you're making it, I guess I can come along." |Teasingly, you raise your finger to your cheek as though it requires much thought. "I suppose I can find the time to enjoy the smell of cooking sweets with some company." |"Yes please! I'd love some time with food! Um, time with you! I meeeean, both?" ] "Wonderful," she says, [silly |flipping the sign on her desk to read 'The Seneschal is OUT' |clapping her hands ]. "This way!" [var0 |"Yesss!" Cait exults. Her hand migrates straight to her tummy as she follows Annika away from the desk. "Free treats! Oh, Mallach, I think I love it up here. Plenty of fish and tasty baked sweets... [cait.isLeothran |now that I've got such a warm winter coat |if it weren't so cold ], I might come to live here for good!" ] Just off of the main dining hall, there are several smaller rooms — larders, storerooms, and more than one kitchen. Fortunately, there's a bit of a lull in the mess, so Annika using her authority as seneschal to temporarily commandeer a room with an oven and a few tables makes no never-mind to anyone. [party.hasCompanions |[party.compNames] find some drinks |You find a drink ] and sit down at the table; you don't have to be told twice not to irritate someone in a kitchen by getting in the way and offering unsolicited help. And, untrammeled by would-be helpers, the[pc.swornGod lumia | other ] valkyrie moves quickly, cleaning off her hands before gathering bowls, a shaped earthen tray with divots in it, and the ingredients: a powdery brown and white meal — ground almonds, apparently, which she confirms with you and the group are safe to serve — milk, eggs, butter, sugars, and spices. "Come to think of it," Annika says, as she starts to beat some of the ingredients into a paste, "I don't know very much about you yet, and I would absolutely love to. Other than being a great fighter and, apparently, clever enough to navigate the gods' dreams, what can you tell me about yourself?" [pc.dcb |"Most important person I know." You yawn theatrically and stretch your hands to the sky. "Stop me if I tell you about something too spectacular or amazing for this snowy hole in the wall." |"Well, now. That... that's a tale." You crack your knuckles and grin. "I'll give it a shot. Although, you know, I'm not from around here. We might get into an awful lot of place names that won't mean anything to you." |"Oooh! I can try telling some things! Like, I remember lots and lots about the places I was before." Then a thought comes to mind. "Um, I might not remember some of the deeetails of stuff, so if you don't know about faraway places..." ] "Unlike most of the people of Njorhaalt, we valkyries actually do a decent amount of traveling." Even as she pounds on the pastry ingredients, the blue-skinned elf has the wherewithal to give you an easy shrug. "There's a lot of opportunity to visit interesting places, what with bringing Lumia's light to the corners of Savarra, doing battle with Wraithkind, protecting her disciples, and all. In the last hundred years, I've been to most of the provinces of the old Empire. Try me!" "[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee! Okie-doke. |Fair enough. ]" Over the next several minutes, you relate some of the highlights of your life outside the Marches, reminiscing about [pc.bgMulti arcanist barbarian soldier scholar acolyte slumrat hunter noblescion courtesan minstrel |learning the intricacies of the inner workings of magic from your mentor, unlocking the mysteries of the universe far from the disturbances of cities and towns. It was a good life for a while. But you couldn't stay, and that led you here. |battling tribal foes and the elements alongside the rest of your people, surviving by wit and skill and sheer courage. But then it all came crashing to an end. You lost everyone, and only lately have you managed to start picking up any of the pieces. |fighting in the Heartlands' endless wars; in the company of your comrades, you learned a warrior's skills and, more importantly, a soldier's discipline. That was a hard life, though, so you came north looking for something better... if not noticeably much less violent, [pc.isDK |but you don't really have a problem with violent anyway |unfortunately ]. |the camaraderie and collaboration of like-minded scholars at the pinnacle of academia, including many nights arguing over theories and interpretations over drinks. It was a good life, learning from and working with some of the cleverest minds in the world, but unfortunately, there are a lot more students than job openings as court mage or teacher.[silly | You could've had an adjunct job teaching a 4/4 or a 5/5, but at practically minimum wage with no health care, and fuck that right in the eye. Per-course payment is raw academic bullshit, and so is the fact that except for Marouka, Belhar, and Eldenstone, there are no damn tenure-track jobs within a thousand imperial miles of where you grew up. ] Besides, you had an adventurous itch that you just couldn't scratch any other way. |entering the service of the Seven as a young initiate and serving as the devout should: healing the hurt and feeding the hungry and bringing the living gods closer to them all. That's why you're here on the frontier. As bad as it sometimes is for people in the Heartlands, the Marchers need the gods' love just as much as anyone else... and it's been thrilling to meet godservants like herself doing the same thing. |the cleverness and fortitude it takes to live hard on the [silly |killing |mean ] streets, outwitting the powerful whenever you could and outfighting them when you couldn't. You moved in the alleys and the corners, doing whatever you had to do to survive. It was exhilarating sometimes[silly |; whatever else you can say about it, the Game is always the Game |, even if it was vicious and deadly the rest of the time ]. Eventually, you had to get out, and the Marches... well, they're just about as far away from your old slums as you can get. |surviving on the edge of civilization as a skilled hunt[pc.mf |er |ress ]; you tracked many a beast through the wastes and brought it down through clever planning, fleetness of foot, and careful aim. You were born to adventure — your parents taught you the way — and it didn't take much for you to follow in their footsteps across the northlands. |your family and the high offices they held; whatever else you might think of them, they gave you many of the tools and schooling you needed to succeed out here in the frozen north, to say nothing of the aura of authority that comes in very handy when you need it. You came to build something for yourself, though, and you're proud of what you've already managed to accomplish. |your trail of conquests and clients, for whom you provided only the very best of companionship... and who rewarded you very appropriately for the pleasures you provided them. It was a shame about the scandal that ended your career, of course, but there have been prospects — and lovers — just as good here in the back end of nowhere. |your accomplished bardic mentor and the crowds the two of you would draw; even after parting ways, you always seemed to find a warm fire and plenty of smiles as you journeyed around the northern parts of Old Belhar. The minstrel's life is one meant to be led on the road, and that's what brought you here. ] Then after that, you outline your adventures on the way to Hawkethorne as Annika works the paste into something closer to a batter, interjecting questions and opinions and commiseration at appropriate stopping points. Apparently, the last time she's been anywhere near where you grew up was before you were born, and things have changed an awful lot! But apart from a few comments about shared experiences, the valkyrie mostly lets you hold the balance of the conversation — and you're quite happy to unburden yourself. The time before you and Cait stumbled on the portal... it's seemed so distant, almost unreal, and taking the time to remind yourself of who you once were helps to reify it. Sometime around the point where your hostess starts to pour the batter into the kiln-fired mold, you get into more familiar territory once you reach the Hawkethorne portion of your tale. It's a story you've told her before, so you try not to retread familiar ground, but there are plenty of details you missed the previous time that you don't mind sharing. [party.hasCompanions |Besides, now [party.compNames] can share the load a bit — and [party.manyCompanions |they do |[companion1.heShe] does ], even if the topic of conversation does start to wander a bit here. |With details like that out of the way, the conversation's quick to wander onto other things. ] [party.hasCompanions |[party.oneComp arona etheryn brienne agnimitra |Arona doesn't even pretend to want to talk about, say, fighting Argoth. She's got other fish to fry, and the sly, tusky grin on her face shows it. "So," she chuckles, "these things have nuts in 'em, right?" "Yes, that's right," Annika says. The orc starts to say, "Well, I got tw—" But the valkyrie wasn't done talking. "— and I hope that that's okay. You don't have a problem with eating nuts, do you?" [arona.isSub |"Ha! Good one. [pc.hasRealCock |But yeah, actually, I fucking love eating nuts." Arona gives you an approving side-eye, smirks, and jabs you in the shoulder. "Big. Huge. Creamy. Nuts.[arona.fucked | | Hint hint, big [pc.mf |guy |girl ]. ]" Annika grins at you, too. "Oh, very nice. [arona.fucked |You must keep her well fed. |She doesn't keep her crush quiet, does she? ] |Yeah, it's hot as fuck, but I like eating pussy too." Arona glances at you approvingly and gives you a[arona.fucked | proud |n unsubtle ] nudge. "Wet. Tender. Quivering. Pussy. Especially [arona.fucked |when |if ] I[arona.fucked | | could ] get to put my head between a certain big bad [pc.mf |bastard |bitch ]'s thighs and get it squeezed nice and tight and..." "Oh my," Annika laughs. "You know, if you[arona.fucked | two don't mind spreading it around |'re not taken, Arona ], there's more than a few girls around here who'd take you up on that. ] But we were talking about, ah, more normal food." "Shit yeah. I'll eat that too." |"Like I said, I got two mo— hey, wait." Your big green alpha's smile slowly disintegrates. "[silly |Aw nuts. T |Fuck, t ]hat messed it up." Annika's face is the picture of innocence. "Messed what up, dear?" "Never mind," she sulks. ] |[etheryn.highConfidence |Ryn, of course, is practically vibrating with excitement. They're kind of a warm, sweet treat for those days when the whole city's buried in snow and it's just you and the family stuck indoors." "Mumma, huh? Do m[pc.isBimbo |ama |om ]s usually make them?" rows.translation: 下一步
安妮卡与卢米娅

rows.original: Before long, the little almond cakes are all in their mold, set inside a ceramic wood-fired oven, and filling the room with a wonderfully enticing aroma. Annika continues to work while they bake, cleaning the table of most of her ingredients and what little mess she's made[party.has brienne |; then, she goes over the recipe and the instructions for Brienne as promised, using the empty bowl to demonstrate ]. Even that task, though, doesn't take forever, and the cakes are still baking when the valkyrie sits down to a now-spotless table. The conversation continues in a more muted form as you focus more on the warmth and the sweet smells gracing the room, and you barely notice time's elapsed at all until Annika stands up again, cleans her hands again, and carefully removes the oven from the fire. [pc.dcb |"Am I gonna have to hold myself back from eating these right where they stand?" you sigh. "They smell fuckin' great." |"Ooh." You click your tongue hungrily. "God[pc.swornGod lumia |des ]s, I don't know if I'll be able to wait for them to cool." |"Oh nooo they smell too good!" you gasp. "It's gonna be soooo hard to stop myself from eating them right now even though they're probably really really hot!" ] "I'm sure you'll do your best. After all, I haven't coated them in the sugar mix yet..." [party.has cait |At that, your kitty companion groans with anticipation. "Sugar mix? Be still, my beating heart!" ] "[pc.isBimbo |Ooooh." Then you blink a few times. "Ooooh! ]So that's why you left some of the ingredients out[pc.isBimbo |!" |," you venture. ] "Of course!" Annika laughs. "Cakes need toppings, after all, don't they?" Within a few minutes, your snacks are ready to eat: light, airy, very sweet, and very warm. Each one could easily fit in the palm of your hand, and you could very easily [silly |[rand |house one in a single bite |snarf one whole ] |gobble one up without even needing to chew ], but you don't. It's more fun to let the almond sweetness rest on your tongue for a while before you swallow, then let the aftertaste linger for a while. Something to balance with wanting to eat the cakes warm — oooh, decisions, decisions. Your eyes slowly drift closed as you savor the taste of it. "[pc.dcb |Not bad. Not fuckin' bad. |Mmmm-mm! Wow. I can say one thing: these came out very well. |Oooooh... so gooooood... ]" [var0|"Mmmmmnf! I know, right?" Cait squeals. "Oh, I love these! We need to get the recipe, [pc.name]!"] "I'm glad!" Annika says brightly. "Like I said, it's been a while... but I think you're on the money. These are going down just right." And just like that, the berobed Dawn Maiden herself appears in the door, motherly as ever. If she walked to get here, and she very well may have, you didn't notice amidst the snacking. The divine presence, looking very relaxed, breathes deeply of the sweet almond aroma and smiles. "I'm glad to hear — mmm, and smell — that you've lost none of your touch, Annika.[party.has brienne | Nor," she continues, eyes and smile shifting to a suddenly somewhat blushy Brienne, "your penchant for passing on what you've learned. ]" "Oh!" Your hostess straightens up a bit, but she doesn't seem surprised in the slightest; apparently the goddess has a habit of just wandering around the Keep, as one does. "Hey there, my lady. Want some mumma? We've got plenty." "Mmm, I certainly would," the goddess sighs happily. It's followed by another "mmm" when she plucks one cake from its place in the mold and pops it in her mouth. "That was wonderful. What's the occasion?" "Just a little thank-you and get-to-know-you sort of thing for [party.combatNames]. And an opportunity to relax." Lumia makes another of the mouth-watering mumma vanish. "Mmmf. So good. Ah. It's a worthy idea, but it's had some unforeseen consequences. You've even ensnared me — if I stay here much longer, I'm going to deprive you [party.som |both |three |all ] of the rest of these treats. I might have done too well by asking you to stay at the Keep, Annika." Annika winks. "I go wherever I'm needed." "And regardless of those unforeseen consequences, you are needed here," the goddess of light agrees. She starts to reach for another almond cake, stops herself, shakes her head, and instead lifts her hand to her cheek. "Hmm." You cock your head. "[pc.isBimbo |Is something wrong |Problem ]?" "Not at all. Just trying to stop myself, and," Lumia continues ruefully, "only partly succeeding. Annika's very good at taking care of people." "Thank you. I do have an example to live up to; that helps." She nods toward her goddess, then holds up the mostly-empty tray of mumma. "Go ahead: finish these off while they're still warm." "Yes," Lumia hastens to add. "Please. Before I do it." [party.oneComp brienne arona |"Ooh, could I?" your mino[brienne.married |-wife |[brienne.fucked |-lover |taur companion ] ] asks. "They're really good!" [pc.dcb |You extract a tax of a few of the cakes, then nod your assent. "All right. Now you're good." |As if you could ever say no to her. "Sure! Go wild." |"Of course, sweetie!" You flutter your eyelashes at her. "I could never say no to you." ] "Thanks, sweetie! I, um... I kind of have a thing for baked goods, and these are delicious." Blushing first at you, then at Lumia, Brienne carefully picks up the treats and eats them with as little mess as she can. One by one, the warm mumma disappear, and soon Annika's left with a clean plate; even the crumbs vanish. "Thank you, dear. I do appreciate it." the goddess of light says. |"Aaah, forget the pussyfootin'," chuckles Arona. Her enormous green meathooks reach out for the rest of the mumma, gathering them into her palms and leaving you with a lonely singleton. "[arona.isSub |There ya go, [pc.name]. |That's for you, bottom bitch. ]" [pc.dcb |"How gracious of you," you say drily. |"Aw, you shouldn't have." You smile, shake your head, and reluctantly take your prize. |"Gosh, thanks, sweetie!" You pluck your treat from the mold and hum happily once it goes down. "You're really nice sometimes, you know that?" ] "[arona.isSub |[pc.isBimbo |And I had this whole snooze-ya-lose thing ready to go, too, but you just decided to be sweet about it. Aaah, well. |Hey, even if you're the big cheese around here, ya snooze and ya lose. ]" Sugary coating gets all over Arona's hands, tusks, and lips as she double-fists the treats, swallows them whole, and pats her [arona.belly]. "[arona.pregStage 2 |Nnnf. Good shit. Besides, the kiddo's makin' me hungry, and who am I to say no to our little one? |Oof. That right there? Hit the fuckin' spot. Nice. ]" |Yup, that's me. Nicest damn top in the whole tribe." One by one, she devours the treats, tossing them back into her open betusked maw and shifting her gaze to you every so often to make sure you're watching. Once she's done, she licks her fingers clean — well, 'clean' — with the most exaggerated tongue motions she can muster. "Damn, that was good." ] The goddess of the sun smiles wryly. "Uncouth as that was, I suppose I did ask for it." |With what amounts to divine permission, [party.combatNames] finish off the tray of goodies with haste that's just shy of unseemly. Savoring the taste of the cakes goes out the window in favor of a rapid series of grabs for food, one after the other.[var0| Cait takes a little more than her fair share — she asks first, of course, but wastes no time in stuffing her face once she has the okay.] Within a few minutes, there's nothing left but crumbs... and even those vanish in due time. "My, my," chuckles Lumia. "Thank you, dear[party.hasCompanions |s ]. I guess it was just as hard for you to resist as it would have been for me." [pc.dcb |"Mmffff." You swallow. "Yeah, this is good shit." Lumia shakes her head. "I suppose I did ask for you to do that." |"Hey," you say defensively, "you've gotta eat 'em while they're warm. That's the absolute rule of tasty baked desserts." "You know what you're about, [pc.name]." The Dawn Maiden gives you a beatific smile. |"Ugh, I know, right?" you agree. "Like, it was real torture or something to have to even wait for them to cool. But the taste was totally worth[silly | | it ]!" The Dawn Maiden pats you on the shoulder. "Definitely." ] ]
rows.translation: 不久之后，那些小杏仁饼都已经被放入模具中，然后被放入陶瓷制的木炉中进行烘烤，整个房间顿时弥漫着一种令人垂涎的香气。安妮卡在它们烘烤的过程中继续忙碌着，她清理掉了桌子上大部分的食材，也收拾好了自己留下的那一小堆杂物。[party.has brienne |然后，她按照约定，仔细讲解了为布蕾妮准备的食谱及制作方法，并用那个空碗作为示范。 ]然而，即便是这项任务也不需要花费太长时间。当女武神坐下来时，那些蛋糕仍在烤箱中烘烤着，桌面也早已变得一尘不染。你们继续交谈着，语气也变得更为轻柔。你们更加专注于那种温暖的气息以及弥漫在房间中的甜香，几乎完全没有注意到时间是如何流逝的。直到安妮卡再次站起来，洗净双手，然后小心翼翼地将烤箱从火上取下来。 [pc.dcb |我是不是得忍住不去当场把这些吃掉啊？”你叹道，“它们闻起来简直太香了。 |哦。”你馋馋地吐了吐舌头，“天啊……[pc.swornGod lumia |欲望]嗯，我不知道自己是否能够等到它们冷却下来。 |哦不，它们闻起来太香了！”你惊呼道，“现在就算这些食物可能非常非常烫，我也绝对控制不住自己，一定会吃掉的！ ] 我相信你会尽自己最大的努力的。毕竟，我还没有在它们上面撒上糖粉呢…… [party.has cait |听到这话，你的小猫伙伴兴奋地叫了起来：“糖粉吗？安静点，我的心都快跳出来了！ ] "[pc.isBimbo |哦哦哦……”然后你眨了几下眼睛。“哦哦哦！ ]那么 那就是 为什么你漏掉了一些材料呢？[pc.isBimbo |!" |你这么大胆地说出来。 ] 当然！”安妮卡笑着说，“毕竟，蛋糕总是需要配料的，对吧？” 几分钟之后，你的零食就准备好了：口感轻盈、香甜可口，而且温度正好。每一块零食都小到可以轻松放在手掌里…… [silly |[rand |一口吞下整个猎物 |一口吃掉 ] |不费吹灰之力就占到了便宜 ]但你并没有那么做。其实，让杏仁的甜味在舌头上停留一会儿，然后再咽下去，让余味在口中回荡，这样会更有乐趣。这种感觉，正好能与那种想要立刻吃掉热乎乎蛋糕的冲动形成平衡——哦，真是让人难以抉择啊…… 你慢慢地闭上眼睛，继续品味这种美妙的感觉。[pc.dcb |不错。真的不错。 |嗯嗯！哇，我得说，这些做得非常棒。 |哦哦哦……真是太棒了…… ]" [var0|哼！我懂的，对吧？”凯特尖叫道，“哦，我太喜欢这些了！我们一定要弄到这个食谱才行…… [pc.name]!"] 太好了！”安妮卡高兴地说道，“就像我之前说的，已经有一段时间没见面了……不过我觉得你说得对，这些真的非常合适。” 说着，那位穿着长袍的黎明少女就这样出现在门口，依旧带着那种慈母般的神情。 如果她是步行来到这里的，而且很有可能确实是这么做的，那么在你们吃零食的时候，你肯定没有注意到她。这位气质非凡的女士看起来非常放松，她深深地吸了一口甜杏仁的香气，然后微笑着说：“听到这个消息，而且闻到这种香气，我真的很高兴——嗯，安妮卡，你的技艺果然一点也没有退步啊。[party.has brienne | 还有，”她继续说道，目光和笑容转向了突然有些脸红的布蕾妮，“你那种乐于将自己所学的知识传授给别人的习惯。 ]哦！”女主人稍微挺直了身子，但她的表情丝毫没有表现出惊讶；显然，这位女神有在城堡里闲逛的习惯，就像其他人一样。“嘿，女士，想要一些妈妈茶吗？ 我们有很多呢。” “嗯，我当然愿意。”女神开心地叹道。当她从模具中取出一块蛋糕放进嘴里时，又发出了“嗯”的一声。“真是太美味了。 这是为了什么场合呢？” “只是想借此机会表达一下感谢，同时也想互相了解一下而已。 [party.combatNames]同时也是一种放松身心的好机会。” Lumia再次让那些让人垂涎不已的东西消失了。“嗯……真是太棒了。 不错啊，这个想法确实不错，但却产生了一些意想不到的后果。你甚至把我也卷了进去——如果我再在这里待太久，我就会耽误你的事情了。 [party.som |两者都 |三 |所有 ] 在这些好处中，让你留在城堡里或许真的是我做得很对，安妮卡。” 安妮卡眨了眨眼：“只要有人需要我，我就会去。” “而且，无论会带来什么意想不到的后果，你…… 是 这里确实需要它，”光之女神说道。她刚要伸手去拿另一块杏仁蛋糕，又停了下来，摇了摇头，而是将手放在脸颊上，轻声说道：“嗯……” 你歪了歪头，问道：“啊？[pc.isBimbo |出什么问题了吗？ |问题 ]一点也不。我只是在努力克制自己，不过……”卢米娅懊恼地继续说道，“还是没能完全成功。安妮卡真的很擅长照顾别人。” “谢谢。我确实有一个需要效仿的榜样，这确实帮了大忙。”她朝自己的‘女神’点了点头，然后举起那个几乎空了的妈妈做的点心盘，“快吃吧，趁它们还热着。” “好的，”卢米娅急忙补充道，“请吧。在我吃之前。 [party.oneComp brienne arona |哦，我可以吗？”你的米诺人说道。[brienne.married |妻子 |[brienne.fucked |爱人 |金牛座伙伴 ] ] 问道：“它们在…… 真的吗 太好了！ [pc.dcb |你从那些蛋糕中抽取了一部分作为税款，然后点了点头表示同意。“好了，现在你们没问题了。 |好像你根本不可能拒绝她似的。“当然！随你便吧。 |当然，亲爱的！”你眨着睫毛对她说，“我永远都不会拒绝你。 ] 谢谢，亲爱的！我，嗯……其实我挺喜欢烘焙食品的，这些真的很好吃。”布里恩先是对你红着脸，然后又看向卢米娅，她小心翼翼地拿起那些点心，尽量不弄脏自己，一口一口地吃着。那些温暖的小点心一个接一个地被吃光了，很快安妮卡的盘子就变得干干净净的，连一点碎屑都没有留下。 “谢谢。 你亲爱的，我真的很感激。”光之女神说道。 |啊，别再小心翼翼的了，”阿罗娜笑着说。她那巨大的绿色肉爪伸向妈妈剩下的部分，将它们全部抓到自己的掌心里，只留下那个孤独的单独存在的东西。[arona.isSub |好了，就是这样。 [pc.name]. |这就是给你的，底层贱人。 ]" [pc.dcb |你真是太慷慨了，”你冷淡地说道。 |哎呀，你本来不应该这样的。”你微笑着摇摇头，最终还是不情愿地接过了自己的奖品。 |天哪，太谢谢你了，亲爱的！”你从模具里取出那份零食，吃下去后开心地哼了一声。“你知道吗，你有时候真的非常贴心。 ] "[arona.isSub |[pc.isBimbo |我也准备好了那套“小睡一会儿就会输掉游戏”的策略，但你们却选择以一种温柔的方式来处理这件事。啊，好吧。 |嘿，就算你是这里的大人物，犯困也会让你输掉一切的。 ]当阿罗娜用双拳把那些甜食捏碎、整个吞下去后，糖分就会沾满她的手、獠牙和嘴唇，然后她还会轻轻拍拍自己的…… [arona.belly]. "[arona.pregStage 2 |哇塞，太棒了。而且，这孩子让我觉得饿了，对于我们的小宝贝，我怎么可能拒绝他的要求呢？ |哎哟，正好命中要害啊。干得漂亮。 ]" |没错，就是我。整个部落里最棒的食物了。”她一颗一颗地吃着那些美食，把它们重新塞进自己张得大大的嘴里，还不时地看向你，确保你在看她。吃完后，她用尽全力做出夸张的舔手指的动作，把手指“舔”得干干净净……“哇，真是太美味了。 ] 太阳女神苦笑着：“虽然那样做有些粗鲁，但我想，我确实是自找的。 |仿佛得到了神的许可一般， [party.combatNames] 你几乎是迫不及待地吃光了那一盘美味点心，速度快得有点不太礼貌。本来应该仔细品尝那些蛋糕的味道，但你却一门心思地快速地一个接一个地把食物塞进嘴里。[var0| 凯特总是拿得比她应得的还要多——当然，她会先征求别人的同意，但一旦得到许可，她就会立刻毫不迟疑地开始大吃特吃。] 几分钟之内，一切都化为齑粉……就连那些齑粉也会在适当的时刻消失无踪。 “哎呀，哎呀，”卢米娅轻笑道，“谢谢你，亲爱的。[party.hasCompanions |s ]我想，对你来说，抵制这种诱惑应该和我一样困难吧。 [pc.dcb |嗯……”你咽了咽口水，“没错，这确实挺不错的。” Lumia摇了摇头：“我想，我确实是让你这么做的吧。 |嘿，”你辩解道，“这些东西必须在热的时候吃掉，这才是品尝美味烘焙甜点的绝对原则。” “你确实很懂行啊…… [pc.name]晨曦少女向你露出了幸福的微笑。 |唉，我懂的，对吧？”你表示认同。“真的，等着那些东西冷却下来，简直就像在受折磨一样。不过，味道确实值得等待。[silly | | 它 ]黎明少女”轻拍着你的肩膀，说道：“当然可以。 ] ]

"Yes," Lumia hastens to add. "Please. Before I do it." [party.oneComp brienne arona |"Ooh, could I?" your mino[brienne.married |-wife |[brienne.fucked |-lover |taur companion ] ] asks. "They're really good!" [pc.dcb |You extract a tax of a few of the cakes, then nod your assent. "All right. Now you're good." |As if you could ever say no to her. "Sure! Go wild." |"Of course, sweetie!" You flutter your eyelashes at her. "I could never say no to you." ] "Thanks, sweetie! I, um... I kind of have a thing for baked goods, and these are delicious." Blushing first at you, then at Lumia, Brienne carefully picks up the treats and eats them with as little mess as she can. One by one, the warm mumma disappear, and soon Annika's left with a clean plate; even the crumbs vanish. "Thank you, dear. I do appreciate it." the goddess of light says. |"Aaah, forget the pussyfootin'," chuckles Arona. Her enormous green meathooks reach out for the rest of the mumma, gathering them into her palms and leaving you with a lonely singleton. "[arona.isSub |There ya go, [pc.name]. |That's for you, bottom bitch. ]" [pc.dcb |"How gracious of you," you say drily. |"Aw, you shouldn't have." You smile, shake your head, and reluctantly take your prize. |"Gosh, thanks, sweetie!" You pluck your treat from the mold and hum happily once it goes down. "You're really nice sometimes, you know that?" ] "[arona.isSub |[pc.isBimbo |And I had this whole snooze-ya-lose thing ready to go, too, but you just decided to be sweet about it. Aaah, well. |Hey, even if you're the big cheese around here, ya snooze and ya lose. ]" Sugary coating gets all over Arona's hands, tusks, and lips as she double-fists the treats, swallows them whole, and pats her [arona.belly]. "[arona.pregStage 2 |Nnnf. Good shit. Besides, the kiddo's makin' me hungry, and who am I to say no to our little one? |Oof. That right there? Hit the fuckin' spot. Nice. ]" |Yup, that's me. Nicest damn top in the whole tribe." One by one, she devours the treats, tossing them back into her open betusked maw and shifting her gaze to you every so often to make sure you're watching. Once she's done, she licks her fingers clean — well, 'clean' — with the most exaggerated tongue motions she can muster. "Damn, that was good." ] The goddess of the sun smiles wryly. "Uncouth as that was, I suppose I did ask for it." |With what amounts to divine permission, [party.combatNames] finish off the tray of goodies with haste that's just shy of unseemly. Savoring the taste of the cakes goes out the window in favor of a rapid series of grabs for food, one after the other.[var0| Cait takes a little more than her fair share — she asks first, of course, but wastes no time in stuffing her face once she has the okay.] Within a few minutes, there's nothing left but crumbs... and even those vanish in due time. "My, my," chuckles Lumia. "Thank you, dear[party.hasCompanions |s ]. I guess it was just as hard for you to resist as it would have been for me." [pc.dcb |"Mmffff." You swallow. "Yeah, this is good shit." Lumia shakes her head. "I suppose I did ask for you to do that." |"Hey," you say defensively, "you've gotta eat 'em while they're warm. That's the absolute rule of tasty baked desserts." "You know what you're about, [pc.name]." The Dawn Maiden gives you a beatific smile. |"Ugh, I know, right?" you agree. "Like, it was real torture or something to have to even wait for them to cool. But the taste was totally worth[silly | | it ]!" The Dawn Maiden pats you on the shoulder. "Definitely." ] ] '

rows.original: After the mumma disappear, you chit-chat — or, as Annika says once when she's not being careful about her accent, 'shit-shat' — but, it's clear, you can't leave the used baking supplies out dirty for long. When you offer to help her clean, the seneschal's words are just as warm as her food. "Thank you, sweetie. It would've been fine if you just stayed sitting — an older woman likes to dote! But I won't turn down help from a [pc.mascFem |dashing |gorgeous ] hero[pc.mf | |ine ] like you..." The smile from what she says sticks on your face for a while as you start to help her, and it's only after a minute or so of scrubbing that you wonder whether she'd have been quite so sweet to any other [pc.manWoman]. Many hands make light work. Bowl and oven are scraped and washed, ingredients placed back where they're normally stored, and even after all that work, the lovely warmth of the almond cakes continues to permeate your whole tummy. As the last things disappear and the little kitchen returns to the state it was in before you were there, the valkyrie turns to you with a smile. "Thank you again! I appreciate you sharing so much with me. Would you —" Whatever she was about to ask, however, is summarily interrupted. A brown-skinned human valkyrie with long, black, wavy hair that descends from her head in a waterfall pokes her head in the door. She looks like an experienced warrior in her black-and-gold armor, but when confronted with the people in this room, she still stops in the doorway and clears her throat deferentially. "Hey. Sorry. My lady; Annika[pc.swornGod lumia |; [pc.name] ]. Could I...?" "Hey, Halima. It's fine," your hostess says. "We're just cleaning up. What do you need?" The younger valkyrie's smile creases a little. "It's just... um. The meeting about the south wall?" "Aaaahhhh. I didn't realize we'd gone so far over." Annika turns to you sadly. "I have to cut this short. I hope you won't mind needing to catch up again later." [pc.dcb |"Really? Fine, whatever. I guess you have big shot responsibilities or some shit." |You give her a knowing nod. "The responsibilities of being seneschal, huh?" |"It's a little bit sad, but I don't mind!" you chirp. "You have sun mommy stuff to handle." ] "Yes, I do. And the responsibility of bringing hundreds of people back to the Keep who haven't been here consistently in over a year," she sighs. "I'm really sorry." "These things happen," you assure her. "[pc.isDK |I'll live |It's fine ]." "Thanks. I won't be more than an hour, [silly |so if you want, you can just use the Wait button and I'll be ready to go! |but I'd understand if you didn't just want to sit around for that long just waiting for me to get done. ]" [silly |Is the south wall also the fourth wall of this Keep? Heh. ]"I guess I'll see you when I see you[pc.isBimbo |! |. ]" "I'm looking forward to it!"
rows.translation: 等妈妈离开后，你们就会开始闲聊——或者用安妮卡的话来说，当她不小心带上自己的口音时，就会说“瞎扯瞎聊”……不过很明显，那些用过的烘焙工具是不能被扔在那儿不管的。当你主动提出帮忙清理时，女管家的话语和她做的食物一样温暖：“谢谢你，亲爱的。如果你只是坐着不动的话也没关系啦——年纪大些的女人就喜欢被宠溺嘛！不过，对于别人的帮助，我当然是不会拒绝的。 [pc.mascFem |潇洒的 |美丽动人 ] 英雄[pc.mf | | ] 就像你一样……” 她说的这句话带来的笑容会让你脸上久久难以消退，于是你开始帮助她。然而，在擦洗了一分钟左右后，你不禁开始思考：如果当时没有帮忙，她会不会…… 相当 对别人来说，这简直太美好了…… [pc.manWoman]人多力量大。洗碗和擦烤箱，把食材放回它们原本存放的地方，尽管做了这么多工作，但杏仁蛋糕带来的美好滋味依然会让你感到满腹愉悦。 当最后的东西都消失殆尽，小厨房恢复到你到来之前的原貌时，那位女武神微笑着转向你：“再次感谢你！我很感激你与我分享这么多。你愿意…… 然而，她正要提出的问题被突然打断了。一位皮肤呈棕色的女性英灵走了进来，她那长长的黑色波浪发如同瀑布般从头顶垂下。身着黑金相间的铠甲，她看起来就像一位经验丰富的战士，但当看到房间里的这些人时，她还是在门口停了下来，恭敬地清了清嗓子。 嘿，对不起，我的女士，安妮卡。[pc.swornGod lumia |; [pc.name] ]我可以……吗？” “嘿，哈利玛，没关系，”女主人说道，“我们只是在打扫而已。你需要什么帮助吗？” 这位年轻的女武神的笑容略微有些僵硬：“就是……那个关于南墙的会议……” “啊……我都没意识到我们已经讨论到这个地步了。”安妮卡遗憾地转向你，“我得先结束这次谈话了。希望你不会介意之后再继续讨论这个话题吧。 [pc.dcb |真的吗？好吧，随你便。估计你是有什么重要的职责之类的吧。 |你会会意地点了点头：“担任管家，责任确实不小啊。 |有点可惜吧，但我并不在意！”你开心地说道，“你还有‘太阳妈妈’的事情要处理呢。 ] 是的，我明白。而且，让那些已经一年多没有再来过这个地方的数百人重新回到这里，这个责任确实很重……”她叹了口气，“我真的感到很抱歉。” “这种事情难免会发生，”你安慰她道。[pc.isDK |我还能活下去。 |没关系。 ]谢谢。我大概一个小时内就会回来。 [silly |所以，如果你愿意的话，可以直接使用“等待”按钮，到时候我就可以开始行动了！ |不过，如果你并不想花那么长时间只是等着我完成事情，我也能理解。 ]" [silly |这座堡垒的南墙，也是它的“第四面墙”吗？呵呵。 ]我想，到时候见吧。[pc.isBimbo |! |. ]我非常期待！

rows.translation: 拥抱

rows.original:
"[pc.dcb
                        |Sure, okay
                        |All right then
                        |Okie-doke
                    ]," you say amiably as you open your arms. "Have a good meet[pc.isDK
                        |ing or whatever.
                        |!
                    ]"
                    
                    Annika's already reaching over for the hug before you finish your sentence; in short order, she sweeps you into a big, muscular, warm-hearted embrace. "I will now." When she releases you, her hands stay firmly attached to your arms, and she looks you squarely in the eye. "Don't get into too much trouble, okay?"
                    
                    [pc.dcbc
                        |You scratch your cheek absently. "No promises."
                        |You're the picture of innocence as you answer, "Me? Trouble?"
                        |"Ooh! Is she another one of your sisters here?"
                        
                        Off to the side, Lumia tries and fails to smother a giggle.
                        
                        "I can think of one or two names I might say," the valkyrie says wryly. "But no. I just want you to stay safe, sweetie."
                        
                        "Oh. Okay!"
                        |"I promise, on one condition: I'm the one who gets to pick how much trouble is too much."
                    ]
                    
                    She smiles and shakes her head. "You goof." Her ice-eyes meet yours for a while, and the head-shakes get smaller. Then her eyes drop to your shoulder, and she leans in to brush a few crumbs of almond cake off of you. "Can't have you going out like that..."
                    
                    "Oh, hey. Thanks."
                    
                    With her other hand, she claps you on the shoulder. "Sure. See you around, [pc.name]."
                    
                    Once the two valkyries have left, Lumia lets her face break into a little smile. "And yet, they still won't be the last to arrive. Halima was a little overzealous; they're really not late at all."
                    
                    "So, she's an eager one[pc.isBimbo
                        |! Goootcha gotcha
                    ]."
                    
                    "Halima doesn't like to keep people waiting," the goddess says delicately.
                    
                    [pc.dcb
                        |"Yeah, she's a springbutt," you mumble. "It's whatever."
                        |"I get that." You shrug.
                        |"It's not fun when other people are unhappy," you agree.
                    ]
                    
                    "All in all, little harm done. Besides, maybe it's a good thing. Despite my best efforts, having a goddess involved in a conversation does tend to change it a bit. Perhaps you'll be able to enjoy your talk more when I'm not around."
                    
                    "[pc.isBimbo
                        |It's okay! 
                    ]I didn't mind."
                    
                    When the curvy mother-goddess spreads her hands and smiles, you suddenly understand why so many sculptors have chosen that pose for her. Gentle, welcoming gracefulness comes as naturally to the voluptuous goddess as breathing. "Thank you. And thank you[party.som
                        |
                        | both
                        | all
                    ] for your company, too. [pc.swornGod lumia
                        |Be well, my Champion, and stay safe.
                        |As ever, be at home in our Keep.
                    ]" Then she, too, swishes out the door.
rows.translation:
"[pc.dcb
                        |好的，没问题。
                        |那好吧。
                        |好的，没问题。
                    ]欢迎来到这里，”你友好地张开双臂说道，“希望你们能度过一段愉快的时光。[pc.isDK
                        |无论是什么。
                        |!
                    ]在你的话还没说完之前，安妮卡就已经伸出手来想要拥抱你；不一会儿，她就把你紧紧地搂在了怀里，那是一个充满温暖与力量的拥抱。“现在我就去做。”当她放开你时，她的手仍然紧紧地握着你的手臂，她直视着你的眼睛说：“千万不要惹上太多麻烦，好吗？
                    
                    [pc.dcbc
                        |你心不在焉地挠了挠脸颊上的肌肉。“不敢保证。
                        |你回答的时候，简直就是纯真的化身——“我？会惹麻烦吗？
                        |哦！她是你的姐妹之一吗？”

莉亚玛躲到一边，努力忍住笑意，但还是没能成功。

“我想起来一两个名字可以叫她……”女武神苦笑着说道，“不过算了。我只是希望你能平平安安的，亲爱的。”

“哦，好吧！
                        |我答应你，但有一个条件：必须由我来决定什么程度的麻烦才算过分。
                    ]
                    
                    她微笑着摇了摇头：“你真是个傻瓜。”她的冰冷的目光与你对视了一会儿，随后她的摇头动作也变得轻柔起来。接着，她的目光移向你的肩膀，身体微微前倾，轻轻帮你拂去身上残留的杏仁蛋糕碎屑：“总不能让你这样出门吧……”

“哦，谢谢。”

她用另一只手拍了拍你的肩膀：“不客气。回头见吧。 [pc.name]当那两位女武神离开后，卢米娅的脸上露出了淡淡的微笑。“不过，她们肯定也不会是最后一个到达的人。哈利玛有点过于急切了；其实她们根本不算迟到。”

“看来，她确实是个急切的人啊……[pc.isBimbo
                        |好啦，被抓到啦！
                    ]哈利玛不喜欢让别人等待，”这位女神轻柔地说道。
                    
                    [pc.dcb
                        |是啊，她就是个脾气暴躁的人，”你低声说道，“随便吧。
                        |我明白了。”你耸了耸肩。
                        |当别人不开心的时候，这种游戏体验就变得没有乐趣了，”你这样认为。
                    ]
                    
                    总的来说，并没有造成什么坏处。相反，也许这反而是件好事。尽管我尽了最大努力，但当有位女神参与谈话时，谈话的内容确实会发生变化。也许在我不在场的时候，你们会更容易愉快地交谈。[pc.isBimbo
                        |没关系！ 
                    ]我并不介意。”

当这位曲线优美的女神张开双臂微笑时，你立刻就能理解为什么那么多雕塑家会选择这个姿势来塑造她了。这种温柔而亲切的优雅，对于这位身材丰满的女神来说，就像呼吸一样自然。“谢谢。也谢谢你们。[party.som
                        |
                        | 两者都
                        | 所有
                    ] 也对您的公司有帮助。 [pc.swornGod lumia
                        |保重，我的勇士，一定要注意安全。
                        |像往常一样，在我们的基地里尽情享受吧。
                    ]然后，她也匆匆地走出了门。

rows.original: On approach, Halima sighs with relief and walks over to you. "Hey, [pc.swornGod lumia |sister |Champion ]. How are you?" [pc.dcb |"Eh. I'm around. Whereas you are freaking out. What the fuck's the matter, anyway?" |"You know. Living the dream." You shrug amiably. "Thanks for asking. What about you — what's wrong? Where's Annika?" |"Aww, thanks for asking. I'm feeling happy and huggy as ever! Want a hug, cutie? You look like you could use one." "I — yeah, actually. Thank you." You give her just the kind of hug a friendly valky lady deserves: warm and cozy and full of little squeezles! Then you step back, put your hand on her shoulder, and muster your bestest concerned friendo face. "I hope that helps! What's wrong?" ] "It's Annika. She's, um..." "She's not having a good day." Thrud, the enormous half-jotun warmaiden you met earlier, moves into view. Her slightly slumped shoulders and pensive frown speak volumes about the nature of that not-good-day Annika's having. "I don't know how that meeting you were holding went, but —" Halima puts her hands to her head. "It was fine — I thought it was fine, anyway. Nothing too weird or difficult. We talked about some foundation issues, the rockslide a few weeks back that created a little dead space where there didn't used to be any, talked about where we'd go to get workers to fix it up properly, you know... the kinds of things that are pretty normal for meetings like that. But you could tell she was having more and more trouble controlling her temper. She didn't fly off the handle at any of us, she didn't blame anybody for anything, but still." "And now she's — uh, I guess you can see." Thrud's right. Now, at first glance, the Annika that walks toward you from further down the hall doesn't seem that different from the one who made you sweetcakes and listened to you talk about your life. She still manages a façade of equanimity, still manages a smile at the sisters that pass her. But you can see tension in her steps, even a little bit of a tic in her cheek, and the smile disappears every time the other women around look away. She strides toward you with a purpose, but before she reaches you, she — "Um, Annika? Lady Seneschal? Do you have time for a quick question?" The smile reappears, a little bit forced, and the seneschal turns away from you to the young valkyrie calling to her from across the cavernous chamber. Her "Yes? Turidel, isn't it? What can I help you with?" is correct, proper, not unfriendly, but you can also tell that it's stripped of its usual singsong. Halima turns to you and shudders. "See? I've never seen her this mad before." [pc.dcb |"That's what you call mad?" you snort. "She's a hundred fifty years old! Calm is her normal state of affairs. I've never seen her without a smile — a real smile, a genuine one — outside of battle." |"She... well, she definitely doesn't look as happy as she normally is," you concede. "No, not just that," Thrud insists. "This is about one notch down from white-hot rage, at least for her. Other than Lumia, she's the calmest person I know. This is like seeing my mom [silly |swear at a bad driver |get into a shouting match with a merchant ] or something." |"That does look a li'l bit mad." You chew your lip dubiously. "I mean, not thaaaat mad, but I guess she's normally a pretty calm lady!" "She is, yeah." Thrud's ears twitch down a few inches. "Outside of actual battle, she's that calmest person I know — other than Lumia, anyway." ] For several seconds, you watch the intensity of Annika's coiled-spring frustration as the younger valkyrie yammers on about, well, whatever she's talking about. Though their conversation's too distant to follow, all you really need to do is watch her body language. She's obviously annoyed, annoyed enough to interrupt the younger woman a few times, even if she hasn't actually blown up at her or, apparently, even raised her voice all that much. But whatever's inside is simmering. You should probably figure out what it is... and how to deal with it before something blows the lid off the pot. Hmm. Stress. Good ways to deal with stress. "Have you — or does anybody — really talk to her about this stuff? Does she have a confidant?" Halima purses her lips. "I mean, a little. But it's usually more going the other way. We lay our problems out, and she helps us talk through them. And most of the valkyries who're her age are... gone." "There's always Lumia," Thrud offers. "But I don't know if they've had time, what with all the keep stuff and all." So maybe she just needs to talk about it. Or vent. If lots of stress is building up for whatever reason, she might just have to go out and yell it all out somewhere where people can't hear. In front of the rest of her warrior-sisters, she's got to be nice — hell, maybe whatever's bugging her isn't even their fault. But venting in front of everybody would probably send the wrong message about her leadership, even if it is a good way to temporarily take a load off. Somewhere secluded with close friends would probably be better. Then again, there are other ways to relieve stress... "Does Annika have a special someone?" you ask. "She seems like the romantic type." "Not as far as I'm aware," the human valkyrie says. She purses her lips and brings a few fingers to her chin, looks off to the side for a few moments, then shakes her head. "No, no one. At least, not in a while." Thrud swivels toward you. "Um, why do you ask?" she says querulously. For the moment, you ignore her. If Annika's not with anybody, she's probably not getting laid, and that could be a pretty spectacular way to relieve stress, too. Well, then! How do you want to help her solve this? Talking things out, or making sure the blue-skinned musclemilf relieves her blue balls?
rows.translation: 当哈利玛靠近时，她松了一口气，然后走过来对你说：“嘿， [pc.swornGod lumia |姐姐 |冠军 ]你最近怎么样？ [pc.dcb |呃，我就在这儿啊。而你却慌慌张张的……到底发生了什么事情啊？ |你知道的，追求自己的梦想吧。”你友好地耸了耸肩，“多谢关心。你呢？怎么了？安妮卡去哪儿了？ |哎呀，谢谢你的关心。我现在感觉开心极了，特别想拥抱别人呢！想被拥抱吗，小可爱？你看起来好像很需要一个拥抱哦。” “我……其实，谢谢。” 你给了她一个真正符合一位友善的女武神应该得到的拥抱：温暖而舒适，还带着一些轻柔的捏捏按按！然后你退后一步，把手放在她的肩上，露出最关切、最友好的表情：“希望这能帮到你！到底发生了什么？ ] 是安妮卡。她，嗯……” “她今天过得不太顺。”早些时候你见过的那位巨大的半巨人的女战士瑟拉德出现在视野中。她微微低垂的肩膀以及若有所思的表情，已经充分说明了安妮卡今天遭遇了什么不顺心的事。 我不知道你们那次会议进行得怎么样，但是——” 哈利玛把手放在头上。“会议进行得还不错，至少我是这么认为的。没有什么特别奇怪或困难的事情发生。我们讨论了一些基础性问题，还有几周前发生的山体滑坡，那次滑坡造成了一块原本不存在的空白区域，我们也讨论了该去哪里找工人来把那里修好，你懂的。这些情况在那种会议上其实挺常见的。不过你能看出，她越来越难以控制自己的情绪了。她没有对我们中的任何人发火，也没有指责任何人，但情况确实如此。现在她就是——呃，我想你们应该能看出来。” Thrud说得对。乍一看，从走廊那头朝你走来的这个Annika，确实…… 似乎 那个与曾经为你制作甜点、倾听你倾诉生活的人截然不同。她依然保持着表面的平静，依然会对经过她身边的姐妹们微笑。但你可以从她的步伐中看出紧张，甚至能看到她脸颊上偶尔出现的抽搐；而每当周围的其他女性转开视线时，她的笑容也会立刻消失。 她带着明确的目的朝你走来，但在她走到你面前之前，她—— “嗯，安妮卡？女管家？您有时间回答我一个简单的问题吗？” 她的笑容再次浮现，不过显得有些勉强。然后，这位女管家便转身，朝着洞室另一边呼唤她的那位年轻女武神走去。 她的回答“是的？是Turidel吧？需要我帮忙什么吗？”既正确又得体，并不显得不友好，但也能看出她已经不再使用平时那种带有节奏感的说话方式了。 Halima转向你，颤抖着说道：“看到了吧？我从来…… 看到过 她以前可从来没有这么生气过。 [pc.dcb |这就是你们所说的‘疯狂’吗？”你嗤笑道。 “她已经一百五十岁了！平静才是她的常态。除了在战斗之外，我从未见过她不微笑——那种发自内心的、真诚的微笑。 |她……嗯，她看起来确实没有平时那么开心了，”你承认道。 “不，不仅仅是这个，”Thrud坚持说道。“对她来说，这种情绪已经接近暴怒的程度了。除了Lumia，她是我认识的最冷静的人。现在看到她这个样子，真的就像看到了我的妈妈一样。 [silly |对那些糟糕的司机破口大骂 |与商贩发生激烈的争吵 ] 或者类似的东西。 |那样子确实有点疯狂……”你怀疑地咬着嘴唇说，“我不是说真的疯狂，不过她平时应该是个很冷静的女士吧！” “是啊，她确实很冷静。”Thrud的耳朵微微动了一下，“除了真正的战斗之外，她是我认识的人里最冷静的人了——至少除了Lumia之外吧。 ] 有那么几秒钟，你只能眼睁睁地看着安娜卡那充满压抑与愤怒的表情——那个年轻的女武神还在喋喋不休地说着些什么。虽然她们谈话的内容你听不清，但只要观察她的肢体语言，你就足以明白她此刻的感受了。 她显然很恼火，恼火到甚至几次打断了那位年轻女性的话，尽管她实际上并没有对她发火，甚至也没有提高音量。但不管她心里在想什么，那些情绪肯定在不断积累。你或许应该弄清楚到底是怎么回事。以及如何在事情变得不可控之前找到解决办法。 嗯，压力……应对压力的好方法。“你们有没有人真正和她谈论过这些事情？她有没有可以倾诉的对象？” 哈利玛抿了抿嘴唇：“嗯，也有聊过一些。但通常都是我们向她倾诉自己的问题，她才会帮助我们分析这些问题。而且，和她同龄的那些女武神们……大多都已经不在了。 总是有Lumia这个选择的，”Thrud说道，“不过我不知道他们是否有时间去处理这些事情，毕竟还有那么多其他的事情要忙。” 所以，也许她只需要把心里的话说出来而已。或者发泄一下情绪。如果因为某些原因而积累了太多的压力，她或许需要找一个没人能听到的地方，把一切都大声说出来。在她的那些女战士姐妹面前，她必须保持礼貌——毕竟，也许困扰她的事情根本不是她们的错。但是，发泄情绪总比把它们憋在心里要好得多。 前线 对每个人来说，这种做法可能会给她们的领导能力带来负面的影响，尽管这种暂时性地将压力卸下的方式本身并无不妥。如果能够和亲密的朋友们一起到某个僻静的地方去，或许会更好。 不过，另一方面来说…… 是 其他缓解压力的方法…… “安妮卡有没有特别的对象呢？”你问道，“她看起来像是那种喜欢浪漫的人啊。” “据我所知，并没有。”这位人类女武神说道。她抿了抿嘴唇，用几根手指托着下巴，侧过头想了一会儿，然后摇了摇头。 不，没有人和她在一起。至少，目前还没有。” Thrud转过身来看着你，疑惑地问道：“嗯，你为什么这么问呢？” 你暂时没有回答她。如果Annika没有和任何人在一起，那么她很可能现在没有发生什么亲密关系…… 那个 这也可能是一种非常有效的缓解压力的方式。那么，就这么办吧！ 你想怎么帮助她解决这个问题呢？是和她好好谈谈，还是想办法让那个蓝皮肤的肌肉猛男帮她缓解一下压力呢？

rows.original: [dayNight |Lumia's light still shines |[silly |At this time of night, it's not Lumia's light that shines, but rather Tira's fat ass and pearl necklace — uhhhh, that is, moon and st... let's start again. ]The moon and stars shine ] on the snow-capped Rift peaks and the drifts that coat the other glaciers that surround this part of the frozen north. It's a clear [dayNight |day |evening ], and you can see for miles across the immense crack of the Rift itself all the way to the ice sheet of the north and beyond to the sea; to the south, the tips of the Hornpeaks are barely visible, and the elven fjordland is a [dayNight |light blue |dark ] ribbon snaking its way east toward [var0|Dracia|the sea]. Most of the Winter City itself is concealed by the edge of the table-land cloven in half by the Rift, but beyond the rise you can see [dayNight |the smoke of elven cookfires |the glow of city lamplights ], and past that all the way to the edges of the fjordland, you can make out little villages and homesteads here and there. You wouldn't mind some of those elven fires yourself. It's cold out here. [pc.isMage |At least magic is enough to help out with that for a while, to say nothing of the three radiant valkyries standing around you |[pc.hasFur |At least you've got fur. Plus, t |At least t ]he three valkyries in your company radiate sun-warmth enough to mitigate the chill for a while ]. And the cold is absolutely worth the view. You can see the whole northern Marches as if they were on a map. [silly |But can you see any borders from here? What have borders given us? Wait, shit. This is idyllic. This is not what V2 was for. Abort! Never mind! |Kind of a slightly more dramatic setting than you'd thought you'd have for this conversation, but whatever. ] "So." Annika looks between you and Thrud and Halima. "What can I help you with?" "Other way around," the human valkyrie says. "[pc.dcb |These two think something's up, |Your sisters are a little bit worried about you, |Yeah! ]" you continue, gesturing to Thrud as well.[pc.isBimbo | "We're all kinda worried about you." ] She picks up right where you leave off. "Like... you've only been seneschal for a short time, but already you're looking a little more frustrated." "And we want to help," Halima says, "so... are you feeling okay? Have you noticed anything?" Lumia's seneschal smiles, dips her head slightly, then looks out over the balcony. "I guess. I may have just, you know, bitten off more than I can chew."[silly | As ever with her accent, the 'chew' sounds like 'shoe'. ] You spread your hands. "[pc.dcb |We ain't got all day. |Is it the kind of thing you're okay with talking about? |You wanna talk it out? ]" "Sure." She leans down, rests her forearms on the balcony, and keeps staring at the immense vista. "You know what I keep thinking? I should be out there." "Fighting?" "Fighting. I mean... it's what I do. I go out, I stand between ordinary people and bad people, I beat up the bad people. That's why I'm here. I do something I'm pretty good at and take pride in it. Not doing that, I mean — goddess, I only just started as the seneschal of the Keep and I'm already starting to doubt whether it was the right choice. But for my sisters..." She smiles wanly, flicks a glance over her shoulder at Thrud and Halima. "If this is what best helps them do their work, I guess I should figure out a way to deal with it." "Having a safe place to come back to really does help," Thrud ventures. "And," Halima adds, "having someone here to show the newest sisters the ropes helps a lot, too. I mean, you've been doing that for Lumia knows how long." Annika nods, straightens up, turns around, and leans against the balcony. "Yeah. And I really like it, being there for you all. Helping you figure things out, unlock what's inside you, see the true heroines you can all grow to become. I remember when you were just starting, Thrud, getting overwhelmed at the thought of anchoring a battle line with everyone looking to you for leadership; I remember when you, Halima, first picked up a bow instead of your trusty spear and shield." Again she pauses and dips her head, and when it comes back up again her eyes are a little shimmery — and full of parental pride. "Now look at you both. I couldn't be prouder to have been even a tiny part of your lives and the way you've grown. And it's like that for every one of the maidens here. I love talking with you, hearing your struggles and successes, sharing what I know and seeing how you can make it better." "So what changed?" you ask. "Well," she says ruefully, "mentoring stopped being that thing I did between bits of hero stuff and started being my whole job." "Oh." "When Lumia invested me as the seneschal of this Keep, I told my sisters that I was available if they ever needed help, that I wanted to be there for them, that I was completely ready to help with any aspect of getting the Keep back into shape and organizing logistics. Since then, apart from a brief break with you, I've been doing little else." Annika folds her arms and shakes her head, more doleful than full-on depressed. "Any individual question is fine. I can't get mad at Halima for reminding me that I have to talk about construction projects, or Turidel asking about [silly |whether the curtains should be ruched or not ruched |the specifics of the decor ]. I did tell them — you — that I wanted to help." "[pc.dcb |Sounds like they should be dealing with their own shit. |But doing nothing but that kind of sucks." You pause. "It kind of sounds like there's a lot of stuff that they should be handling on their own, too. |That's nice! But if that's all you do, you don't have time for other stuff!" You pause. "Can they maybe do more of this stuff themselves? ]" "The older sisters do. The younger ones, the ones who don't remember what it was like to live and work in the Keep, whose time in the Order has been mostly an endless series of desperate small-scale battles against Wraith-touched? They're all great warriors, but being under the same roof as all their other sisters and directly under Lumia's eyes makes things a little different." "Maybe more of us older warriors could step up," Halima says hesitantly. "I mean, for me, more than a decade in the Order... I should be taking on the kind of burden that you and Thrud do. You do a lot for the new girls, don't you?" The half-jotun valkyrie manages a wan smile of her own, along with a blush. "I... yeah. I hope it helps you, at least." "[pc.dcb |That's part of it. The other part," you say, "is you learning when to say no |It's not just that, though," you offer. "It sounds like you need to learn when to say no |I think that'll be great!" you chirp. "But, um, also? Maybe you should start sayin' no to people more ]." Annika's brow furrows. "If I'm going to be there for them..." [pc.dcb |"[pc.mf |Lady |Girl ], just take some damn alone time already. Tell 'em to wait a bit if you're doing something else. They're big girls. They can deal. |"You can't be there for them all, all the time. Moms need breaks from their kids too, y'know." You spread your hands. "[silly |You could try limiting them to specific office hours; so long as you keep them, unlike the majority of instructors for undergraduate courses, they should be able to get all the help they need. Otherwise, j |J ]ust tell them to wait for a bit if you need a little sanity time. |"It's okay! You still can! Just, like, not aaaall the time." You accentuate the 'all' with a little rainbow-hands motion. "Even mamas gotta take breaks from their kids sometime, right? ]" She chuckles and brushes a lock of white hair back over her ear. "Ha. Okay, I'll think about it. And if I don't follow through, then it's my own fault." "[pc.dcb |Finally. Good. |Seems fair. |Yay! It'll be great, you'll see! ]" "All right." Halima claps her hands, rubs them together. "All right! Awesome. So. I know it isn't really cold out here for us, but..." "Yes. It wouldn't be very hospitable of us to let [pc.name] freeze to death out here." Annika gestures toward the door. "Let's come in out of the cold. And [pc.name]?" "[pc.isBimbo |Uh-huh |Yeah ]?" "If I'm not having to make decisions about every last minute detail, or give my time to any one of the other sisters here, I'll have more time to chat with you. That, certainly, is not a hardship." "[pc.isBimbo |Aw, thanks! But |Hey, ] you don't have to..." She cuts you off with a broader smile. "I want to. You're a friend. I would enjoy spending more time with you and making you feel welcome. For me, that would be relaxing. Besides..." Her ice-eyes twinkle in the [dayNight |sun |moon ]light. "I'll let you call me Anni." [pc.dcb |"Oh. Okay, then." You grin back. "Ah. Knee. I'll keep that in mind... Anni." |"You make a compelling argument," you chuckle. "All right. Anni. Ah Knee. Okay. Thanks, Anni." |"You will? Yessss!" You lunge at Anni — Ah Knee? Anni! — and gift her your biggest, squeezliest hug yet! "Aww, thanks, Anni!" ] "Good." Her gaze flicks out toward the distant horizon again, then back to you. "I appreciate you giving me the opportunity to unburden myself. If you ever feel the need to do the same, I will always lend a friendly ear. Again, it would not be a hardship, especially now that I think I'm in a better place as regards my friends and my time. And if you ever need to... de-stress in a more active way, I would be very happy to be the kind of friend who would do that with you." Thrud turns from where she is at the door. "Oooh, do you mean exercise? Because I —" "Perhaps." Annika — Anni — grins, then preemptively shushes the oblivious younger valkyrie before she can ask for details. "Now, let's go warm up indoors, shall we?"

Have you noticed anything?" Lumia's seneschal smiles, dips her head slightly, then looks out over the balcony. "I guess. "[pc.dcb |We ain't got all day. |Is it the kind of thing you're okay with talking about? |You wanna talk it out? ]" "Sure." I go out, I stand between ordinary people and bad people, I beat up the bad people. That's why I'm here. I do something I'm pretty good at and take pride in it. Not doing that, I mean — goddess, I only just started as the seneschal of the Keep and I'm already starting to doubt whether it was the right choice. But for my sisters..." She smiles wanly, flicks a glance over her shoulder at Thrud and Halima. "If this is what best helps them do their work, I guess I should figure out a way to deal with it." "Well," she says ruefully, "mentoring stopped being that thing I did between bits of hero stuff and started being my whole job." "Oh." "When Lumia invested me as the seneschal of this Keep, I told my sisters that I was available if they ever needed help, that I wanted to be there for them, that I was completely ready to help with any aspect of getting the Keep back into shape and organizing logistics. rows.original:
[flags.ANNIKA_TALK_PHIL
            |As she takes in your question, Annika cocks her head and grins, and lets a little of her icy white hair drift down over one of her eyes before twirling it around one of her fingers. "What makes war like war, huh? You really like to fish for aphorisms there, [pc.name]. Let's see...
            |"What do I think about war?" Annika asks. "That's... huh. I wasn't expecting [silly
                |some kind of military inquisition
                |a question like that out of you
            ], [pc.name]."
            
            [pc.dcb
                |"I need an edge[pc.swornGod lumia
                    |, especially if the boss-lady's making me her number two
                ]. Gonna give or not?"
                |"That's fair. I just figure there's no better person to give thoughts about how war in general works than you. At least, no one else I've met."[pc.swornGod lumia
                    | You grin. "Besides, if we're doing this godsworn thing together, I could use the crash course."
                ]
                |"Yeah, 'cause normally, being all angry-fighty isn't my thing, right? But I dunno. You're really really good at it, right? Maybe you've got some tips and tricks to help me out!"
            ]
            
            A finger taps thoughtfully against her blue cheek. "I guess so. It's... when you talk about war, it's hard to make things abstract. What you do in battle is concrete and specific. Based on circumstance. But, mmm, I'll try to distill something useful from it."
            
            [silly
                |"Should we be playing the Clausewitz Drinking Game here?"
                
                "First of all," she says severely, "no. You'll die of alcohol poisoning. Secondly, and this time for a different reason: no. This isn't supposed to be mindless, completely-anachronistic Clausewitz. For example, no culminating point and no Schwerpunkt because those aren't ideas that an allegedly Bronze Age but in reality probably somewhat classical warrior should be able to draw on. The things I'm going to talk about here should still more or less make some kind of sense for this relatively ancient context. You know, apart from my refusal to think of warfare solely in terms of stratagems like Polyainos, because the author can't make herself write that.
                
                "But, uh, otherwise... yeah, if you know Uncle Carl, you'll recognize some things."
            ]
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.ANNIKA_TALK_PHIL
            |听到你的问题，安妮卡歪了歪头，露出微笑，她那冰冷的白色头发有一缕垂到了眼睛上，然后她用手指把那缕头发绕了起来。“是什么让战争成为了战争呢？你真的很喜欢用这样的方式来表达哲理啊…… [pc.name]. 好吧，让我们看看……
            |我对战争有什么看法呢？”安妮卡问道，“那个……嗯，我本来没想好该怎么说。 [silly
                |某种军事审判机构
                |你竟然会问出这样的问题来。
            ], [pc.name]."
            
            [pc.dcb
                |我需要优势。[pc.swornGod lumia
                    |尤其是当那位女老板想让我成为她的得力助手的时候……
                ]到底给还是不给呢？
                |这确实很合理。我觉得，没有谁比你更适合来探讨战争的本质和运作方式了。至少，我遇到的其他人都没有这个能力。[pc.swornGod lumia
                    | 你咧嘴笑了：“再说，如果我们要一起做这件麻烦事的话，我确实需要这个快速入门指导。
                ]
                |是啊，因为通常来说，我可不是那种喜欢生气打架的人，对吧？但也不知道……你在这方面真的非常非常在行，对吧？也许你有一些技巧或方法可以帮我吧！
            ]
            
            她若有所思地用手指轻敲着自己的蓝色脸颊，说道：“我想也是吧。因为……当人们谈论战争的时候，很难把那些概念抽象化。在战斗中发生的种种事情都是具体而明确的，它们取决于具体的环境。不过，嗯，我会试着从中提炼出一些有用的东西来。
            
            [silly
                |我们在这里玩克劳塞维茨饮酒游戏合适吗？”

“首先，”她严肃地说，“不行。你会因为酒精中毒而死的。其次，这次还有其他原因：还是不行。这个游戏本来就不应该是一种毫无意义、完全脱离时代背景的克劳塞维茨饮酒游戏。 例如，没有高潮点，也没有所谓的“重点”或“核心要素”，因为这些概念显然不是一个所谓的青铜时代战士——而实际上很可能属于古典时期的战士——应该能够理解或运用的东西。我在这里要讨论的内容，至少应该在某种程度上符合这种相对古老的背景设定。 你知道，我之所以拒绝仅仅从波利阿伊诺斯那样的战略角度来思考战争，是因为那位作者本身就无法写出这样的内容。

“不过，嗯，其他方面的话……是的，如果你认识卡尔叔叔，你就会明白其中的一些含义。"
            ]
        ]

rows.original: "Gods, that's a question," Anni laughs. "I'm not... well, I guess I have been around for a while, especially by most southerners' standards. A century and a half, and much of it very exciting." [pc.isBimbo |"That is a lot of years," you admit, "and I totally wouldn't have guessed! You look so sexy. Could you tell me all the things you do to keep yourself looking so goshdarn good?" Her face creases mirthfully. "Thank you, sweetie. It does take a little work, yes, and maybe we could do that together sometime. Part of it's just me being an elf[pc.ra elf | from the north ], though." "Oh, right! Frost-elfy-elf stuff. Gotcha." You frown. "A hundred years is a suuuper long time. Did things used to be different?" |[annika.kissed |"Still blows my mind when you say you're that old," you admit. "I just can't wrap my head around it, not when you look that good." She spreads her hands and grins. "Things are different for frost elves, but I gather you don't know many my age. Even given that, though, yes, I do have to work on myself a bit. Thank you for noticing. I guess I can still get it, huh?" "Mmm, definitely." It takes a little bit for you to regather your thoughts after that, but then: "So, has a lot changed in the last hundred and fifty years?" |You probe a bit: "A lot's probably changed in a hundred years and more." ] ] "In some ways, yes," she admits, "but in others, not so much. Okay, well. Hm. I grew up within the walls of the Winter City. My mom was an armed retainer for one of the noble families; my dad made sausages. She taught me and my siblings to sing songs of heroic deeds. He took up woodworking at home and enlisted us in helping him build every piece of furniture in the house. We all added decorations and carvings with all the love a family can muster. It was a good way to grow up. We were never as poor as some, but nobody would be writing our line into the history books or anything. I don't have a family name like[party.has etheryn | you, ] [etheryn.crowned |Queen |Lady ] Etheryn; it's just Annika Rótudóttir, not that anybody uses the second half of the name." "Rótudóttir. Rótu." You hazard a guess: "[pc.isBimbo |If you're Rótu's daughter, is Rótu your mama's |That was your mom's ] name?" "[silly |Because of the genitive case, her name was actually ]Róta," she corrects. "And my dad was Pandellin. They both passed away a few decades ago." [pc.dcb |"What about your siblings?" |"I'm sorry. It sounds like they were both good people." There's still a hurt behind the smile she gives you: it's an old one, but one she's at peace with. "Thank you. They were." You give her a [annika.kissed |warm, friendly hug, one that she reciprocates as a very tight squeeze. Only after a long pause and respectful, emotional silence does she release you. And only after that do you find the words to continue. |'there's that, at least' smile and pause respectfully while you collect your thoughts. Only after that pause do you continue: ] "What about your siblings? How are they doing?" |"Awww, I'm sorry. Are you okay?" "It was their time," she says. Her voice is quiet, and her eyes are a little bit sad, but she's got enough of a smile to be reassuring. "I'm never going to stop missing them, but other than that, I am okay. Thank you." It's rare for your big, strong valky [annika.fucked |lover |[annika.kissed |girl ]friend ] to look like she needs a hug instead of wanting to give one, but this is one of those times! So you give her one, a nice big squeezy one where she squeezes you back and you just kinda stand there quietly holding each other and it feels really really nice and you stay there as long as she needs. And it's only when she lets go and manages a smile again that you ask her, "Are your sibbies doing okay too?" ] "They're still around and in good health: an older sister, a younger brother. They're both a bit bigger than I am; being the littlest one in the family was something of a challenge for a while!" She casually flexes one bicep and grins[pc.isDK | |, all evidence of her earlier distress gone. Talking about her living relatives clearly cheers her up a lot ]. "I had to work to keep up with them — eventually, to overtake them. They were good teachers. No real family strife or disagreements... you know, apart from the usual. We all love each other quite a lot. "My parents, bless their souls, did sometimes remind me of how bad it was for them when they were our age. They lived through the Godswar and the worst part of the schism, and they were extremely religious. Every time I was out in the market at my dad's stall, we'd spend slow times talking, and half the time the conversation would circle back around to the queen's new cathedral and once that happened, my siblings and I would get an earful about gratitude and saving the world." You wrinkle your nose. "You make it sound a little bit like a lecture. Those aren't usually very fun." "Not always, no," she agrees. "I did like hearing about heroism; those stories took. Saving lives? Those were the kinds of stories I could get used to. The moral lessons maybe didn't always chime so well. But I understand where it all came from. Back in the Godswar, my parents saw their whole lives — they saw life itself — in the balance, and Lumia protected them. She rescued our people from an extinction so thorough that no one would have known that pale elves had ever existed. My parents were grateful, and they desperately wanted us to feel the same way. And it made an impact on me, certainly, but not to the point that I was thinking of pledging myself to our lady's service even as a young girl." "That makes sense. But I guess it changed?" "Yeah. After I took my vows as a valkyrie, things changed quite a lot. My parents were very proud. So's the rest of my family. I try to visit my siblings, my nieces and nephews, their families, whenever I can and, well, I think they like having their Aunt Anni around."
rows.translation: 天啊，这问题可真有意思，”安妮笑着说，“我嘛……嗯，按照大多数南方人的标准来说，我确实已经活了很长时间了。整整一个半世纪，其中很多时光都充满了激动人心的经历。 [pc.isBimbo |那个…… 是 这么多年了，”你承认道，“我绝对猜不到！你看起来真是太性感了。能告诉我你都是做了些什么才能保持这么好的状态吗？” 她的脸上浮现出愉悦的笑容。“谢谢你，亲爱的。确实需要花一些心思来保养，不过也许我们以后可以一起试试看。其中的一部分秘诀，其实就是因为我是个精灵吧。[pc.ra elf | 从北方而来 ]哦，对了！那些关于霜精灵的事情。明白了。”你皱了皱眉头，“一百年真的是很长的时间啊。那时候的情况会不会有所不同呢？ |[annika.kissed |当你告诉我你已经那么老了的时候，我还是觉得难以置信，”你说道，“真的无法想象，尤其是当你看起来还那么年轻、那么健康的时候。” 她摊开双手，笑了起来：“对于冰霜精灵来说，情况确实有所不同，不过我想你应该不太认识和我同龄的人吧。 即便如此，我确实还需要再努力一些。谢谢你的提醒。我想我还是能够做到的，对吧？” rows.original: "How I got to be in the guard? Or a valkyrie? I'll say both." Annika cracks her knuckles and stretches her neck a few times, only stopping when you hear a satisfying little pop. "There it is. Well, I told you how much bigger my brother and sister are than I am, right?" "You had to keep up, yeah! I remember." "I mean, it's one thing girls like me[party.has etheryn |—" she nods at Etheryn "— like us ] can do. Sometimes being the smallest pushes you further. It's tougher for someone like me to get and keep muscle mass, to be in the kind of shape that comes easy for men and for amazons. Some half-sexed girls, they go the other way with it, develop their curves or stay slim and cute, and that works too, but it wasn't going to be me. And once I was fit and grown up, I couldn't have my mother's place as a retainer, because that was going to go to my older sister. That's just how it works. The royal guard, though... they were taking everybody. And they protected people from all of the enemies in the north." "Even women like you?" "So long as I pulled my weight. It was never easy, [pc.bg soldier |as I'm sure someone like you would know. You bore arms for pay, didn't you? Same kind of thing. |but ] I worked hard enough to stay in and find a place in the ranks. It helped, too, having a mom and sister who could help me out whenever I was floundering. I slowly learned how to soldier: how to [silly |be part of a staunch line of spears |stand in formation with spear and shield ], how to use bow and arrow and magic, how to survive on patrols long and short. And also how to stand at attention and look pretty, because that's important, too." [party.has arona |"Lookin' pretty?" Arona claps appreciatively. "Nice. I mean, who the fuck wouldn't want to show off sweet-ass armor, right?[flags.RAGS_BRONZE | Like, me? I love wearin' [var0 |this |that ] shit Rags made me. Except her competition was just other elves." "At any rate, I enjoyed being in the guard quite a lot." ] ] "[flags.ANNIKA_TALK_WARRIOR |It got you in a place where you could meet the queen, too. |The royal guard — so you knew Ryn's family, too? ]" Annika smiles and nods. "Yes. Queen Atheldred wasn't just a war leader. I mean, she was a war leader; she personally led us out to fight many times, of course. We battled Wraith-touched, kept the peace with the druids, cleared the paths of the Frostwood of driders and the like. Very intense stuff, and she trained us hard to be ready for it all. She was hard but fair, and she knew how to find talent. Which is why it was such a shock — and such a compliment — when she told me that I was wasted in the guard and that I had a higher calling. That, honorable as it was, there were better ways to save lives than royal service." "Wow. [pc.dcb |Guess that was that, then. |It must've been an amazing feeling for you, becoming a valkyrie with the support of the queen herself. |That's so cool! She was there when I took my vows and left the guards forever. But that happened, goddess, two generations ago. The men and women at the palace nowadays? I don't really know them all that well. The people I knew are gone."
