rows.original: "Yes." Anni's response is immediate. "We got lucky. Halima actually just told me that she stumbled on one of their supply caches — a place to store arms and other goodies. It looks like they spent quite some time going back and forth to the rubble you left up north. They went overland, too, for most of that route. Not just difficult, but risky. Whatever they left up there must have been important. "The problem is that the cache was near the water in the fjordland east of here. [var0 |I'm sure you're familiar with it by now. Wherever they were going, it clearly isn't Dracia, not anymore. Back to the Undermountain, maybe, down the underground rivers. There's got to be a hundred little hideouts in those warrens." She sighs. "Tough work to track, but we're up to it. |From there, they could be going to that hideout they seem to have on Dracia or back down into the Undermountain. Those underground rivers are a nightmare to navigate, but they must've left something behind somewhere. We'll narrow it down. |Goddess knows where they went from there. West seems unlikely, because the Ridell brings you close to Hawkethorne, and they won't get too close to you there. East is possible and very unnerving, especially if they get out into the seas. They could travel anywhere from there. My guess, though, is south. Maybe into the rivers that lead underground, into the Undermountain. It sounds like that's where most of the demons are hiding these days. It won't be easy to narrow it down from there, but we'll keep looking for more hideouts. ] It'd be nice if we could capture and question one, but that hasn't worked too well yet. They don't go quietly." [pc.dcbc |You roll your eyes. "Have you tried beating the shit out of them?" "There's no need to be crude; we're finding out what they know as best we can. The point is that so far, at least, nobody's talking. Yet. I'll let you know if that changes, or if we find out in some other way. And actually... could we talk about the things you saw inside the cultists' hideouts up here in the Rift? I have some thoughts." "Kay." You run down some of the details that catch your mind, but it's more perfunctory than anything else. You didn't have time for this details bullshit up there; that whole thing was about knockin' heads[silly | and takin' corners ]. Anni does notice, too. As she writes notes in what looks like her bullshit[pc.ra elf | frost ] elf language, she does gently point out that "all the pieces matter", asking you to go back over things to make sure she doesn't miss anything. But eventually she gets everything she can get from you. [party.has quin |"I've got some tidbits too, if they help." From there, Quintillus picks up the thread, outlining what he knows of the cult's organization thanks to his excellent memory and observant eye. "The fighting style's changed since those assholes started turning into actual demons, but everything else feels the same. We have some lucky breaks, though, because even though they're dangerous, they're not disciplined. No cells. From the Masters on down, it's less about chain of command and more about force of personality..." He sketches out their organization in enough detail to keep Annika smiling and her pen scribbling for several minutes. ] More than a little irritation creeps into your voice when you finally ask her, "Good enough?" "Yes, [annika.kissed |sweetheart |[pc.name] ]. Thank you." |"Still," you say, "that's good work. Now that you mention it, [flags.UM_UNLOCKED |I spend a fair amount of time down in the Undermountain. |I've never been to the Undermountain, but I think that a personal look's long overdue. ] I'll let you know if I see anything. You wouldn't mind keeping me posted about anything that comes up on your end, would you?" "Not at all. And you know what?" She thoughtfully puts her finger to her lips. "I could use a list of the things you saw when you were tangling with the cultists up here. The warship, the supply dump, the actual hideout. Get at as many details as we can to see if anything we find down in the Undermountain matches. All the pieces matter." "[silly |You sure you didn't spend thirteen years and four months riding a desk somewhere? Cause damn. Well, h |That's a pretty good idea. H ]ere's what I can remember." You do your best to run down the list, with Anni's encouragement. Your mind isn't exactly a sieve, but you can't quite grasp every detail anymore. She's still appreciative for what you can give her, though. The valkyrie smiles at you as she scribbles down notes in Alvarin and reads them back to you — in Belharan — to make sure the details are as close to what you remember as possible.[party.has quin | She's even more appreciative when Quin joins you; the additional insight he brings to their organization apparently helps quite a bit. ] Then, when you're done, she [annika.kissed |gives you a hug and a peck on the cheek. "Thank you for your help, sweetie." You grin right back. "For you? Of course." |claps you on the shoulder and grins. "Thank you very much! This will help quite a lot." "Happy to be of service." ] "It's a good starting point for us, which is just what we need." |"Yeah." You chew your lip dubiously. "They're pretty stinky. And, um, nooooot really helpful." "Not at all." Then you remember a thing: "Oooh! [flags.UM_UNLOCKED |I go to the Undermountain sometimes! The place with all the undermoos. Maybe I could look around, too! |I've never, like, been to the Undermoo— I mean, the under... the, uh... that place! Maybe I should. ] If you think it could help, anyway." "It could, sweetie. I'd appreciate that. But you know what would help a lot? Could you tell me about all the things you saw in the cultists' hideouts up here in the Rift? The supply dump, the warship, the caverns, everywhere." "Everywhere?" you say worriedly. "As much about their hideout as you can remember, sweetie. It's okay if you don't remember everything, just whatever you can, no matter how small. All the pieces matter." "O-okay, Anni. If you think it'll help." You do your absolute bestest for her. rows.original:
Fortunately, the valkyries have an open training room in the southern part of the hall, and it's there that Annika leads you to work on your newfound skills. At first, the work goes slowly as she demonstrates things to you and helps you sort through the fundamentals: where to set your hands, the best stance to employ, the calm mindset needed to turn a practice dummy into a wreck. Fundamentals, though, only take so much time. Then[flags.ANNIKA_TRAINING
            |, as usual,
        ] she has you go through velocities, doing the same move again and again and again, each time faster and faster, with a few breaks for water and high-energy snacks as necessary. Annika intersperses these breaks with comments about your technique, suggestions for improvement, and praise for how quickly you pick things up.
        
        Of course, stationary combat has its uses, but per the valkyries' traditional emphasis on agility, Anni soon has you working through physical drills [pc.hasWings
            |that have you make full use of both your legs and your wings
            |that tax your legs to the limit
        ] in preparation for using your newly acquired skills on the go. [var0
            |Unfortunately, given your expectant condition, she insists that outright sparring is off limits and refuses to budge on that rule... [var1|and not even your insistence that you and your baby have magical protection sways her|not that you particularly mind]. But she does gently work you through block and counter, moving as quickly as you can without taxing your body too much. A great deal of sweat and a few sore muscles later, Anni and the valkyries looking on are happy to pronounce you a master.
            |It all culminates after several hours with a series of running[pc.hasWings
                |, soaring
            ] sparring sessions, some of which are joined by [pc.swornGod lumia
                |your other sisters in the Order
                |some of the other valkyries
            ]. Several healthy bruises later, Anni and the other warriors are happy to pronounce you a master — not least because they picked up a few bruises of their own.
        ]
        
        "Much better than I was at your age," she says approvingly. "Maybe even better than I am now. Well done."
        
        "Thanks," you puff, "but I'm still breathing [pc.agilityRange 66
            |a little
            |way
        ] harder than you are. And we both went through all the same [pc.isBimbo
            |trainy stuff!
            |velocities and exercises.
        ]"
        
        [var0
            |Anni raises an eyebrow. "Isn't there something else that might be slowing you down? You have a very good excuse, dear."
            
            "Well... yeah[pc.isBimbo
                |, I guessss
            ]." That's cause enough for you to flash a rueful grimace. "Okay."
            
            "Don't worry, many of my sisters have done the same thing: some healthy exercise to keep off the baby weight or get back into shape once the little ones are born. You're doing great, though, baby or no baby." She gently places a hand on your shoulder[annika.pregStage 1
                | and leans in to smooch your cheek. "Besides, you look great when you're doing this."
                
                "[pc.isBimbo
                    |Oooh! How great is great? 'Cause if you wanna, we could
                    |Oh, do I, now? Does that make you feel
                ]..."
                
                "Down, [pc.boyGirl]," Anni laughs. "At least give us both a little time to rest first.
                |. "Well done.
            ] Go ahead and get cleaned off — and get a little of the soreness out."
            |Anni laughs. "That's just age; an older warrior knows how to conserve energy, and you're still young yet. You'll get the hang of it eventually. Go ahead and get cleaned off... and again, well done."
        ]

rows.original: "Ah, no. Lumia's godsworn... you could say that we can control that sort of thing pretty well. I'm very safe." Annika gives you a reassuring smile. "You don't have to worry about any, mmm, happy little accidents[var0 |... or at least, you wouldn't if you weren't already expecting! Congratulations, by the way ]." [var0 |"[pc.isDK |Thanks for noticing. And also, well, thanks. |Aw, thanks! ]" The valkyrie's smile turns into an outright grin. "Feeling okay?" "I'm holding up." You rub your tummy and chat for a little bit about the good and the bad before circling[silly |, pun absolutely intended, ] back around: "Anyway, I'm surprised Lumia's okay with you keeping that under control. You've been a valkyrie for so long, and you don't have any children, right? Wouldn't she want you to have as many kids as possible?" |"Thanks for that. [pc.isInfertile |I'm pretty safe, too, but it never hurts to ask. |I haven't been quite that safe myself[pc.isDK | |, and I appreciate you going the extra mile ]. ]" Then a thought comes in your head: "You know, I'm surprised Lumia's okay with you not being a mom." ] "Our goddess isn't the [silly |foxen Lord of Mischief; she's not going to force or trick me and my sisters into having children |kind of person who makes someone have a baby, even if that someone really doesn't want to, just because 'Lumia likes babies' ]. Motherhood as part of a plan is lovely; motherhood as an accident is, well... she's still there for you and the baby if you need her help, of course, but she's not about to cause the accident in the first place. She doesn't want you to just have babies; she wants you to make sure that you're safe and happy and that the babies are safe and happy, too. Breeding's only one side of the coin. Raising your family is the other. And if you're not ready, that's not safe for you or your family." [silly |Idly, you note that the Swedish-inflected way she pronounces 'children' is the exact same as the way Shyldren's name, from the dream, was pronounced. Hah. ][pc.hasKids |"She's definitely got that right." |"[pc.isBimbo |Oooh, I bet |I can only imagine ]." ] She nods. "I'm sure I could have helped some devout couple or other start their own family. [pc.swornGod lumia |Many of our sisters |There are many sisters in the Order who ] act as surrogates, and some[pc.swornGod lumia | | who ] choose to be donors, too. Not me, though. I don't think I could know that I have a child with someone out there and not want to be there for both the baby and the other parent — or both other parents. So it hasn't happened. Yet. Lumia understands." "Mmm," you say. "Well, that's good." "I think so! With that said, she still sometimes acts like a 'mother who wants to be a grandmother' to those valkyries who haven't had children yet. She doesn't bother me about it all that much, but it's pretty easy to tell that she wants to see me start a family." "[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. But a frost elven family, even just one child, is a big commitment. I wouldn't want to make anybody go through that unless they really, really wanted to. Unless they... um." "[pc.isBimbo |Sweetie |Hmm ]?" You cock your head. "You kind of trailed off there." Anni's smile turns a little wan. "Don't worry about it."

You sidle a little closer to Annika. "[pc.isBimbo
        |I see somebody who needs a huuu-uuuug...
        |You look like you could use a hug.
    ]"
    
    [annika.kissed
        |"So do you, sweetie," she says brightly, opening her arms without hesitation. "Come here."
        
        The pair of you enfold each other in a wonderfully warm embrace. Annika's strong arms feel reassuring and confident around you, and her wings join the embrace too, suffusing the both of you in a golden glow. As for you — [pc.hasWings
            |her wings block yours from joining the hug, but otherwise you do exactly what she does, offering
            |you offer
        ] a squeeze of your own, one that you hope shows just how much you care for the Lumian war-elf. Forehead to forehead, then cheek to cheek, you rest your bodies against each other and hold each other close.
        
        "Mmm." Lumia's seneschal gently nuzzles against you. "[var0|I love you, sweetheart.|This is nice.]"
        
        In return, you smooch her right on the cheek — a cheek that, despite her frost-elven heritage, feels more than a little warm right now. "[var0|I love you, too.|Yeah.]"
        
        For a moment — a long, glorious moment — the rest of the hall disappears and all there is is the sensation of what it is to hold and be held.
        
        When the moment passes, Annika's arms and wings pull back, and she plants a kiss on your lips, right where it belongs. "There we go. I feel much better." She brings her hand to your cheek, only close enough to barely brush it with her fingertips. "So much that I don't really want to stop..."
        
        "[pc.isBimbo
            |That's okay!" you giggle. "I won't make you wait long for the next one.
            |I guess we should do it again very soon, hmm?"
        ]
        |"Hmm? Oh!" She grins. "Sure, I'll take a hug — but only if I can give one back!"
        
        The valkyrie's powerful arms wrap around you, warm, welcome, and inviting. She gives you a friendly shoulder-rub as she holds you, and you really feel it, as powerfully as you would from any other motherly woman: the reassurance that everything will be all right. You're glad to have this elf as [pc.swornGod lumia
            |your sworn sister
            |a friend
        ], and you put every ounce of that happiness into your own hug.
        
        [pc.swornGod lumia
            |"Remember," she whispers, "your sisters and I will always be there for you. You have Lumia's light and you have a wonderful heart. There's no heroic task that you can't do if you set your mind to it."
        ]
        
        Eventually, Annika gives you one last pat on the back, and then you pull apart. "Feel better, [pc.name]? I know I do."
        
        "[pc.isBimbo
            |Yeah! I really liked it!
            |Yeah. That was good.
        ]" You smile right back at her, recharged by Lumia's love — as transmitted through a very friendly elf. "Thanks[pc.isBimbo
            | so much
        ], Anni[pc.isBimbo
            |!
            |.
        ]"
        
        "Anytime."
    ]

Annika beams at you. "That sounds lovely. I know just the place!"
        
        The seneschal's hand [annika.kissed
            |holds yours
            |rests casually on your shoulder
        ] as she ushers you down the hall away from her desk. You pass pairs and knots of other valkyries, talking amongst themselves; you pass doorways and murals and altars. The whole hall feels calm, cozy, relaxed... and you haven't even sat down yet.
        
        Just taking the Keep in, without thinking about going somewhere or doing something in particular, settles your mood a lot. You and Anni quietly take in the murals and mosaics on the walls as you walk, and you marvel at the artists' work. There are serried ranks of warriors, their blades glittering gold; there are heroic last stands amid fire and smoke; there are apocalyptic battles of light and dark. But there are also calm, peaceful scenes of families eating, playing, laughing together; there are scenes depicting endless amber waves of grain in the breeze. Even in this Keep, full of her divinely empowered warriors, Lumia and her followers are not shown just as [silly
            |sisters of battle
            |makers of war
        ].
        
        The Keep isn't just ringed by art and braziers and candles, though. There are places to sit and relax, and it's to one of these that Annika directs you. On the cushion here, you can rest comfortably arm-in-arm and just people-watch.
        
        You see elven maidens moving with purpose, but not rushing, in from the cold, decked out in their full war panoply, bearing a few dents and dings on their armor and the smiles of victory on their faces. Further down, a few human and taeleer women kneel at an altar praying while a minotaur — for whom kneeling is difficult at the best of times — stands and murmurs the same prayer. You see faces you recognize from your time thus far at the Keep, and others you don't; you see comradely good friendship and good-natured laughing.
        
        And you see it all with your eyes only half-open, because you're relaxing in Anni's strong arms, basking in the feeling of the fires' warmth and her cool touch.

            |!
            |.
        ]" You lean a little further into her shoulder and smile.
        
        "Mhm," she hums happily. "I don't suppose a few pats on the head would make it nicer."
        
        "[pc.isDK
            |Don't threaten me with a good time
            |They wooooould
        ]..."
        
        "[pc.isDK

            |Goooood," she croons
        ]. And just like that, she gives you those very pats. Her cool hand pulls your head even closer to her body, then gently rubs your scalp. [pc.hasHair

            |Soon it becomes a massage that relaxes the top of your bare head and makes
        ] your eyelids flutter with happiness; [pc.tailTag long

            |you even start wiggling your [pc.butt] from side to side
        ]. [pc.hasEmoteEars

            |She holds you close as she rubs, humming in a calm, motherly way, as if she were helping [annika.numKids 1 2
                |your baby
                |one of your babies
                |a baby
            ] go back to sleep — and it works on you just as well as it would work on an infant, wiping away all the cares of the world and helping you close your eyes.
        ]
        
        [annika.pregStage 1
            |Even as she rubs, your lover nuzzles up against your body. Her voice is quiet, as soothing as the way she caresses your head. "Don't fall asleep all the way, angel."
            
            "Why not?" you murmur sleepily. Then: "Oh. Wait. [pc.mascFem

            ]. I [pc.isBimbo
                |think
                |have a feeling
            ] I know what you wa[pc.isBimbo
                |aa-aa
            ]nt."
            
            "Only if you say yes."
            
            [annika.pregStage 2 3
                |"[pc.isDK
                    |Okay, fine
                    |Yes
                ]." [pc.isDK
                    |Despite everything, a
                    |A
                ] smile slowly spreads across your face. "You can touch my tummy instead."
                |"You know I wouldn't say no to you, though." Your body shakes with a little silent giggle. "Especially not when I'm so big and full of baby... I need all the touch I can get."
                |"Mmm. You know, I don't have that much of a tummy yet." With your eyes still closed, you grin. "But you can still give it a rub anyway."
            ]
            
            Happily, Annika brushes your forehead with her lips. Then she moves her hand down to your tummy and starts to rub. Her gentle, circular motions [annika.pregStage 2
                |soon attract little shifts and movements from inside you as your [var0|babies wake|baby wakes] to the touch, and the two of those things together feel so lovely that it brings tears to your still-closed eyes
                |help alleviate the early-pregnancy discomfort in you, set your tummy at ease. Then you hold her hand in yours and rub alongside her, fully at peace with yourself, your lover, and your bab[var0|ies|y]-to-be
            ].
            |There you rest, insensate to the rest of the world, just cuddled together with the seneschal of Lumia's Keep. She rubs idly, calmly, making sure to hold you close, and between her and the comfy warmth of the great hall you almost feel as if you could slip into a genuine sleep... but you don't. You float in that ethereal, restful space between slumber and wakefulness, and bask in the attention of the Dawn Maiden's chosen.

rows.translation: 我死了。[pc.isBimbo |iii ]你……”你轻声说道。你的手伸向她的头部，绕到她的耳后，手指轻轻穿梭进她那美丽的白色头发中。从她眼中的神情来看，这位强大的女武神自你们相识以来，第一次陷入了无言以对的状态。[pc.isBimbo |我可以向您表示感谢吗？ |我想为此感谢你。 ]" [annika.kissed |安妮和其他任何事情一样，也非常清楚那意味着什么。你只来得及看到她那愉悦的笑容，随后她就凑得如此之近，以至于你只能看到她的双眼……然后，你们的嘴唇相触，那一刻，你便明白了…… 感受 而是露出了微笑。 过了漫长的时间，当这一切结束时，她将额头轻轻贴在你的额头上，深情地凝视着你的眼睛：“我应该可以习惯这样的感觉的。 [pc.isBimbo |你能习惯这个吗？”说着，你把手指伸出来，轻轻碰了碰她的鼻子。“碰！” 她的眼睛惊讶地睁大了，但并没有表现出震惊或恼怒。“哦哦。” “嘿嘿，你的鼻子就是这么容易被碰的哦！” 然后，她也做了同样的事情…… 你的 鼻子，还会让你笑得前仰后合。“啵！你也是。继续这样做吧……把这两件事都坚持下去。 |你最好这么做，”你低声说道，“之后你还会在很多地方遇到更多这样的情况。 [pc.hasLipstick |天哪，看来我用的这种口红，每次涂抹后都会留下很多痕迹…… |在嘴唇上，在脸颊上，在你的脖子上……也许还有一些现在不太容易看到的地方…… ]我喜欢这个说法。”上帝说道。[pc.swornGod lumia |欲望]她的声音轻快而富有韵律，真是太动听了。“你最好赶紧把接下来要做的事情都完成，这样我就能早点得到那些吻了。” 你眨了眨眼：“别着急……不过我会看看能做些什么的。 ] |安妮沉默了一两秒钟，才终于找回了自己的声音：“哦，天哪。你是不是有什么想法？[pc.isBimbo |嗯。 |是的。 ]你倾身靠近，眼睛微微睁开，刚好看到她也在倾身过来，然后你在她的嘴唇上轻轻一吻。她也回吻了你，热情地回应着你，两人紧紧相拥，沉浸在这个吻中，仿佛时间在这一刻静止了，直到最后她才松开你的手。[silly |啊哈 |哎呀，哎呀。 ]当她的冰冷的双眼再次睁开时，其中闪烁着一丝光芒。[var0 |我原以为你还没有准备好面对一些更严肃的事情。现在情况有变化吗？ |那个 是 亲爱的，这真是太贴心、太感谢了。我想你应该不会愿意再给我一些这样的东西吧？还是说那只是偶尔一次而已？我必须承认，这样的举动真的让我感到非常温暖。 ] 让我想要……[var0 |是啊。”你露出灿烂的笑容，“我正好也在想这个呢。[pc.isBimbo | 不断地思考着、思考着…… ] 就这么定了[pc.isBimbo |这对我来说真的很难。 ] 然后我突然意识到，其实…… 做 想要某样东西，我是说…… 是 好了，就这样。 |[pc.isBimbo |我并不希望它只是这样而已。 |这绝对不仅仅只是…… ] 只是一次性的安排而已，”你说道。 [pc.isBimbo |轻笑 |轻声笑起来 ]我知道，对你来说，拥有真实的东西是多么重要…… ] 妈的！” 她突然抓住你的手臂，打断了你的话。 你的 她的吻如此热烈、如此深沉，让你完全失去了控制，只能任由自己沉溺其中。你的嘴唇仿佛失去了重量，就像在她怀里时一样。当这个吻结束时，她把额头贴在你的额头上，微笑着看着你。 你也勉强挤出了一个微笑，回应她。[pc.isBimbo |哦哦哦，我觉得我爱上别人了。 |绝对不是一次性的事情。 ]" "[pc.isBimbo |我也一样。 |不错 ]她帮你从座位上站了起来。‘我知道你现在有事情要忙，亲爱的，但是……下次我们见面时，我真的很希望…… 慷慨大方 再稍微多一点注意力吧，嗯。” 嗯，这样会让你的步伐变得轻快一些。至少在那之前是这样。 ]

rows.original: You enter the seneschal's chambers right on Annika's heels, but out of force of habit you turn to close the door behind you. By the time you've turned around again, Annika's got the once-empty fireplace to the side crackling cheerily with warm magical flame. [pc.isMage |Truth be told, it's one of your own favorite spells, too... but there's something alluring about how effortlessly the older woman wields this particular bit of magic. |Whether an extension of Lumia's motherly ability to make everything more cozy or inviting or simply the power of the sun, the casual magic use makes you smile. ] Besides, it sets the scene wonderfully; a fire in the fireplace makes everything feel better. With her wings still glowing, diffracting the firelight onto the walls, Anni turns to you and beckons you over to the furs and pillows in front of the fireplace. When you follow, she quickly draws you into a lovely hug. "Here we go," she murmurs happily. "[var0 |Is this a good temperature for you? I know that things are pretty warm when you're expecting." You wince at the thought of it; things have gotten pretty warm sometimes, but... "[pc.dcb |I'm fine. Don't turn it up any more and I'll stay that way." |It's sweet of you to ask. It is a little bit warm, but the fire doesn't hurt. It's kind of a happy warmth, not oppressive." |That's so sweet! Thank you. I mean, like it's a teensy bit warm, for sure, but it's not bad! I don't feel uncomfy yet." ] "I bet it'll help to have some cool elfskin right next to you, too." "Oooh." That's a moan you don't even bother to try suppressing. "It wooould." T |Nice and warm. I know it's a cold day out there for a southerner like you..." It really is. But t ]hough the wind does blow and the snow does come down in sheets outside, the icy weather you can see through her window doesn't intrude into the seneschal's cozy chambers. Instead, the two of you rest on the furs in front of the fireplace. Annika holds you close, not just with her strong right arm but with her wing: golden, glowing, and just as warm. As ever with your welcoming sun-warrior lover, you let your head drift down onto her shoulder. And your own arm stretches out for her other shoulder, too. [pc.swornGod keros lumia |Then, idly, a few of your tails swish over to rub against her butt, because you wouldn't be the Champion of Keros if you didn't stir things up a little. "Mmm." Anni squeezes you a little tighter. "Doing something cheeky with your fluff, hmm?" "[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. Just bein' teasy and tricksy," you murmur. A little eyelash-fluttering wouldn't go amiss either! "Does it make you wanna do something?" "I do want to pet your tails now." Oooh, just what you wanted her to want! "Maybe you should try catching them!" Her hand slides off your shoulder and up, toward the top of your head and your delicate, sensitive ears. "I don't know if I'd ever catch them, though. You're much too clever and agile a [pc.mf |fox |vixen ] for an old woman like me. What if..." She pauses, making a show of mulling it over. "What if I gave you a pat with one hand, and rubbed your tails with the other?" H-Headpats? That's even better! "Oooh! Oooh! Yes please!" And just like that, the game ends, and your fluffy, cuddleable tails end up right in the valkyrie's lap. |I might be." Another flick of your tails, a smug little grin: "Or I might not." "I think it's more than 'might'," she hums. "I think you're trying to tease me into wanting to pet them." "Tch. Such an accusation. I'm wounded that you feel the need to say such things of me." "Oh, that's a shame. Nevertheless, I do want to pet your tails now. I bet they'd feel wonderfully fluffy." Your smug little grin gets a teensy bit bigger. "Why not just reach out and touch them? They're right there..." Her hand slides off your shoulder and up, toward the top of your head and your delicate, sensitive ears. "Oh now, that's never a good idea, letting a clever kitsune lead you by the nose... or any other organ. I can only imagine how badly I'd get teased if I tried to do that, especially an old lady like me who's not as agile as a clever [pc.mf |fox |vixen ] like you. What if I did something else instead? Perhaps I could offer a trade. As I understand it, my [pc.name] likes pets..." Uh-oh. "What — this is — you can't —" And then her fingers reach the tippy-top of your head, and she starts to slowly pet and rub you and tease your twitchy ears and all you can say is: "Aaaaaaaahhhh..." At which point, regardless of your own volition, your tails slowly come to rest in Anni's lap. "It's... mmm... it's a w-worthy trade..." you moan. Before long, you find yourself doing just that by snaking your [pc.tail] around Anni's hip and onto her lap. "Oooh." Her hand hovers just over it without actually quite touching it. "What a lovely gift you've brought me." You nuzzle in a little deeper. "You can pet it if you want." "I do want. Thank you, [annika.fucked |darling |sweetie ]." First one rub, then another, then another, until rubs transition straight into more rubs and a soft, happy noise starts to thrum in the back of your elven lover's throat. She hums and hums happily as she touches your tail, fingers gently dancing along the length of it. You'd be lying if you said that basking there in her adoration didn't feel amazing to you, too. The warmth of the fire, the touch of her fingers... mnf. You could stay like this forever. |"Mmm. Just look at these wings of yours." Annika shifts her hand to one of them and uses her knuckles to gently brush down its length. "Feels good for them to get a little attention too, doesn't it?" Softly, you say, "Mhmmm..." "Let me preen them for you. I have some experience handling wings, after all..." Your fireside cuddle gets just that much more comfortable as Anni positions herself behind you to brush and stroke your [pc.wings]. They get so little attention that even a little bit of touch would be lovely, but she does more than that; her fingers glide over them with skill born of experience. As she has her gentle way with them, you resist the powerful urge to turn around, instead gazing at the firelight and letting your satisfied smile slowly get wider and wider. "This is the best place for it." "So eager! Then I suppose I should ask if you want to rub my ears, too." "I doooo..." |"Oooh! Is it ear rubs? Yes please!" "So eager! Then I suppose I should ask if you want to rub my ears, too." "I doooo..." ] [pc.ra elf |If there's anybody better than your[pc.ora wyldelf | | adopted ] people at giving ear-rubs, you've never met them. |Nobody gives better ear-rubs than elves do. ] Annika's particularly dextrous, which you should probably have expected, given her decades of practice; all she needs to turn you into a delighted puddle is her thumb and forefinger and little else. Gradually, as she rubs all the tension out of your delicate ears, you sink down against her side. Tension bleeds out of the rest of your body, too, bit by bit. And next to you, the rubs you give Anni do something of the same to her. You, the fire, and a mighty elven girlfriend to cuddle. Because when those things are all together, time has little meaning at all, and it stretches out into infinity. ] ] ] Muscle, sinew, curves, and coolness combine to wake you from your reverie as she sensuously moves against you. "This is nice," Anni sighs. "You're a lovely person to hold." Mmm. She is too. But you know, you could go for more than just holding each other. '

rows.original: "I like it like this," you murmur. "[pc.isBimbo |It's all warm, you're all pretty |I have a nice warm fire, a beautiful lover ]... sometimes a [pc.mf |guy |girl ] just wants to feel cozy, you know?" "Good choice." Annika plants a little smooch on your forehead. You return the kiss, then nuzzle in a little closer after that, humming happily at the feel of your frost elven lover's gentle chill lingering on your lips. Then you hum with even greater delight, because she chooses that moment to once again reach up for one of your [pc.ears] and give it a stroke. [pc.hasEmoteEars |"AaaaAAAAaaa..." She doesn't stop stroking, but you do hear a certain satisfaction in her voice. "Somebody really likes [pc.hisHer] ear-rubbies." "[pc.dcb |It's a good thing we're not in public; I can't let anyone know that. I am going to get you back for that, though. |Mmmmmmmm. You're always so good at them that I've been starting to look forward to you doing the rubbies. [pc.ra elf |I'm not the only elf in this room who does, though. |But you know, I hear elves like them too. ] |You know I do! Goooo-osh. They make me wanna give you some more ear-rubs tooooo. ]" |"Ooooooh." "This feels good, right?" she asks softly. "Even if they don't flutter like mine?" "They do... and [pc.dcb |I guess I owe you now, huh? |thanks for reminding me. |now I get to give you some of yours! ]" ] Your own fingers seek out one of her long, delicate ears and now it's your turn to make her coo. At first, her ear twitches with tension and then, as you keep rubbing, slowly sags down toward her shoulder. And even though you're not touching it, her other ear does something similar. "Ohhhh, that's heavenly," she hums. "That's what I want." [annika.pregStage 1 |"Good," you murmur. "[pc.isBimbo |Can I ask you to do a thing for me, though? |I do have one request, though. ]" Your lover's fingers pause and sink to your shoulder. "Oh? What's that?" "[pc.isBimbo |I... awww, everything's getting warm again, especially my tummy, and I thought that maybe the sexy lady who's having [var0|these babies|this baby] with me who's got these nice chilly hands would help me take care of that!" "I guess you're lucky that we're starting a family together, hmm?" You give her the most adoring, heartfelt look that you have in you. "I... I am, Anni. I'm so super incredibly lucky that I have you. I love you so much!" "Okay, first of all: I love you, too. Second: I meant that you were lucky that I have chilly hands, but I like the way you think better." She holds up her hands. "You still get my hands, though." |There's this one part of my body that just feels so warm. It's like I've got a furnace running inside me. A lovely cool frost elf hand giving it some rubs would go a long way to making me feel more comfortable." "Is that right." It's not a question. "You'll have to tell me where that place is. Otherwise I might put my hand on, say, your forehead..." "My belly, you goof," you giggle. "I want a tummy rub." "Ohhh. Silly me." ] And then, of course, she does start to rub your belly, and of course it feels as lovely as you expected it to: a gentle cool to alleviate the heat of all that blood rushing through your veins.[annika.pregStage 2 | Not only that, but now that your tummy's getting touched, your [var0|babies-to-be are|baby-to-be is] moving around a little in there... not so much as to be uncomfortable, fortunately, and you love the way it feels. ] Mmm, you don't mind being pregnant if you can get attention like this... |"Mmm. [pc.dcb |I guess I have to |You can have them |All the rubbies you want ], then[pc.isBimbo |! |. ]" Of course, the two of you don't just rub each others' ears, lovely and relaxing as that is. Sometimes you just rest there, arm in arm, and listen to the gentle crackle of the fire. Once, Annika even gets up — albeit briefly — to find the pair of you some tasty warm drinks. And, of course, sometimes you exchange kisses, too, because what's the point of being cuddled by an elf by the fire if you don't get and give smooches, too? ] Some time later, much later, the fire burns down toward its embers, and the pair of you reluctantly return to your responsibilities. But you feel refreshed and much happier to have shared some time with your winged lover — just the pair of you.

rows.original: You turn to her sleepily. "Mmm. I kinda just want to relax. And those thighs look awfully tempting..." "The reason I work so hard for them," Anni murmurs, "is so they can be pillows for special cuties. And, you know, being in shape, having muscles for battle, all that, but those are just side effects." She pats the fabric lying atop her legs. "Whenever you're ready." No time like the present. Moving slowly — between them, the fire and the coziness and Anni herself have you feeling downright soporific — you nuzzle in, finding just the perfect spot for you to lay your head. Even through your tired mind, a few thoughts do penetrate as you lay down on her. First: god[pc.swornGod lumia |des ]s, she's powerful. Never gets old. Second: you're awfully close to a very hefty serving of elf meat. She's soft right now, but you could very easily... no. Down, [pc.boyGirl]. It's time to relax[silly |, not be a gremlin ]. "There we go." A few fingers find their way [pc.hasLongHair |between locks of your hair and gently sift through, strand by strand, before transitioning into a lovely, soothing pet |onto your scalp, where they rub a slow, gentle pattern that does so much to relax you ]. "It's nice, you know, having you around here when you can spare the time. I know it's silly because it's you, but I do worry about you when you're not here.[annika.pregStage 1 | [var0|All three|Both] of you. ]" Your reply comes out slowly; [pc.ra mothfolk |you're sleepy and also the fire is just sooooooo pretty |there's no more perfect position to make you drowsy than this ]. "There's nothing to worry about here, though." "No." Her finger gently caresses your cheek. "Or at least, there shouldn't be. I... I know things can be troubling, out there. I know that you lead a stressful life. If you feel comfortable with it, I would be happy to ease those burdens. Is something the matter?" [pc.dcb |That's a hard thing to admit to. For a few moments, sick black indignation at the mere thought of some kind of stupid weakness bubbles to the surface. How dare. How fucking da... But then, right before you open your mouth, she guilelessly strokes your head again, and some of that anger slowly drains away. Maybe it wasn't ever really part of you at all. "I... okay." You swallow. "Just between us." "Just between us," she promises.[flags.ANNIKA_LAP_PILLOW| "Like always."] |"Yes." The admission isn't easy[flags.ANNIKA_LAP_PILLOW|, even though you've made it before with her]. But it's simple, and Anni's so attentive and friendly, and you just can't help yourself... and once you've said it, the rest of the words get easier. "Yeah. I... I could use a chat." She kisses her fingers, then gently presses them against your cheek. "That's what I'm here for. Whenever you're ready." |Well, you're so smooth that those kinds of things aren't usually problems for you! But... well... there is one thing. "Okay! I can talk for a bit!" "Thank you, darling," she murmurs. Once again, her fingers lightly brush your cheek, and all the love in that single gesture makes you feel so calm and happy and peaceful and and and just and — ] And so you do talk to her. For the most part, she simply lets you talk, and only on those rare occasions when you don't quite know what to do or to say does she offer her own words. Without judgment, without concern, she helps you let a worry out into the world and watch it float away up the chimney[silly | — yes, they have chimneys in this era, shut up — ] with the smoke and sparks. When you're done, everything feels just that little bit lighter. But though the talking slowly peters out, the care and attention she gives you does not. She's so gentle with you, so reassuring, but there's also that raw muscular power behind it all. You can feel it coursing through every part of her, especially in her thighs — powerful, watermelon-annihilating thighs. Yet with you, here, now, that power isn't being put to use. Anni's so damn strong and sets it all aside to be sweet with you. Just feeling that it's there, though, puts a tired little smile on your face. [pc.strengthRange 66 |And, since even strong [pc.mf | |wo ]men like you need a break every once in a while, w |W ]ho better to make sure you feel safe than a strapping Lumian warlady? So, completely worry-free, at least for a while, you rest on Annika's thighs and accept the headpats and cheek-caresses[pc.hasEmoteEars | and ear-rubs ] that she tenderly bestows.[annika.pregStage 1 | For your part, your hand migrates to your belly, as it so often does, and rubs its own aimless pattern over your bab[var0|ies|y]-to-be. ] But beyond that, both you and your lover simply rest there in quiet too profound for words, broken only by Anni occasionally humming a sweet elven melody, or you nuzzling in just that little bit more. There is nothing else in the world but you, and her, and the firelight you share together.
rows.translation: 你昏昏沉沉地转向她：“嗯，我其实只是想放松一下而已。而且她的大腿看起来真的太诱人了……” “我之所以这么努力锻炼，”安妮轻声说道，“就是为了让它们能成为那些特别可爱的人的‘靠垫’。当然，保持好身材、拥有适合战斗的肌肉，这些也是锻炼带来的好处，但那些其实都只是副产品罢了。她轻轻抚摸着搭在腿上的布料，说道：“等你准备好的时候就可以。” 此刻正是最好的时机。在他们的陪伴下，再加上篝火带来的温暖与安妮本身的亲切感，让你感到无比舒适，甚至有一种想要昏昏欲睡的冲动——你慢慢靠近，最终找到了一个最舒服的位置，把头靠了上去。 即使你的思绪已经变得混乱，当你躺在她身边时，还是有那么一些想法悄然浮现。首先： 上帝[pc.swornGod lumia |欲望]s她非常强大，而且永远不会过时。其次：你离吃到一大份精灵肉只有一步之遥了。她现在看起来很柔软，但你完全有可能……不，趴下。 [pc.boyGirl]是时候放松一下了。[silly |别惹麻烦。 ]好了，就这样。”几根手指熟练地完成了动作。 [pc.hasLongHair |从你的一缕缕头发中轻轻挑选出来，一根一根地仔细筛选，最终变成一只可爱又令人感到舒缓的宠物。 "There's nothing to worry about here, though." "No." Her finger gently caresses your cheek. "Or at least, there shouldn't be. I... I know things can be troubling, out there. I know that you lead a stressful life. If you feel comfortable with it, I would be happy to ease those burdens. Is something the matter?" [pc.dcb |That's a hard thing to admit to. For a few moments, sick black indignation at the mere thought of some kind of stupid weakness bubbles to the surface. How dare. How fucking da... But then, right before you open your mouth, she guilelessly strokes your head again, and some of that anger slowly drains away. Maybe it wasn't ever really part of you at all. "I... okay." rows.original:
[flags.ANNIKA_MASSAGE
            |More than just holding her... "Hey, Anni? Do you want another massage?"
            
            She plants a quick kiss on your cheek before answering, and the feel of her lips tells you everything you need to know. "Of course."
            |"Hey, Anni?"
            
            She slowly turns to look at you with an attentive, affectionate smile and blue eyes full of reflected firelight that make them look like the warmest and most romantic things in the world.
            
            [pc.dcb
                |"You know," you say quietly, "even I can feel how tense your back is."
                |"One of the things about hugging you," you murmur, smiling right back, "is that I can feel when you need a backrub."
                |In one of your most seriousest of voices, you tell her, "You feel a li'l bit tense. Can I give you a backrub?"
            ]
            
            "I..." For the briefest of moments, one of the corners of her smile twitches up even higher. "I would be delighted to accept, darling."
        ]
        
        Her golden wings vanish, and she half-turns back away from you. In the outfit she's wearing now, you're acutely aware that the only thing covering her back at all is the back of her top, and that's little more than a brassiere; you can see her well-defined shoulder blades, her powerful neck and back muscles, and there's barely anything in the way. Her head turns just far enough to catch a glimpse of you with one eye, to flash you part of a lip bite, and then, just slowly enough to entice without feeling exaggerated, she lies down front-first on the soft animal-fur carpet.
        
        You run your hand down one of her shoulder blades first, because it's so hard not to want to touch muscles these impressive. But then you slowly remove what little clothing she has: her ceremonial collar, her badge of office, then finally, reverentially, her top, all unhooked from the back and left lying there beneath her.
        
        At first[flags.ANNIKA_MASSAGE|, as ever], you simply marvel at her back. [pc.toneRange 75
            |Like yours, her muscles are so well-formed, so well-defined.
            |It's almost exotic, just how well-formed and well-defined her muscles are.
        ] You spend a little time just looking, pressing your [pc.hands] against her slightly-chilly skin, admiring, not massaging just yet. Shit, you could fit your whole fist under her scapula... Then, as soon as you start exploring with your fingers, you find the knots. It's not hard to sense the nexuses of discomfort, of tension and snarled-up soreness, [pc.bg courtesan
            |especially for a trained masseu[pc.mf
                |r
                |se
            ] like yourself
            |even for an enthusiastic amateur like yourself
        ], and once you have a good idea of where they are, you set to work gently smoothing them out.
        
        Even with just your hands and fingers, even without using your elbow, you can feel the grit in her back, the way it jumps as you move over it. Someone who works out this frequently definitely needs a proper massage more often than not.
        
        "Mmm. You needed this..."
        
        She sighs; despite the pain involved in any good massage, she breathes through it well enough that you can hardly sense any discomfort from her. Instead, the sigh sounds downright happy. "I do. It helps that it's you who's giving me my backrub. My [pc.mf
            |handsome
            |lovely
        ] [pc.name], here to make it all better."
        
        With Anni's verbal help, you travel around her back, alternating gentle and firm strokes as she needs. One knot gets careful, intensive attention, as you explore all the ways to make her muscles untighten, relax, get back to normal: kneading, rubbing, finding the exact amount of pressure to apply with your thumbs and fingertips. And once that one's gone, you rub a few times overtop of it, then slowly circle your way to the next. You travel up and down, from lower back to shoulders to neck, brushing silver-white hair out of the way, always circling your hands even over untroubled parts of her back because that sense of touch is lovely. Lingering, not rushing, you take all the time you can over every part of her because that's what's best for her, what's most fun, and what lets you appreciate her wonderful musculature best. Not every stroke is a massage, either. Sometimes you just gently drag your fingernails over her slightly chilly skin and simply marvel at it. And when you do return to the massages, you spend a little more time on her shoulders than she strictly needs, but from the curve of her smile she's not about to complain.

她在回答之前快速地在你的脸颊上吻了一下，她的嘴唇带来的触感已经告诉你一切你想知道的事情。“当然想。
            |嘿，安妮？”

她缓缓转身，用充满关爱与温柔的微笑看着你，那双蓝色的眼睛中倒映着火光，使得它们看起来仿佛是这个世界上最温暖、最浪漫的东西。

                |你知道吗，”你轻声说道，“就连我也能感觉到你的背部有多紧张。

            ]

            我……”有那么一瞬间，她嘴角的笑意变得更加深了。“亲爱的，我非常乐意接受。
        ]

        她的金色翅膀消失了，她半转身背对你离去。看着她现在穿的这套衣服，你清楚地看到，她背上唯一遮盖身体的东西就是上衣的后部，而那几乎只是一件胸罩而已；你可以看到她轮廓分明的肩胛骨、强健的颈部和背部肌肉，几乎没有任何东西遮挡这些部位。 她微微转动头部，用一只眼睛瞥见了你，然后轻轻咬了咬嘴唇，接着又以一种既不夸张又充满诱惑的方式，面朝下躺在了那铺着柔软动物毛皮的地毯上。

        你首先将手沿着她的肩胛骨轻轻滑下，因为实在忍不住想要触摸如此引人注目的肌肉。然后，你慢慢解开她身上为数不多的衣物：那条仪式用的领带、她的职务徽章，最后，你怀着敬意地脱下了她的上衣——所有这些衣物都是从后面解开的，此刻都静静地躺在她的身下。

        起初[flags.ANNIKA_MASSAGE|一如既往]你只能对她的身材感到惊叹。 [pc.toneRange 75
            |和你的一样，她的肌肉线条也非常分明，轮廓也非常清晰。
            |她的肌肉线条如此分明、轮廓如此清晰，简直有一种异国风情。
        ] 你只需花一点时间来观察、点击即可。 [pc.hands] 她的皮肤略带凉意，你只是欣赏着，还没有开始按摩。该死，你的整个拳头都能放在她的肩胛骨下面……然后，当你开始用手指轻轻探索时，就会发现那些僵硬的结块。那些引起不适、紧张以及疼痛的地方，其实很容易被察觉到的。 [pc.bg courtesan
            |尤其是对于一位受过专业训练的按摩师来说。[pc.mf
                |r
                |
            ] 像你自己一样
            |即使对于像你这样充满热情的业余玩家来说也是如此。
        ]一旦你大致了解了它们的位置，就可以开始轻轻地将它们抚平。

它们开始发光。此刻，不再仅仅是那支火炬，也不是安妮卡将光芒照进房间……而是它们本身在发光。[pc.isDK |不知怎么的， ] 也是你。 第一次达到那种心境的和谐状态其实很困难，但第二次就容易多了。到了第四次，你甚至都不需要闭上眼睛。这个过程会变得越来越快，直到最终它仅仅成为一个念头而已：与你内心深处的女神携手相拥，而你的双眼也会绽放出神圣的光芒。 接下来，你只需要把握住那股光能的流动，将其照射到房间的其他地方。起初，这些光线还显得模糊不清，就如同那支已经被遮住的火炬所发出的光一样；但随着时间的推移，这些光线会逐渐变得清晰、真实起来。不久之后，你真的会感受到它们的存在。 是 在一片毫无隐喻意义的黑暗中，那道光芒出现了。不久之后，安妮卡就会认为你已经准备好，能够与那道光芒同步使用你的武器了。 然后，就是时候去拆毁那些训练假人了。
rows.raw: ' Annika claps her hands. "Of course! If you're ready now, we can start right away."[var0 | She pauses, smiles, and points to the Dawnsword. "You'll want to have that with you, incidentally." ] [pc.dcb |"Okay." You raise an eyebrow. "Did you have something in mind?" |"Sounds good to me! What kind of thing did you have in mind?" |"Okie-doke! What're we doing-making-learning... stuff?" ] "How does a blade of holy sunlight sound?" she chuckles.[var0 | "Another blade of holy sunlight, that is." ] [pc.dcb |"Don't mind if I do." |"I like it!" |"Ooooh! That sounds perfect for sun mommy stuff!" ] You heft [var0 |the holy blade |your [pc.weapon] ] and gesture forward. [silly |"Lead on, Macduff. I mean, I know it's 'lay' on, and I know that they were fighting each other instead of together, and... never mind. I'm ready when you are." |"I'm ready when you are." ] As the two of you walk, Anni chats; even the tone of her voice is warm. "You know, from a certain point of view, the most important thing we do is shine a light into the darkness." [pc.dcb |"Since when did you start talking in metaphors?" |You smile. "Normally, that's just a metaphor." |"Yes! It's really bad to trip over stuff. So people need to be able to look where they're going, right?" ] She leads you further down a passage into the Keep's interior and opens a door into a room lit by a single torch. [pc.isBimbo |"Sometimes that means more than just real light, sweetie," she says, ushering you inside. "Sometimes that means helping people who need it and fighting against the dark — the bad guys." |"Sometimes," she says, ushering you inside, "if the metaphor is powerful enough, truth grows out of it." ] [pc.dcb |"Who is this person who speaks in literary devices and what has she done with Annika?" |"That's a little more, mmm, literary than I would've expected from you." |"Oh! I get it now. I think. Tripping's still bad, though, right?" ] Anni smiles and shuts the door behind you. [pc.dcb |[annika.kissed |"You know how much of a romantic I am. |"Maybe I'm just a romantic at heart. ] |"And yet it's true. |"That's true, dear. It's very important to light others' way. ] After all, one single candle can hold back the darkness. That's why we do what we do. We... we are more than candles." She paces around the stone-walled room, marking out space with reference to your reach with [var0 |the blade |your [pc.weapon] ], all the while continuing her conversational tone. "Lumia chooses us and we choose her. The two actions are really one, a single seamless instant, because the things that make someone choose Lumia are the things that make her choose us. We are hers because she is the kind of goddess — the kind of person — we want to serve, to be like, to emulate; she is ours because we are the kinds of people who best represent what she stands for in the first place. It's... an attunement. Deep, broad. Everlasting." [pc.dcb |"Which," you point out, "doesn't make me Lumia's meat puppet." |"But," you venture, "we're not one with her. We're each our own person." |"I like being in tune! Then the music sounds better. But what does that have to do with Lumia?" ] [pc.isBimbo |"That's a good way to think about it, actually. See? You can handle metaphors. We're playing the same tune, but we've all got different instruments. H |"You're right.[silly | And if you want to come at me with beings, substances, energies, and persons, you've got the wrong girl. This isn't the Greek East. ] We make our own decisions. It's more like this: h ]er light shines through us, but it's also our light at the same time. That means we can shape it and guide it." [var1 |"[pc.isBimbo |Oh yeah! This is a white magic thing, right?" |Just like any other kind of white magic," you murmur, nodding. ] "Not exactly, but close." Anni spreads her hands. "It comes from within us. We don't even have to petition Lumia for power. It simply... is." |[pc.isBimbo |"Huh. Okay! Is it one of those things where we have to ask or say a prayer or something? |"Do we have to say anything for it? A trigger word, a spell? ]" She spreads her hands. "Not at all. It comes from within us. There's no petition for power, it's just... the way things are." ] First, she demonstrates it to you. With nary a flicker of intention, her eyes and spear[silly | — her actual spear, perv — ] glow with light and another glowing spear appears over her other shoulder, and in a single motion she uses them both to stab into the air before the second spear vanishes into the ether. Then she does it again, slowing it down, letting you see every individual movement that goes into it, adding techniques to focus energy and will, showing you breathing and focus, modeling every meditative behavior. And then it's your turn. Step by step, together with Annika at first and then on your own as you repeat it, you breathe yourself into attunement with your goddess. The first time, it's a little slow, like any completely new thing. You reach for Lumia and don't quite find her, but then you remember the within us part. All you have to do is close your eyes to feel all the support and determination and love you could ever need. I AM WITH YOU, [pc.NAME]. You reopen your eyes and feel them glow. No longer is it just the torch, or Annika shining light into the room. Now[pc.isDK |, somehow, ] it's you, too. The first time finding that state of attunement is tough. The second is easy. By the fourth, you don't even have to close your eyes. Faster and faster you go, until it becomes little more than a thought: a clasping of hands with the goddess within you, and your eyes simply flare with holy light. Then all you have to do is take hold of the flow of light energy, shining it into the rest of the room. What starts unfocused, like the light from the now-covered torch, slowly becomes more tactile and real. Soon you truly are the light in a very non-metaphorical darkness. It's not long before Annika deems you ready to wield your weapon in time with that light as well. And then it's time to wreck some training dummies. '

rows.original: "There it is," Annika says. She opens the door and lets the light of the corridor outside rejoin that of the lonely, once-more-uncovered torch. "You picked that up very quickly[flags.ANNIKA_TRAIN|, just like so much else you do.|; I shouldn't be surprised.] I don't think any other sister I've ever worked with has mastered the sunstrike as quickly as you have." From the way light streams in through the window-panes, you've been at it for several hours. And at this point, you feel every one of those hours in your bones and aching muscles. With that said, it's fulsome praise, and by this time you know your [annika.kissed |lover |shield-sister ] well enough to know she doesn't bother with empty praise. [pc.dcb |"I'll take it. You did an okay job teaching, yourself." |"Thanks. I had a pretty good teacher, though." |"Aww, thanks, Anni! It's just 'cause I had such a good teacher." ] [annika.kissed |"Flatterer." She can't keep a smile off her face as she leans in for a quick smooch. When she separates, you flutter your eyelashes right back at her. "[pc.isBimbo |Just tellin' the truth, cutie! Oooh! Are we gonna learn any other things today? |You deserve it. Any other sisterly secrets to share? ]" |She grins. "Is it what the teacher teaches, or what the student learns?" "[pc.isBimbo |I... um... I don't know! I guess maybe... um... okay, I give up." You shrug expressively. "Um, can we do any more teacher-teaching-student-learning thingies? Are there any more left? |Compliment received on this end. So," you say, switching gears, "are there any other sisterly secrets you have to share? ]" ] "There's one other technique all valkyries should know — a very important one. But perhaps one best shared tomorrow, or even later. These lessons stick better when they don't happen all in a rush[silly |, unless you're mirror-stancing a fight with a ton of learnable moves, I guess ]. Go ahead and get cleaned off; work out some of the soreness." You have learned the move Sunstrike!
rows.translation: 就是这里了，”安妮卡说道。她推开门，让外面的走廊光线与那支再次被点燃的、孤独的火把的光线交织在一起。“你反应真快。[flags.ANNIKA_TRAIN|就像你做的其他很多事情一样。|这并不奇怪。] 我想，在我曾经合作过的所有姐妹中，没有人能像你这样迅速掌握‘阳光打击’这个技能。” 从窗户外透进来的光线来看，你已经练习这个技能好几个小时了。此刻，你真切地感受到这些时间所带来的疲惫——每一刻都深深地刻在你的骨子里，让你的肌肉感到酸痛。不过，这确实是一份由衷的赞美，而你也清楚地知道，自己确实已经取得了不小的进步。 [annika.kissed |恋人 |盾妹 ] 她很清楚，那些空洞的赞美对她来说毫无意义。 [pc.dcb |我收下吧。你自己教得也还不错。 |谢谢。不过，我确实遇到了一位非常优秀的老师。 |哇，谢谢安妮！只是因为我有这么一位优秀的老师而已。 ] [annika.kissed |马屁精。”她忍不住笑出声来，然后凑过去快速吻了他一下。 分开后，你也眨了眨眼，回赠了她一个吻。[pc.isBimbo |说真的，宝贝！哦哦！今天我们还会学习其他东西吗？ |你值得这样的待遇。还有其他姐妹间的秘密想要分享吗？ ]" |她笑了起来：“这是老师教的内容，还是学生自己学到的东西呢？[pc.isBimbo |我……呃……我不知道！我想也许……呃……好吧，我放弃了。”你无奈地耸了耸肩。“呃，我们还能再做一些师生互动的活动吗？还剩下一些这样的活动吗？ |我这边收到了这样的称赞。那么，”你话锋一转说道，“是不是还有其他姐妹间的秘密想要分享呢？ ]" ] 还有一种技巧是所有女武神都应该掌握的——一种非常重要的技巧。不过，或许最好明天再分享，或者更晚一些。当这些知识不是被匆忙地传授给别人时，它们会更容易被记住。[silly |除非你在与对手对战时使用大量可学习的招式来进行精确模仿，否则我想应该是这样的吧。 ]去把身上的污垢洗干净吧，活动一下身体，缓解一下酸痛吧。 你已经学会了“太阳打击”这一招式！

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: "Last time we turned intent into light, light into power, power into a weapon. But it isn't enough, of course, to find ways to vanquish the wicked." Annika speaks slowly and intently; this is a route she's trod many times before. There's nothing mechanical or rote about the words, but there's a weight behind them that hints at the sheer number of valkyries who've heard them from her before. "One must protect the innocent as well. [party.oneComp etheryn azyrran arona |Whether commoner or, as in this case —" she gestures "— monarch." [etheryn.lnhConfidence |Across the training room, Ryn hesitantly waggles her fingers. |"I — um — w-well." Ryn's blush is apparent even from the other side of the training room. |Ryn smiles excitedly, broad enough for you to see even from the other side of the training room. "I can't wait to see what you'll do, [pc.name]!" ] |Or, indeed —" she gestures "— brave Hive Knights." [azyrran.kdb |On the other side of the training room, Azzy buzzes up into the air before settling back down. "I've always wanted to see cool valkyrie powers," she gushes. |Azzy turns a charming smile on you that shines from all the way across the training room. "I look forward to seeing what my valkyrie can do." |"That's me!" Azzy giggles. From across the training room, she flutters her eyelashes. "I can't wait to see your cool new sun mommy power, angel!" ] |Or, at least —" and here the corner of her mouth twitches into a little smile "— a reasonable facsimile thereof." [arona.isSub |[silly |"I just got dunked on, didn't I?" |"Hey! That... uh... well, fair, I guess." ] From the other side of the training room, Arona laughs. "Okay, whatever. Boss, show me the cool shit!" |"I —" Arona's brow furrows deeply enough for you to see it from the other side of the training room. "Uh, whatever. Show me the cool shit, beta bitch." ] |Sometimes, of course, that means our own sisters." Even from across the training room, Thrud towers over the two of you.[silly | Given how she acts sometimes, though, 'innocent' wouldn't be incorrect in this case. ] "Hey there, [pc.name]!" ] You acknowledge her with a nod and a smile, then turn back toward Anni. "Last time, the light within was enough. But sometimes... sometimes, to keep someone truly safe, you need to draw a little more directly on the power of a goddess." She sweeps her palms around in circles, then flattens them pointing down to the floor. "In this case, you really are more of a conduit. You still need to find that state of attunement for everything to flow through you properly, but once it does, seamlessly and without hindrance, you can use it to surround and protect someone." "Anyone?" "I mean, ideally not your opponent," she chuckles. "But yes: a friend, an ally, a person you're protecting — even yourself, if need be. If you happen to be alone, or the main focus of enemy attention, speaking some words of power, opening yourself to your goddess, and letting her magical protection embrace you while you charge into the enemy ranks can be very useful. So's what happens when the protection runs its course: it rushes outward in an explosion of holy energy. A technique that's useful on both the defensive and the offensive!" [pc.isBimbo |"Oooh, like you were saying about protecting the good people and vain wishing or something for the bad ones?" "Something like that." |"Protecting the innocent and vanquishing the wicked," you muse. ] From across the way, [party.oneComp etheryn azyrran arona |Ryn [etheryn.highConfidence |cheerful |hesitant ]ly waggles her fingers. "[etheryn.highConfidence |T |I[etheryn.lowConfidence |-I ] guess t ]hat's why I'm over here!" |[azyrran.kdb |Azzy flashes a quick smile. "Which is why I'm over here! Don't want you to get hurt when all the, uh, Lumia energy detonates." |Azzy preens. "Hence why I'm over here, darling. Wouldn't want you to get hurt by your own spell." |Azzy giggles. "That's me, I think! And it's why I'm aaaall the way over here. That way, nobody gets hurt when all the sun mommy stuff around me goes boom!" ] |Arona rotates her shoulder and grins. "So you get to practice makin' me invincible for a little bit until I vomit Lumia all over the bad guys? Nice." |Thrud cracks her neck. "It's one of the most fun things to do in battle — let them gather around you, and then boom! So, um, that's why you two aren't gathered around me." ] Anni nods at her, then turns back to you. "Let's start with a [silly |little bit of skill modeling, an important part of any educator's toolkit |demonstration ]. Breathe yourself into attunement first —" her eyes flash golden as she says the words "— and open yourself to Lumia. Seek out the strands of energy, direct the flow toward [party.oneComp etheryn azyrran arona |Etheryn |Azyrran |Arona |Thrud ], watch it wrap around them, shape it into a shield. Only then do you say the incantation; as soon as you do, the flow turns into a torrent, the shield gains solidity, and you can finish shaping it." Then the seneschal suits action to words as a gentle glow suffuses [party.oneComp etheryn azyrran arona |Ryn |Azzy |Arona |Thrud ], seemingly from nowhere, then almost immediately coalesces into a tactile-seeming second skin. [party.oneComp etheryn azyrran arona |"O-oh my," your [etheryn.married |elf-wife |[etheryn.fucked |elven lover |elven companion ] ] gasps. "This feels... so strange. But it's... it's nice." |"Ooooh," the hornet [azyrran.kdb |sigh |purr |gasp ]s. "I like it[azyrran.kdb |. |. |! ]" |"Not bad." Your orcish [arona.isLover |lover |companion ] looks down at herself and flexes a muscle. "This is the cool shit." |Instead of saying anything, the enormous valkyrie stretches and cracks her neck; her pleased smile communicates all it needs to about how much she enjoys the feeling. ] [pc.dcb |"I like it," you murmur. |"Very cool," you murmur. |"That's pretty neat!" you gasp. ] "Then we wait for a bit, and watch it explode?" "Indeed," Anni says. As moments pass, the golden shield, already translucent, already covering all of [party.oneComp etheryn azyrran arona |Ryn |Azzy |Arona |Thrud ]'s body, starts to glow brighter and brighter. She looks around at it with awe, then back to Anni, then over to you. More seconds tick by, and the shield continues to brighten, almost brilliant enough to force your eyes closed. Then there is a final pulse of light, of warning, and then the room is filled with brilliant sunlight as everything covering her explodes, every single bit of it instantly converted into energy... and though it absolutely annihilates the carpet that [party.oneComp etheryn azyrran arona |Ryn |Azzy |Arona |Thrud ] is standing on, as well as a wooden practice dummy not too far from her, not a hair on her head is so much as singed. "Whoa." Anni turns to you again and smiles. "Now it's your turn."
rows.translation: 上次，我们将意志转化为光，光转化为力量，力量又变成了武器。但当然，仅仅这样还不够，我们还需要找到战胜邪恶的方法。”安妮卡语速缓慢而认真，这条路她已经走过很多次了。她的话语中没有丝毫机械或刻板之处，但其中蕴含的分量，却暗示着已经有无数女武神听她讲过这些话。“我们还必须保护无辜的人们。 [party.oneComp etheryn azyrran arona |无论是平民，还是像这种情况下的君主——她做了个手势说明。 [etheryn.lnhConfidence |在训练室的另一端，瑞恩犹豫着动动手指。 |我……嗯……好吧。”即使从训练室的另一边，也能明显看到瑞恩的脸颊已经涨红了。 |瑞恩兴奋地笑了，那笑容如此灿烂，以至于即使在训练室的另一边，你也能清楚地看到。“我真迫不及待想看看你会做出什么来。 [pc.name]!" ] |或者，更确切地说——她做了个手势——“勇敢的蜂群骑士们。 [azyrran.kdb |在训练室的另一边，阿齐飞到半空中，然后又落了下来。“我一直都很想看看那些酷炫的瓦尔基里力量呢，”她兴奋地说道。 |阿齐向你露出了一个迷人的微笑，那笑容仿佛穿越了整个训练室，一直传到了你的耳边。“我很期待看看我的女武神能展现出什么样的实力。 |那就是我！”阿齐咯咯地笑了起来。她在训练室的另一头眨了眨眼睛：“真迫不及待想看看你那超酷的新能力了，天使！ ] |或者，至少——她嘴角微微一扬，露出一丝微笑——“是一个相当逼真的仿制品。 [arona.isSub |[silly |我刚刚被人狠狠地打败了，对吧？ |嘿！那个……呃……好吧，我觉得也挺合理的。 ] 在训练室的另一边，阿罗娜笑了起来。“好吧，随便吧。老板，快让我看看那些厉害的东西吧！ |我——”阿罗娜的眉头皱得如此之深，以至于在训练室的另一边都能看到。 “呃，算了。快给我看看那些厉害的东西吧，这个测试版的家伙。 ] |当然，有时候这也意味着我们的姐妹们也会受到影响。 即使站在训练室的另一端，Thrud依然比你们两个高出一大截。[silly | 不过，考虑到她有时候的表现，用“天真无邪”来形容她也不为过。 ] 嘿，你好， [pc.name]!" ] rows.original:
You sit in the connecting room near Lumia's throne, waiting for Eira to arrive and playing with the fist-sized crystal prism she gave you. She told you to hand it to the mail carrier, but didn't really give any explanation of what it was. It's semi-transparent and glows softly with an internal light that swims about within. Whatever it is, it's very pretty, but you doubt that's the only reason she wants you to deliver it.
    
    All at once you hear a flutter of movement and a whoosh of air, and the mail-woman is floating in front of you. She's fast! [flags.RYN_VALK_NOTIF|You have to do a double take before you realize that this is the same messenger who informed you about the ceremony that the valkyries put on for Etheryn. Just like before, she moves purposefully — but once she sees you, she pauses to intently examine both you and the crystal in your hands. That|The hovering valkyrie is smaller than most of her sisters you've seen, but no less imposing. A sense of purpose pervades her form — one only briefly interrupted as she looks you over, but renewed as she notices the crystal in your hands. Still, that] pause allows you to get a decent look at her [flags.RYN_VALK_NOTIF|and refresh your memory about her|before she can approach further].
    
    The uniform she's wearing is a more form-fitting cloth take on the usual valkyrie gear, and it shows off her modest chest and [silly
        |monster dumpy
        |full round ass
    ] quite well. A pair of tiny wings sprout just above her hips, with solid looking feathers of gold that flutter to keep her in place. Her feet are almost bare, covered only by a securing silver ring and some of the cloth from her leggings that connects to it. Most shocking of all, her eyes are covered by a second pair of tiny wings that sprout from behind her head. Despite that, it still feels like she's looking at you.
    
    "[flags.RYN_VALK_NOTIF|Ah! Hello, [pc.name]. It's a pleasure to see you again|[pc.isValk
        |Hmm. You're new, and I don't recogni- hmm.
        |Hmm. You're not a valkyrie, how did you- hmm.
    ] Ah! You must be the hero who helped vanquish the shadows troubling Lumia]," she says. Though she looks youthful, there's a tiredness in her voice that belies her appearance. "I see you have a letter. Hand it over and I'll get it where it needs to go. Has the mail system been explained to you?"
    
    "No, I was just told to wait here with this. What is it?" you ask. It's technically the truth, even if you aren't giving her the full reason. She gives you a suspicious look, but takes the crystal nonetheless.
    
    "It's a memory matrix crystal, just a small one. It shows off the last few memories the creator was thinking of before making it when it's broken. Lumia teaches us how to make them, but they... aren't exactly something I like seeing in the mail. This one's different though. Who is it fo-" she says, puzzling over the crystal and then loosing a frustrated sigh as something clicks. "This is for me. Did she put you up to this?"
    
    "I, um, [pc.dcb
        |yeah. What of it?
        |yes. That doesn't mean it's not important, though.
        |maybe a little bit. That's not, like, a bad thing though!
    ] Aren't you going to open it?" you ask, both wanting to help and a little curious after her explanation.
    
    "I suppose I'd better. I don't want her wasting time making more," she crosses her legs, taking a seated position midair as she fidgets with the gem. 
    
    The purple light inside hums brighter, and then the whole thing dissolves with a sound like breaking glass. Instead of shards, it shatters into a matrix of warm light that surrounds you both. Inside your head, you hear Lumia's patient voice begin to speak.
    
    "Eira. You know I'm happy with the work you're doing, but you have to take breaks sometimes. You don't have to be the only one who delivers messages. Please, take some time to relax. I won't command you to do so, but it would set me at ease to see you getting some rest," the voice hums. When it finishes, the light dissipates and the room returns to normal.
    
    "I should have guessed that would be it. You can report back to her if you want. Tell her I'm busy. Busier now having wasted the time for this. Goodbye, hero," she says, and then zips off out of the room without another word.
    
    You only remain shocked for a second before shaking your head to clear it. Well, looks like this will be a little harder than the goddess wanted it to be, but that's no reason to give up. Maybe there's a way to ease her burden somehow...
rows.translation:
你坐在卢米娅王座附近的休息室里，等待艾拉的到来，同时摆弄着她送给你的那个拳头大小的水晶棱镜。她让你把它交给邮递员，但却没有详细解释这个东西的用途。 它呈半透明状，内部散发出的光芒让它轻轻发光，那些光芒仿佛在内部游动般。无论那究竟是什么，它确实非常漂亮，但你也怀疑，这肯定不是她让你去送它的唯一原因。

突然，你听到一阵轻快的移动声和空气流动的声音，那位邮递员竟然漂浮在你面前。 她速度真快！ [flags.RYN_VALK_NOTIF|你得仔细看几眼，才能意识到这位使者就是之前告诉过你关于女武神们为埃瑟琳举办的仪式的那个人。和之前一样，她行动得很有目的性——但一旦看到你，她就会停下来，仔细地打量你以及你手中的水晶。|这只盘旋在空中的女武神比你见过的大多数同类都要小，但她的威严丝毫不减。她的整个身形都散发着一种坚定的气势——这种气势在她打量你的瞬间略有减弱，但当她注意到你手中的水晶时，那种气势又重新涌现了出来。总之，她……] 暂停功能让你有足够的时间仔细观察她。 [flags.RYN_VALK_NOTIF|同时也能帮助你重新回忆起关于她的那些记忆。|在她还能继续靠近之前]她所穿的这套制服，是在传统的瓦尔基里战斗服基础上改良而成的，材质更加贴身，因此更能凸显她那娇小的胸部…… [silly
        |怪物胖墩
        |十足的蠢货
    ] 相当不错。她的臀部上方长出了一对小小的翅膀，那些看起来质地坚硬的金色羽毛会轻轻摆动，帮助她保持平衡。她的双脚几乎赤裸，只有一个小银环以及紧贴脚部的部分紧身裤布料将它们覆盖着。最令人惊讶的是，她的双眼也被另一对从后脑部长出的小翅膀所遮盖。尽管如此，她看你的眼神依然十分清晰。[flags.RYN_VALK_NOTIF|啊！你好， [pc.name]很高兴再次见到你。|[pc.isValk
        |嗯，你是新来的，我不太认识你……嗯。
        |嗯……你又不是女武神，那你怎么会……嗯。
    ] 啊！你一定就是那位帮助我们战胜那些困扰卢米娅的阴影的英雄吧！]是吧，”她说。虽然她看起来很年轻，但她的声音中却带着一种疲惫，这与她的外表并不相符。“我看你手里有一封信。把信交给我，我会把它送到该去的地方。有人给你解释过邮件系统的使用方法吗？
    
    不，我只是被吩咐在这里等着拿这个。这是什么？”你问道。从技术上讲，这确实是事实，尽管你并没有告诉她全部原因。她用怀疑的眼神看着你，但还是接过了那颗水晶。

“这是一颗记忆矩阵水晶，只不过是一颗小小的而已。 当它损坏的时候，它会展示出创作者在制作它之前所思考的那些最后的回忆。Lumia教会了我们如何制作这样的东西，但是……它们并不是我愿意在邮件里收到的东西。不过，这个例外。 这是给谁的……”她一边说着，一边仔细观察着那块水晶，突然，她沮丧地叹了口气，似乎明白了什么。“这是给我的。是她指使你这么做的吗？”

“我，呃…… [pc.dcb
        |是啊，那又怎样？
        |是的。不过，这并不意味着它不重要。
        |也许有一点吧。不过，这也不是什么坏事啊！
    ] 你不去打开它吗？”你问道。在听完她的解释后，你们俩都想要帮忙，同时也感到有些好奇。

“我想我还是应该打开吧。我可不想让她浪费时间再去制作另一个了。”她交叉双腿，在半空中坐下来，开始摆弄那颗宝石。 
    
    内部的紫色光线变得愈发明亮，随后整个装置伴随着玻璃破碎般的声响消失了。那些碎片并没有散落一地，而是化作了一片温暖的光芒，将你们两人包围在其中。在你的脑海中，Lumia那耐心的声音开始响起。
    
    艾拉，你知道我对你的工作非常满意，但你也应该偶尔休息一下。没有必要总是你一个人来传达这些消息。请一定要抽时间放松一下吧。我不是在命令你，但如果能看到你休息一下，我会放心很多。”那个声音轻声说道。 当这一切结束后，光芒渐渐消散，房间恢复了正常状态。

“我早该猜到会是这样的结果。如果你想的话，可以回去告诉她。告诉她我很忙——现在更是忙得不可开交，毕竟浪费了这么多时间在这上面。 再见了，英雄，”她说完，便一言不发地走出了房间。

你只愣了一下，随即摇了摇头，让自己恢复清醒。好吧，看来这次的任务会比女神预想的要困难一些，但这也不能成为放弃的理由。 也许有办法可以减轻她的负担……

    The uniform she's wearing is a more form-fitting cloth take on the usual valkyrie gear, and it shows off her modest chest and [silly
        |monster dumpy
        |full round ass
    ] quite well. A pair of tiny wings sprout just above her hips, with solid looking feathers of gold that flutter to keep her in place. Her feet are almost bare, covered only by a securing silver ring and some of the cloth from her leggings that connects to it. Most shocking of all, her eyes are covered by a second pair of tiny wings that sprout from behind her head. Despite that, it still feels like she's looking at you.
    
    "[flags.RYN_VALK_NOTIF|Ah! Hello, [pc.name]. It's a pleasure to see you again|[pc.isValk
        |Hmm. You're new, and I don't recogni- hmm.
        |Hmm. You're not a valkyrie, how did you- hmm.
    ] Ah! You must be the hero who helped vanquish the shadows troubling Lumia]," she says. Though she looks youthful, there's a tiredness in her voice that belies her appearance. "I see you have a letter. Hand it over and I'll get it where it needs to go. Has the mail system been explained to you?"
    
    "No, I was just told to wait here with this. What is it?" you ask. It's technically the truth, even if you aren't giving her the full reason. She gives you a suspicious look, but takes the crystal nonetheless.
    
    "It's a memory matrix crystal, just a small one. It shows off the last few memories the creator was thinking of before making it when it's broken. Lumia teaches us how to make them, but they... aren't exactly something I like seeing in the mail. This one's different though. Who is it fo-" she says, puzzling over the crystal and then loosing a frustrated sigh as something clicks. "This is for me. Did she put you up to this?"
    
    "I, um, [pc.dcb
        |yeah. What of it?
        |yes. That doesn't mean it's not important, though.
        |maybe a little bit. That's not, like, a bad thing though!
    ] Aren't you going to open it?" you ask, both wanting to help and a little curious after her explanation.
    
    "I suppose I'd better. I don't want her wasting time making more," she crosses her legs, taking a seated position midair as she fidgets with the gem. 
    
    The purple light inside hums brighter, and then the whole thing dissolves with a sound like breaking glass. Instead of shards, it shatters into a matrix of warm light that surrounds you both. Inside your head, you hear Lumia's patient voice begin to speak.
    
    "Eira. You know I'm happy with the work you're doing, but you have to take breaks sometimes. You don't have to be the only one who delivers messages. Please, take some time to relax. I won't command you to do so, but it would set me at ease to see you getting some rest," the voice hums. When it finishes, the light dissipates and the room returns to normal.
    
    "I should have guessed that would be it. You can report back to her if you want. Tell her I'm busy. Busier now having wasted the time for this. Goodbye, hero," she says, and then zips off out of the room without another word.
    
    You only remain shocked for a second before shaking your head to clear it. Well, looks like this will be a little harder than the goddess wanted it to be, but that's no reason to give up. Maybe there's a way to ease her burden somehow...
    "
