rows.original: As you maneuver through the halls of Lumia's palace, you feel a sudden rush of wind and a tug on your wrist as Eira swoops down out of the sky and pulls you into a corner. The pink-skinned delivery girl's lips are pursed in frustration, and she takes a second to gather her thoughts before she actually talks. "Look. I don't know what you and Lumia are trying to do, but I don't need an assistant. I know you've been delivering letters," she says, sounding more exasperated than angry. "We didn't think you needed help, but maybe you[pc.dcb |'d be less prickly if you had some | might be able to relax a little if you had some |'d feel less stressed if you had some ]. I thought I'd help out a little while Lumia finds someone permanent to help. I didn't mean to intrude on your job, but I can see why you'd want to keep that to yourself. Interacting with people every day is pretty wonderful." The adroit messenger regards you with some skepticism for a moment, but it fades as swiftly as it comes. "You're serious, aren't you?" she asks, the stressed dodginess draining out of her. She deflates a little, looking tired more than anything else. "Okay. I... I'll have to talk with Lumia. She can tell me all about this plan of yours." With that, she releases her hold on your wrist and flits off in the direction of the throne room. You're left to follow her [pc.hasWings |from behind, stretching your [pc.wings]. |on foot, navigating the main halls. ] By the time you arrive, the two are mid conversation, and you don't pick up any hostility on either side. Eira is on the ground for once, standing straight while Lumia looks down at her from the throne with an understanding smile. "That's all. I'm not trying to undermine you. I just remember how happy you were when we first met, and it makes me weep to see you act cold toward those you used to love so deeply," the goddess says. "I... Then what would you have me do in the meantime?" Eira responds, tossing a glance in your direction as you approach. "You don't need to stop, nor would I want you to do so. I'd just like to see you enjoy it again. Work out the stress that's been building up. There's fun things to do around here, show some of them to [pc.name]! You've already met several times, so do something fun together, for me." Eira thinks long and hard, an odd mix of doubtful and hopeful expressions warring on her face. It's impossible to get a better read than that, but her expression settles into a determined resolution. "Okay. It's a little hard for me to grasp, but I'll try. Somewhere in these years I lost something I didn't even notice was missing, but I'll do my damndest to get it back," she finally says. "[pc.dcb |Good, s |Glad to hear it, s |Oh goodie! S ]o when do we start," you ask. "I trust you'll at least stay in the castle for a little while?" Lumia asks, raising an eyebrow. "I can give the long distance deliveries to other girls for now." "Don't worry, I'm not going to run off like some child. I'm sure the hero here can find me around. It's not like I work all the time, even now. [pc.HeShe] can find me in the... Okay, maybe I've been working a little too much," she says as she struggles to think of a meeting place. "[pc.HeShe] can find my room in the residence hall, just... Give me a day to clean up. I haven't really used it a whole lot recently." "Perfect! I expect to hear good things, but for now I have some other things to attend to as well. Please, don't hesitate to come to me if you feel like falling back into this kind of routine. It troubles me more if you don't." Lumia leaves the conversation at that, stepping up from the throne and giving each of you a nod before heading off toward the door to her sanctum. "See you later then, hero. I'm kind of looking forward to it now. I'll try to have some suggestions ready, but it's been a while since I've just... had fun," Eira says once she's gone. That's no problem with you. You're sure it'll be something worth doing. With a nod and a thoughtful smile, the short-winged woman flies off toward the dorms. She turns back once, halting in place. "Oh! My room is the door with the big blue mirror on the outside," she says before spinning again and resuming her exit. You pack that information away for when you'll need it. She said she needed a day to clean up, but surely you can find something else to do in the meantime.
rows.translation: 当你穿梭在Lumia宫殿的走廊中时，突然一阵风袭来，你的手腕被拽住——Eira从天而降，将你拉到了一个角落。这个皮肤呈粉红色的送信女孩沮丧地抿着嘴唇，她花了一秒钟时间整理思绪，才终于开口说话。 听着，我不知道你和Lumia到底在图什么，但我并不需要一个助手。我知道你们一直在送信，”她说，语气中更多的是无奈而非愤怒。 “我们本来并不认为你需要这个帮助…… 需要 帮忙吧，不过也许你……[pc.dcb |要是你有点的话，情况就不会这么棘手了。 | 如果你有一些的话，或许就能稍微放松一下了。 |如果你有一些的话，会感觉压力小一些吧。 ]我想在Lumia找到固定的助手之前，先帮上一点忙。我并没有打算打扰你的工作，但我也能理解你为什么想把这件事保密。每天与人们互动，确实是一件非常美好的事情。那位机敏的信使起初对你抱有几分怀疑，但这种怀疑很快就消失了。 “你是认真的，对吧？”她问道，那种紧张戒备的神情已经从她的脸上消失了。她看起来有些疲惫，更多的是显得精疲力竭。 好吧。我……我得去和Lumia谈谈。她可以告诉我关于你这个计划的全部细节。” 说完，她松开了握着你手腕的手，然后朝王座厅的方向飞走了。你只能跟在她后面。 [pc.hasWings |从背后伸出手来，拉住你…… [pc.wings]. |步行着，穿梭于各个主厅之中。 ] 当你到达时，他们两人正在交谈，你没有察觉到他们之间有任何敌意。这一次，艾拉是坐在地上的，而卢米娅则站在王座上，用一种理解的表情注视着她。 就这些吧。我并不是想贬低你，我只是想起我们初次见面时你有多开心，而看到你对那些你曾经深爱过的人如此冷漠，我真的感到很难过。”女神说道。 “我……那你希望我在这期间该怎么做呢？当你靠近时，艾拉回应了你，同时朝你的方向瞥了一眼。 “你不需要停下来，我也不希望你停下来。我只是想看到你再次享受这一切，释放那些积累起来的压力。这里有很多有趣的事情可以做，不妨带他们去体验一些吧。 [pc.name]你们已经见过面好几次了，所以一起做点有趣的事情吧，也是为了我。” 艾拉深思熟虑，她的脸上同时浮现出怀疑与期待两种复杂的表情。很难从她的神情中读出更多的信息，但最终，她做出了一个坚定的决定。 “好吧。虽然我还有点不太明白，但我会试试的。这些年来，我似乎失去了某些东西，甚至都没有意识到它们的存在，但我一定会竭尽全力把它们找回来。”她最终说道。[pc.dcb |好的，谢谢。 |很高兴听到这个消息，真的。 |哦，太好了！S ]那我们什么时候开始呢？”你问道。 “我希望你至少能在这座城堡里待上一段时间，好吗？”卢米娅挑了挑眉毛问道，“暂时可以把那些远距离的配送任务交给其他女孩去完成。” “别担心，我不会像小孩子一样跑掉的。我相信这里的英雄肯定能找到我。而且，我现在也并不是在一直工作啊。 [pc.HeShe] 可以在……那里找到我。好吧，也许我最近工作得太多了，”她一边说着，一边努力想着该在什么地方见面。[pc.HeShe] 我能在宿舍里找到自己的房间，只是……给我一天时间来整理一下吧。最近我其实并没有怎么使用那个房间。” “太好了！我期待听到好消息，不过现在我还有其他事情需要处理。 如果你们觉得自己又会陷入这种日常模式中，请随时来找我。如果你们不这么做，反而会让我更加担心。” 说完，Lumia结束了谈话，从王座上走下来，向在场的每个人点了点头，然后朝着通往她私密空间的门走去。 那回头见吧，英雄。我现在其实挺期待那一天的。我会尽量准备一些建议的，不过已经有一段时间……我没有真正享受过乐趣了。”艾拉离开后说道。 对你来说，这根本不是问题。 你确定这是值得去做的事情吗？ 那个短翼女子点了点头，露出若有所思的微笑，然后飞向了宿舍区。她在半路上停了下来，转过身来说： “哦！我的房间是外面有一面大蓝镜子的那扇门。”说完，她又转身继续飞走了。 你把那些信息保存起来，等需要的时候再使用。她说她需要一天的时间来整理东西，但在这期间，你肯定可以找到其他事情来做吧。

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original:
[eira.anyKids
        |Eira is right there to greet you when you open the door, and this time you wrap your arms around her in a pre-emptive hug. She accepts it, laughing loud as you spin her in a swift circle.
        
        "Ahaha! Another tour of maternity duty is complete! I [rand
            |actually got to meet with the parents this time. High Priestess Elthara introduced us, and I was able to see the relief on the mother's face in person. I'd do it again in a heartbeat after that,
            |didn't get to meet with the parents this time, but High Priestess Elthara has been very helpful with the adoption efforts. Hearing the stories from the delivery girls makes me want to do it all over again,
        ]" she says, sighing dreamily. "Maybe not immediately, though. Did you come for anything specific this time?"
        |[flags.EIRA_APPROACH
            |You approach Eira's room and knock off to the side of the mirror. There's a brief shuffle inside before the door unlocks and Eira opens it. After the first time, you swear the room is cleaner every time you show up. All evidence of the cobwebs from your first visit is gone, and [flags.EIRA_DRAPES
                |the new draperies and bedding you picked out together match wonderfully with the rest of the decor.
                |even the mismatched bedding and draperies look a little nicer cleaned up.
            ]
            
            "Welcome back," she says, still looking a little stiff. "It's getting easier, but I don't know if I'll ever be able to retire if this is what it's like all day. I just want to be flying."
            
            "You certainly look it. Maybe we can make that happen, or at least something else to put your mind to work," you say.
            
            What kind of things did you have in mind, though?
            |It doesn't take long to find the door Eira mentioned to you. In fact, the entire outside of the door is a blue mirror. The handle is set into the frame, with a flat surface around it. You settle on that blank section to knock, and give the door a few short raps. Almost immediately, you hear a thunk and a noise of surprise, and hear a yelp before the door opens a crack.
            
            "H-hello? Oh! [pc.name]! You can come in, but my room is still in a miserable state," she says, opening the door wide enough for you to enter.
            
            You slip inside, and right away you see that she wasn't lying. While efforts to clean have obviously been made, it looks like this room hasn't been occupied for years. There's more cobweb than wall where the corners meet the ceiling, and the bed is a garish mishmash of colors between its sheets and drapes.
            
            "If this is what you had to come back to, I can sympathize with you staying away," you say with a whistle.
            
            "This wasn't the reason for that! It's just an... unfortunate side effect."
            
            "Sure it is. Well, [pc.dcb
                |I guess you'll be needing some help.
                |shall we continue cleaning?
                |side effects need special treatment!
            ]" you say, heading for a particularly nasty gob of cobweb.
            
            Eira stares slack-jawed as you start helping her, but doesn't refuse your assistance. She only stays stunned for a moment, and then hands you a feather duster on a pole capable of reaching the dust-webs that inhabit the top corners. 
            
            "Thank you," she says, taking a broom and dustpan that were leaning against the wall.
            
            "[pc.dcb
                |It's not a problem. I wouldn't have come back to a place like this either.
                |You're welcome. I'm sure we can make this a place worth coming back to.
                |You are very welcome, cutie! Let's make this a nice home again!
            ]"
            
            The two of you clean for over two hours, leaving the door open so as not to choke on the dust. In the end, however, it makes a truly incredible amount of difference. The room is still far from sparkling clean, but once you've taken the bedding to be washed and finished sweeping the dust away the whole thing starts to look like a real bedroom again. You didn't even have to burn anything along the way!
            
            "Wow. I, uh, didn't really expect to be half as done as this today. I think you've helped enough for now, really. I'll keep at it when you're gone, but do you want to do anything more fun while you're here?"
        ]
    ]
rows.translation:
[eira.anyKids
        |当你打开门时，艾拉就在那里迎接你，而这一次，你抢先拥抱了她。她开心地接受了这个拥抱，还随着你快速地转圈而大笑起来。

“哈哈！又完成了一次‘产前护理’任务啊！我…… [rand
            |这次我真的见到了那些孩子的父母。大祭司艾尔塔拉为我们做了介绍，我亲眼看到了那位母亲脸上流露出的欣慰之情。如果再有机会，我一定会毫不犹豫地再次去做这件事。
            |这次没能与孩子的父母见面，但大祭司艾尔塔拉在收养事宜上给予了我们很大的帮助。听到那些送婴女们的故事，让我真的想再尝试一次。
        ]她说，带着梦幻般的叹息，”也许不会马上发生。不过，这次你来找我是有什么特别的事情吗？
        |[flags.EIRA_APPROACH
            |你走到艾拉的房间前，在镜子旁边敲了敲门。里面传来一阵轻微的动静，随后门打开了，艾拉走了出来。每次你去的时候，你都会觉得这个房间变得越来越干净了——第一次来访时那些蛛网痕迹已经消失得无影无踪了。 [flags.EIRA_DRAPES
                |你们一起挑选的新窗帘和床上用品与整个装饰风格搭配得非常和谐。
                |就连那些不配套的床单和窗帘，洗干净之后看起来也顺眼多了。
            ]
            
            欢迎回来，”她说，语气仍然显得有些生硬。“虽然情况正在逐渐好转，但我不知道如果每天都是这样，我是否还能真正退休。我其实只是想继续飞翔。”

“你看起来确实很渴望那样做。也许我们可以帮你实现这个愿望，或者至少找到其他事情让你全身心投入其中，”你说。

不过，你究竟指的是哪些事情呢？
            |找到艾拉跟你提到的那扇门并没有花费太长时间。事实上，整扇门的外表面都是一面蓝色的镜子。门把手镶嵌在门框上，周围是一片平坦的区域。你就在那片平坦的地方敲了几下，门很快就打开了。

“喂？哦！ [pc.name]你可以进来，不过我的房间现在还是一团糟，”她说着，把门开得足够大让你能够进去。

你走了进去，立刻就发现她并没有说谎。虽然显然有人尝试过打扫，但这个房间看起来已经好几年没人住了。 在角落与天花板的交界处，积满了更多的蛛网；床上的床单和窗帘更是色彩杂乱、难以入目。

“如果这就是你不得不回到这里的原因，那我完全可以理解你为什么想要远离这里。”你轻声说道。
            
            这并不是造成那种结果的原因！只不过是一个……不幸的副作用罢了。”

“当然是这样。嗯， [pc.dcb
                |我想你可能需要一些帮助。
                |我们继续打扫吧？
                |副作用需要特别处理！
            ]你说得对，我们正朝着一片特别脏乱的蜘蛛网走去。”

当你开始帮助她时，艾拉张大嘴巴愣住了，但她并没有拒绝你的帮助。她只是愣了一会儿，然后递给你一根长柄羽毛掸子，这根掸子能够够到那些藏在角落里的蜘蛛网。

“谢谢。”她一边说，一边拿起了靠在墙边的扫帚和簸箕。[pc.dcb
                |这不是什么问题。换作是我，也不会回到这样的地方来。
                |不客气。我相信我们一定能把这个地方打造成一个让人愿意再次光顾的地方。
                |不客气，小可爱！让我们把这里重新变成一个温馨的家吧！
            ]你们俩花了两个多小时进行打扫，还把门开着，以免被灰尘呛到。不过，最终效果确实令人惊喜。房间虽然还远称不上一尘不染，但把床单拿去清洗、把灰尘彻底扫干净之后，整个房间终于又看起来像一个真正的卧室了。 哇，其实我真没料到今天能完成这么多工作。我觉得你现在已经帮了我很大的忙了，真的。你离开后我会继续努力的，不过你在这里的时候，还想做点什么有趣的事情吗？"
        ]
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    [eira.anyKids
        |Eira is right there to greet you when you open the door, and this time you wrap your arms around her in a pre-emptive hug. She accepts it, laughing loud as you spin her in a swift circle.
        
        "Ahaha! Another tour of maternity duty is complete! I [rand
            |actually got to meet with the parents this time. High Priestess Elthara introduced us, and I was able to see the relief on the mother's face in person. I'd do it again in a heartbeat after that,
            |didn't get to meet with the parents this time, but High Priestess Elthara has been very helpful with the adoption efforts. Hearing the stories from the delivery girls makes me want to do it all over again,
        ]" she says, sighing dreamily. "Maybe not immediately, though. Did you come for anything specific this time?"
        |[flags.EIRA_APPROACH
            |You approach Eira's room and knock off to the side of the mirror. There's a brief shuffle inside before the door unlocks and Eira opens it. After the first time, you swear the room is cleaner every time you show up. All evidence of the cobwebs from your first visit is gone, and [flags.EIRA_DRAPES
                |the new draperies and bedding you picked out together match wonderfully with the rest of the decor.
                |even the mismatched bedding and draperies look a little nicer cleaned up.
            ]
            
            "Welcome back," she says, still looking a little stiff. "It's getting easier, but I don't know if I'll ever be able to retire if this is what it's like all day. I just want to be flying."
            
            "You certainly look it. Maybe we can make that happen, or at least something else to put your mind to work," you say.
            
            What kind of things did you have in mind, though?
            |It doesn't take long to find the door Eira mentioned to you. In fact, the entire outside of the door is a blue mirror. The handle is set into the frame, with a flat surface around it. You settle on that blank section to knock, and give the door a few short raps. Almost immediately, you hear a thunk and a noise of surprise, and hear a yelp before the door opens a crack.
            
            "H-hello? Oh! [pc.name]! You can come in, but my room is still in a miserable state," she says, opening the door wide enough for you to enter.
            
            You slip inside, and right away you see that she wasn't lying. While efforts to clean have obviously been made, it looks like this room hasn't been occupied for years. There's more cobweb than wall where the corners meet the ceiling, and the bed is a garish mishmash of colors between its sheets and drapes.
            
            "If this is what you had to come back to, I can sympathize with you staying away," you say with a whistle.
            
            "This wasn't the reason for that! It's just an... unfortunate side effect."
            
            "Sure it is. Well, [pc.dcb
                |I guess you'll be needing some help.
                |shall we continue cleaning?
                |side effects need special treatment!
            ]" you say, heading for a particularly nasty gob of cobweb.
            
            Eira stares slack-jawed as you start helping her, but doesn't refuse your assistance. She only stays stunned for a moment, and then hands you a feather duster on a pole capable of reaching the dust-webs that inhabit the top corners. 
            
            "Thank you," she says, taking a broom and dustpan that were leaning against the wall.
            
            "[pc.dcb
                |It's not a problem. I wouldn't have come back to a place like this either.
                |You're welcome. I'm sure we can make this a place worth coming back to.
                |You are very welcome, cutie! Let's make this a nice home again!
            ]"
            
            The two of you clean for over two hours, leaving the door open so as not to choke on the dust. In the end, however, it makes a truly incredible amount of difference. The room is still far from sparkling clean, but once you've taken the bedding to be washed and finished sweeping the dust away the whole thing starts to look like a real bedroom again. You didn't even have to burn anything along the way!
            
            "Wow. I, uh, didn't really expect to be half as done as this today. I think you've helped enough for now, really. I'll keep at it when you're gone, but do you want to do anything more fun while you're here?"
        ]
    ]
    "

rows.original:
"So you said before that you'd do maternity duty again if asked. Would you do it right now if we went to Lumia and she said yes?" 
    
    "Well... Yeah I guess! If she says it's ok and you want to help out, I'd love to. Just to make sure though, I'm not planning to raise a child right now, and I'm not sure if or when I would in the future either. Any kid I have through maternity work will be for adoptive mothers in need. As long as you're ok with that, we can go ask Lumia about it."
rows.translation:
你之前说过，如果有人请求，你愿意再次承担生育任务。那么如果我们现在去找Luma，而她也表示同意，你会愿意这么做吗？”

“嗯……我想是的！如果她同意，而且你也希望帮忙的话，我当然愿意。不过我需要先确认一点：目前我并没有打算抚养孩子，也不确定将来是否会考虑这个想法。如果通过这次生育任务有了孩子，那些孩子将会被送给有需要的养母。只要你没有意见，我们就可以去问Luma了。

rows.translation: 好的。
艾拉与卢米娅

rows.original:
"Yeah! That's fine with me. I'd hate to see those families go without kids if they don't have to." 
        
        "Wonderful! In that case, lead the way," she replies, fluttering over to open the door for you. 
        
        Eira floats above you on the way there, admiring the tapestries in the main hall while you make your way to the throne room. Things are mostly quiet, but there are still a few valkyries milling about on the way to their daily tasks or off-duty routines. No one stops either of you before you reach the large double doors at the end of the corridor, and you quietly push them open.
        
        [var0
            |Lumia is seated cross-legged on the throne, watching the door with her chin in her hands. When she sees you, she un-pretzels her legs and hops down to come greet you. There's a very un-godlike giddiness in her demeanor as she looks between the two of you and smiles.
            
            "Eira! I'm glad to see you making friends again! To what do I owe the pleasure of you two's company? Something more exciting than report deliveries or storage evaluations, I would hope," she asks.
            
            "About that. We were wondering if there's any need for frost-elf babies for maternity duty. Eira expressed some interest and I told her I'd help out if I could," you reply.
            
            "There certainly is, dears!" Lumia says, grabbing one hand each from both of you. "We hadn't been keeping up with things for a while, and we're going to need several new joyful bundles for mothers in need in the coming year. If Eira wants to help, I can't say no!"
            
            "Yeah. I don't really feel like backing out at all, either, which is weirder if you ask me," the multi-winged woman confirms, rocking her arm in Lumia's grip to bump into yours.
            |You find Lumia there once again. This time she's [rand
                |seated much more comfortably in her throne.
                |Stretching beside the throne.
                |eyeing a piece of parchment by the light of a glowing sconce.
            ] When she sees the two of you, she bounces over in a very un-godlike fashion and greets you.
            
            "Hello again, Eira, [pc.name]. To what do I owe the pleasure?"
            
            "We were actually wondering if the maternity wing needed any further assistance. Seeing as the last time worked out so well," Eira asks, idly rubbing her stomach.
            
            "As a matter of fact... I just received word of a woman in need before you arrived. I think we can get just the thing to help her out," the goddess says, taking your hands in hers. "As long as [pc.name] is willing as well."
            
            "[pc.dcb
                |Hell yeah!
                |Of course!
                |You, like, better believe it!
            ]" you reply.
        ]
        
        "Perfect! You guys wait right over here," the goddess says, pulling you to the door you know leads down to her inner sanctum, "and I'll be right back."
        
        "Sure thing, Lumes," Eira says as she goes, prompting the goddess to stop and give her a teasing honk on the boob.
        
        After that she disappears down into her sanctum, but she's true to her word when it comes to her timeline. No more than a handful of minutes pass before she's rushing back up the stairs. Cradled in her hands is a faintly glowing orb that she holds protectively close to her chest. The thing looks like a miniature sun, though its glow is much less harsh. Small wisps of smoky light pool around it and curl between her fingers like heavy mist.
        
        "Okay. Just hold still for a second here," Lumia says, more to the orb than to Eira.
        
        The swift-winged courier stands with a casual smile, laughing as the goddess presses the ball against her stomach. She then gasps when it sinks into her skin, just above where her womb would be.
        
        "[var0
            |Oh! That's warm!
            |I'll never -ah- get used to that feeling,
        ]" she says, rubbing the spot as Lumia steps away.
        
        "Don't let me keep you! You two have fun now," she says, giving you a wink. "Remember, anything you do will result in a pregnancy, so have a little fun."
        
        With that, the goddess heads back down into her sanctum, leaving you alone with Eira.
rows.translation:
好啊！我完全没意见。如果可以避免那些家庭失去孩子，我当然不希望看到这种事情发生。”

“太好了！那你就带路吧。”她说道，然后快步走过来为你开门。 
        
        在前往王座厅的路上，艾拉漂浮在你上方，欣赏着主厅里那些华丽的挂毯，而你则继续前行。周围大多一片寂静，但仍有几名女武神在忙碌着，她们或是正在执行日常任务，或是正在休息放松。 在你们走到走廊尽头那扇巨大的双开门之前，没有人阻止你们。你们轻轻地推开了门。
        
        [var0
            |卢米娅盘腿坐在王座上，双手托着下巴望着门口。当她看到你时，立刻伸直双腿跳下来迎接你。她看着你们两个人，脸上露出了那种完全不符合女神形象的兴奋神情，然后笑了起来。
            
            艾拉！看到你又能交到新朋友，我真是太高兴了！我究竟做了什么，才能有幸与你们两位共度这段时光呢？希望这件事一定比报告的送达或存储情况的评估要有趣得多吧，”她问道。

“就是关于这件事。 我们在想，是否需要让霜精灵的婴儿来承担生育任务呢。艾拉表现出了兴趣，我就告诉她如果可以的话，我会帮忙的。”你这样回答道。

“确实需要啊，亲爱的们！”卢米娅说着，握住了你们两人的手。 我们已经有一段时间没有关注这些事情了，所以在来年，我们确实需要为那些有需要的母亲们准备一些新的礼物包。如果艾拉愿意帮忙的话，我当然不会拒绝！”

“是啊，说实话，我也没什么想退出的念头，这倒有点奇怪吧……”这位长着多只翅膀的女性说道，一边说着，一边在卢米娅的搀扶下晃动着自己的手臂，让你的手臂也跟着晃动起来。
            |你又一次在那里找到了Lumia。这一次，她…… [rand
                |她坐在王座上，显得更加舒适自在。
                |站在王座旁。
                |在闪烁的烛光下，他仔细端详着那张羊皮纸。
            ] 当她看到你们两个人时，她以一种完全不符合神明形象的方式欢快地跑过来向你们打招呼。

“又见到你啦，艾拉…… [pc.name]我究竟该怎样才能报答你的这份好意呢？”

“其实我们一直在考虑，是否还需要为产科病房提供进一步的帮助。毕竟上一次的合作非常成功，”艾拉边说边闲闲地揉了揉肚子。

“事实上……在你到来之前，我刚刚收到消息，说有位妇女正处于困境中。我想我们正好有办法帮助她，”女神握住你的手说道，“只要…… [pc.name] 我也愿意。[pc.dcb
                |太棒了！
                |当然可以！
                |你绝对应该相信这一点！
            ]你回复吧。
        ]
        
        太好了！你们就在这里等着吧，”女神说道，然后拉着你们走向那扇通往她内室的门，“我马上就回来。”

“当然，卢梅斯，”艾拉边说边走开了，这让女神停下了脚步，调皮地敲了敲她的胸脯。
        
        之后，她便回到了自己的密室中。不过，她在遵守时间安排这件事上确实说到做到了。没过几分钟，她就急匆匆地跑上了楼梯，手中紧紧抱着一个散发着微弱光芒的球体，将其护在胸前。 那个东西看起来像一颗微型太阳，只不过它的光芒要柔和得多。一些烟雾般的光芒在它周围缭绕，然后像浓雾一样从她的指缝间流淌而过。

“好了，先在这里保持不动一会儿，”卢米娅说道，这话更多的是是对那个光球说的，而不是对艾拉说的。
        
        那只翅膀敏捷的信使站在那里，脸上带着随意的微笑，而女神将那个球按在她的腹部，她笑着。当球沉入她的皮肤，正好位于她的子宫所在的位置上方时，她不禁倒吸了一口凉气。[var0
            |哦！真暖和啊！
            |我永远都无法习惯那种感觉……
        ]她说着，一边揉着那个地方，一边让卢米娅走开。

“别让我妨碍你们了！你们俩好好享受吧，”她说着，还朝你眨了眨眼。“记住，无论你们做什么，都可能会怀孕的，所以尽情享受吧。”

说完，这位女神便回到了她的圣所，把你和艾拉留在了那里。

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: The normally excitable valkyrie looks very mellow, and her head-wings give a flap that lets you see her sparkling eyes are half lidded. "You feeling ok?" you ask, guiding her back toward the door. "Better than ever," she says, giggling as her hip-wings go through a similar series of flutters. "We should hurry up though. My wings are already shaky, and I don't know how long my legs are going to last." You try your best to accommodate her, walking through the halls at a brisk pace on your way back to her room. Things are mostly quiet, but Eira does get a few weird looks when her fellow valkyries see her walking. None of them stop you, however, and you soon arrive at her door. Not a moment passes between you crossing her threshold and her tackling you from behind with a hug. Passion boils off her body in waves, and she kisses your back before letting go. Then she darts around to your front, and her body shudders as she lifts a foot or so into the air. She's flushed right down to her chest, and waiting for you to suggest anything to do. On top of that, it feels like Lumia was right. Just off of raw energy alone, you feel like she'd get pregnant from cuddles and kisses at this point. Your life energy just needs to intertwine, and you think you know the perfect way.
rows.translation: 这位平时总是充满活力的女武神此刻显得格外宁静，她的头翼轻轻扇动，让你看到她那双闪烁着光芒的眼睛半闭着。 “你没事吧？”你问道，一边搀着她往门口走去。 比以前任何时候都要好，”她笑着说，同时她的臀部翅膀也开始了类似的颤动。“不过我们得快点了，我的翅膀已经开始发抖了，也不知道我的腿还能坚持多久。” 你尽力配合她，加快脚步穿过走廊，朝着她的房间走去。 周围大多时候都很安静，但当其他女武神看到艾拉走路时，确实会向她投来一些奇怪的目光。不过，没有人会阻拦你，你很快就来到了她的门前。 你一跨进她的家门，她立刻从背后抱住了你。 她的热情如波浪般从身体里散发出来，她亲吻你的后背，然后松开手。接着她迅速移到你的面前，身体微微颤抖着，将一只脚抬到了半空中。她的脸颊已经涨得通红，此刻正在等待你给出下一步该做什么的指示。 除此之外，它还…… 感觉起来…… 就像卢米娅说得对。仅仅从纯粹的能量角度来看，你就觉得，只要和她依偎在一起、亲吻她，她就会怀孕。你们的生命能量只需要相互交织在一起，而你觉得自己知道完美的方式。

"Hmm, on second thought, I was hoping for a kid to raise myself," you say, hoping she isn't disappointed.
        
        "Hey, that's totally fine. I understand not everyone is up for that aspect of maternity duty. We can still hang out whenever, though," Eira replies, patting you on the shoulder.

rows.translation:

Happens a lot with Siorcana too, people tend to stay as either alphas or betas to maintain a cultural connection. Lumia tends not to force them to come back if she can help it. Any chance she can get for them to live normal lives is one she'll probably take, especially if they show they want it," she says. 
    
    "If she can afford to leave them there, that sounds like a good thing."
    
    "I think it is," she agrees. "Is there anything else you wanted to ask about?"

你的邮件工作职责和产假职责之间有没有发生过重叠？这么问可能有点奇怪，但是……[pc.isBimbo

    ]你问得倒好。

“嗯，确实是这样。尤其是在刚开始的时候，我…… [silly
        |扮演了鹳鸟的角色

“那么你认为自己还是能够胜任这个任务的吗？”

“当然可以！我又不是忘了如何保护婴儿的安全。 [eira.isPregnant
        |如果有需要的话，我应该能够直接把这个孩子交给它的新妈妈吧，”她说着，轻拍着自己的肚子，嘴角勾起了一丝淡淡的微笑。
        |我知道在没有寒冷和风干扰的情况下，自己能够以多快的速度飞行；也知道在天气过热时，该如何让自己保持凉爽。而且，我绝对是你们见过的最快捷的换尿布高手！”她一边说着，一边用手指一一列举着自己的这些优点。
    ]
    
    听起来你之前挺热衷于这个工作的，是什么让你放弃了呢？”

“就像我之前说的，这种工作更适合那些在为婴儿保暖和喂食方面比较方便的女性。只要有足够的布料和适当的包裹方法，同样的事情也可以做到，但人工护理带来的亲密接触能让婴儿习惯这种触感，这样他们一出生就可以直接交给母亲照顾。因为当时有其他很多工作要处理，所以我一直没有仔细考虑过这个问题，但如果再有机会的话，我也不会拒绝的。

“我不知道，我想这取决于具体的情况吧。我觉得大多数情况下，他们会一直留下来，直到确信孩子将来能够独立生活。有时候，这意味着他们会短暂停留，以确保孩子的母亲能够处理好一切；而有时候，这意味着他们会留上很多年，直到孩子长大成人。 我记得听说过我的一位同僚，他留在了贾西拉，还真的成为了某个贵族后宫的一员。在希奥尔卡纳，这种情况也很常见——人们往往会选择留在那里，成为那些贵族的“阿尔法”或“贝塔”，以此来维持与当地文化的联系。 如果可以的话，Lumia通常不会强迫他们回来。只要有机会让他们过上正常的生活，她肯定会抓住这个机会，尤其是当他们表现出自己真正想要这样的生活时。”她说。 
    
    如果她有能力把它们留在那里，那应该是一件好事。”

“我也这么认为，”她同意道，“还有其他你想问的事情吗？

    "Did your mail duties ever intermingle with maternity duty? It sounds kind of weird to ask, but[pc.isBimbo
        |, like,
    ] were any of the [pc.isCunning
        |bundles you had to deliver bundles of joy?
        |packages you had to deliver children?
    ]" you ask.
    
    "Well, yeah. Especially early on, I [silly
        |played the stork
        |delivered newborns
    ] a couple times. I probably still could for short trips. These days for longer flights they prefer women who are, erm... a little warmer and softer. On top of that they favor girls who are already nursing. It's better for the baby if they can stop to feed them and take a few days on the trip to make sure nothing goes wrong. Safety over speed," she explains.
    
    "So you think you could still handle it?"
    
    "Yeah! It's not like I forgot how to keep a baby safe. [eira.isPregnant
        |I could probably deliver this one straight through to its new mom if need be," she says, tapping her stomach with a faint smile curling her lips.
        |I know how fast I can fly without the cold and the wind causing trouble, or how to keep them cool if it gets too hot. I'm also the fastest diaper changer you've ever seen," she says, listing off the traits on her fingers.
    ]
    
    "It sounds like you were into it, what made you stop?"
    
    "Like I said, It's better for girls who have an easier time keeping them warm and feeding them. The same can be done with enough cloth and bundling, but a personal touch has the added effect of keeping the child accustomed to touch, so they can be handed right off to the mother. I never really asked because of how busy it was with other deliveries, but if I was asked to do it again I wouldn't say no,"
    
    "Fair enough. With all these deliveries, do the surrogate mothers ever get too attached to the babies?" you ask. Eira puts a finger to her chin, contemplating for a moment before she answers.
    
    "I'd be lying if I said it never happened, but usually it happens near to the end of someone's career when they were already having thoughts about settling down. In which case they can most often just keep the baby, and a new surrogate is chosen. Apart from that it happens a lot less. If someone feels particularly attached to the child, they usually stay on as a protective assignment if the parents are amicable to that. That way the original mother and the surrogate can bond over that connection they share," she explains.
    
    "How often do they usually stay?"
    
    "I don't know, depends on the person I guess. I think most often they stay until they feel the kid will be ok long term. Sometimes that means staying for a short time while they make sure the mother can handle everything, and sometimes it means they stay for years, till a child is full grown. Happens a lot with Siorcana too, people tend to stay as either alphas or betas to maintain a cultural connection. Lumia tends not to force them to come back if she can help it. Any chance she can get for them to live normal lives is one she'll probably take, especially if they show they want it," she says. 
    
    "If she can afford to leave them there, that sounds like a good thing."
    
    "I think it is," she agrees. "Is there anything else you wanted to ask about?"
    '

rows.original:
[var0
        |"I mean, I'm pregnant right now and you're the one who did it, so I'd like to think I've thought a bit about it. Honestly I thought it would weigh more. I thought I was gonna be bogged down and maybe even unable to fly. I guess that was kind of over-worrying, but it hasn't really affected my flight at all. Maybe I have to account for a bit of extra oomph when I'm turning or landing to make sure the baby doesn't get hurt, but I hardly notice it in the moment," she says.
        
        "I still don't think I'd just do this willy nilly all the time like some of the girls, but I could get used to it on occasion. The feeling of investing my strength in something that's alive is incredibly... warm."
        
        [var1
            |You know exactly how she feels. Cradling a life inside you is worth every temporary downside. At least after the fact...
            |You can't exactly relate, but she makes it sound a lot more comfortable than you would have thought.
        ]
        |"You mean like having a child myself? I'd be lying if I said I hadn't. I'm certainly not ready to permanently settle down, but if it's to help someone who otherwise couldn't be with child... I think you'd be hard pressed to find a valkyrie who hasn't at least considered it. Technically anyone can do the maternity duty, you just have to ask. On rare occasions people who have said it's ok in the past get commanded to do it in an emergency, but that's specifically for people who don't mind getting knocked up or knocking someone up at a moment's notice," she says, indicating her belly.
        
        "That's not me. I don't think I could ever just up and drop everything for a several month go at being a surrogate. If it were planned ahead of time, though, I might be able to be convinced. You weren't planning to convince me right now, were you?" she teases, raising an eyebrow.
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |我的意思是，我现在怀孕了，而这个孩子是你让我怀上的，所以我觉得自己应该已经仔细考虑过这个事情了。说实话，我原本以为怀孕会对我飞行造成很大的影响，甚至会让我无法飞行。不过我想，我可能是想得太多了，实际上怀孕并没有对我的飞行能力产生任何影响。 也许在转弯或降落时，我需要稍微多用一点力，以确保宝宝不会受到伤害，但当时我几乎感觉不到这一点，”她说。

“我还是觉得，我不会像有些女孩那样总是随意地这样做，但偶尔这样做，我应该也能习惯吧。 将自己的力量投入到有生命的事物中去，这种感觉真是无比……温暖。
        
        [var1
            |你完全明白她的感受。怀揣着一个生命在体内，所经历的一切暂时的不便都是值得的。至少在事后看来是这样……
            |你可能无法完全理解她的感受，但她表达的方式确实比你想象中要自然、轻松得多。
        ]
        |你是说像我自己生孩子那样吗？如果我说自己没有考虑过，那肯定是骗人的。我当然还没准备好安定下来，但如果是为了帮助那些 otherwise 无法生育的人……我想，很难找到一个女武神不会考虑过这个选择。 从技术上讲，任何人都可以承担这项生育任务，只要主动提出来就行。不过在极少数情况下，那些之前表示愿意承担的人也可能会在紧急情况下被要求履行这一职责——当然，这些情况通常是针对那些不介意随时可能怀孕，或者不介意在短时间内让别人怀孕的人来说的，”她边说边指了指自己的肚子。
        
        那不是我。我觉得我绝对不可能为了当几个月的代孕母亲而抛下所有事情。不过，如果这件事事先有计划的话，或许我能被说服。不过你现在并不是想说服我，对吧？她挑逗地挑了挑眉毛。
    ]

rows.original: "So how does the average day of mail delivery go?" you ask. "I saw some of your work, but it all seemed rather hectic." "Oh that was just while everything was in a tousle with the return to the palace. It's normally much more relaxed. I aim to get everything delivered as quickly as possible. That way everyone receives their letters and packages as swiftly as possible, and I can get back to my free time," the beflighted beauty says. She crosses her legs midair, raising her chin proudly. "So... what's a regular day like, then?" you continue probing. She didn't actually answer you before. "It's, well, much the same, but with less mail and therefore less fluster. Should I not use the utmost haste in my work?" she asks, turning her face in some measure of obstinance. "I didn't mean to accuse you of anything, but the people I delivered to said they preferred when you used to stay long enough to talk to. Are you really sure you feel more relaxed this way? It sounds like you used to be relaxed even when you stayed to talk." It takes her a second to respond, and when she does you can hear a tinge of doubt wiping away her previous insistence. "But I never really had anything to say. I just listened to them talk about what notes they had received and what their families or friends were up to," she says. "Sometimes having someone there to listen makes it that much better. It helps other people relax." "I guess I hadn't thought about how soothing it was just to hear about the lives of people I don't know. Was I too brash when I hastened my process? Having more time alone certainly doesn't seem a worthy trade when it's in my face like this," she says, briefly downcast. She looks up at you hopefully after another moment's reflection. "I should hope it's not too late to go back to that older method." "Do you really think it'd be that easy?" she asks, averting her eyes. "Won't it be weird if I go back to talking to people like nothing changed in the first place? I haven't exactly been enjoying my time alone, but surely they've grown used to not having me stay, haven't they?" "[pc.isBimbo |Oh no! They loved you with a capital L! I'm sure they'd be [silly |Bomb Dot Com |just delighted ] if you wanted to sit and listen again. |Not at all. I'm sure anyone you've delivered to before would be delighted to have you sit and listen again. ] Some might even ask you to join in on the conversation, but I think you'll do just as well then as you are now," you reply. "O-of course I will. I haven't forgotten how to talk with people. Thank you, though. Maybe that jolt is enough to get me out of a stubborn funk. I think I've quite missed hearing about the things in the letters I deliver," she says. The proud look from before has returned in full, but now her smile is full of more excitement than boastfulness. "In the meantime, though, was there anything else you wanted to hear about?" Well? Is there?
rows.translation: 那么，平常寄送邮件的工作流程是怎样的呢？”你问道，“我看过你们的一些工作，看起来似乎挺忙碌的。” “哦，那只是因为在回到宫殿之后，一切工作都变得杂乱无章而已。平常情况下，工作节奏要轻松得多。我的目标就是尽快完成所有寄送工作，这样大家就能尽快收到自己的信件和包裹，而我也能重新享受属于我的闲暇时间了。”这位轻盈美丽的少女说道。她将双腿交叉在半空中，骄傲地抬起了下巴。 那么……平常的一天都是怎么过的呢？”你继续追问。其实她之前并没有回答你这个问题。 “嗯，差不多就是这样的，只不过收到的邮件会少一些，因此也不会那么忙乱了。不过我在工作时还是应该尽最大努力尽快完成工作吧？”她带着一丝固执的神情问道。 我并不是想指责你什么，但是那些我送过去的人都说，他们更喜欢你以前会留下来多聊一会儿的样子。你真的确定这样你会觉得更放松吗？听起来，以前你留下来聊天时，反而会更放松啊。 她花了一秒钟才回应，当她开口时，你可以听到一丝疑虑正在消散她先前的坚持。 “但我其实从来没有什么话要说。我只是听他们谈论自己收到了哪些消息，以及他们的家人或朋友都在忙些什么，”她说。 有时候，有一个人在身边倾听，确实会让一切变得好很多。这能帮助别人放松下来。” “我想我之前从未想过，仅仅是聆听那些我不认识的人的故事，也会带来如此舒缓的感觉。当我急于改变自己的方式时，是不是太鲁莽了？现在看来，如果能够多一些独处的时间，显然并不是一个糟糕的代价。” 她沉思了一会儿，随后抬起头，带着一丝希望地看着你：“希望现在还来得及，能够重新回到原来的方法上来。 你真觉得会那么简单吗？”她问道，同时移开了视线。“如果我回去后还是像以前一样和别人交谈，难道不会显得很奇怪吗？其实我一个人待着也并不是很开心，但他们应该已经习惯了我现在的样子了吧…… 不是 他们不是想让我留下吗？[pc.isBimbo |哦不！他们是真心爱你的！我敢肯定，他们一定会…… [silly |Bomb Dot Com |非常高兴 ] 如果你想再坐下来听一遍的话。 |完全不会。我相信，你之前服务过的任何人，都会很高兴再次让你来聆听他们的故事。 ] 有些人甚至可能会邀请你加入他们的谈话，但我觉得你到时候的表现也会和现在一样好，”你回答道。 “哦，当然会。我可没有忘记怎么和别人交流。不过还是谢谢你，也许这个小小的刺激足以让我摆脱这种固执的状态。 我想，我真的很怀念听到那些写在信里的内容，”她说。之前那种自豪的神情又完全显现出来了，不过现在的笑容中更多是兴奋，而不是骄傲。“不过，在此之前，还有其他你想了解的事情吗？那么？有吗？
rows.raw: ' "So how does the average day of mail delivery go?" you ask. "I saw some of your work, but it all seemed rather hectic." "Oh that was just while everything was in a tousle with the return to the palace. It's normally much more relaxed. I aim to get everything delivered as quickly as possible. That way everyone receives their letters and packages as swiftly as possible, and I can get back to my free time," the beflighted beauty says. She crosses her legs midair, raising her chin proudly. "So... what's a regular day like, then?" you continue probing. She didn't actually answer you before. "It's, well, much the same, but with less mail and therefore less fluster. Should I not use the utmost haste in my work?" she asks, turning her face in some measure of obstinance. "I didn't mean to accuse you of anything, but the people I delivered to said they preferred when you used to stay long enough to talk to. Are you really sure you feel more relaxed this way? It sounds like you used to be relaxed even when you stayed to talk." It takes her a second to respond, and when she does you can hear a tinge of doubt wiping away her previous insistence. "But I never really had anything to say. I just listened to them talk about what notes they had received and what their families or friends were up to," she says. "Sometimes having someone there to listen makes it that much better. It helps other people relax." "I guess I hadn't thought about how soothing it was just to hear about the lives of people I don't know. Was I too brash when I hastened my process? Having more time alone certainly doesn't seem a worthy trade when it's in my face like this," she says, briefly downcast. She looks up at you hopefully after another moment's reflection. "I should hope it's not too late to go back to that older method." "Do you really think it'd be that easy?" she asks, averting her eyes. "Won't it be weird if I go back to talking to people like nothing changed in the first place? I haven't exactly been enjoying my time alone, but surely they've grown used to not having me stay, haven't they?" "[pc.isBimbo |Oh no! They loved you with a capital L! I'm sure they'd be [silly |Bomb Dot Com |just delighted ] if you wanted to sit and listen again. |Not at all. I'm sure anyone you've delivered to before would be delighted to have you sit and listen again. ] Some might even ask you to join in on the conversation, but I think you'll do just as well then as you are now," you reply. "O-of course I will. I haven't forgotten how to talk with people. Thank you, though. Maybe that jolt is enough to get me out of a stubborn funk. I think I've quite missed hearing about the things in the letters I deliver," she says. The proud look from before has returned in full, but now her smile is full of more excitement than boastfulness. "In the meantime, though, was there anything else you wanted to hear about?" Well? Is there? '

rows.original: [flags.EIRA_TALK_EYES |Would you mind explaining that thing with your eyes again?" |[pc.dcb |So what's up with your eyes? |If it's okay with you, may I ask why you keep your eyes closed all the time? |Hmmm. How can you see when your eyes are always closed!? I didn't want to ask but I can help it I, like, gotta know, ] ] you ask, staring at the fair-skinned valkyrie. "[flags.EIRA_TALK_EYES |Sure, it's no big deal |Oh, I'm sorry, I tend to forget I'm doing it. It's a little unsettling I think, but it's not painful or anything ]," she replies, and then simply opens her eyes. Instead of [flags.EIRA_TALK_EYES |what you'd see on a normal person |what you'd normally expect to see ], her eyelids shield a sea of prismatic stars, similar in color to the aurora strand in Lumia's inner sanctum. She's right about it being unsettling, but it's not like it's terrifying or anything. "It's a blessing from Lumia herself, one meant to help me see. When I was little, there was a day when the sun went dark. It was only for a few minutes, and the royal diviner from Khor'minos had bid people not to look a week or so before. I'm sure I wasn't the only one, but I watched the whole time. It was fascinating, as if an immense darkness was covering the sun, so that only a halo of light was visible. I went to sleep that night in awe of the sky, but when I woke my vision was gone. For some of those who looked, healing magic was enough to repair their sight, but mine was too far gone," she explains. The pools of light don't really move, but you can see her eyelids shift as she looks down at her hands. "At least, they were too far gone until the goddess herself answered my prayers. I wanted so greatly to do something more, and Lumia found me moping in my home. She restored my sight and more when I became a valkyrie. Sure, it was a little different than she intended, but I don't mind," she says. "Different? What was the intention?" you ask. It doesn't seem like the kind of thing that wouldn't be deliberate. "When she made me a valkyrie, she intended to use some of that power to heal my eyes with the power of creation. Instead, she created something new. Whether my eyes are open or not, I have perfect vision. It's... it's like my head is a giant eyeball that I can focus in any direction," she says. "[var0 |It's a little different, but what you're describing sounds like the powers of a crystal ball or scrying pool. It's [pc.isBimbo |fascinimicating |fascinating ], like you're constantly divining the world around you subconsciously. |That sounds amazing. Being able to see everything around you and even behind you without moving your head must help so much when you're flying. ] Although, does it get uncomfortable? If you see even when your eyelids are shut, can you ever[pc.isBimbo |, like, ] stop seeing?" you ask. "I can, just as easily as I could before. It's weird to think about it, but I even blink, I guess. It feels just like it did before, like a pair of eyes, except they don't get eyelashes or other gunk stuck in them, and they remain open even under the water if I want them too. I can still close off my vision if I want, or if I need to sleep. New girls get curious sometimes, so I've had to explain it a bunch. Never gets any easier." "No, no, That helps plenty to answer my question. Now I know what's up with your eyes!" "You certainly do. Did you have any other questions planned for today, or was that all?" [var2 |"Hold on one moment. I have one more question, but it involves another member of my party. You won't need to explain it all again, but would you be willing to show her your eyes?" you ask. "Sure. I don't see why not. I'm intrigued now," she replies. Holding a hand up, you sprint out of the room, stopping in the hall when you find Atugia patiently seated on one of the benches and chatting with a pair of girls who appear to have just returned from the training halls. "Good! You stuck around! Am I interrupting something or do you have a minute?" you ask, looking between her and the two valkyries. "N-no, I'm free, we were just talkin' about the kinds of trainin' we do. What's up?" she asks back. She stands, waving goodbye to the pair as they stand to leave. "This valkyrie, Eira, you've got to see her eyes. It's easier to see than to explain," you say, starting back in the direction of Eira's room. "Eira, isn't that one of the delivery girls? The head delivery girl? There are so many more valkyries than I thought there would be," she replies, letting you pull her all the way back to the divine messenger herself. You plop her down in front of Eira, who's still floating a few inches above the ground with her legs crossed and an amused grin on her face. "This must be her, then? Well, girl, I don't know why [pc.name] is so insistent, but here," she says, opening her eyes without so much as a flourish. Atugia gasps, looking so rapidly between you and the other woman that her bangs swing near horizontally. "It's! It's!? I'm sorry. It's really cool lookin', but I don't know exactly why you'd pull me aside for it," she says, slumping her shoulders. "[pc.dcb |It's just like your neck, you numbskull! |It's kind of like your neck, isn't it? |It's, like, the exact same thing as your neck except different, isn't it!? ]" you say, pointing at her eyes and then at the confused dullahan's starscape of a throat. Eira seems to notice it for the first time, raising an eyebrow and pivoting forward. She holds Atugia by the chin, pushing her face up and examining the sea of stars that makes up her neck. The grounded woman lets her look, flushing a bit at the intensity of her attention but otherwise remaining still and silent. The colors are different, but there's no doubt a similarity exists between that deep and endless blue and the bright and sharp aurora in the mail-mistress's gaze. "Have you also been blessed by a god? Not all the Living Gods had incidents like this, but I know for sure I'm not the only one. I don't recognize this feeling you exude though, what is it?" she asks, her face a mask of curious wariness. "N-no! It's a curse, not a blessing. I was marked by a Wraith that killed my tribe. I was left alive, but cursed with this mark and, um, the ability to remove my head..." Atugia explains. She fidgets sheepishly, oblivious to the wide eyed stare the angelic valkyrie has adopted. "Remove your head? May I see?" she asks. Her expression remains awestruck as your companion reaches up and lets her head drop into her hands with a pomf. She doesn't reach out to grab for it, but she does poke at the other girl's cheek and tap on the glassy surface between her shoulders. "[silly |It boggles the mind |I couldn't imagine such a thing ]. Have you spoken with Lumia about this? I think you should. It's above me, but she might know something more," Eira says, rubbing her chin. "[var1 |Yeah, she didn't have any real answers. It's okay, though. I'm glad you all want to help, |No. We spoke briefly, but she was more surprised to see me than anythin'. Do you think it would be a good idea, [pc.name]? ]" Tui [var1 |says |talk ], putting her head back in its place and turning to you. "[var1 |I'm sure we'll find some answers somewhere, |It might be. Perhaps she'll be able to find out something else about the protective magic that was upon you. At the very least it can't hurt, ]" you say. The two of you say your goodbyes to Eira, and head back to the central halls of the palace. [var1 | |Maybe you can find out something further about this from Lumia herself. ] ]
rows.translation: [flags.EIRA_TALK_EYES |你能再用你的眼睛解释一下那个东西吗？ |[pc.dcb |你的眼睛怎么了？ |如果你不介意的话，我可以问一下，为什么你总是闭着眼睛呢？ |嗯……当你一直闭着眼睛的时候，怎么还能看到东西呢！？我本来不想问的，但实在忍不住，我总得知道才行啊。 ] ] 你这么问，同时凝视着那位皮肤白皙的瓦尔基里……[flags.EIRA_TALK_EYES |当然，这没什么大不了的。 |哦，对不起，我有时候会忘记自己正在做这件事。我觉得这有点让人不安，但并不会感到疼痛或什么不适。 ]她这样回答，然后只是睁开了眼睛。” 而不是…… [flags.EIRA_TALK_EYES |一个正常人会表现出来的样子 |你通常会期待看到的内容 ]她的双眼遮掩着一片由彩色光点构成的海洋，这些光点的颜色与Lumia内室中那道极光相似。她说这种景象令人不安，确实如此，但倒也不至于令人感到恐惧或害怕什么。 “这是Lumia亲自赐予我的恩赐，目的是帮助我看清真相。 我小时候，有那么一天，太阳突然变暗了。这一现象只持续了几分钟，而来自科尔米诺斯的皇家占卜师曾告诫人们，在那之后的大约一周内都不要外出看太阳。我敢肯定，不止我一个人这么做了，但我确实全程都守在窗边观察着这一现象。 那景象真是令人着迷，仿佛有一片无边的黑暗笼罩了太阳，只留下了一圈淡淡的光芒。那天晚上，我在对天空的惊叹中进入了梦乡，然而醒来后，我的视力却消失了。对于某些人来说，治愈魔法足以恢复他们的视力，但我的情况已经太严重了，”她解释道。 那些光点其实并没有移动，但你可以看到她的 eyelids 在她低头看着自己的双手时微微动了动。 至少，在女神亲自回应我的祈祷之前，一切都已经走得太远了。我如此渴望能够做些什么，而卢米娅发现我正闷闷不乐地待在家里。当我成为女武神后，她不仅恢复了我的视力，还给了我更多的力量。当然，结果有些偏离了她最初的设想，但我并不在意。”她说。 不同？这样做的意图是什么呢？”你问道。这种事情似乎不可能是无心之举。 “当她将我变成女武神的时候，她本打算利用那种力量，用创造之力来治愈我的双眼。然而，她却创造出了完全不同的东西。现在，无论我的眼睛是否睁开，我都能拥有清晰的视野。就好像……我的整个头部就是一个巨大的眼球，我可以将其焦点对准任何方向。”她说道。 "[var0 |虽然有点不同，但你描述的内容听起来就像是水晶球或占卜池所拥有的那种能力。 [pc.isBimbo |令人着迷的 |引人入胜 ]就好像你在无意识地不断地解读周围的世界一样。 |那听起来太棒了。在飞行时，无需转动头部就能看到周围甚至身后的所有景象，这肯定会让飞行体验变得更加便捷。 ] 不过，这样会不会让人感到不适呢？即使闭着眼睛，你也能感觉到吗？[pc.isBimbo |就像，比如说…… ] 不再看到东西了？”你问道。 “我可以，就像以前一样轻松地看到东西。仔细想想其实挺奇怪的，但我还是会眨眼睛的。那种感觉和以前一样，就像有一双眼睛在看着我，只不过现在这些‘眼睛’上不会再有睫毛或其他东西粘住，而且如果我愿意的话，即使在水中它们也会保持睁开的状态。 如果我想的话，或者当我需要睡觉的时候，我还是可以闭上眼睛的。新来的女孩们有时候会感到好奇，所以我不得不反复向她们解释这个原因。不过，这确实从来都不是一件容易的事。” “不，不，你这样的解释已经帮我解答了很多疑问了。现在我终于明白你眼睛的情况是怎么回事了！确实如此。你今天还有其他问题要问吗，还是就这些而已？ [var2 |等一下，我还有一个问题，不过这个问题涉及到我团队中的另一位成员。你不需要再从头解释一遍，但你能让她看看你的眼睛吗？”你问道。 “当然可以。我觉得没什么问题。现在我反而很好奇了，”她回答道。 你举手示意，然后冲出房间，在走廊里停了下来，发现阿图吉亚正耐心地坐在长椅上，正和两个看起来刚从训练场回来的女孩聊天。 “太好了！你还在这里！我是打扰你们了，还是你有时间陪我聊一会儿？”你边问，边将目光在她和那两个女武神之间来回移动。 不，我没事，我们只是在讨论一些训练内容而已。怎么了？”她反问道。她站起身，向那两个人挥手道别，然后他们也准备离开了。 “这个女武神，艾拉，你一定要看看她的眼睛。那种眼神，光是描述出来都很难让人理解。”你边说边往艾拉的房间方向走去。 艾拉，那个不就是送货女之一吗？还是头号送货女吧？维京女战士的数量比我想象中要多得多啊，”她说道，同时让你把她带到了那位神圣的信使面前。 你把她放在艾拉面前，而艾拉仍然悬浮在离地面几英寸的地方，双腿交叉坐着，脸上带着一丝有趣的笑容。 那么，这个人一定就是她了吧？唉，姑娘，我真不知道为什么…… [pc.name] 他这么坚持，但这里就是了，”她说道，睁开眼睛，动作却并不夸张。 阿图吉亚倒吸了一口凉气，她的目光在你们两人之间快速切换，以至于她的刘海几乎都横竖晃动了。 “这……这是！？对不起，这个设计确实很酷，但我真的不明白你为什么要把我叫到一边来谈这个。”她说着，肩膀耷拉了下来。[pc.dcb |这就跟你的脖子一样，你这个笨蛋！ |它有点像你的脖子，对吧？ |它其实和你的脖子一模一样，只不过有些不同而已，对吧！？ ]你是这么说的，”他说着，一边指着她的眼睛，一边又看向那个困惑不已的杜拉汉那布满“星星”的喉咙。 艾拉似乎是第一次注意到这一点，她挑了挑眉毛，然后向前倾了倾身子。她抓住阿图吉亚的下巴，把她的脸往上推，仔细观察她脖子上那片“星星海”。 "[flags.EIRA_TALK_EYES |Sure, it's no big deal |Oh, I'm sorry, I tend to forget I'm doing it. It's a little unsettling I think, but it's not painful or anything ]," she replies, and then simply opens her eyes. Instead of [flags.EIRA_TALK_EYES |what you'd see on a normal person |what you'd normally expect to see ], her eyelids shield a sea of prismatic stars, similar in color to the aurora strand in Lumia's inner sanctum. She's right about it being unsettling, but it's not like it's terrifying or anything. "It's a blessing from Lumia herself, one meant to help me see. When I was little, there was a day when the sun went dark. It was only for a few minutes, and the royal diviner from Khor'minos had bid people not to look a week or so before. I'm sure I wasn't the only one, but I watched the whole time. It was fascinating, as if an immense darkness was covering the sun, so that only a halo of light was visible. I went to sleep that night in awe of the sky, but when I woke my vision was gone. For some of those who looked, healing magic was enough to repair their sight, but mine was too far gone," she explains. The pools of light don't really move, but you can see her eyelids shift as she looks down at her hands. "At least, they were too far gone until the goddess herself answered my prayers. I wanted so greatly to do something more, and Lumia found me moping in my home. She restored my sight and more when I became a valkyrie. Sure, it was a little different than she intended, but I don't mind," she says. "Different? What was the intention?" you ask. It doesn't seem like the kind of thing that wouldn't be deliberate. "When she made me a valkyrie, she intended to use some of that power to heal my eyes with the power of creation. Instead, she created something new. Whether my eyes are open or not, I have perfect vision. It's... it's like my head is a giant eyeball that I can focus in any direction," she says. "[var0 |It's a little different, but what you're describing sounds like the powers of a crystal ball or scrying pool. It's [pc.isBimbo |fascinimicating |fascinating ], like you're constantly divining the world around you subconsciously. |That sounds amazing. Being able to see everything around you and even behind you without moving your head must help so much when you're flying. ] Although, does it get uncomfortable? If you see even when your eyelids are shut, can you ever[pc.isBimbo |, like, ] stop seeing?" you ask. "I can, just as easily as I could before. It's weird to think about it, but I even blink, I guess. It feels just like it did before, like a pair of eyes, except they don't get eyelashes or other gunk stuck in them, and they remain open even under the water if I want them too. I can still close off my vision if I want, or if I need to sleep. New girls get curious sometimes, so I've had to explain it a bunch. Never gets any easier." "No, no, That helps plenty to answer my question. Now I know what's up with your eyes!" "You certainly do. Did you have any other questions planned for today, or was that all?" [var2 |"Hold on one moment. I have one more question, but it involves another member of my party. You won't need to explain it all again, but would you be willing to show her your eyes?" you ask. "Sure. I don't see why not. I'm intrigued now," she replies. Holding a hand up, you sprint out of the room, stopping in the hall when you find Atugia patiently seated on one of the benches and chatting with a pair of girls who appear to have just returned from the training halls. "Good! You stuck around! Am I interrupting something or do you have a minute?" you ask, looking between her and the two valkyries. "N-no, I'm free, we were just talkin' about the kinds of trainin' we do. What's up?" she asks back. She stands, waving goodbye to the pair as they stand to leave. "This valkyrie, Eira, you've got to see her eyes. It's easier to see than to explain," you say, starting back in the direction of Eira's room. "Eira, isn't that one of the delivery girls? The head delivery girl? There are so many more valkyries than I thought there would be," she replies, letting you pull her all the way back to the divine messenger herself. You plop her down in front of Eira, who's still floating a few inches above the ground with her legs crossed and an amused grin on her face. "This must be her, then? Well, girl, I don't know why [pc.name] is so insistent, but here," she says, opening her eyes without so much as a flourish. Atugia gasps, looking so rapidly between you and the other woman that her bangs swing near horizontally. "It's! It's!? I'm sorry. It's really cool lookin', but I don't know exactly why you'd pull me aside for it," she says, slumping her shoulders. "[pc.dcb |It's just like your neck, you numbskull! |It's kind of like your neck, isn't it? |It's, like, the exact same thing as your neck except different, isn't it!? ]" you say, pointing at her eyes and then at the confused dullahan's starscape of a throat. Eira seems to notice it for the first time, raising an eyebrow and pivoting forward. She holds Atugia by the chin, pushing her face up and examining the sea of stars that makes up her neck. The grounded woman lets her look, flushing a bit at the intensity of her attention but otherwise remaining still and silent. The colors are different, but there's no doubt a similarity exists between that deep and endless blue and the bright and sharp aurora in the mail-mistress's gaze. "Have you also been blessed by a god? Not all the Living Gods had incidents like this, but I know for sure I'm not the only one. I don't recognize this feeling you exude though, what is it?" she asks, her face a mask of curious wariness. "N-no! It's a curse, not a blessing. I was marked by a Wraith that killed my tribe. I was left alive, but cursed with this mark and, um, the ability to remove my head..." Atugia explains. She fidgets sheepishly, oblivious to the wide eyed stare the angelic valkyrie has adopted. "Remove your head? May I see?" she asks. Her expression remains awestruck as your companion reaches up and lets her head drop into her hands with a pomf. She doesn't reach out to grab for it, but she does poke at the other girl's cheek and tap on the glassy surface between her shoulders. "[silly |It boggles the mind |I couldn't imagine such a thing ]. Have you spoken with Lumia about this? I think you should. It's above me, but she might know something more," Eira says, rubbing her chin. "[var1 |Yeah, she didn't have any real answers. It's okay, though. I'm glad you all want to help, |No. We spoke briefly, but she was more surprised to see me than anythin'. Do you think it would be a good idea, [pc.name]? ]" Tui [var1 |says |talk ], putting her head back in its place and turning to you. "[var1 |I'm sure we'll find some answers somewhere, |It might be. Perhaps she'll be able to find out something else about the protective magic that was upon you. At the very least it can't hurt, ]" you say. The two of you say your goodbyes to Eira, and head back to the central halls of the palace. [var1 | |Maybe you can find out something further about this from Lumia herself. ] ] "

rows.original: "So the mail delivery means you probably see a lot of your fellow valkyries, but how do you get along with them?" you ask. "Pretty well, I think! Maybe not as well as I used to, all things considered, but I know a lot about them! They're all willing to share stories when I stay to listen, especially the ones who have a lot of relatives. I love that, you know? Just listening to the happy news makes me feel like I'm a part of it." "Are you ever actually a part of it, though? You like flying, right? Do you ever go out flying with anyone?[var0 | Other than me, I mean, ]" you ask. "Yeah! Well, sometimes. I usually like going alone and flying up over the sea or the ice shelf, but I've gone up with Annika once, and some others too! I do like hanging out, but sometimes I need to be drug along. Really I prefer conversation. Did you know Annika has half as many nieces and nephews as Yoli has siblings? If you can believe it, three or four of them even share the same birthday, a couple years apart! That makes it easier on me, and it was fun seeing their writing improve on top of that," she says, pausing for a moment before she continues. "I don't have family, really, but I've been doing this long enough that it feels like I'm a part of all those families." "Aww! [pc.dcb |Don't go and get too sappy on me, now, |[pc.isValk |I hope I can be a part of that family as well, for better or worse, |[pc.bg barbarian |My family is gone as well, but I've met lots of people I'd be glad to count among them during my travels |I haven't seen my family in ages, but I've met lots of people in my journeys that I'd be glad to count among them. ] ] |[pc.isValk |Now that I'm also part of your family, I can't wait to tell you, like, all the stories[silly |. Like, this one time, when I was walking in the Old Forest, I saw this, like, really cool shiny rock, and it was, like, the prettiest rock I had ever seen! So of course I stopped to pick it up. Can you imagine if, like, a bunch of hornets would have come right then? I could've, like, distracted them with the rock and then milked, like, all their honey while they were distracted! THAT was how amazing and shiny this rock was. But, like, I was so busy dreaming about drinking honey that the rock dropped out of my hand. I looked real hard for it, but I couldn't find it at all, |, ] |Well I'd be, like, super happy to come tell you stories some time[silly |. Oh! Like, one time, I was sleeping in a tent, and outside I could hear all these owl noises! Well, I guess I wasn't really sleeping since I could hear the owls, but I was going to sleep. They were being loud, but also cute, so I started going 'hoot hoot hoot', and sometimes it sounded like they were talking back to me! I guess what I'm saying is I can speak owl. I'd love to teach you sometime, but it might be too hard cause I've never taught anyone before, |, ] ] ]" you say, placing a hand on both of her cheeks and squeezing till her smile widens. "Enough," she laughs. "[pc.dcb |I won't |I'm glad |I'll listen any time ]. Now, where was I? Oh, Lumia sometimes gives me special letters. If she notices one of the valkyries is feeling down, she likes doing things to cheer them up. Whether that means a good cheer-up session or an understanding embrace depends entirely on the person. I like being involved either way, especially if I was the one to deliver the sad news." "Being the head deliverer means I get to deliver a lot of good news, but it also means I see a lot of bad tidings. That's when my sisters need me most. I love being there for the celebrations, but I wouldn't take back a moment of the time I spent lending a shoulder to cry on. The knowledge that someone is there for you makes the blows easier to take." "It's good that you're able to be there whether they're happy or sad. Sometimes it helps just to have anyone to listen to you, right?" "Exactly. Lumia said something similar to me once, and I guess I just need the occasional reminder," she says. "Was there anything else you had in mind while you're at the palace today? Perhaps something a little less emotional?" Well? Is there?
rows.translation: 所以，通过邮件交流，你可能会经常遇到很多你的同僚女武神，那么你们是怎么相处在一起的呢？”你问道。 “我觉得还挺不错的！虽然考虑到各种因素，可能没有以前那么亲密了，但我对她们了解得很多。当我愿意倾听的时候，她们都很乐意分享自己的故事，尤其是那些有很多亲戚的女武神。我就喜欢这样，你知道吗？ just listening to their happy stories makes me feel like I’m part of their lives.” “你有没有…… 其实 不过，这也是你喜欢的事情之一吧？你喜欢飞行，对吧？你有没有和别人一起出去飞行过呢？[var0 | 除了我之外，我的意思是…… ]你问这个啊…… “是啊！有时候会。我通常喜欢独自飞行，飞越海洋或冰架，但也有过和安妮卡一起飞，还有和其他人一起飞过呢！我确实喜欢和大家一起出去玩，但有时候也确实需要有人陪我一起才行。 其实我更喜欢聊天。你知道吗，安妮卡的侄子侄女数量只有约莉兄弟姐妹数量的一半。而且，其中有三四个孩子的生日甚至相差几年，却都是同一天！这样对我来说反而更方便，而且看到他们的写作水平不断提高，也是一件很有趣的事情。”她说道，然后稍作停顿，继续说道。 其实我并没有自己的家人，但因为我从事这份工作已经很久了，所以感觉自己已经成为了那些家庭中的一员。” “哇哦！ [pc.dcb |别去拿。 太 现在对我这么甜言蜜语，是吧？ |[pc.isValk |我希望自己也能成为那个家庭的一员，无论结果是好是坏。 |[pc.bg barbarian |我的家人也都离开了我，但在旅途中，我遇到了很多值得与我结为朋友的人。 |我已经很久没有见到我的家人了，但在这段旅程中，我遇到了很多值得我视为朋友的人。 ] ] |[pc.isValk |现在我也成为了你们家庭的一员，我迫不及待地想要把所有这些故事都告诉你们。[silly |有一次，我在老森林里散步的时候，看到了一块非常酷、闪闪发光的石头，那真的是我见过的最漂亮的石头了。 曾经 看到了！所以我当然停下来把它捡了起来。你能想象如果当时有一群黄蜂飞过来会怎么样吗？我本来可以用石头把它们引开，然后再把…… 所有 在他们分心的时候把他们的“甜头”据为己有！ 那个 那块石头真是漂亮极了，闪闪发光。可是，因为我当时满脑子都在想着喝蜂蜜的事情，结果那块石头就从我手里掉了下去。我拼命地寻找，却怎么也找不到它了。 |, ] |嗯，我非常乐意在某个时候过来给你们讲故事。[silly |哦！有一次，我在帐篷里睡觉，外面能听到各种猫头鹰的声音！嗯，我想我其实并没有真正睡着，因为那些声音让我根本无法入睡。 进行中 它们太吵了，但也挺可爱的，于是我就开始模仿猫头鹰的声音，说“呼呼呼”，有时候听起来它们好像在回应我呢！我想说的是，我其实会“说猫头鹰的语言”。我很想有空教教你，不过可能有点困难，因为我还从来没教过别人呢。 |, ] ] ]你说得对，”他把手放在她的双颊上，轻轻一捏，让她的笑容更加灿烂。 “够了，”她笑着说。[pc.dcb |我不会的。 |我很高兴。 |我随时都愿意倾听。 ]现在，我刚才说到哪里了？哦，Lumia有时候会给我发一些特别的消息。如果它发现有哪位“女武神”情绪低落，它就会想办法让她们开心起来。是陪她们聊聊天、逗她们开心，还是给予一个安慰的拥抱，这完全取决于具体情况和那个人的需求。 无论哪种情况，我都很乐意参与其中，尤其是当需要由我来传达那些令人难过的消息时。” “作为主要的信息传递者，意味着我需要传达很多好消息，但同时也意味着我会听到很多坏消息。在这种时候，我的姐妹们最需要我的帮助。 我喜欢在庆祝时刻陪伴在他们身边，但我也毫不后悔那些为他们提供倾诉对象的日子。知道有人愿意陪伴在自己身边，确实能让那些艰难时刻变得容易承受一些。 “你能无论他们在开心还是难过的时候都陪伴在他们身边，这真的很好。 有时候，只要有个人愿意倾听你的心声，就已经很有帮助了，对吧？” “没错。Lumia也曾对我说过类似的话，我想我只是需要偶尔有人提醒我这一点而已，”她说道。“今天你在宫殿里，还有其他想做的事情吗？ 或许可以选择一些不那么充满情感的内容吧？” 那么，有这样的选择吗？

rows.original:
"Do you want to just go out for a bit and fly around the rift? [flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |Last time was fun, even if it is a bit cold up there
        |It's a bit cold, but you have to know some good scenic views or good places to see
    ]," you ask.
    
    Eira lights up at the suggestion, her hip-wings fluttering excitedly before she can even voice a response.
    
    "[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |I'll take any chance I can get. We can use the same terrace as last time for take-off,
        |Sun's blessings, do I ever. Come on, I know one of the back ways from here to the east terrace,
    ]" she says, leading the way as you exit her room.
    
    The two of you travel through some of the back rooms of the converted dormitories, all the way to a set of stairs that lead up to a much colder part of the castle. The door at the top sticks when she tries to open it till she throws her shoulder against it. This high, the rooms on the other side are mostly abandoned. Still, the warmth of the goddess of light is beginning to creep back into them. With time, the whole castle will be warm enough to occupy. Still, it's not there yet, and the both of you need to work the door that leads to the outer terrace with [pc.isStrong
        |a good thrust
        |all that you have
    ] before it will open. 
    
    The outer reaches of the northern terrace are coated with a solid layer of ice, but the wind doesn't quite reach far enough inside to do more than frost the inner walls and doors. Out beyond the castle, this side gives a breathtaking view of the mountainous spires of the glacier. The greatest of these pillars of snow and ice climb as high as the keep itself. Each one glints in the [dayNight
        |sunlight, glimmering like platinum in the distance
        |moonlight, shimmering like a field of dark diamonds
    ]. Even if you weren't about to go flying, this view alone would be worth climbing those steps to see. 
    
    "[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |Ready? I'm going up. See you soon!"
        |If you think that view is good, wait till you see the ocean from up there!"
    ] Eira calls, pointing to the top of one of the ice spires.
    
    Kicking off with a bend of her legs and a short hop, the tiny wings on her hips flutter and launch her into the air. Backed up by magic, they provide far more lift than they have any right to. Eira zooms into the air and spins in a twisting roll. She looks back once — to make sure you're still coming — and then zips off with a crack of wind.
    
    Preparing to take off yourself, you find a patch of solid footing on the slippery ice and spread your wings. You join the[pc.mf|| other] woman in the air, fluttering till you find the wind and manage to catch up. She has an incredible amount of maneuverability, zipping and bobbing with a degree of freedom that makes you a little envious. Still, you're here now! That [pc.isDK
        |
        |uncharacteristic
    ] jealousy fades fast in the face of boundless air.
    
    She was right about the view. From above, the light glinting off the snow and ice is even more noticeable. It sparkles and shifts in a kaleidoscope of brightness that catches your eyes from everywhere at once. Raw and natural beauty captures your gaze and commands your attention. The first time Eira talks, after you've been staring and circling for several minutes, you miss what she says as the words fail to penetrate your unabashed fascination.
    
    "What was that?" you shout over the rush of wind. You reposition yourself to be a little closer to her, making sure you're near enough to hear.
    
    "[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |You get so engrossed every time! I'm glad you appreciate it as much as I do!
        |See? I told you it was better up here!
    ]" she shouts, grinning ear to ear. Matching your speed, she pulls back so the two of you can continue onward together. "Let's keep heading toward the coast!"
    
    You both fly in unison toward the water. Along the way there isn't a whole lot of variation in the glacial shapes, but the colors still marvel just as well as before. The only problem with your approach to the ocean is, of course, the cold. Winds coming off the water bite more harshly than those around the castle, and [pc.hasFur
        |even your fur coat doesn't block it out completely.
        |it's especially noticeable without any fur to block it.
    ] But then, it's worth every second spent in the chill wind to see what you came for.
    
    From this high, the ocean looks infinite, stretching across the horizon like a dark azure field. The void is broken in places by foamy waves and large chunks of ice that float upon and just under its surface. Some of the scattered chunks are like jewels, buffeted into fantastic shapes by the water, but too cold to fully melt down to their cores. Off in the distance, you can see the beginning of the peninsula that forms an ice bridge to the Far North when it gets cold enough.
    
    "I've seen waves out there as big as fifty feet! The sound when they crash into each other is absolutely deafening," Eira says, pointing off into the distance.
    
    The ocean seems calm now, but you've heard stories of waves that can capsize ships. You'd have to see it for yourself before you decide if it's as exciting as she makes it sound, or if it would be terrifying. Regardless, you aren't sure flying in such a storm would be a good idea.
    
    "[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |I still can't believe how big it is no matter how many times I look at it!
        |It's so vast! How do you keep track of where you're going out there?
    ]" you [flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |say
        |ask
    ], still gazing out at the expanse of nothingness.

The deeper inside you get, the quicker things return to that all encompassing warmth of the goddess' power. By the time you reach the main thoroughfare, the two of you are nice and toasty. Smiling in Eira's direction, you [eira.fucked
        |pull her into a spontaneous kiss while she's still breathing heavy from the exercise.

rows.translation:
你想出去逛逛，在裂隙中飞一圈吗？ [flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |上次真的很有趣，虽然那里有点冷……
        |虽然有点冷，但至少你能看到一些美丽的风景或者一些值得去的地方吧。
    ]你这么问，”你说道。

听到这个提议，艾拉的眼睛立刻亮了起来，她的臀部翅膀兴奋地扑腾着，甚至还没等她来得及回答。[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |我会抓住任何机会。我们可以像上次一样，在同一个露台上开始行动。
        |太阳保佑，我当然知道。来吧，我知道从这里去东侧露台有一条捷径。
    ]她说着，走在你前面，引领你离开她的房间。

你们俩穿过那些被改造而成的宿舍里的一些偏僻房间，一直来到一组楼梯前——那些楼梯通向城堡中更加寒冷的区域。 当她试图打开顶层的门时，门会卡住，直到她用肩膀去推它才能打开。从这个高度来看，另一边的房间大多已经被废弃了。不过，光明女神的温暖正在逐渐重新渗透进这些房间里。 随着时间的推移，整个城堡会变得足够温暖，可以让人居住了。不过现在还不是这样，你们两个人需要一起把通往外露台的门修好。 [pc.isStrong
        |有力的推进
        |你拥有的一切
    ] 在它打开之前。

北方露台的外围覆盖着一层厚厚的冰，但风势并没有蔓延到内部，因此只能让内墙和大门上结上一层霜。从城堡的这一侧望去，可以欣赏到冰川上那些巍峨的雪峰，它们的高度与城堡的塔楼相当。每一座由冰雪构成的冰柱都在阳光下闪闪发光。 [dayNight
        |阳光在远处闪烁，宛如铂金般熠熠生辉。
        |月光闪烁，宛如一片由黑色钻石构成的田野。
    ]. 即使你并不打算从这里飞下去，仅仅是为了欣赏这一景色，爬上这些台阶也是值得的。[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |准备好了吗？我要上去了，回头见！
        |如果你觉得那种景色已经很美了，那就等着从高处看到大海吧！
    ] 艾拉指着其中一座冰刺的顶部叫道。

她弯曲双腿，轻轻一跳，臀部上的小翅膀开始扑动，将她送向空中。在魔力的辅助下，这些翅膀产生的升力远远超出了它们的实际能力。 艾拉冲向空中，开始旋转翻腾。她回头看了一眼——确认你仍在追赶之后，便伴随着一阵风声迅速远去了。

而你也在准备起飞，终于在湿滑的冰面上找到了一块可以站稳的地方，然后展开了你的翅膀。 你加入了[pc.mf|| 其他] 那个在空中飞舞的女人，不断飘动，直到你找到风向并设法追上她。她拥有惊人的机动性，上下翻飞，那种自由度实在让人有些羡慕。不过，现在你已经在这里了！ [pc.isDK
        |
        |不符合其一贯性格的
    ] 在无边无际的广阔空间面前，嫉妒之情很快就会消散。

她说的景色确实没错。从高处望去，雪地和冰面上反射的光芒更加显眼了。那些光芒闪烁着，变幻着，宛如一道绚丽的万花筒，从四面八方吸引着你的目光。 原始而自然的美景会吸引你的目光，让你无法忽视它。当你凝视着那美景好几分钟，终于决定走上前去仔细观察时，艾拉第一次开口说话了——然而你却完全没听清她在说什么，因为你的注意力完全被那美景所吸引，她的言语根本无法进入你的耳中。
    
    那是什么？”你在狂风中大声问道。你调整了自己的位置，让自己离她更近一些，确保自己能够听清她的回答。[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |你每次都看得如此入迷！我很高兴你和我一样喜欢它！
        |看到了吧？我就说这里更好吧！
    ]她笑着大喊，速度与你保持一致，然后向后退了一些，这样你们就可以继续一起前进了。‘我们继续朝着海岸方向飞吧！’”

你们俩同步朝着水面飞去。沿途，冰川的形态并没有太大变化，但那些色彩依然令人惊叹。当然，接近海洋时唯一的问题就是寒冷——从海面上吹来的寒风比城堡周围的寒风更加刺骨。 [pc.hasFur
        |就连你的毛皮大衣也无法完全阻挡它。
        |在没有任何毛发遮挡的情况下，这一点尤为明显。
    ] 但是，为了看到自己为之而来的一切，这些在寒风中度过的每一秒钟都是值得的。

从这么高的地方望去，海洋显得无边无际，像一片深蓝色的广阔领域，一直延伸到地平线的尽头。偶尔，海面上会泛起层层泡沫，一些巨大的冰块也会漂浮在海面上或接近海面的地方，打破了这片宁静与空旷。 那些散落在水中的冰块有些就像宝石一样，被水浪冲刷成了奇特的形状，但由于温度过低，它们始终无法完全融化到核心部分。在远处，你可以看到那片半岛的起点——当气温足够低时，这片半岛会形成一座连接远北地区的冰桥。
    
    我见过高达五十英尺的巨浪！当它们相互撞击时，发出的声音简直震耳欲聋，”艾拉指着远处的海面说道。

此刻的海面看起来很平静，但你也听说过那些能够将船只掀翻的巨浪吧。 在你决定这究竟是否像她所说的那么令人兴奋，或者是否会令人感到恐惧之前，你真的需要亲身体验一番。无论如何，你都不确定在这样的暴风雨中飞行是否真的是个好主意。[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |无论我看多少次，还是无法相信它到底有这么大！
        |这片区域太广阔了！在这么大的范围内，你要怎么确定自己应该往哪个方向前进呢？
    ]你 [flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |说
        |询问
    ]仍然凝视着那片无边的虚无。[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |[silly
            |她就是这么说的！
            |我完全理解这种感觉！真是令人惊叹不已。
        ]
        |我不知道！我想这是直觉在起作用吧……或者是我与生俱来的某种能力。我从来都不会感到迷路。
    ]她回答道。

你们俩沿着海岸线飞行了几分钟，欣赏着那些被无情的海潮侵蚀而成的悬崖。你们绕着海岸线来回飞行，最终飞到了光之宫殿的正上方。 从这样的高度望去，那些山峰和尖塔同样令人惊叹；在返回的过程中，你可以慢慢飞行，穿梭于那些高塔之间，最终又会回到你出发时的那个平台上。
    
    你们降落后，赶紧拍打身上的雪粒以保持温暖，然后匆忙朝着城堡里更温暖的地方走去。越往里面走，周围的环境就越能感受到女神力量带来的那种无处不在的温暖。当你们来到主干道时，两个人已经暖和得不行了。 你朝着艾拉的方向微笑着。 [eira.fucked
        |在他还因为运动而呼吸急促的时候，突然吻了她。
        |陪在她身边，直到你们都能平静下来。
    ]
    
    "[eira.fucked
        |你真傻。换作是我，也会抓住任何机会这么做。
        |谢谢。我当初说会一有机会就去做这件事，确实是认真的。
    ] 也许我们很快就能再一起出去玩了。回头见吧。 [pc.name]再见了，”艾拉说道，挥手告别后便飞快地回到了宿舍。你独自留在中央大厅，思考着接下来该做什么。
rows.raw:
"
    "Do you want to just go out for a bit and fly around the rift? [flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |Last time was fun, even if it is a bit cold up there
        |It's a bit cold, but you have to know some good scenic views or good places to see
    ]," you ask.
    
    Eira lights up at the suggestion, her hip-wings fluttering excitedly before she can even voice a response.
    
    "[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |I'll take any chance I can get. We can use the same terrace as last time for take-off,
        |Sun's blessings, do I ever. Come on, I know one of the back ways from here to the east terrace,
    ]" she says, leading the way as you exit her room.
    
    The two of you travel through some of the back rooms of the converted dormitories, all the way to a set of stairs that lead up to a much colder part of the castle. The door at the top sticks when she tries to open it till she throws her shoulder against it. This high, the rooms on the other side are mostly abandoned. Still, the warmth of the goddess of light is beginning to creep back into them. With time, the whole castle will be warm enough to occupy. Still, it's not there yet, and the both of you need to work the door that leads to the outer terrace with [pc.isStrong
        |a good thrust
        |all that you have
    ] before it will open. 
    
    The outer reaches of the northern terrace are coated with a solid layer of ice, but the wind doesn't quite reach far enough inside to do more than frost the inner walls and doors. Out beyond the castle, this side gives a breathtaking view of the mountainous spires of the glacier. The greatest of these pillars of snow and ice climb as high as the keep itself. Each one glints in the [dayNight
        |sunlight, glimmering like platinum in the distance
        |moonlight, shimmering like a field of dark diamonds
    ]. Even if you weren't about to go flying, this view alone would be worth climbing those steps to see. 
    
    "[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |Ready? I'm going up. See you soon!"
        |If you think that view is good, wait till you see the ocean from up there!"
    ] Eira calls, pointing to the top of one of the ice spires.
    
    Kicking off with a bend of her legs and a short hop, the tiny wings on her hips flutter and launch her into the air. Backed up by magic, they provide far more lift than they have any right to. Eira zooms into the air and spins in a twisting roll. She looks back once — to make sure you're still coming — and then zips off with a crack of wind.
    
    Preparing to take off yourself, you find a patch of solid footing on the slippery ice and spread your wings. You join the[pc.mf|| other] woman in the air, fluttering till you find the wind and manage to catch up. She has an incredible amount of maneuverability, zipping and bobbing with a degree of freedom that makes you a little envious. Still, you're here now! That [pc.isDK
        |
        |uncharacteristic
    ] jealousy fades fast in the face of boundless air.
    
    She was right about the view. From above, the light glinting off the snow and ice is even more noticeable. It sparkles and shifts in a kaleidoscope of brightness that catches your eyes from everywhere at once. Raw and natural beauty captures your gaze and commands your attention. The first time Eira talks, after you've been staring and circling for several minutes, you miss what she says as the words fail to penetrate your unabashed fascination.
    
    "What was that?" you shout over the rush of wind. You reposition yourself to be a little closer to her, making sure you're near enough to hear.
    
    "[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |You get so engrossed every time! I'm glad you appreciate it as much as I do!
        |See? I told you it was better up here!
    ]" she shouts, grinning ear to ear. Matching your speed, she pulls back so the two of you can continue onward together. "Let's keep heading toward the coast!"
    
    You both fly in unison toward the water. Along the way there isn't a whole lot of variation in the glacial shapes, but the colors still marvel just as well as before. The only problem with your approach to the ocean is, of course, the cold. Winds coming off the water bite more harshly than those around the castle, and [pc.hasFur
        |even your fur coat doesn't block it out completely.
        |it's especially noticeable without any fur to block it.
    ] But then, it's worth every second spent in the chill wind to see what you came for.
    
    From this high, the ocean looks infinite, stretching across the horizon like a dark azure field. The void is broken in places by foamy waves and large chunks of ice that float upon and just under its surface. Some of the scattered chunks are like jewels, buffeted into fantastic shapes by the water, but too cold to fully melt down to their cores. Off in the distance, you can see the beginning of the peninsula that forms an ice bridge to the Far North when it gets cold enough.
    
    "I've seen waves out there as big as fifty feet! The sound when they crash into each other is absolutely deafening," Eira says, pointing off into the distance.
    
    The ocean seems calm now, but you've heard stories of waves that can capsize ships. You'd have to see it for yourself before you decide if it's as exciting as she makes it sound, or if it would be terrifying. Regardless, you aren't sure flying in such a storm would be a good idea.
    
    "[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |I still can't believe how big it is no matter how many times I look at it!
        |It's so vast! How do you keep track of where you're going out there?
    ]" you [flags.EIRA_FLIGHT
        |say
        |ask
    ], still gazing out at the expanse of nothingness.
    
    "[flags.EIRA_FLIGHT

        ]

You circle long and wide in a crisscross that eventually takes you right over the top of the Palace of Light. Its peaks and spires are just as fantastic as the glacier from this height, and you take your time on the return for landing, swirling between the towers till you wind up right back at the same terrace you left from.

The deeper inside you get, the quicker things return to that all encompassing warmth of the goddess' power. By the time you reach the main thoroughfare, the two of you are nice and toasty.     ]
