rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: "Okay. First of all we need to get you some new stuff. [pc.dcb |These blankets and drapes are disgusting. |The stuff you've got now is all motheaten and nasty |These blankets are mad wicked uggo, and dirty. We gotta get you some crisp clean blankies and a big soft pillow. ] Frankly I'm surprised you managed this long. The only good things here are that chair and the bed itself." you say, looking around at the combined furniture of Eira's room. "Is that something we can get in the castle?" "Yeah... sorry about that. I guess I kind of let it go since I was never at home," she replies, looking around with a similar exasperation. "Oh! I know a couple seamstresses in the maternity wing we can talk to. They do the repairs for bedding around the castle, but they might have new stuff as well just in case things get ruined. I'm sure I remember where it is." The two of you head out into the dorms and through the halls, traversing the tiled floors and pathways to reach the maternity wing. You pass by several nursing mothers, cutting through the nursery and recovery wards to find a section decorated with numerous fabrics and displayed pillows. Several women mill about, mostly chatting with each other or with expecting mothers who have wandered over to the displays. Still, some are simply lounging and on the lookout for people who need help. "Huh. It's a bit bigger than I remember it being. There's so much here," Eira says, staring about at the vast selection in awe. "Of course there are! We have ladies coming in from all over, so we sometimes ask them to bring bedding from their homes to add to our supply. Some of us just bring them back ourselves when we're assigned to other lands," one of the ladies explains. "We try to keep things from all over in case people get homesick or want a reminder of a long assignment. For example, this lovely purple silk is all the rage in Jassira. We don't have much use for keeping the heat away up here, but it's certainly as pretty as it is comfy." "We also keep so much in case things accidentally catch fire or are ruined by [silly |erm... juices... |water. ] This way people don't have to worry, and it's also nice for devotees on pilgrimages from afar," another pipes in. "I dunno if I need something as cushy and memorable as all that, but if you've got anything nice and clean and maybe a little soft-" Eira begins, looking at a simple brown bedsheet hung by the side. "Oh no, dear, that won't do! You haven't had a look at everything to see what you prefer," the woman from before says. She takes Eira by the wrist to stop her from simply flying away, and tugs her further into the displays. "Here. These are a favorite! Feather pillows from Khor'minos." Pulling a large and fluffy looking pillow from a case, the matronly figure pushes it into Eira's arms. She tries to protest, but then her eyes widen as she fluffs the pillow with her hands. There's a moment of shock as she then holds the pillow against her head. Her eyes close, and a long sigh of comfort escapes her lips. When she pulls her head away, her eyes are open, and just as wide with surprise as they were before. "I... didn't know pillows could get this soft," she says in utter disbelief.[silly | That tracks, her pillows are quite firm. ] The next bit of display bedding is in her hands before the lady can even offer it, and she's squeezing and kneading with curious excitement. "That one's from Kitsuhon! It's a more firm style, for better support. It's rare that any of us visit their shores, but sometimes we help exiles relocate," she explains. Eira has already moved on to a particularly thick looking comforter, and is busy rubbing her face all over it. She pulls the large blanket off the rack and bundles it up in her arms, turning back toward the rest of you with a slight blush. "I want this one," she mumbles. "Certainly! That one is also from here in the north. Would you like us to set it up, or will you carry it yourself?" the other woman asks. "We can do it, and I'll take that downy pillow too," Eira says, adding the pillow to the piled up comforter in her arms. "Perfect! You'll need new sheets as well if you're getting a whole set. Grab a set in your size, and we'll come by to pick up the old ones soon. You can just pile them up outside your room," the seamstress says. Your excited partner grabs a set of sheets from the indicated bin, and the two of you return to her room. Eira only bumps into one wall before letting you guide her the rest of the way back by hand. The precarious balance she's keeping manages to hold up despite her blocked view, and after that first snafu no further trouble presents itself. She turns to the side occasionally for a better view of the hall and nearby obstructions, but beyond that she needs no further guidance. When you reach her room, she continues to hold the new bedding while you dispose of the trash. Promptly depositing the old and musty sheets by the door side, you and Eira replace them with the fresh and newly acquired ones. The sheets are exactly the right size, but the comforter is a massive affair that scrunches up in multiple places to fit the smaller bed. Folding those spots in at the corners helps, and when you're under the blankets they'll provide extra material to cover up with. The change in atmosphere is immediate. The rest of the room was already mostly clean, and with the nasty essence of those sheets fading in favor of the new ones you feel more like you're in a place someone would want to stay. "I'm [silly |utterly boggled at |astounded by ] how much of a difference that makes," she says, hovering over to the bed and plopping down with a pomf. "Thanks for helping me with this. Honestly, I probably would've just suffered through it if you didn't suggest I get something new. I actually feel like sleeping here for once. Was there anything else you wanted to do?" Well, is there?
rows.translation: 好的。首先，我们需要为你准备一些新的物品。 [pc.dcb |这些毯子和窗帘真是太恶心了。 |你现在用的这些东西都已经破旧不堪、脏兮兮的了。 |这些毯子又丑又脏，我们得给你换一些干净整洁的毯子和一个柔软的大枕头。 ] 老实说，我很惊讶你居然能坚持这么久。这里唯一还算不错的东西就是那把椅子和那张床了。”你环顾着艾拉房间里的那些家具说道，“这些我们在城堡里也能买到吗？ 是啊……实在不好意思。因为我平时都不在家，所以就把这件事忘得一干二净了，”她边说边环顾四周，脸上也带着同样的无奈。“哦！我知道产房区有几位缝纫工，我们可以去问问看。她们负责修理城堡里的一些床上用品，不过她们可能也有新的用品，以防万一需要用到的时候这些东西已经损坏了。 我肯定记得它在哪里。         |You meander through the training halls, keeping an eye out for the burly northern minotaur. It doesn't take you long at all to find her, and luckily you catch her on a break. Waving to get her attention, you step around a couple other valkyries who are milling about the halls on your way to greet her. She sees you coming, and smiles wide when she recognizes you.
        
        "[pc.name]! Hail and well met. Are you here to train? Or just here to keep me company?" she asks, clapping you on the shoulder from the bench she's seated on.
        
        "Company might be one way to put it, but for now I have another delivery," you say, pulling out the purple crystal and handing it over.
        
        Hjörr listens to the message inside with her eyes closed and a curious smirk on her lips. As she continues to listen, it spreads into a wide and genuine grin, and the hand on your shoulder gives a heartening squeeze.
        
        "Ah! Lady Light is no liar. I'm always up to help with such things. It brings me great pride to know we can help the people of the north worry less about their children's survival. [pc.isPregnant
            |It seems you're a bit... pre-occupied at the moment, however. Did you come for something else this time, or just to alert me for the future?
            |Is this what you've come for now? Or something else?
        ]" 
        |You search the training halls, waiting till you can catch Hjörr on a break from training. When you see her taking a seat on one of the benches, you make your approach. She waves when she sees you approaching, and you wave back. It takes you a second to weave through the other valkyries milling about the halls, but you make it nonetheless. She claps a hand down on your shoulder and smiles brightly.
        
        "[pc.name]! Here for some training, or for something else? I'm free for a little while, at least."
    ]

"Can I join the next training exercise?" you ask.
    
    "I don't see why not. [pc.isValk
        |The other newbies might be a bit star-shocked, but they can learn to deal with distraction
        |The newbies can use the ground training
    ]. Follow me, then," she says, pushing back up to her feet and calling out for some of the milling trainees to join you.
    
    There are fifteen or so other valkyries that join in total, though the flourishing wings and gold make it tough to be exact. When you make it to the training room, they split into a handful of three-to-four person groups. Three of them pull you along with, [pc.isValk
        |excitedly gushing about your new-bound soul.
        |excitedly chattering about training with an outsider.
    ] They're very helpful when it comes to updating you on the methods they've been learning, and the exercises they were in the middle of before their last break.
    
    [rand
        |This time the focus is on general endurance training and movements. You perform what's essentially a full workout with your designated team, while also learning how best to keep each other's positions in mind. The three others make room for you like you were always meant to be there. They aren't perfect by any means, but they learn from every mistake they make. In the end you make for a pretty perfect match, keeping up with the rest of the groups without much trouble.
        |This time the focus is on building impromptu shelters. The room has a number of simulated environments, like a patch of sand and some woven brush. Your group travels to each of the designated areas and builds the provided material into shelters. Some of them wind up being much too small for four people to comfortably get any sleep, but this practice is simply for the building. Some of the trainees already know the constructions by heart, and are able to help the less knowledgeable through the process. You're [pc.bgMulti hunter soldier barbarian
            |in the former group, easily helping some of the struggling valkyries through constructing basic shelter.
            |in the latter group, getting help from the more experienced valkyries to learn how to build some of the shelters.
        ]
        |This time the focus is on flight! You [pc.hasWings
            |join in with gusto, weaving through the more aerial-focused training room with the other valkyries in your group. Some of the time is spent on specific flying drills, but a lot of it is letting the new flyers get used to their wings. Nobody crashes, and you assume some level of built-in instinct must come with the wings themselves. Even so, a lot of them still have plenty to learn. You fly till your wings tire and then land with the rest of them.
            |sit with Hjörr on the sidelines, watching the aerialists dance about through the more open training room. Some of the time is spent on specific flying drills, but a lot of it is letting the new flyers get used to their wings. Nobody crashes, and you assume some level of built-in instinct must come with the wings themselves. Even so, a lot of them still have plenty to learn. They fly till their wings tire, and then return to the ground.
        ]
    ]
    
    Training continues for another hour, and then it's time for another break. Break time consists mostly of chatting and relaxing, with some sneaking off to grab snacks or a moment of peace and quiet. There's a bit of time before the next training exercise starts, and they're relieved to have the free moments. You take your leave of the group at that point, saying your goodbyes before heading back to the main halls.

rows.original: You make your way through the large double doors of the throne room, and there you find Lumia waiting for you on the marble throne. She's dressed in the same casual outfit she was in when you woke up after your battle. Somehow she still looks regal and godlike, even with one breast and much of her midriff completely exposed. The simple wrap conceals exactly what it needs to, and reveals the most motherly parts of its wearer. It's obvious that she knew you were coming. "I'm glad you've come so soon!" she exclaims, beaming brightly. "Come closer. We have much to discuss." "I figured it would be rude not to show up when a goddess wants to talk," you say, [pc.dcb |bowing curtly |bowing deeply |curtsying with a happy bounce ]. "None of that formality, please. I have enough trouble convincing the new girls that they can relax around me..." she sighs, rubbing her temples with an exaggerated frown. "I'd much rather we speak as friends, at the very least." She smiles at that, and all the pressure in the room disappears. It's the smile of someone who's known you forever, and someone you feel like you could share anything with. "Now then. I told you I owed you a few things last time, didn't I? I'd like to pay at least one of those debts back to you now. Please, follow me," she says, standing from the throne and turning to walk toward the door to her inner sanctum. You fall in behind her, walking through the small waiting room and then continuing into the center of the palace. Without the oppressive miasma that clouded the place on your last visit, the place takes your breath away. The room is shaped like a dome, with a large glass sphere at the center containing the twisting aurora of color you saw the first time you were here. It shines much brighter than it did then, enough to fill the entire chamber with a warm light. Apart from that, the place is filled with tables and work areas neatly arranged so as not to take up space. There's no telling what each area is meant for, but Lumia isn't headed toward them anyway. "It's just through here," she says, holding out her hand as a keyring of golden light materializes on her bent finger. She opens an unassuming door at one side of the chamber, and leads you down a flight of stairs in a compact stone passageway. This part of the castle is much colder, especially after the warmth of the previous one. Still, Lumia herself radiates enough warmth that it never gets uncomfortable. The hall trails down deep beneath the castle, and perhaps even into the mountain beneath the glacier. Finally, you arrive at another door. This one has no handle or lock, but is emblazoned with ancient runes and symbols that hum with power. The goddess stops you at the bottom of the steps, and then touches one hand to the door. After a second of concentration the noise dies down, and Lumia pushes the door open without effort. The inside is utterly dark until your godly guide creates an orb of glowing light. Once it's lit, however, the sight takes your breath away. This room is much simpler than the sanctum, just a thin hall set with a number of alcoves. Inside each one is a weapon, garment, or suit of armor[pc.bg scholar |, some of which you recognize as artifacts pulled straight from myth and legend! |. ] Some of them are on racks, and others appear as translucent silver figures who each wear a specific object highlighted in gold. Lumia watches as you walk forward and take in the room. [party.has atugia |"I recognize that one!" Atugia says, pointing at the flickering image of a tall anubian who wears around his neck a sparkling scroll amulet. "That's Asim the Impervious! The stories all said his faith was his shield, but none of them mentioned something like this!" "Indeed. Asim is quite likely my most faithful champion in Jassira. Most often though, he is lent to the service of Mallach. The god of art's most treasured servants sometimes draw ire for choosing a lower paying noble to bear a child, and Asim has thwarted myriad assassins hired by jilted aristocrats," Lumia explains. "The Scrolls of Gadarat and Abena both protect him from magical threats and ward his body against common weaponry as well as any armor." ] "This one is Audrey the Swift-Silver," she says, pointing to a shimmering visage of a stern woman wearing a flowing robe and a golden diadem that covers her eyes. A thin golden halo shimmers in a half arc behind her head. "She wields Gostoc's Nimbus and the Eyes of Osbert, both of which enhance her already potent magical talents in her service to the king of Yvennes. I wasn't able to be there to personally grant them to her, but it fills my heart with joy to know that they've served her well." You walk all the way to the end of the hall, looking among the images of the heroes and the very real artifacts on their pedestals. There are four such objects that remain unclaimed. When you get to the end, you turn back toward the goddess and raise an eyebrow. "Is this what you meant? Am I to pick one of these?" you ask. "Yes! Does a champion who aids the very gods not deserve something of their caliber?" she replies with a laugh. Stepping forth, she meets you at the end of the hall and guides you to each of the remaining artifacts in turn. The first one she brings you to is a suit of burnished plate armor inlaid with sigils that glow with an inner light. The open faced helm has a visor that would slip down to protect even the face. While visually impressive, the thick plates make the armor look like it would be extremely heavy. "This is the Panoply of the Holy City, one of the most recent artifacts to come into my care! It was the last piece of armor created by the Belharan mage-smiths during the war, but unfortunately it never saw use on the battlefield. The knight to whom it was assigned was killed when a Wraith-touched sorcerer obliterated the fortress he commanded, before he ever wore the blessed armor to battle. It was unearthed by treasure seekers from beneath two stories of decimated rubble, perfectly intact," she explains, reaching out to trace a finger along the magical lettering. "These markings are designed to both make the armor much lighter than it appears, and to self-repair any dents or other damage dealt to it. It's the perfect protection for a mythical hero, and it never got its chance to shine." Next, she leads you to another set of armor, but this one differs significantly than the last. Instead of metal, this one looks more like a wedding dress than armor that belongs on a battlefield. The cuirass is crafted from linked alabaster scales interlaced with a single golden thread that trails throughout them in weaving veins. A neck guard of downy white feathers keeps the rough edges of the scales from being abrasive. The rest is a shockingly pure white fabric laced with patterns [pc.bg scholar |reminiscent of ancient Izkanti. |you don't recognize. ] Lumia straightens an errant wrinkle in the cloth and smiles. "This one, though, got plenty of time to shine. It was passed down by the warrior queens of Izkanti, a gift from all the people of the nation to its first queen. Originally it had no power of its own, but it's absorbed a little of the talent from each queen to wear it. That nation no longer exists in the same fashion as it did then, but the dress maintains their legacy. It was first used in my name to repel an invasion of blood sucking monstrosities left over from the war. When that wearer's time in this world was up, my valkyries brought it here, where it has been waiting for a new champion." After letting you take it in, she ushers you on to the next item. This one is a massive greatspear, long enough to [pc.isBimbo |plant in the ground and dance around! |dwarf your height [pc.heightRange 0 58 |twice over! |by a good few feet! ] ] Compared to the two sets of armor, however, its design is quite simple. The blade guard is forged to resemble a pair of flowing wings, but apart from that it's no different than any other spear in its appearance. Still, an aura of importance stems from it. In all directions, you can't help but feel revitalized while the weapon is nearby. "This is the great spear Caranbrot, which clove the black thorn from the dragon Azgaloth's breast. No one truly knows how the thorn found its way into the mighty drake's body, but it dug almost to his heart and drove him into such a rage that it threatened the Yvennese countryside. I bequeathed this spear to a nameless warrior who, rather than slaying the dragon, used it to skewer the thorn and pry it out before it could sink deeper. The knight chose to return Caranbrot to me immediately afterwards, and it has remained here ever since." Finally, Lumia leads you to an alcove containing a thick fold of cloth. As you approach, the cloth opens to reveal a brace of throwing daggers. Each one looks identical, with silver and gold veins arcing through in patterns that look impossible to replicate. The effect makes them resemble the feathers of a particularly colorful bird. A trill of musical clinks fills the air as you get closer, and you feel a gentle wind at the small of your back. "This last artifact is the Wing of Asira. In ancient times, the great sunbird lost a wing in a battle with a dragon. Rather than see him die, a powerful magesmith forged for him a wing of endless blades— or at least enough to match the eighty foot span of his other wing. The glint of his descent alone was enough to blind a kingdom's worth of men. When the roc died, a little of his spirit remained with the daggers, giving them some of his inner fire and sense of freedom. "They also retain some of Sorra's blessing; nothing and no one can prevent them from returning to their wielder. Given that my sister goddess is always on the move, they are kept here. They've always longed to be used again, though. Being cooped up doesn't suit them at all," she says, and you feel another gentle bump of wind. "Speaking of which, has anything you've seen here caught your eye?" You look back at the four objects you've been shown, trying to decide which you'd like.
rows.translation: 你穿过王座室那扇巨大的双开门，看到Lumia正坐在大理石王座上等待着你。她穿着与你战斗结束后醒来时相同的休闲装束。然而，即便只露出了一侧乳房，腹部的大部分也暴露在外，她依然显得如此高贵、宛如神明一般。 这件简单的衣物恰好遮住了需要遮盖的部分，同时又将穿着者最温柔、最母性的一面展现了出来。显然，她早就知道你会来。 “真高兴你这么快就来了！”她满脸笑容地说道，“过来坐吧。 我们有很多事情需要讨论。” “我想，当一位女神想要与我交谈时，如果我不出现，那未免太无礼了，”你说道。 [pc.dcb |简短地鞠了一躬 |深深鞠躬 |欢快地弯腰行礼 ]请别这么正式了。我已经费了好大劲才让那些新来的女孩们相信，在我面前可以放松下来……”她叹了口气，夸张地皱着眉头揉着太阳穴，“至少，我希望我们能以朋友的身份交谈。” 听到这话，她露出了微笑，房间里的紧张气氛立刻消失了。那是一种仿佛与你相识已久、让你觉得可以毫无保留地与她分享一切的微笑。 那么，我上次说过我欠你一些东西，对吧？现在我想至少偿还其中一项债务。请跟我来吧。”她说着，从王座上站起来，转身朝着通往她内室的门走去。 你跟在她身后，穿过那个小小的等候室，然后继续朝着宫殿的中心走去。与你上次来访时笼罩在这里的那种压抑气息不同，此刻这里的景象真的令你惊叹不已。这个房间的形状像一个圆顶，中间有一个巨大的玻璃球体，里面正闪烁着那些你第一次来到这里时所看到的绚丽色彩。 它现在发出的光芒比那时要明亮得多，足以让整个房间充满温暖的光线。除此之外，房间里还摆放着各种桌子和工作区域，它们都被整齐地安排着，以免占用过多的空间。虽然不知道这些区域各自是用来做什么的，但卢米娅并没有朝那些地方走去。 就在这边，”她说着，伸出手来——这时，一串由金色光点组成的钥匙环出现在她弯曲的手指上。 她打开了大厅一侧那扇不起眼的大门，然后引领你沿着一条狭窄的石制通道走下楼梯。 城堡的这一部分要冷得多，尤其是在经历了前面区域的温暖之后。不过，卢米娅本身散发的温暖足以让人感到舒适，因此从未有过不适的感觉。这条通道一直延伸到城堡的深处，甚至可能通向冰川下方的山脉之中。 终于，你来到了另一扇门前。 这个门没有把手也没有锁，但上面刻满了古老的符文和符号，那些符号散发着强大的能量。女神在台阶底部拦住了你，然后用一只手触碰了门。在集中注意力了一秒钟之后，那些噪音渐渐消失了，Lumia毫不费力地推开了门。门内一片漆黑，直到你的神圣向导制造出一个发光的光球。然而，当光芒亮起来的那一刻，眼前的景象简直令人窒息。 这个房间比那个密室简单多了，只不过是一条狭窄的走廊，走廊两侧分布着一些小隔间。每个隔间里都放着一件武器、一件衣物或一套盔甲。[pc.bg scholar |其中一些，你一定会认出它们是直接源自神话和传说的元素！ |. ] 有些物品被陈列在架子上，而另一些则以半透明的银色形态出现，每一个这样的形象都佩戴着用金色标出的特定物品。当你向前走，观察这个房间时，Lumia也在注视着你。 [party.has atugia |我认得那个人！”阿图吉亚指着屏幕上那个高个子的阿努比斯人的影像说道，那个角色脖子上戴着一个闪闪发光的卷轴护身符。“那就是坚不可摧的阿西姆！所有的故事都说过，他的信仰就是他的护盾，但从来没有人提到过他会使用这样的东西！的确。在贾西拉，阿西姆很可能是我最忠实的拥护者。不过，他大多数时候都是被借给马拉赫使用。那些艺术之神最珍视的仆从，有时会因为选择了一位收入较低的贵族来生育后代而招致怨恨，而阿西姆已经多次挫败了那些被被抛弃的贵族雇佣来的刺客们的阴谋。”卢米娅解释道。 《加达拉特与阿贝纳的卷轴》既能保护他免受魔法威胁，也能使他的身体免受普通武器的伤害，甚至能抵御任何形式的盔甲。 ] 这个是奥黛丽·斯威夫特-银色版，”她说道，同时指向一个形象栩栩如生的角色形象：那位女性面容严肃，身着飘逸的长袍，头戴一顶遮住双眼的金色王冠，周围还环绕着一圈淡金色的光环，呈半弧状分布在她的头顶后方。 她持有戈斯托克的权杖与奥斯伯特之眼，这两件神器极大地提升了她原有的魔法天赋，使她能够在为伊文尼斯国王服务的过程中发挥更大的作用。虽然我没能亲自将它们赠予她，但得知它们为她带来了如此大的帮助，我感到由衷的欣慰。你一路走到了大厅的尽头，仔细观察那些英雄们的画像以及陈列在他们基座上的真实文物。其中有四件物品仍然没有人认领。当你走到尽头时，你转身朝那位女神望去，微微挑了挑眉毛。 这就是你的意思吗？让我从这些选项中选择一个吗？”你问道。 “没错！那么，选择一个能够帮助众神的英雄…… 不是 这样的东西，他们确实配得上吧？”她笑着回答道。 她走上前，在走廊的尽头与你会面，然后依次带你参观剩下的那些文物。她首先带你看到的是一套经过抛光处理的板甲，甲片上镶嵌着会发出内光的符文。那顶开放式头盔还配有面甲，可以向下拉下来保护面部。虽然外观十分壮观，但这些厚重的甲片使得这套盔甲看起来肯定非常沉重。 这就是圣城的护甲，是我最近负责保管的文物之一！这是贝尔哈兰的法师铁匠们在战争期间制造的最后一批护甲，可惜它们从未在战场上被使用过。 被分配到这件神圣铠甲上的骑士，在他有机会穿上它上战场之前，就被一位被怨灵影响的巫师摧毁了他所指挥的堡垒，从而丧生了。”她一边说着，一边用手指轻轻触摸着那些刻在铠甲上的魔法文字，“后来，一些寻宝者从两层废墟下面将这件铠甲挖了出来，它竟然完好无损。 这些设计使得这种盔甲的实际重量远低于看上去的重量，同时还能自动修复任何凹痕或其他损伤。对于一位神话中的英雄来说，这种盔甲无疑是完美的保护装备，可惜它从未有机会展现出自己的价值。" 接下来，她带你看到了另一套盔甲，但这套与上一套有着显著的不同。它并非由金属制成，反而更像一件婚纱，而非适合在战场上使用的盔甲。这套盔甲由相互连接的雪花石膏鳞片制成，这些鳞片之间交织着一条金线，这条金线如同脉络一般贯穿其中。颈部还佩戴着由白色羽毛制成的护垫，这样可以防止鳞片边缘产生的摩擦伤害。其余部分则是由纯白色布料制成，上面绣着精美的图案。 [pc.bg scholar |让人联想到古老的伊兹坎蒂。 |你认不出来了。 ] 卢米娅整理了一下布料上那道不平整的褶皱，然后笑了起来。 “不过，这块布料可是有足够的时间来展现它的光彩的。它是伊兹坎蒂的女战士们传承下来的，也是整个国家的人民送给第一位女王的礼物。 它原本并没有自己的力量，但吸收了每位女王身上的一点点天赋，从而具备了这种力量。那个国家早已不复存在，不再是以往的模样了，但这条裙子依然承载着他们的传承。最初，它是以我的名义被使用的，用来抵御那些战争遗留下来的、会吸食血液的怪物。 当那位佩戴者在这个世界上的使命完成时，我的女武神们就将它带到了这里，它一直在等待着新的主人。 在让你仔细观察了这个物品之后，她便引导你去看下一个物品。这个物品是…… 庞大的 那根长矛，长度足以…… [pc.isBimbo |把植物种在土里，然后围着它跳舞吧！ |使你的身高显得矮小 [pc.heightRange 0 58 |再重复一遍！ |远远领先于其他人！ ] ] 然而，与那两套盔甲相比，它的设计显得相当简单。刀刃护手被锻造得宛如一对流动的翅膀，但除此之外，它在外观上与其他长矛并无区别。即便如此，这种武器仍散发出一种与众不同的气质。每当它出现在你身边时，你会不由自主地感到一股力量在涌动。 这就是那柄伟大的长矛——卡拉恩布罗特，正是它将那根黑色的荆棘从巨龙阿兹加洛斯的胸膛中刺了出来。没有人真正知道那根荆棘是如何进入这条强大的巨龙体内的，但它几乎刺入了它的心脏，使得巨龙陷入了极度的愤怒之中，这种愤怒甚至威胁到了伊文尼斯地区的安宁。 我将这把长矛留给了那位无名战士。他没有用它杀死那条龙，而是用它刺穿了那根刺，将其拔出来，防止它进一步刺入体内。之后，那位骑士立刻将卡兰布罗特归还给了我，从那以后，它就一直留在这里。" 最后，Lumia将你引向一个壁龛，那里有一层厚厚的布帘。当你靠近时，布帘缓缓拉开，露出几把投掷匕首。每一把匕首看起来都一模一样，银色与金色的纹路以复杂的图案交织在一起，这些图案看起来根本无法复制。这种设计使得这些匕首看起来就像某种色彩斑斓的鸟儿的羽毛。当你越来越接近时，空气中会传来清脆的金属碰撞声，同时，你还会感觉到有一阵轻风从后背吹过。 这最后一件神器，就是阿西拉之翼。在远古时代，这种巨大的太阳鸟在与巨龙的战斗中失去了一只翅膀。为了不让它死去，一位强大的法师铁匠为它锻造了一只由无数刀片组成的翅膀——至少其长度要能与它另一只翅膀八十英尺的跨度相媲美。当这只太阳鸟翱翔天际时，它翅膀上闪烁的光芒足以让整个王国的人们都陷入黑暗。当这只巨鸟死去后，它的一部分灵魂留在了这些匕首之中，使它们拥有了它内在的力量与自由的精神。 它们还保留着索拉的一些祝福；没有任何东西或任何人能够阻止它们回到它们的主人手中。既然我的女神姐姐总是在四处游历，这些物品就被留在了这里。不过，它们一直都非常渴望再次被使用——被关在这里，根本不适合它们。”她说着，这时你又感受到了一阵轻柔的风吹过。“说起来，你在这里看到的东西中，有没有什么特别吸引你的注意？ 你回头看了看那些被展示给你的四个物品，试图决定自己想要哪一个。
rows.raw: ' You make your way through the large double doors of the throne room, and there you find Lumia waiting for you on the marble throne. She's dressed in the same casual outfit she was in when you woke up after your battle. Somehow she still looks regal and godlike, even with one breast and much of her midriff completely exposed. The simple wrap conceals exactly what it needs to, and reveals the most motherly parts of its wearer. It's obvious that she knew you were coming. "I'm glad you've come so soon!" she exclaims, beaming brightly. "Come closer. We have much to discuss." "I figured it would be rude not to show up when a goddess wants to talk," you say, [pc.dcb |bowing curtly |bowing deeply |curtsying with a happy bounce ]. "None of that formality, please. I have enough trouble convincing the new girls that they can relax around me..." she sighs, rubbing her temples with an exaggerated frown. "I'd much rather we speak as friends, at the very least." She smiles at that, and all the pressure in the room disappears. It's the smile of someone who's known you forever, and someone you feel like you could share anything with. "Now then. I told you I owed you a few things last time, didn't I? I'd like to pay at least one of those debts back to you now. Please, follow me," she says, standing from the throne and turning to walk toward the door to her inner sanctum. You fall in behind her, walking through the small waiting room and then continuing into the center of the palace. Without the oppressive miasma that clouded the place on your last visit, the place takes your breath away. The room is shaped like a dome, with a large glass sphere at the center containing the twisting aurora of color you saw the first time you were here. It shines much brighter than it did then, enough to fill the entire chamber with a warm light. Apart from that, the place is filled with tables and work areas neatly arranged so as not to take up space. There's no telling what each area is meant for, but Lumia isn't headed toward them anyway. "It's just through here," she says, holding out her hand as a keyring of golden light materializes on her bent finger. She opens an unassuming door at one side of the chamber, and leads you down a flight of stairs in a compact stone passageway. This part of the castle is much colder, especially after the warmth of the previous one. Still, Lumia herself radiates enough warmth that it never gets uncomfortable. The hall trails down deep beneath the castle, and perhaps even into the mountain beneath the glacier. Finally, you arrive at another door. This one has no handle or lock, but is emblazoned with ancient runes and symbols that hum with power. The goddess stops you at the bottom of the steps, and then touches one hand to the door. After a second of concentration the noise dies down, and Lumia pushes the door open without effort. The inside is utterly dark until your godly guide creates an orb of glowing light. Once it's lit, however, the sight takes your breath away. This room is much simpler than the sanctum, just a thin hall set with a number of alcoves. Inside each one is a weapon, garment, or suit of armor[pc.bg scholar |, some of which you recognize as artifacts pulled straight from myth and legend! |. ] Some of them are on racks, and others appear as translucent silver figures who each wear a specific object highlighted in gold. Lumia watches as you walk forward and take in the room. [party.has atugia |"I recognize that one!" Atugia says, pointing at the flickering image of a tall anubian who wears around his neck a sparkling scroll amulet. "That's Asim the Impervious! The stories all said his faith was his shield, but none of them mentioned something like this!" "Indeed. Asim is quite likely my most faithful champion in Jassira. Most often though, he is lent to the service of Mallach. The god of art's most treasured servants sometimes draw ire for choosing a lower paying noble to bear a child, and Asim has thwarted myriad assassins hired by jilted aristocrats," Lumia explains. "The Scrolls of Gadarat and Abena both protect him from magical threats and ward his body against common weaponry as well as any armor." ] "This one is Audrey the Swift-Silver," she says, pointing to a shimmering visage of a stern woman wearing a flowing robe and a golden diadem that covers her eyes. A thin golden halo shimmers in a half arc behind her head. "She wields Gostoc's Nimbus and the Eyes of Osbert, both of which enhance her already potent magical talents in her service to the king of Yvennes. I wasn't able to be there to personally grant them to her, but it fills my heart with joy to know that they've served her well." You walk all the way to the end of the hall, looking among the images of the heroes and the very real artifacts on their pedestals. There are four such objects that remain unclaimed. When you get to the end, you turn back toward the goddess and raise an eyebrow. "Is this what you meant? Am I to pick one of these?" you ask. "Yes! Does a champion who aids the very gods not deserve something of their caliber?" she replies with a laugh. Stepping forth, she meets you at the end of the hall and guides you to each of the remaining artifacts in turn. The first one she brings you to is a suit of burnished plate armor inlaid with sigils that glow with an inner light. The open faced helm has a visor that would slip down to protect even the face. While visually impressive, the thick plates make the armor look like it would be extremely heavy. "This is the Panoply of the Holy City, one of the most recent artifacts to come into my care! It was the last piece of armor created by the Belharan mage-smiths during the war, but unfortunately it never saw use on the battlefield. The knight to whom it was assigned was killed when a Wraith-touched sorcerer obliterated the fortress he commanded, before he ever wore the blessed armor to battle. It was unearthed by treasure seekers from beneath two stories of decimated rubble, perfectly intact," she explains, reaching out to trace a finger along the magical lettering. "These markings are designed to both make the armor much lighter than it appears, and to self-repair any dents or other damage dealt to it. It's the perfect protection for a mythical hero, and it never got its chance to shine." Next, she leads you to another set of armor, but this one differs significantly than the last. Instead of metal, this one looks more like a wedding dress than armor that belongs on a battlefield. The cuirass is crafted from linked alabaster scales interlaced with a single golden thread that trails throughout them in weaving veins. A neck guard of downy white feathers keeps the rough edges of the scales from being abrasive. The rest is a shockingly pure white fabric laced with patterns [pc.bg scholar |reminiscent of ancient Izkanti. |you don't recognize. ] Lumia straightens an errant wrinkle in the cloth and smiles. "This one, though, got plenty of time to shine. It was passed down by the warrior queens of Izkanti, a gift from all the people of the nation to its first queen. Originally it had no power of its own, but it's absorbed a little of the talent from each queen to wear it. That nation no longer exists in the same fashion as it did then, but the dress maintains their legacy. It was first used in my name to repel an invasion of blood sucking monstrosities left over from the war. When that wearer's time in this world was up, my valkyries brought it here, where it has been waiting for a new champion." After letting you take it in, she ushers you on to the next item. This one is a massive greatspear, long enough to [pc.isBimbo |plant in the ground and dance around! |dwarf your height [pc.heightRange 0 58 |twice over! |by a good few feet! ] ] Compared to the two sets of armor, however, its design is quite simple. The blade guard is forged to resemble a pair of flowing wings, but apart from that it's no different than any other spear in its appearance. Still, an aura of importance stems from it. In all directions, you can't help but feel revitalized while the weapon is nearby. "This is the great spear Caranbrot, which clove the black thorn from the dragon Azgaloth's breast. No one truly knows how the thorn found its way into the mighty drake's body, but it dug almost to his heart and drove him into such a rage that it threatened the Yvennese countryside. I bequeathed this spear to a nameless warrior who, rather than slaying the dragon, used it to skewer the thorn and pry it out before it could sink deeper. The knight chose to return Caranbrot to me immediately afterwards, and it has remained here ever since." Finally, Lumia leads you to an alcove containing a thick fold of cloth. As you approach, the cloth opens to reveal a brace of throwing daggers. Each one looks identical, with silver and gold veins arcing through in patterns that look impossible to replicate. The effect makes them resemble the feathers of a particularly colorful bird. A trill of musical clinks fills the air as you get closer, and you feel a gentle wind at the small of your back. "This last artifact is the Wing of Asira. In ancient times, the great sunbird lost a wing in a battle with a dragon. Rather than see him die, a powerful magesmith forged for him a wing of endless blades— or at least enough to match the eighty foot span of his other wing. The glint of his descent alone was enough to blind a kingdom's worth of men. When the roc died, a little of his spirit remained with the daggers, giving them some of his inner fire and sense of freedom. "They also retain some of Sorra's blessing; nothing and no one can prevent them from returning to their wielder. Given that my sister goddess is always on the move, they are kept here. They've always longed to be used again, though. Being cooped up doesn't suit them at all," she says, and you feel another gentle bump of wind. "Speaking of which, has anything you've seen here caught your eye?" You look back at the four objects you've been shown, trying to decide which you'd like. '

For now you'd just like to chat. It feels strange to 'just sit and talk' with an actual goddess, but it's what you'd like nonetheless.
    
    "It's alright. 'Just sitting and talking' is one of my favorite things to do. It helps me get to know the girl's and their families, and everything else that goes on in my keep. [flags.LUMIA_TALK
        |I will always be open to chatting
        |I missed comfortable chatting while I was... indisposed
    ]," Lumia replies. "What did you want to talk about?"
rows.translation:
目前你只是想聊聊天。与一位真正的女神“坐下来聊天”确实感觉有些奇怪，但这就是你想要做的。

“没关系。‘坐下来聊天’其实是我的爱好之一。这样可以帮助我了解那些女孩们以及她们的家庭，还能了解我的领地里发生的各种事情。 [flags.LUMIA_TALK
        |我随时都愿意聊天。
        |在我身体不适的时候，我真的很怀念那种能够轻松愉快地聊天的时光。
    ]你想谈些什么呢？”卢米娅问道。
rows.raw:
"
    For now you'd just like to chat. It feels strange to 'just sit and talk' with an actual goddess, but it's what you'd like nonetheless.
    
    "It's alright. 'Just sitting and talking' is one of my favorite things to do. It helps me get to know the girl's and their families, and everything else that goes on in my keep. [flags.LUMIA_TALK
        |I will always be open to chatting
        |I missed comfortable chatting while I was... indisposed
    ]," Lumia replies. "What did you want to talk about?"
    "

rows.original: "I actually have some questions about the Godswar, if you don't mind my asking. Also I have some further questions about more recent events," you say. "Ask away, hero! If I can provide an answer then I shall, to the best of my ability." "I'll start with something simple then. How did the fighting change when you descended? I understand that the gods are powerful, but there are only seven of you. Are you really that much more powerful? In all the stories the number of victories changed so quickly that it's astounding." "For one thing, I and any of my fellow gods are exactly that powerful, but you're right in that we aren't omnipresent in our material forms. The primary reason decisive victories didn't happen before we descended was both because of the mortal kingdoms who had fallen to depravity already by the time we arrived, and because those who hadn't were suffering a blitz by monsters they weren't even sure could be killed. "Once you knew for sure that your enemy could be defeated, no monsters from beyond nor any of their beasts could stop you. When you have hope, the things you mortals are capable of multiply tenfold. All it took was for me to rout the forces who were currently encroaching on the Winter City, and that was enough to instill thoughts of victory in the elves. The change was not quite so fast as you may have gleaned from the stories, but it was a magnificent sight. "With my guidance, the elves and other peoples of the north learned how to destroy the Wraiths utterly. In other places of the world, the same was happening with the rest of the pantheon. It took some time for us to find each other, but when all of us were united the battles truly did become like the tales. We eradicated the Wraiths without a single further loss. The things from beyond the world proved incapable of devouring it wholly." "[pc.dcb |What I wouldn't give to have experienced a battle like that! |It sounds like it was a sight to see! |Oh. My. Goddess. You guys are so cool! ] Was that when you started the valkyrie order, or did that not happen till after the war?" "It was during the war, but not right away. Some time went by before any of us started to actually intertwine mortals with our essence. Keros was first, and is still the most widely reaching. After that, I asked the most fitting mortals in the combined armies if they wanted something similar, and gave it to those who did. It wasn't nearly as organized then as it is now, and each of my valkyries stayed mostly with the armies they had previously been a part of. "After the war, I settled here in the palace, and brought some of them with me. The Winter city was the only place to deliberately send warriors for me to judge fit to become valkyries after the war in an official capacity, but the natives of the rift and sometimes travelers from afar make the journey of their own volition. After interactions with the Lumian orders in their homelands, they wish to join in a more official capacity." "Huh, I would have figured you'd bring some valkyries with you when you descended." "I do not keep them hidden inside me, dear. On top of that I cannot bring spirits back from the dead, let alone give them physical forms. I could not have brought anyone with me if I wanted to, though it would have definitely helped if it were an option." "That's fair. What about after the war. What happened with that Wraith beneath your sanctum? Didn't you say you eradicated them?" "Yes. I may have been caught up in the moment. We eradicated their armies, but I kept at least that Wraith alive in an attempt to find a way to undo the corruption that fractured the Wraithspawn. I was... unsuccessful, at least in regards to healing it. It did help me to change them in some ways. The Wraith-touched chimeras in the rift used to be much more volatile and hate-filled. I was able to redirect their anger towards motherly instinct. Not what I originally wanted, but a success nonetheless. "After that single breakthrough, however, the Wraith began to grow in power to a degree that it kept me more and more occupied. It took more and more of my time until I was in the state you found me in: only able to sneak away for minutes at a time without its seal breaking. Apart from explaining the mental stress I was under during that time, I'm afraid the especially recent history would only be secondhand from my lips. You would do best to ask Annika or Thrud for specific information regarding the valkyries." "[pc.dcb |A shame. I'll have to hunt them down for the rest of my questions, |I had worried it would be like that. I'll ask them if I have more questions, |It's OK! You don't need to worry your big blessed booty about any of that. I'll stick with other things I know you can talk about, and ask them later if I need to, ]" you conclude. Did you have anything else you wanted to discuss with the goddess herself?
rows.translation: 其实我有一些关于‘神战’的事情想请教，如果您不介意的话。另外，对于最近发生的一些事件，我也有一些疑问。”你说。 “请随时提问吧，英雄！只要我能提供答案，我一定会尽我所能帮助你。” “那我就先从简单的问题开始吧。当你们降临之后，战斗的情况发生了哪些变化？我知道诸神都非常强大，但你们只有七位。那么，你们真的…… 那个 强大得多？在所有的故事中，胜利的次数变化得如此之快，简直令人难以置信。” “首先，我和我的其他神明们…… 是 确实拥有那样的力量，但你说得对，我们以物质形态存在时并不能无处不在。在我们降临之前之所以没有取得决定性的胜利，主要原因在于：在我们到达之前，那些凡人王国就已经堕落了；而那些尚未堕落的王国，却正在遭受那些他们甚至不确定能否被消灭的怪物的猛烈攻击。 一旦你确信自己的敌人是可以被击败的，那么无论是来自远方的怪物还是它们派出的任何野兽，都无法阻挡你。当你拥有希望时，人类所具备的能力就会成倍增长。而我只需要将那些正在入侵冬之城的敌军击退，这就足以让精灵们重新燃起胜利的信念。 这种变化并没有你们从故事中听到的那么迅速，但这一景象确实令人赞叹。 “在我的引导下，北方的精灵们以及其他民族学会了如何彻底消灭那些幽灵。在世界其他地方，其他神明也正在经历同样的变化。 我们花了一些时间才找到彼此，但当所有人团结在一起后，那些战斗确实变得如同传说中那样精彩。我们彻底消灭了那些幽灵，没有再遭受任何损失。那些来自异世界的东西，终究无法完全吞噬这个世界。" "[pc.dcb |我愿意付出任何代价来体验那样的战斗！ |那场面肯定非常壮观吧！ |天啊，你们真是太酷了！ ] 就是在那个时候你创立了女武神军团，还是说这件事是在战争之后才发生的？” “是在战争期间，但并不是立刻就行动的。过了一段时间，我们当中才有人开始真正地将凡人的命运与我们的力量联系在一起。 凯罗斯是第一个采用这种制度的，至今它依然是应用范围最广的。之后，我询问了联合军队中那些最合适的凡人，看看他们是否也有类似的想法，然后将这种制度提供给了那些有需求的人。当时，这个制度的组织结构远没有现在这么完善，我的每一位女武神大多还是继续留在她们之前所属的军队中。 战争结束后，我定居在了这座宫殿里，并带了一些人一起来到这里。在战后，只有冬之城会特意派遣战士们，让我正式评估他们是否适合成为女武神；而裂隙地区的原住民，以及一些远道而来的旅行者，则是出于自己的意愿前来投奔的。在与他们家乡的卢米安组织进行了接触之后，他们也都希望能够以更正式的身份加入我们。 哈，我本来以为你下凡的时候会带上一些女武神呢。” “亲爱的，我并没有把她们藏在体内啊。更何况，我根本无法让死去的灵魂复生，更不可能给它们赋予实体形态。就算我想带人同行，也做不到啊……不过如果这个选项存在的话，肯定会很有帮助的。 那也说得通。那么战后呢？你所说的那个藏在你的圣所里的幽灵，后来发生了什么？你不是说你已经把它们消灭了吗？” “是的。当时我可能有些急于求成。我们确实消灭了它们的军队，但我还是让那个幽灵活了下来，希望能找到办法消除那些导致幽灵族分裂的腐败因素。 至少在治愈它这方面，我是……失败的。不过，我在某些方面确实改变了它们的行为。那些被怨灵影响的奇美拉，在裂隙中原本更加暴躁、充满仇恨，但我成功地将它们的愤怒转化为母性本能。 虽然不是我最初想要的，但终究还是取得了成功。 然而，在那次突破之后，那个名为“Wraith”的存在开始逐渐增强它的力量，这种力量让我越来越忙于应对它。我花费的时间越来越多，最终陷入了你现在看到的这种境地：每次只能偷偷溜走几分钟，否则它的封印就会解除。除了说明那段时间我所承受的精神压力之外，恐怕关于最近发生的事情，你只能从我的口中了解到一些间接的信息。如果你想了解关于那些女武神的具体情况，最好去问安妮卡或者瑟鲁德。 "[pc.dcb |真遗憾。那我只好在剩下的时间里自己去寻找这些答案了。 |我就担心会是这样。如果我还有其他问题，我会去问他们的。 |没关系的！你完全不需要为那些事情担心。我会选择那些你知道我们可以聊的话题来继续交流，如果真的需要的话，我以后再问你也不迟。 ]你得出了结论。 还有其他你想与那位女神亲自讨论的事情吗？

rows.original: "How does your reputation affect you, if at all? [var0 |I know you don't really require worship to gain power, and lack thereof doesn't make you less powerful, but how do you feel about |Not just among your followers, but with ] the people who shun worship of the Seven? It doesn't need to be you specifically, but that too if the answer is different," you ask. "Hmm. Those will be two different answers. I think I can provide an answer for both, but let me start with the one that hits closer to home," Lumia replies, [party.has etheryn |looking off into the main hall at Etheryn, who is in the midst of an animated discussion with two valkyries. |thinking for a moment. ] "I have mixed feelings about those who worship other gods. When I first descended during the Godswar, I felt that the only way to ensure that we defeated the Wraiths with minimal casualties was to have everyone united under the banner of The Seven. Any dissenters would only cause strife and that could have caused the whole war effort to fall apart. "However, in the years that came after that I came to greatly regret that decision. I had figured the Wraiths would be enough of an overwhelming threat, but faith is not so easily altered. The schism it caused between the elves who supported me and their druidic counterparts imploded even during the war. If I could do it over again, I may have sought to ally myself with their ancient spirits. "The longer I'm in this world as a living god, the more experience I actually get with the lesser divinities and spirits that abound in it. Each of them is unique and wonderful in its own way. Nowadays it would hurt me greatly to see them snuffed out over something as petty as worship. It's easy to make decisions like that without experiencing the outcome firsthand," she explains. "That sounds very noble, but what about when they're actively hostile to the idea of sharing worship, like the druids?" you ask. "Like I said, perhaps it could have been different if we had approached in a way that wasn't so barbaric. There may even have been a path to peace. As they are now, I've heard their spirits are on the brink of death and accepting that. It begrudges me to admit that sometimes Tira's embrace is the best way to move on, but I still question if it's too late for them. "On the other hand, in the case of places like Kitsuhon, I can fully understand my negative reputation. The corrupt paladin orders who used my name as the 'goddess of conquerors' to ensorcel and steal from its people are long dead now, but the wound they left still stings centuries later. It's even brought them to attempt a retaliation with the descendents left from those who helped in the war. "I can't let that awfulness simply breed more awfulness, but they don't exactly trust me. They've been trying to convert the local spirits to be more like their own. Velun and I have begun plans to stymie their efforts, and they'll be all the easier now that I'm free to interact with the spirits once again. I wonder if they could be convinced to help out around here rather than following some imperial decree..."
rows.translation: 你的名声究竟会对你产生什么影响呢？ [var0 |我知道你其实并不需要通过崇拜来获得力量，缺乏崇拜也不会使你的力量减弱，但你对这种做法究竟有什么看法呢？ |不仅仅是在你的粉丝中，而是在所有人中。 ] 那些拒绝崇拜七神的人吧？不一定是你个人，但如果答案不同的话，也包括你吧？”你问道。 “嗯……那些人…… 会 这两个问题的答案截然不同。我想我可以为两者都提供一个答案，但先从那个与我的生活更息息相关的问题开始吧，”Lumia回答道。 [party.has etheryn |望着主厅里，埃瑟琳正与两位女武神热烈地交谈着。 |想了一会儿。 ] 对于那些崇拜其他神明的人，我怀有复杂的感情。在神战爆发之初，我就认为，要想以最小的代价战胜那些幽灵，唯一的办法就是让所有人团结在“七神”的旗帜下。 任何持不同意见的人只会导致纷争，而这种纷争可能会使整个战争计划彻底失败。 “然而，在那之后的几年里，我开始深深后悔那个决定。我原本以为那些‘幽灵’所带来的威胁已经足够令人畏惧了，但人们的信念却并非那么容易改变。 这导致了支持我的精灵们与他们的德鲁伊同僚们之间的分裂，而这种分裂最终彻底爆发了。 在……期间 这场战争……如果能够重来一次，我或许会尝试与他们那些古老的精灵们结盟。 “在我以‘活神’的身份存在于这个世界的时间越长，我就越能了解到这个世界上那些低等神灵和精灵们的特性。它们每一个都有自己独特而奇妙的地方。如今，看到它们仅仅因为一些微不足道的崇拜仪式就被消灭，我真的会感到非常痛心。在没有亲身体验这些后果之前，人们很容易做出这样的决定。”她解释道。 听起来确实很高尚，但要是那些人从一开始就坚决反对共享崇拜的理念，比如德鲁伊们，那该怎么办呢？”你问道。 “正如我所说，如果我们当初采取的方式不那么粗暴，或许结果会不同。或许本来还存在通往和平的道路。但就目前的情况来看，我听说他们的精神已经濒临崩溃的边缘，而且他们也接受了这一事实。虽然我很不愿意承认，但有时候，接受提拉的庇护确实是继续前行的最佳途径……不过，我还是怀疑对他们来说，现在是否还为时已晚。 另一方面，对于像Kituhon这样的地方，我完全能够理解自己为何会有这样的负面名声。那些利用我的名字，自称‘征服者的女神’来迷惑当地人民、掠夺他们的腐败圣骑士们早已去世，但他们留下的伤痕至今仍在作痛。这种伤害甚至促使他们试图对那些在战争中曾提供帮助的人的后代进行报复。 我绝不能让那种恶劣的行为继续滋生更多的邪恶，但他们并不完全信任我。他们一直在试图让当地的精灵变得更像他们自己。我和维伦已经开始制定计划来阻止他们的行动，而现在我终于可以再次与这些精灵交流了，我们的行动也会变得更加顺利。我在想，是否能够说服他们在这里帮忙，而不是盲目执行那些帝国的命令……

rows.original: [flags.LUMIA_PREG_EVENT |"If you can get pregnant, then why haven't I heard any stories of demigods running about in the world?" you ask. |"Now I could probably ask this of any of the gods, but with you it's the most odd. How come the goddess of breeding doesn't have children of her own?" you ask. "But I do," Lumia says simply, smiling at you in confusion as if you'd asked her if she has [pc.isBimbo |two massive titties. |glowing eyes. ] "H-how many? Why are there no stories of demigods sharing your powers?" ] Lumia marvels at you for a moment, plainly shocked at your surprise. It doesn't take her long to recover, but there's a further pause as she thinks about how to respond. "If you know my myths well enough to know there are no stories of demigods, then you should know exactly why I don't create them. If everything I produced shared my power, it would wreak havoc on all the natural races of the world!" she explains, [lumia.isPregnant |idly rubbing her gravid belly. |tapping on her stomach wistfully. ] "No, my womb produces children that are wonderfully mortal in every way. Each of them is raised by a family that is just as mortal and just as wonderful. And those families are blissfully ignorant that the child came directly from me, rather than one of my valkyries." "[pc.dcb |So you just make babies for other people? Do you not want them for yourself? |That sounds... as difficult as it is selfless. Do you ever wish you could keep them for yourself? |Aww! That's so thoughtful and amazingful and just all the kinds of ful you could ever think of! Don't you, like, want to keep the babies for yourself, though? ]" "I want to keep every single one. No matter how many times over how many years, it never hurts less. Still, I know in my heart that I could never give them the life they deserve. Seeing the love in the hearts of the parents I help fills some of that void. Never all of it, but enough to make it worth every moment of pain." "I'm glad it doesn't keep you down." "I have far too many helpful people like you and[pc.isValk | the rest of] my valkyries to ever sink too far. You mortals keep showing me how worth it all of this is," Lumia concludes. Well that's an answer you hadn't expected, but certainly an interesting one. [flags.ARCHWAY_BOTH_SAVED |"With that other discussion out of the way: how is it that you can become pregnant despite your[pc.isBimbo |, um, |... ]" you ask, at a loss for the exact words to use. The warm goddess smiles knowingly all the same. "It would be quite the miracle, wouldn't it? Creating a soul from nothing? That's beyond even my considerable power. But saving people isn't. Even before you would probably consider them 'people.' Occasionally, a child in the womb will be too weak for my valkyries to save with their magic, or perhaps a parent will die before we can reach them. Rather than let those unfortunate souls be snuffed out as well, I rescue them personally, and give them a chance to live, and to thrive," she explains, drumming her fingers on her [lumia.isPregnant |belly |stomach ]. "So you're behaving more like a surrogate? The baby originally came from elsewhere?" "Ah. Not quite. That could certainly be true in some cases, but [lumia.isPregnant |this baby does belong to this body |those children do belong to this body. ]," she says, pointing her thumbs at her own chest. "One of my warriors was afflicted with a particularly horrific Wraith-born hex that would drain away her very essence. By the time she reached the keep, it had progressed too far for even me to reverse completely. In her last moments of lucidity, she confided in me the fear of fading from the world before she could bring life into it, and I was struck by a longing that I had not felt since coming to consciousness in that plaza in the Winter City. "I poured every bit of myself into her body to stop that curse. Everything she could handle without her shredded being fading away. My mind and power filled every crack, till it was both of us inhabiting her body. [flags.TODO_VALK_POSSESSION |You know how impossible it is to describe the sensation, but it felt even stranger that first time. |It is impossible to describe the feeling of inhabiting the same body. I'm sure some of my girls could find a way to explain the sensations, but for me each experience is different. Especially that first time. ] To me it felt very small, but it was also the first time I had experienced that drive to be a mother from a mortal's standpoint. "And she was there, marveling in my thoughts about what was happening. I've since learned to hide it, but for that first time I had no concept of needing to hide my own being. In an instant, she learned my secret and everything it entails, but that didn't shake her faith for a moment. Self doubt leads me to believe that she was too far gone to really comprehend the gravity of what she learned, but she simply exuded the impression that 'if I am here, and granting her wishes, then surely that is the wish of her goddess'. "Regardless, I was able to find a donor among her squad-mates, and was able to hold her together for long enough to carry out the pregnancy. This was also my first time actually experiencing that, beyond recreations of my mythos that seemed childish in comparison. All those new sensations felt so correct, and I felt more than ever before like I belonged in this world. "You cannot possibly comprehend how wonderful it is to feel something so vital growing within you when you yourself do not possess such animus. After she left, I changed this body to fit my most commonly enshrined image, but I couldn't bring myself to leave. Not entirely," she says, rubbing her shoulders. "It's... hard to go back to nothing, when it feels like you had everything. It's rare these days that at least some of my godly essence isn't conjoined with one of my followers. "I hide my true nature, of course, and it's never as deeply interwoven as that first time, but still they want to feel what it's like," she continues with a somber laugh. "I said earlier that it's impossible to describe, but that's not quite true. Every one of them says it's warm. It's the only constant from all of them. [flags.TODO_VALK_POSSESSION |Even you did the same thing. |Can you imagine? ] Sharing a body with a formless nightmare from beyond the world, and [flags.TODO_VALK_POSSESSION |you |they ] say 'warm'." "Perhaps that should be evidence that you're no longer a 'nightmare.' One could argue you stopped being a monster the moment you stopped being mindless. Regardless, it's weird to hear you sound so down about being able to have kids! [pc.dcb |You're a god, so you should act like one and be proud of what your followers think of you! |You're a god! Believe in yourself like [pc.isValk |we |your followers ] believe in you! |You're the most babe-alicious goddess there is! If I believe you can have a baby, then it should be totally ok and normal! ]" you say. You aren't sure if she looks completely convinced, but the Wraith-turned-goddess gives you a brief and quizzical look that morphs back into her usual smile. "You are one hundred percent correct, [pc.isValk |my brave hero |dear champion ]. I'm glad to have people like you and [pc.isValk |your wing-sisters |my valkyries ] around to keep reminding me." "That does beg one more question, though," you say, rubbing your chin thoughtfully. "What happened to that baby? If you normally do the whole surrogate and adoption thing just like the valkyries, then what happened to that first one?" "Oh! I suppose I did leave that part out. We raised him here! Most often valkyries return to their homes when they wish to have children, but those who still wish to remain or who have tasks that allow them to do so sometimes raise their children here in the castle. When he came of age, he opted to join one of the Arkacian orders, and served them right up till his death. He still has living descendants whom I occasionally check in on, but I don't meddle that deeply," she concludes. Well, now you know how she's having children, and have some deeper understanding of why. What else do you want to know? ]
rows.translation: [flags.LUMIA_PREG_EVENT |如果人类能够怀孕，那么为什么我从来没听说过有半神在世界上四处游荡呢？”你问道。 |现在，我或许可以向任何一位神明提出这个问题，但对你来说，这个问题似乎格外奇怪——为什么这位掌管生育的女神自己却没有孩子呢？”你问道。 “但我有啊，”卢米娅简单地回答，困惑地对你笑了笑，仿佛你在问她是否已经有孩子一样。 [pc.isBimbo |两个巨大的胸部。 |发光的眼睛。 ] 多少个？为什么没有关于半神们分享你这种力量的故事呢？ ] 卢米娅愣住了片刻，显然对你表现出的惊讶感到十分震惊。她很快恢复了镇定，但随后又陷入了沉思，不知道该如何回应。 “如果你足够了解我的传说，就会知道根本不存在半神这样的存在。那么你也应该明白，为什么我不会创造它们。如果我创造的一切生物都拥有我的力量，那么这个世界上的所有自然种族都会陷入混乱之中！”她解释道。 [lumia.isPregnant |她闲闲地揉着自己隆起的腹部。 |无奈地轻拍着自己的肚子。 ] 不，我的子宫孕育出的孩子，无论在哪个方面，都不过是平凡而渺小的生命。每个孩子都是由同样平凡而美好的家庭抚养长大的。而这些家庭却完全不知道，这些孩子其实是直接从我这里诞生的，而不是由我的任何一位女武神所生。[pc.dcb |所以你只是为别人生孩子吗？你自己就不想要孩子吗？ |那听起来……就像无私奉献一样困难。你有没有想过，能不能把它们留给自己呢？ |哇！真是太贴心、太棒了，简直包含了你能想到的所有美好之处！不过，你难道不想把这些宝宝留给自己吗？ ]我想把它们全部保留下来。无论经过多少年、重复多少次，这种痛苦始终不会减轻。但我心里明白，我永远无法给予它们应得的生活。看到那些我帮助过的父母们心中的爱，这种痛苦确实得到了一些缓解。虽然不能完全消除，但至少足以让这一切痛苦都变得值得。” “我很高兴这并没有让你感到沮丧。” “像你这样的热心人士实在太多了，我真的很感激……[pc.isValk | 其余部分] 我的女武神们，千万不要堕入太深的深渊。你们这些凡人，一直在让我感受到这一切都是值得的，”卢米娅说道。 嗯，这确实是一个你没有预料到的回答，但无疑是非常有趣的。 [flags.ARCHWAY_BOTH_SAVED |既然另一个话题已经讨论完毕，那么我就想问：尽管你存在这样的情况，为什么还是能够怀孕的呢？[pc.isBimbo |嗯， |... ]你这样问，实在不知道该用什么词来表达。” 然而，那位温暖的女神依然会心一笑。 “这确实会是一个奇迹，不是吗？从无到有地创造出一个灵魂？就连我这样的强大存在，也难以做到这一点。 但拯救生命却并非如此。事实上，在你将那些生命视为“人类”之前，这种情况就已经发生了。有时候，腹中的胎儿会过于虚弱，以至于我的女武神们无法用魔法将其拯救；又或者，在我们赶到之前，孩子的父母就已经去世了。 我并不想让那些不幸的人也遭到毁灭，所以我亲自去拯救他们，给他们生存和发展的机会，”她一边说，一边用手指轻轻敲打着桌面。 [lumia.isPregnant |肚子 |肚子 ]所以你的行为更像是一个代孕者？这个孩子本来是来自其他地方的吧？” “啊，不完全是那样。在某些情况下确实可能是这样，但是…… [lumia.isPregnant |这个孩子确实属于这个身体。 |那些孩子确实属于这个大家庭。 ]就是这样的，”她说着，用拇指指着自己的胸膛。“我的一名战士罹患了一种极其可怕的、由怨灵引发的诅咒，这种诅咒会逐渐消耗她的生命力。当她来到这座城堡时，病情已经发展到了连我都无法完全治愈的地步。 在她最后的清醒时刻，她向我倾诉了自己那种在为这个世界带来生命之前就可能会从这个世界消失的恐惧。而这种感受，让我产生了一种自从在冬之城的那个广场恢复意识以来从未有过的渴望。 我将自己的全部力量注入她的身体，只为解除那诅咒。只要她还能承受，我的力量就不会消失。我的意识与力量填满了她身体的每一个角落，直到我们两个人共同存在于她的身体之中。 [flags.TODO_VALK_POSSESSION |你知道，那种感觉根本无法用语言来描述，但第一次体验的时候，那种感觉更是显得格外奇妙。 |很难用语言来描述拥有同一个身体的那种感觉。我相信我的一些女性朋友或许能够找到办法来描述这种体验，但对我来说，每一次体验都是独一无二的。尤其是第一次的时候。 ] 在我看来，那个空间显得非常狭小，但那也是我第一次以一个普通人的视角，体会到成为母亲所带来的那种冲动与渴望。 “而她就在那里，默默地关注着我内心的思绪，了解着我正在经历什么。后来我学会了隐藏这些情绪，但那第一次，我完全没有意识到自己有必要隐藏自己的真实感受。 转眼间，她就知道了我的秘密以及其中所涉及的一切，但这一点丝毫没有动摇她的信念。我常常怀疑，她或许根本无法真正理解自己所了解到的这些事情的严重性，但她给人的感觉却是：「既然我在这里，满足了她的愿望，那么这肯定就是她的女神所期望的。」 无论如何，我还是在她的队友中找到了一个愿意捐赠的人，这也让我有足够的时间帮助她完成整个孕期。对我来说，这也是第一次真正经历这样的经历。 那个这一切，都远远超出了那些看似幼稚的神话再现。所有那些全新的感受都显得如此真实，我比以往任何时候都更强烈地感受到，自己确实属于这个世界。 “当你自己并没有那种内在的动力时，却能感受到有某种如此重要的东西在你自己体内逐渐成长，这种感觉究竟有多美妙，你是永远也无法理解的。 她离开后，我将这个身体改成了与我最常被人们所认知的形象相匹配的样子，但我实在无法让自己离开那里。至少不是完全地，”她边说边揉着肩膀，“当你觉得自己已经拥有一切的时候，要回到一无所有的状态，真的……很难。 如今，我的神圣力量至少不会与我的某个追随者结合，这种情况已经变得十分罕见了。 “当然，我会隐藏自己的真实本性，而且这种结合也再不会像第一次那样紧密了，但他们仍然想要体验那种感觉，”她带着一丝忧郁的笑声继续说道。 我之前说过，这种感觉很难用语言描述，但其实也不完全正确。他们每个人都说这种感觉很温暖，这是他们所有人共同描述的一个特点。 [flags.TODO_VALK_POSSESSION |就连你也会做出同样的事情。 |你能想象吗？ ] 与一个来自异世界的无形噩梦共享同一个身体…… [flags.TODO_VALK_POSSESSION |你 |他们 ] 说‘温暖’吧。” “或许这应该能证明你已经不再是一个‘噩梦’了。可以说，从你不再盲目、不再失去理智的那一刻起，你就不再是一个怪物了。不过，听到你对自己能够拥有孩子这件事表现得如此沮丧，还是让人觉得有些奇怪啊！ [pc.dcb |你是一位神明，所以你应该像神明一样行事，并为你的追随者们对你的评价感到自豪！ |你简直就是神一般的人物！要像那样相信自己。 [pc.isValk |我们 |你的追随者们 ] 相信你！ |你绝对是世界上最会吸引男人的女神了！如果我相信你真的能生孩子的话，那么那个孩子肯定非我莫属！ 完全地 没问题，一切正常！ ]你说得对。” 你不确定她是否真的被说服了，但这位曾经是幽灵、如今已成为女神的女性只是短暂地、带着一丝疑惑地看着你，随后又恢复了她那惯常的微笑。 “你完全正确。 [pc.isValk |我勇敢的英雄 |亲爱的冠军 ]我很高兴有你这样的人在身边。 [pc.isValk |你的姐妹机 |我的女武神们 ] 总是不停地提醒我。” “不过，这确实引出了另一个问题，”你若有所思地摸着下巴说道，“那么，到底发生了什么呢？ 那个 宝贝？如果你平时也像那些女武神一样选择代孕和收养孩子，那么第一个孩子后来怎么样了呢？” “哦！我想我确实忽略了这个部分。我们就是在这里把他养大的！通常情况下，女武神们在想要孩子的时候会回到自己的家乡，但那些想要继续留在这里，或者因为有任务而无法回家的女武神，有时也会在城堡里抚养自己的孩子。 当他成年后，他选择了加入阿卡西亚的某个骑士团，并为他们效力直至生命终结。他的后代至今仍然健在，我偶尔会去关心他们的近况，但并不会过多干涉他们的生活，”她总结道。 嗯，现在你们已经知道她是如何生孩子的了，也应该对其中的原因有了更深入的了解。还有什么你想知道的吗？ ]
rows.raw: ' [flags.LUMIA_PREG_EVENT |"If you can get pregnant, then why haven't I heard any stories of demigods running about in the world?" you ask. |"Now I could probably ask this of any of the gods, but with you it's the most odd. How come the goddess of breeding doesn't have children of her own?" you ask. "But I do," Lumia says simply, smiling at you in confusion as if you'd asked her if she has [pc.isBimbo |two massive titties. |glowing eyes. ] "H-how many? Why are there no stories of demigods sharing your powers?" ] Lumia marvels at you for a moment, plainly shocked at your surprise. It doesn't take her long to recover, but there's a further pause as she thinks about how to respond. "If you know my myths well enough to know there are no stories of demigods, then you should know exactly why I don't create them. If everything I produced shared my power, it would wreak havoc on all the natural races of the world!" she explains, [lumia.isPregnant |idly rubbing her gravid belly. |tapping on her stomach wistfully. ] "No, my womb produces children that are wonderfully mortal in every way. Each of them is raised by a family that is just as mortal and just as wonderful. And those families are blissfully ignorant that the child came directly from me, rather than one of my valkyries." "[pc.dcb |So you just make babies for other people? Do you not want them for yourself? |That sounds... as difficult as it is selfless. Do you ever wish you could keep them for yourself? |Aww! That's so thoughtful and amazingful and just all the kinds of ful you could ever think of! Don't you, like, want to keep the babies for yourself, though? ]" "I want to keep every single one. No matter how many times over how many years, it never hurts less. Still, I know in my heart that I could never give them the life they deserve. Seeing the love in the hearts of the parents I help fills some of that void. Never all of it, but enough to make it worth every moment of pain." "I'm glad it doesn't keep you down." "I have far too many helpful people like you and[pc.isValk | the rest of] my valkyries to ever sink too far. You mortals keep showing me how worth it all of this is," Lumia concludes. Well that's an answer you hadn't expected, but certainly an interesting one. [flags.ARCHWAY_BOTH_SAVED |"With that other discussion out of the way: how is it that you can become pregnant despite your[pc.isBimbo |, um, |... ]" you ask, at a loss for the exact words to use. The warm goddess smiles knowingly all the same. "It would be quite the miracle, wouldn't it? Creating a soul from nothing? That's beyond even my considerable power. But saving people isn't. Even before you would probably consider them 'people.' Occasionally, a child in the womb will be too weak for my valkyries to save with their magic, or perhaps a parent will die before we can reach them. Rather than let those unfortunate souls be snuffed out as well, I rescue them personally, and give them a chance to live, and to thrive," she explains, drumming her fingers on her [lumia.isPregnant |belly |stomach ]. "So you're behaving more like a surrogate? The baby originally came from elsewhere?" "Ah. Not quite. That could certainly be true in some cases, but [lumia.isPregnant |this baby does belong to this body |those children do belong to this body. ]," she says, pointing her thumbs at her own chest. "One of my warriors was afflicted with a particularly horrific Wraith-born hex that would drain away her very essence. By the time she reached the keep, it had progressed too far for even me to reverse completely. In her last moments of lucidity, she confided in me the fear of fading from the world before she could bring life into it, and I was struck by a longing that I had not felt since coming to consciousness in that plaza in the Winter City. "I poured every bit of myself into her body to stop that curse. Everything she could handle without her shredded being fading away. My mind and power filled every crack, till it was both of us inhabiting her body. [flags.TODO_VALK_POSSESSION |You know how impossible it is to describe the sensation, but it felt even stranger that first time. |It is impossible to describe the feeling of inhabiting the same body. I'm sure some of my girls could find a way to explain the sensations, but for me each experience is different. Especially that first time. ] To me it felt very small, but it was also the first time I had experienced that drive to be a mother from a mortal's standpoint. "And she was there, marveling in my thoughts about what was happening. I've since learned to hide it, but for that first time I had no concept of needing to hide my own being. In an instant, she learned my secret and everything it entails, but that didn't shake her faith for a moment. Self doubt leads me to believe that she was too far gone to really comprehend the gravity of what she learned, but she simply exuded the impression that 'if I am here, and granting her wishes, then surely that is the wish of her goddess'. "Regardless, I was able to find a donor among her squad-mates, and was able to hold her together for long enough to carry out the pregnancy. This was also my first time actually experiencing that, beyond recreations of my mythos that seemed childish in comparison. All those new sensations felt so correct, and I felt more than ever before like I belonged in this world. "You cannot possibly comprehend how wonderful it is to feel something so vital growing within you when you yourself do not possess such animus. After she left, I changed this body to fit my most commonly enshrined image, but I couldn't bring myself to leave. Not entirely," she says, rubbing her shoulders. "It's... hard to go back to nothing, when it feels like you had everything. It's rare these days that at least some of my godly essence isn't conjoined with one of my followers. "I hide my true nature, of course, and it's never as deeply interwoven as that first time, but still they want to feel what it's like," she continues with a somber laugh. "I said earlier that it's impossible to describe, but that's not quite true. Every one of them says it's warm. It's the only constant from all of them. [flags.TODO_VALK_POSSESSION |Even you did the same thing. |Can you imagine? ] Sharing a body with a formless nightmare from beyond the world, and [flags.TODO_VALK_POSSESSION |you |they ] say 'warm'." "Perhaps that should be evidence that you're no longer a 'nightmare.' One could argue you stopped being a monster the moment you stopped being mindless. Regardless, it's weird to hear you sound so down about being able to have kids! [pc.dcb |You're a god, so you should act like one and be proud of what your followers think of you! |You're a god! Believe in yourself like [pc.isValk |we |your followers ] believe in you! |You're the most babe-alicious goddess there is! If I believe you can have a baby, then it should be totally ok and normal! ]" you say. You aren't sure if she looks completely convinced, but the Wraith-turned-goddess gives you a brief and quizzical look that morphs back into her usual smile. "You are one hundred percent correct, [pc.isValk |my brave hero |dear champion ]. I'm glad to have people like you and [pc.isValk |your wing-sisters |my valkyries ] around to keep reminding me." "That does beg one more question, though," you say, rubbing your chin thoughtfully. "What happened to that baby? If you normally do the whole surrogate and adoption thing just like the valkyries, then what happened to that first one?" "Oh! I suppose I did leave that part out. We raised him here! Most often valkyries return to their homes when they wish to have children, but those who still wish to remain or who have tasks that allow them to do so sometimes raise their children here in the castle. When he came of age, he opted to join one of the Arkacian orders, and served them right up till his death. He still has living descendants whom I occasionally check in on, but I don't meddle that deeply," she concludes. Well, now you know how she's having children, and have some deeper understanding of why. What else do you want to know? ] '

rows.translation: 孩子们

rows.original: "[pc.isValk |Could you explain what that [pc.isBimbo |glowy |shining ] light in your sanctum was? I know you explained it before, but I could use a refresher. |What was that flashing light in your inner sanctum? It looked like the Wraith was trying to get at it, ]" you ask. "Would you like to see it again? Come! It's something that deserves an audience for its explanation," the goddess exclaims, guiding you by the hand through the back door and down the two flights of stairs it takes to reach her inner sanctum. Things are much less dark than the first time you saw it, but your eyes are still immediately drawn to the same large glass in the room's center. Inside, that scintillating rainbow of light twists and dances in a way that reminds you of birds in flight. Also, inexplicably, it reminds you of [pc.isValk |you. As if the part of you that lies within is waving at you deliberately. |all the valkyries you've met. ] "This," Lumia says, waving her hand to indicate the light with a proud smile, "is the Aurora Strand. It is the combined souls of all the valkyries under my wing, and all the valkyries that ever have been. Even if their bodies crumble and their spirits pass beyond this world, a part of them remains to guide the new generations." [pc.swornGod lumia |"I'm flattered to hear that I'm in there guiding you," you tease. "Please, dear, inside there you're just one of many," Lumia chuckles. "But thank you. Without you I wouldn't be able to do nearly as much for the people of this world. I may be a god, but I can't be everywhere at once." "I don't think anyone should expect you to be, but at least with us you can get a little closer to that goal. Protection for every corner of the world, and plenty of company so our goddess can have some fun without being bogged down by constantly answering prayers." "Now you are flattering me," she replies. "Tell me, what did you see when your soul was joined with the Strand? I'm told everyone sees something different." "Hmm. It felt like I was being lifted into the air by two gigantic hands. It wasn't alarming, though. I felt like I was being protected, rather than kidnapped or eaten." "How unique! Such things never cease to amaze me. I tend to ask everyone after they've had some acclimation time. Usually it's moments from their past, but some are more abstract like you." "Will I... still be in there? Even after I die?" "Part of you will remain for as long as I'm [flags.ARCHWAY_BOTH_SAVED |here |manifested ], but it's not the you who is talking to me. The Strand is made up of powerful emotional echoes. I use it to gauge whether I'm being too detached in my decisions, but it doesn't allow my followers to cheat death. It merely allows a small part of them to remain with me." |"[pc.dcb |It's... so bright, |It's beautiful, where do the colors come from? |It's so pretty and colorful! Kinda hurts my eyes though, ]" you [pc.isChamp |ask |say ]. "[pc.dcb |Indeed. |Isn't it just? |Don't stare so hard, dear... ] The colors are slivers of each valkyrie's potential. What is kept may not be their greatest achievement, but it is the moment they most exemplified what it means to be a valkyrie," Lumia explains, brushing her fingers against the glass. Wherever she touches, brief shimmers of white flutter in the space between the other side of the glass and the mass of twirling light at the center. It doesn't explicitly change in the way it moves, but it's definitely reacting to her presence. You don't interrupt her as she stares, smiling wistfully for about a minute before she continues talking. "Whenever I worry about whether something I'm doing is correct, I examine those feelings extra hard. That's usually enough to knock me out of a funk and help me make a decision." "You speak almost like it's a living thing. Can it communicate?" "Oh, no, or at least not in the sense a person can. They're powerful echoes of experiences, and I use those as a gauge. If what I feel differs from what caused the same feelings in my valkyries, then I know I'm looking at the problem too much like a detached god and not a living one. It's helped me many times." ] "I'm glad all your followers can continue to help you even after their deaths. And I'm even happier now that the ones who still live can come back to the palace and help you relax." "Heavens, yes. Speaking of, shall we go find something more relaxing to do?" the goddess replies, leading you back up and into her throne room.
rows.translation: "[pc.isValk |你能解释一下那是什么意思吗？ [pc.isBimbo |发光的 |闪耀的 ] 你圣所里的灯光是怎样的？我知道你之前解释过，但我现在需要再回顾一下。 |你那个私密空间里闪烁的灯光是什么？看起来好像“幽灵”试图去触碰它…… ]你问得倒好…… “还想再看一遍吗？来吧！这个故事确实值得有人仔细聆听它的来龙去脉，”女神一边说，一边牵着你的手，穿过后门，沿着两层楼梯，带你来到了她的密室。 虽然景象已经没有你第一次看到它时那么昏暗了，但你的目光仍然会立刻被房间中央那块巨大的玻璃吸引。在玻璃内部，那道闪烁的彩虹般的光芒以一种令人联想到飞翔中的鸟儿的方式蜿蜒舞动。 而且，奇怪的是，它总会让你想起…… [pc.isValk |你。就好像你内在的某个部分正在故意向你招手一样。 |你遇到的所有女武神们。 ] 这就是，”卢米娅骄傲地微笑着，挥手指向那道光芒说道，“极光之光。它凝聚了我麾下所有女武神的灵魂，以及所有曾经存在过的女武神的灵魂。即使她们的肉体消逝，灵魂离开这个世界，但她们的一部分依然会留在这里，引导新一代的女武神。 [pc.swornGod lumia |听到自己能在其中引导你们，我感到非常荣幸，”你开玩笑地说。 “拜托，亲爱的，在那里你只不过是众多引导者中的一个而已，”Lumia笑着说。“不过还是谢谢你。没有你，我就无法为这个世界上的人们做那么多事情了。 我或许是个神，但我不可能同时出现在每一个地方。” “我觉得没人应该期望你能做到这一点，但至少在我们身边，你可以更接近这个目标。为世界的每一个角落提供保护，同时也有很多人陪伴在身边，这样我们的女神就可以享受乐趣，而不会因为不断回应人们的祈祷而陷入忙乱之中。现在 你 非常讨人喜欢 我告诉我，当你的灵魂与‘Strand’相连时，你看到了什么？我听说每个人看到的东西都不一样。” “嗯……那种感觉就像是被两只巨大的手举到了空中。 不过，这并不令人担忧。我感觉自己像是受到了保护，而不是被绑架或吃掉了。 “真是太独特了！这样的经历总让我感到惊奇。我通常会在人们适应一段时间后，询问他们这种感受。 通常这些都是他们过去的某些片段，但有些则更为抽象，就像你所说的那样。” “那我……死后还会留在那里吗？” “只要我还存在，你的一部分就会永远留在那里。 [flags.ARCHWAY_BOTH_SAVED |这里 |显现出来 ]但与我对话的并不是你。这条“道路”由强烈的情感回响构成。我借助它来判断自己在做决定时是否过于冷漠、过于疏离，但它并不能让我的追随者们免于死亡。它只能让其中的一小部分人继续留在我身边。 |"[pc.dcb |太亮了…… |太美了，这些颜色是从哪里来的呢？ |它太漂亮了，色彩也如此丰富！不过，看久了还是会有点刺眼。 ]你 [pc.isChamp |询问 |说 ]. "[pc.dcb |确实如此。 |不是吗？ |亲爱的，别看得那么入迷…… ] 这些颜色象征着每一位女武神的潜力。被保留下来的或许并非她们的最大成就，但却是她们最充分体现“女武神”这一身份意义的时刻，”卢米娅一边解释着，一边用手指轻轻触碰着玻璃。 无论她触碰到哪里，玻璃的另一侧与中央那团旋转的光芒之间都会浮现出短暂的白色闪光。这些光点的运动方式并没有发生明显的变化，但它们显然是在对她的存在做出反应。 当她陷入沉思，带着一丝怅惘的微笑凝视着某物约一分钟之后，你不要去打扰她，让她继续说下去。 “每当我担心自己正在做的事情是否正确时，我就会更加仔细地审视自己的这些感受。 通常这样就足以让我摆脱消极情绪，帮助我做出决定。” “你说话的时候，感觉那个东西就像是有生命的一样。它真的能交流吗？” “哦，不，并不是说它能像人类一样进行交流。 它们是那些经历留下的强烈回响，而我正是通过这些回响来判断的。如果我的感受与那些曾经让我的女武神们产生同样感受的事物有所不同，那么我就知道，我看待这个问题的方式，就像一个置身事外的神明，而不是一个活生生的人。 它确实帮了我很多次。 ] 我很高兴你的所有追随者即使在死后依然能够继续帮助你。而现在，那些还活着的追随者能够回到宫殿中来，帮助你放松，这让我更加开心了。” “天啊，真是太好了。说起来，我们是不是应该去找些更轻松的事情来做呢？”女神回答道，然后带着你回到了她的宝座厅。

rows.original: "How is your relationship with the regular paladin orders devoted to you? Do you interact with them personally or is it mostly through valkyries?" "I used to interact with them regularly, and I hope to start doing so again soon. I would regularly supply the most worthy among them with magical artifacts to aid them in their adventures. Like the ones I showed you, and several more besides those, these objects helped create wonderful stories. More importantly, they kept my principles in the hearts of those who wielded them. If they fell out of line, some of the artifacts had gathered enough spiritual energy to react. "Most of the prominent heroes who belonged to my orders would even be fit to become valkyries themselves, had they wished to do so. The choice is most important, however, and they serve me perfectly well without having their souls tied to me. I hadn't interacted with them at all while I was cloistered and dealing with the Wraith, but I'm excited. Just meeting with them to hear stories from other realms in person is something that fills me with joy. [var0 |That hilt at your hip was given to one such Hero, and passed down by the Order of the Oriflamme before it came to you. |The Order of the Oriflamme even used to make regular pilgrimages to the keep. With luck those visits can resume soon. ] "I'll have to get together with Nareva again to cook up some new artifacts! She'll be delighted, I'm sure! She always loves designing new things with me. Less so when I hand them out to mortal heroes for everyday use, but I know how to mollify her. She can't resist a good hot soak when she's molting, and the hot springs here at the palace are the perfect place for that. It's impossible to stay mad about something so frivolous with someone you're close with," Lumia smiles. "That's a point! How do you interact with the other gods' paladin orders, if at all?" "Very well! And I'm sure the same can be said vis-à-vis others who endorse paladins within my orders. I've provided similar support for a handful of paladins devoted to Tira or Mallach, and a handful of Astrida on top of that. In the time just after the war, heroes needed all the help they could get. It wasn't uncommon for more than one god to provide support to the same person, even if said person only truly worshipped one of them. "We had to help each other out, both out of camaraderie and to make sure the mortal champions whom children looked up to weren't slain in the effort of keeping the world safe. I never met one of them I felt would misuse the treasures I granted them, and I have yet to regret the choice in any case. It could be that I've been graced with good luck, but I choose to believe that those mortals who choose to be heroes are in this world to make it a better place." "[pc.dcb |That sounds righteous and all, I guess. Hope it doesn't end up burning you, |I'm glad your judgements have as of yet been correct, |I'm so glad! I love when, like, my first thoughts about someone turn out to be true, ]" you conclude. "Me too, dear. Did you have anything else you wanted to ask?" Well? Did you?
rows.translation: 你与那些专门为你服务的正规圣骑士团之间的关系如何？你会与他们直接交流吗，还是主要通过女武神来联系他们？” “我以前经常与他们保持联系，希望很快能再次恢复这种交流。 我会定期为其中最值得帮助的人提供魔法道具，帮助他们完成冒险任务。就像我刚才展示给你的那些道具，还有其他许多类似的道具，它们帮助创造了许多精彩的故事。更重要的是，这些道具让使用它们的人们始终牢记我的原则。 如果它们偏离了轨道，其中一些神器就会积聚足够的灵能从而产生反应。 “属于我麾下的大部分杰出英雄，如果他们愿意的话，甚至都有资格成为女武神。 然而，这个选择才是最重要的。这些角色并没有与我产生紧密的联系，但他们依然为我提供了很好的服务。在我闭关应对那些幽灵的时候，我根本没有与他们进行过任何互动，但现在我感到非常兴奋。仅仅是与他们见面，亲耳聆听来自其他世界的故事，就已经让我感到无比快乐了。 [var0 |你腰间那把剑，正是赐予这样一位英雄的，后来经由“奥里弗拉姆骑士团”的传承，才最终到了你手中。 |奥里弗拉姆骑士团甚至曾经定期前往那座堡垒进行朝圣。希望这些活动能尽快恢复。 ] 我得再和纳雷瓦见面，一起设计一些新的神器才行！她肯定会很高兴的，我敢肯定！她总是喜欢和我一起创造新的东西。不过，当我把这些神器交给凡间的英雄们让他们日常使用的时候，她就会不太高兴了……不过我知道该怎么安抚她。 当她正在蜕皮的时候，她实在无法抗拒泡个热水澡，而皇宫里的这些温泉正是做这件事的理想之地。对于这样一件琐碎的事情，和关系亲密的人在一起，根本不可能一直生气吧，”卢米娅笑着说。 有道理！那么你是如何与它进行交互的呢？ 其他 难道只有神的圣骑士才能得到这样的支持吗？” “当然不是！我相信，在我的麾下，那些支持圣骑士的人也同样能够得到这样的帮助。我曾经为一些效忠于蒂拉或马拉赫的圣骑士提供过支持，此外，也帮助过一些效忠于阿斯特里达的圣骑士。 在战争刚结束的那些日子里，英雄们急需一切可能的帮助。即使某个人真正信仰的只有一位神明，也有不少神明会选择支持他/她，这种情况并不少见。 “我们必须要互相帮助，这既是为了情谊，也是为了确保那些被孩子们视为榜样的凡人英雄能够在维护世界安全的斗争中免于牺牲。 我从未遇到过任何一个会滥用我赐予他们的财宝的人，而且到目前为止，我也没有为自己的选择感到后悔。也许是我运气比较好，但我更愿意相信，那些选择成为英雄的凡人，正是为了让这个世界变得更加美好而存在的。" "[pc.dcb |听起来确实挺正义的，嗯。不过希望这最终不会让你自食其果吧。 |我很高兴你的判断迄今为止都是正确的。 |我太高兴了！我就喜欢那种情况：当我最初对某个人的印象后来被证明是正确的时候。 ]你得出了这个结论。” “我也是，亲爱的。你还有其他想问的问题吗？” 那么？你还有其他问题吗？
