rows.original: "This might be a kind of silly way to ask you to gush about your own accomplishments, but do you have any favorite myths or stories that mortals tell about your godly exploits from before you incarnated?" "Oh definitely, dear. There are honestly so many! Where do I begin?" Lumia starts, idly drumming her fingers on the top of one breast as she thinks. "[pc.dcb |Don't rush too quickly now, I wouldn't want you to pick a bad one by accident, |There's no rush! Take your time to think of all the ones you want to talk about, |Take your time. If you need to, like, tell them all, then I'll get a pillow and we can sit here all day, ]" you tease while she's still thinking. "Oh hush, you. I have one," she laughs. "One of my all time favorites, at least, is the local one about the river in the valley, the Tarahugan. Have you heard it?" "[flags.AHMRI_TALK_VALLEY |Yes! My [ahmri.married |wife |friend ] in the centaur village there told me the story. That you did it to break up a conflict, and that allowed two tribes to come together peacefully! [pc.dcb |I wasn't listening too closely, but it was a cool story, |I don't know how realistic it could've been having seen the river, but it was a fun story, |It was so cool! Gosh, it must have taken you a long time to get that river out! I, like, can't even imagine how big your tummy was, ]" you say. "I should have known you would," Lumia says. "And yes! The way mortals tell it is one of my favorites, [pc.isBimbo |especially cuties like you who just assume I was in this kind of body when I did it! |especially the ones who assume I was in this form when it happened. ]" |I don't think I've heard that one. What is it?" you ask. "It's truly ancient history at this point, but there used to be two separate tribes in Harvest Valley who had been at war as long as either side could remember. It came to be that the daughter of one side's chief and the son of the other side's chief fell in love during their parents repeated squabbles over the division of land. When things came to real blows between the tribes, the couple snuck off in the dead of night to beseech me for aid in a cave to the west of their villages. "My favorite telling has me there, a multitude larger than I am now, but still in this form and gravidly pregnant. I then listened to their pleas, and ushered them to leave the cave before giving birth to the entire Tarahugan on the spot!" Lumia says. "That divine division of land was enough to finally stop their squabbles." ] "[pc.isBimbo |Aww, I thought for sure that would be true. So you weren't really there? |I take it you weren't truly there, then? ]" "Oh I was there, but in that moment I was the mountain, and simply ushering something forth that was bound to happen sooner or later. That underground river had been longing to escape for eons, and that seemed like the perfect moment to release it. Now it can provide fresh water and fish from the pristine lakes to the west with a method to reach the east, and in doing so allow that bounty to be accessed by the people of the valley!" "Huh. You make it sound just as majestic when you're talking about a mountain and a river as they did when talking about you being there in person." "I thank you, dear, but I much prefer the excitement in their voices when they imagine the things that sound silly to me," the goddess continues. "Speaking of being there in person, though, I thought of an entirely different myth that I enjoy. There was once a pair of champions, one of mine and one of Tira's, who competed viciously for recognition when it came to their accomplishments. "Since they operated in the same area, it was only natural that several times one or the other stole some of that coveted recognition. Soon Tira and I were receiving daily prayers from the both of them to smite or otherwise inconvenience the competition. It was becoming such a nuisance for the both of us that it began to influence our godly dealings as well. It was infuriating, that the bickering of mortals could affect us so, so we decided to help them! "Uh oh. [pc.isBimbo |You, like, totally helped them fuck, didn't you? |It doesn't sound like the help you decided on was what they intended. ]" "[pc.isBimbo |Totally! |No. Not quite. ] Luckily for us, it turns out that there was quite a buildup of sexual tension between our pair of champions. All it took was a little prodding here, some poking there. Finally, we got them both to a nice secluded village, at twilight, with a problem that had already been resolved! It took so much work to put them in situations that would edge the romance closer and closer to fruition, but that was our moment of success! "After that night, we had a set of heroes who weren't opposed to sharing the glory. At least as long as both of them were given equal credit. But in the case of issues it wasn't us on the other end of the complaints anymore." "I can imagine. That's much more recent than the last one. Still more a story than a myth in that case, but I could see it turning into one. [kas.romantic |It sounds like something to learn from, finding out if you can solve your differences that way |Finding friendships from conflict is a noble goal ]." "Indeed! I wish more things could be resolved that way, but it's not a path that can solve everything. That just makes those things it can resolve all the more cherishable," Lumia concludes with a smile. Did you have anything else to ask about?
rows.translation: 用这种方式来让你夸耀自己的成就，或许有点傻吧，但你是否听过凡人们讲述的、关于你的神一般事迹的那些神话或故事呢？ 在……之前 你转世了？” “哦，当然啦，亲爱的。说实话，这样的例子太多了！我该从哪里说起呢？”卢米娅一边思考，一边用手指轻轻敲打着自己的胸脯。[pc.dcb |现在不要急着做决定，我可不想你不小心选到了一个不好的选项。 |不用着急！你可以慢慢来，仔细思考一下你想谈论的所有话题。 |慢慢来。如果你需要的话，可以把一切都告诉他们，那我就拿个枕头，我们可以坐在这里一整天。 ]她在思考的时候，你还在逗她。” “哦，闭嘴吧你。我有个主意，”她笑着说。一 在我所有喜欢的游戏故事中，至少有一部是关于山谷里那条河流——塔拉胡甘河的。你听说过这个故事吗？[flags.AHMRI_TALK_VALLEY |是的！我的 [ahmri.married |妻子 |朋友 ] 在半人马村庄里，他们向我讲述了这个故事。你说，这样做是为了化解矛盾，让两个部落能够和平地相处在一起！ [pc.dcb |我并没有仔细听，但那个故事确实很有趣。 |看了那条河之后，我不确定这个故事到底有多真实，但确实是个有趣的故事。 |太酷了！天啊，你们肯定花了很长时间才把那条河清理出来吧！我简直无法想象你们的肚子当时得有多大…… ]你是这么说的吧。” “我就知道你会这么说，”卢米娅说道，“没错！人类表达这种想法的方式，确实是我最喜欢的之一。 [pc.isBimbo |尤其是像你这样的可爱女孩，总是以为我当时就是以这种形象来做的这件事的！ |尤其是那些在事情发生时就认为我当时就是这种状态的人。 ]" |我好像从来没听说过这个故事，是什么呢？”你问道。 “这确实是一段非常古老的历史了。在收获谷地，曾经有两个不同的部落，它们之间的战争已经持续了很久很久，长到双方的人都已经记不清这种战争是从什么时候开始的了。 就在两族因为土地划分问题不断发生争执的时候，一方族长的女儿与另一方族长的儿子相爱了。当两族之间的冲突真正升级时，这对恋人便在夜深人静之时偷偷溜走，来到他们村庄西边的一处洞穴中，向我寻求帮助。 我最喜欢的一个故事是这样的：那时我的体型比现在要大得多，但仍然保持着这种形态，而且已经怀孕在身。我听到了他们的恳求，便让他们离开洞穴，然后就在那里生下了所有的塔拉胡甘人！Lumia说道，‘那种神圣的土地划分方式终于让他们的争斗停止了。 ] "[pc.isBimbo |哎呀，我本来还以为那一定是真的呢。所以你其实并没有在那里吗？ |那么，我猜你当时其实并不在场，对吧？ ]哦，我当时就在那里，但在那一刻，我仿佛就是那座山，只是推动着一件迟早会发生的事情罢了。那条地下河流已经渴望逃脱许久了，而那一刻，似乎正是让它释放出来的最佳时机。 现在，我们可以通过某种方法将西部那些纯净的湖泊中的淡水与鱼类输送到东部，这样一来，山谷里的居民就能享受到这些丰富的资源了！” “哈，你描述这两座山和这条河的时候，说得也一样令人赞叹啊——就像他们当初描述你亲自出现在那里时一样。谢谢你，亲爱的，但我更喜欢他们想象那些在我看来很荒谬的事情时，他们声音中流露出的兴奋之情，”女神继续说道。“不过，说到亲临现场这件事，我想起了一个我非常喜欢的完全不同的神话故事。 曾经有一对冠军，一个是属于我的，另一个属于蒂拉的。他们在各自的领域中为获得认可而展开了激烈的竞争。 “由于他们的活动范围相同，因此难免会有几次其中一方窃取了另一方应得的认可。 不久之后，蒂拉和我每天都收到他们俩的祈祷，希望我们能干扰比赛，或者至少给对手带来一些麻烦。这种情况对我们来说真的变得非常烦人，甚至开始影响到我们的…… 虔诚的 他们的种种行为也让我们感到非常恼火。人类的争吵竟然会对我们产生如此大的影响，这真的让我们无法忍受，因此我们决定帮助他们！ “哦不…… [pc.isBimbo |你简直就是帮他们把事情搞砸了，对吧？ |你选择的帮助方式似乎并不是他们所期望的。 ]" "[pc.isBimbo |完全同意！ |不，还不完全是。 ] 对我们来说，幸运的是，我们发现这两位英雄之间确实存在着相当强烈的性张力。只需要稍加引导、稍加推动，最终就在黄昏时分将他们带到了一个僻静的村庄，而那个问题早已得到了解决！为了让他们的恋情逐渐走向圆满，我们付出了很多努力，但那一刻，我们终于取得了成功！ “从那个夜晚之后，我们就有了一对彼此并不排斥的英雄…… 分享 这种荣耀。至少在两者获得同等认可的情况下才是如此。但一旦出现问题，抱怨的对象就不再是我们了。 我能理解。这件事发生的时间比上一次要近得多。在这种情况下，它更像是一个故事，而不是一个传说，但我能想象它最终会变成一个传说。 [kas.romantic |这似乎是一件值得学习的事情——看看是否可以通过这种方式解决你们之间的分歧。 |从冲突中建立友谊，这是一个崇高的目标。 ]确实如此！我希望更多问题都能通过这种方式得到解决，但这种方法并不能解决所有问题。正因为如此，那些能够通过这种方式解决的问题就显得更加珍贵了。”Lumia微笑着说道。 你还有其他想要询问的吗？

I wish more things could be resolved that way, but it's not a path that can solve everything. That just makes those things it can resolve all the more cherishable," Lumia concludes with a smile. Did you have anything else to ask about? '

rows.original: "What kind of power was that? The one you used during our fun at the baths? I haven't seen anything like it," you ask. "That, my dear, is divine possession. Any of my followers can invite a sliver of my divine essence into their bodies, and with that invitation I can control their bodies as if they were limbs of my own. I can feel anything they feel, and taste anything they taste. As you saw, it's a trivial thing to conduct an orgy all by one's self," Lumia replies, beaming proudly. "[pc.dcb |That sounds incredible. You can just assume control of any of your followers? |That sounds like quite the power. You can assume control at any time? |That's totally bonkers! You can just have an orgy at the snap of your fingers whenever you want? ][pc.isValk | Does that apply to me as well?]" "The invitation is important. Forcing myself in would not only violate the trust my valkyries have in me, but it could cause them irreparable harm as their natural defenses clash with my godly spark. That said, some of the girls are so used to it that they accept my... request, for lack of a better term, on reflex. [pc.isValk |And yes, that applies to you as well, if you so desire. All you need do is ask.] "What is it like? From your end. Kind of hard to describe the other end when you're the one doing the possessing, I imagine." "It's wonderful! However, it's difficult to describe. As hard for me as it is for my valkyries to describe in turn. The best I can do is that it's like suddenly gaining an extra pair of arms, an extra pair of legs, an extra everything. The added sensation would probably fry the average mortal's brain with its sudden influx, but to me it's nothing more than a new experience." "Is there any limit to it? How many people can you possess at once?" "[silly |Oh easily at least two. |I don't actually know. ] The most girl's I've managed to bring together in one sitting was twenty, but it didn't feel like a strain. In fact it felt about the same as having only two, but with more sensations added to the pile. The only limit I can conceive of is the number of girls willing to do such a thing," Lumia explains with a laugh. "I hate to shy away from the fun applications of this power, but could it not be used for battle? I imagine having twenty minds interlinked would make it easy to win a fight." "You would think, wouldn't you? So did some of my more tactically minded valkyries. Unfortunately there are too many downsides. Shared sensations invalidate any tactical advantage that would be granted by having those links. I feel every good sensation among those I possess, but I feel every wound as well. Such a downside would quickly become overwhelming in a real battle." "Ah. Indeed. Having to deal with a whole army's worth of pain sounds staggering. At least it has several fun applications," you muse. "Have you ever used it to sneak around when you don't want people to know it's you?" "All the time, dear," the goddess answers with a devious smile. "It's one of my favorite pastimes when I'm not engaged with godly duties. Some of the girls never quite adapt to interacting with me, so it's fun to be able to talk to them like a normal person.[silly | Or, in the case of those like Annika, to give them the chance at a normal conversation. ] It's occasionally fun to track multiple conversations at once, and I absolutely adore the look on some of their faces when I ask them questions relating to those conversations in private." "[pc.dcb |Ha! That's so mean! I love it, |Oh gods, I would be mortified. I love it, though, |That's, like, terrifying! But I love it! ] Hmm. If the number is no issue, then what about distance? Is there a limit to how far away you can be? Could you possess someone who's far away from your main body?" "I... I don't know! Surprisingly it's never come up! Let me just try something, one moment," Lumia says, closing her eyes in concentration. A few seconds later she opens her eyes and shakes her head. "I'd never had cause to attempt the link without someone being close, but it would seem such a distance is the limit. I've just tried with someone in the kitchens, to no avail. As far as the distance once someone is already possessed, I don't think there is one! I can, at the very least, reach the Winter City without my control wavering." "That far! How do you keep track of which body is which? Or which conversations are which. Aren't you worried one body will respond to the other's conversation?" "Fah! You underestimate the mind of a god. Keeping track of those things is natural when your mind works the way mine does. It's not even something that would have occurred to me, but you aren't the first person to express surprise over it. Poor Annika asked if it 'strained' me when she first heard about it, and I don't know if she believed me when I said no. It was quite adorable seeing her worry when we'd only just met." "Alright. Hmm. What's your favorite thing you've done with this power?" you ask. Surely the goddess must have some exciting stories, though you won't be able to hear all of them. "I could not possibly pick a personal favorite, dear, but let me give you one I think you might like. Would you rather hear about my conversational antics, or something more salacious?"
rows.translation: 那是一种什么样的力量啊？就是你在我们泡澡的时候使用的那种力量吧？我从来没见过这样的东西。” “亲爱的，那可是神的力量。我的任何追随者都可以邀请我的一部分神力进入他们的身体，通过这种邀请，我就可以像操控自己的肢体一样操控他们的身体。我能感受到他们所感受到的一切，也能品尝到他们所品尝到的一切。就像你看到的那样，独自举办一场狂欢派对对于我来说简直就是小菜一碟。”卢米娅自豪地回答道。[pc.dcb |那听起来太不可思议了。你可以随意控制你的任何追随者吗？ |那听起来真是相当强大的能力啊。你可以随时掌控局面吗？ |这简直太疯狂了！你想什么时候尽情狂欢就什么时候狂欢，完全随心所欲吗？ ][pc.isValk | 这也适用于我吗？]这份邀请非常重要。强行参与不仅会违背我的女武神们对我的信任，还可能使她们的自然防御机制与我的神圣力量发生冲突，从而导致不可挽回的伤害。不过，有些女孩已经习惯了这种情况，所以她们会下意识地接受我的……这个请求，实在找不到更合适的词语来形容了。 [pc.isValk |没错，如果你有这样的愿望，这也同样适用于你。你只需要提出请求即可。] 那是怎样的感觉呢？从你的角度来看……当你自己处于那种状态时，其实很难描述另一方的感受吧。” “那感觉简直太美妙了！不过确实很难用语言表达出来。对我来说很难描述，我的女武神们也一样，她们也很难把那种感受说清楚。 我所能描述的，就是仿佛突然多出了一双手臂、一双腿，一切都多了起来。这种额外的感觉如果突然涌入普通人的大脑，可能会让他们的脑子“烧坏”，但对我来说，这只不过是一种全新的体验罢了。这有什么限制吗？一次最多可以拥有多少人呢？[silly |哦，至少有两个吧。 |其实我也不太清楚。 ] 我曾经一次性召集过二十个女孩在一起，但一点也不觉得吃力。事实上，这种感觉和只召集两个女孩时差不多，只不过体验会更加丰富罢了。我想，唯一可能的限制就是，有多少女孩愿意参与这样的活动吧。”Lumia笑着说。 我并不想回避这种能力在娱乐方面的应用，但难道它就不能用于战斗吗？我想，如果能让二十个人的思维相互连接，那么在战斗中获胜应该会很容易吧。” “你也会这么想的，对吧？我的一些擅长战术的女武神们也是这么想的。 不幸的是，这样的设定带来的负面影响实在太多。共享的感官体验会使得那些连接所带来的战术优势变得毫无意义。我能够感受到自己所拥有的一切美好感觉，但同时也能清楚地体会到每一处伤痛。 这样的缺点在真正的战斗中很快就会变得难以承受。” “啊，确实如此。要承受相当于整个军队所带来的痛苦，听起来简直令人难以置信。不过，这个能力也有几个有趣的应用方式，”你沉思道，“你有没有试过在不想让别人发现是你的时候，利用这个能力悄悄行动呢？一直都在啊，亲爱的，”女神带着一丝狡黠的微笑回答道，“当我没有忙于神圣职责的时候，这可是我最喜欢的消遣方式之一。有些女孩就是不太习惯和我交流，所以能够像和一个普通人一样和她们聊天，确实是一件很有趣的事情。[silly | 或者，对于像安妮卡这样的人来说，就是给予他们进行正常对话的机会。 ] 同时跟踪多场对话有时候确实会让人觉得挺有趣的，我绝对认同这一点。 非常喜爱 当我向他们询问那些私下谈话的相关内容时，他们脸上流露出的表情真是令人印象深刻。[pc.dcb |哈！太恶搞了！我超喜欢这个。 |哦，天啊，我肯定会尴尬死的。不过，我真的很喜欢它。 |那简直太可怕了！但我就是喜欢这样！ ] 嗯，如果距离没有问题的话，那么距离有多远才没有限制呢？是不是可以附身到离自己主体很远的地方的人身上呢？” “我……我不知道！奇怪的是，这个问题从来没人提过！ 让我先试试看，等一下。”卢米娅闭上眼睛，集中注意力。几秒钟后，她睁开眼睛，摇了摇头：“以前我从来没有机会在没有人在场的情况下尝试这种连接方式，不过看来，这样的距离似乎就是极限了。 我刚刚试着让厨房里的某个人帮忙，但没有任何效果。至于距离的问题，一旦有人…… 已经 被附身了……我想根本没有什么办法可以解决这个问题！至少，我能够在保持控制力的情况下到达冬城。” “竟然能做到这种程度！你是怎么区分哪些身体属于谁的？又是怎么区分哪些对话是哪些人说的？你难道不担心某个身体会回应另一个身体的对话吗？呸！你太小看神明的智慧了。以我的思维方式来说，记住那些事情根本不是什么难事。这种事甚至都不会出现在我的脑海中，但你也并不是第一个对此感到惊讶的人。 可怜的安妮卡在第一次听到这件事时，还问我是否因此感到不适，我不知道她当时是否相信了我说的“没有”。看到我们才刚认识不久，她就这么担心我，真是太可爱了。 “好吧……那么，利用这种能力，你做过最开心的事情是什么呢？你问得对。想必那位女神一定有一些精彩的故事，不过你不可能全部听完的。 “亲爱的，我实在无法选出自己最喜欢的故事，不过让我告诉你一个我觉得你可能会喜欢的吧。你是想听我那些有趣的对话趣闻，还是想听一些更刺激的内容呢？"

rows.translation: 恶作剧

rows.original:
"I think I'd prefer a safer story today."
        
        "Very well," Lumia says, tapping her chin dramatically. "Ah! I know just the one. In the early days after the war, a set of twins joined the order. They were lovably competitive, and upon learning about my skills in possession each of them asked if I would be able to help them get an edge against the other in their rivalry. So naturally I helped both of them! One would have me set a record, and the other would have me break it. Every time it was silly things like 'flying the obstacle course with your legs tied together by rope.'
        
        "On top of that they abandoned these competitions just as quickly! I never had to fear an escalation to the point that I couldn't beat myself in these contests, because by that point one or the other twin had invented a new one! The best part of it for me was that neither of them doubted the other's abilities! I had no reason to feel bad, since I was helping both of them, and each thought the other capable of matching a god in their little challenges. They stopped asking me to join them once they grew more acclimated to life in the palace, but they never stopped chatting with me.
        
        "I always enjoyed hearing about what they were getting up to after they stopped having me do the competing for them. At that point they were also competing with the other valkyries together, and I loved seeing them work together just as much as I loved helping them. They were eventually assigned to help a noble family in Jassira take care of a set of octuplets!" the goddess concludes.
        
        "Sounds like they had their hands full after that," you say, trying to think of something else to ask about.
rows.translation:
我想今天我更想听一个比较温馨的故事。”

“好吧，”Lumia说着，戏剧性地用手托着下巴想了一会儿，“啊！我正好知道一个这样的故事。战争刚结束的那些日子，有一对双胞胎加入了这个组织。他们彼此之间竞争心很强，当他们了解到我拥有某种特殊能力后，每个人都问我是否能够帮助他们在竞争中取得优势。 所以，我自然而然地帮助了他们两个人！一个人让我去创造一项纪录，而另一个人则让我去打破这项纪录。每次都是一些愚蠢的任务，比如“用绳子把腿绑在一起，然后去完成障碍赛道”。
        
        更糟糕的是，他们竟然这么快就放弃了这些比赛！我从来都不用担心比赛会变得如此激烈，以至于我根本无法战胜自己的对手，因为总会有其中一位双胞胎兄弟想出新的比赛方式来！ 对我来说，最棒的一点就是他们两人都没有怀疑对方的能力！我没有任何理由感到内疚，因为我在帮助他们两个人，而且他们每个人都认为对方在自己参与的那些小挑战中具备与神明相媲美的实力。 当他们逐渐适应了宫廷生活后，就不再邀请我加入他们的活动了，但他们仍然一直和我聊天。
        
        我一直都很喜欢了解她们在不再让我为她们参加比赛之后都在做些什么。那时，她们也会和其他女武神一起参与竞争，而我喜欢看她们齐心协力，就像我喜欢帮助她们一样。最终，她们被派去帮助贾西拉的一个贵族家庭，照顾那一群八胞胎！”这位女神总结道。
        
        听起来在那之后他们确实忙得不可开交，”你说道，同时努力想着还能问些什么别的。

粗俗的

rows.original:
"That lewd story is tempting. I've seen some of what you can accomplish with a group, so I'd definitely be interested in the kinds of fun you get up to."
        
        "Well then, dear. Which tale shall I regale you with?" Lumia asks, grinning at you with a seductive lip-bite. "Oh! I know."
        
        "One of the best things I've done was helping one of my young valkyries get over her fears with a lover. The poor girl was concerned about performance anxiety and this and that and everything else one shouldn't have to worry about for their first time. So I let her take the back seat and tell me what she wanted me to do. It was all very chaste and simple, and utterly adorable. When the time came to take him to bed, her heart was like a storm of summer thunder.
        
        "I let him take the lead, and delighted in his and her wonderful inexperience. Her mind and instincts were in the back telling me what to do the entire time, and minute by minute I eased up how much control I was taking. Soon she was at the reins, and I was the backseat observer, guiding her to what would be pleasurable for the both of them. So engrossed in the experience was she, that she never even noticed when the switch occurred. There was a little awkwardness, but certainly no performance anxiety.
        
        "I slipped out to let them relax with each other in peace, and she told me later that she hadn't realized I was gone! I count that as a roaring success. She thanked me in person, and I still cherish the feeling of hearing it and the sight of the smile on her face. Simple thank you's make up many of my favorite memories of my champions."
rows.translation:
那个淫荡的故事真是诱人啊。我见过你们一群人能做出些什么来，所以我肯定会对你们那些有趣的活动感兴趣。”

“那么，亲爱的，我该给你讲哪个故事呢？”Lumia微笑着，用充满诱惑的口吻问道，“哦！我知道了。
        
        我做过的最棒的事情之一，就是帮助我的一位年轻女武神克服了她对恋爱的恐惧。那个可怜的女孩一直担心表演焦虑之类的问题，还有许多初次恋爱时根本不需要担心的琐事。于是我让她主动掌握主导权，告诉我她希望我怎么做。整个过程都非常纯洁、简单，而且无比可爱。当到了该送他上床的时候，她的心里仿佛充满了夏日雷鸣般的激动。
        
        我让他来主导，同时也乐于看到他那缺乏经验却充满活力的表现。她的思维和直觉一直在告诉我该怎么做，于是我逐渐放松了对事情的控制。很快，她就掌握了主动权，而我则变成了一个在幕后观察的人，引导她去做那些能让双方都感到愉快的事情。她完全沉浸在这个过程中，甚至没有注意到控制权究竟是在什么时候发生了转移。虽然有一点点尴尬，但绝对没有出现表演焦虑的情况。
        
        我悄悄离开，让他们能安静地相处。后来她告诉我，她根本没注意到我已经走了！我觉得这简直是一次巨大的成功。她当面感谢了我，而听到她说的那些话，看到她脸上的笑容，至今我仍然记忆犹新。这些简单的感谢，构成了我与这些‘英雄们’之间许多最美好的回忆。

        "One of the best things I've done was helping one of my young valkyries get over her fears with a lover. The poor girl was concerned about performance anxiety and this and that and everything else one shouldn't have to worry about for their first time. So I let her take the back seat and tell me what she wanted me to do. It was all very chaste and simple, and utterly adorable. When the time came to take him to bed, her heart was like a storm of summer thunder.
        
        "I let him take the lead, and delighted in his and her wonderful inexperience. Her mind and instincts were in the back telling me what to do the entire time, and minute by minute I eased up how much control I was taking. Soon she was at the reins, and I was the backseat observer, guiding her to what would be pleasurable for the both of them. So engrossed in the experience was she, that she never even noticed when the switch occurred. There was a little awkwardness, but certainly no performance anxiety.
        
        "I slipped out to let them relax with each other in peace, and she told me later that she hadn't realized I was gone! I count that as a roaring success. She thanked me in person, and I still cherish the feeling of hearing it and the sight of the smile on her face. Simple thank you's make up many of my favorite memories of my champions."
        '

rows.translation: 听一个充满诱惑与占有感的故事吧……

rows.original:
"There's no easy way to bring this up, but I have a question I need to ask and I'm hoping it doesn't make you angry," you say, not quite ready to jump in just yet.
    
    "Dear, please. I am not in the habit of losing my temper, but I'll brace myself nonetheless," Lumia replies with a smirk.
    
    "I spoke with Nareva, and in the process discovered your shared secret. I know what you were before the Godswar, and I just want to hear your side of it. If It's something you're not willing to share, I understand, but I'd like to know," you ask as carefully as you can.
    
    Lumia's smirk fades, but she doesn't look angry. A heavy sigh works its way out of her body, and she fixes her gaze on you.
    
    "I know. Nareva told me everything. You hounded her quite ferociously, my dear. I think she needed it, though. The regret and guilt had been burning inside her this entire time, and it's better she reveal herself to you and her spirits than have that tension explode and reveal herself to the world. I'm amazed at your ability to take the words of one of your world's greatest foes at face value. Why not assume that she alone had infiltrated the living gods?" she asks.
    
    "It's just how I am, I guess. For a goddess of knowledge she seemed awfully terrible at lying, or even trying to hide things. It only made sense that she would be telling the truth when she finally broke down and vented. There wouldn't have been a reason for her to toss that kind of lie in after being revealed," you explain. "What about you? It can't be easy keeping that kind of thing a secret."
    
    "Hmph. You'd be surprised what having love and support, and being forgiven even once can do to quell the flames of guilt. We all work through things differently."
    
    "That's fair. What about your 'awakening'? Would you be willing to talk about that?"
    
    "Hmm. My first memories of the 'me' I am now are of kneeling in the Winter City, cradling the bodies of a mother and daughter whom I had almost certainly been in the middle of devouring. In their last moments, they thought I had tried to rescue them from the monsters," Lumia says, clenching her fist as the memory dredges up old feelings. "I knew I had to stop the other monsters who followed me to the city, and this brand new sunlit goddess they were promoting seemed the perfect persona to adopt. The other Wraiths didn't stand a chance, and each one I snuffed out only added to my own power. I was even able to mold my former Wraith-spawn to my designs. They couldn't fight on the front lines, of course, but they were useful tools for causing madness in the Wraith-touched ranks as they were routed. 
    
    I wish I could have done more to save Atheldred's people from the void taint, but at that point the most I could do was redirect their impulses," Lumia shakes her head, but then smiles. "I think some of them still live, wandering the frozen plains above the city. Or at least their descendants do, I know not how long they live."
    
    "[flags.WRAITH_CHIMERA_MET
        |Wait, those creatures in the rift were originally her doing? [flags.TODO_CHIMERA_PREGGED
            |Well she should be happy to know they're still worshipping her in their own way...
            |Isn't it a bit dangerous to leave them out there?
        ]
        |They're out there still? Isn't that dangerous?
    ]"
    
    "I'm glad to have them! They keep the frost trolls in check, and are intelligent enough to make a strange kind of peace with the locals. My girls give any of them who stray too far a good scolding, and so far that has prevented any major incidents."
    
    "Huh. The both of you seem quite at peace with this kind of discussion. Aren't you afraid people will find out and use it against you? Beyond the occasional, well, me?"
    
    "My dear, no mortal would be able to wield that revelation as a weapon against us, even you. Your allies would sooner believe the demoness ravaging our lands had twisted your mind. And on top of that, no normal mortal would be able to reach that point in the first place. The only mortals who would tote us as false are the ones who were already doing so before we 'descended'."
    
    "Another fair point. I think that's the last thing I wanted to ask directly, but if I think of anything else that's relevant I'll be sure to ask," you conclude.
    
    "As long as it's safe to ask and answer, please don't hesitate. Oh, and do forgive me if I fall into character otherwise around you. I've been doing this too long not to."
rows.translation:
这个问题有点难以启齿，但我确实有疑问需要问，希望这不会让你生气，”你说道，心里还挺犹豫是否应该现在就开口。

“亲爱的，拜托了。我平时并不容易发脾气，不过这次我还是会做好心理准备的，”Lumia带着一丝笑意回答道。
    
    我与纳雷瓦谈过，在这个过程中发现了你们共同的秘密。我知道在神战之前你们是什么样的人，我只是想听听你们的说法。如果这是你们不愿意分享的事情，我理解，但我还是想知道。”你尽可能谨慎地问道。
    
    卢米娅的 smirk消失了，但她看起来并不生气。她深深地叹了口气，然后将目光投向了你。

“我知道的。纳雷瓦把一切都告诉了我。你对她确实追得相当紧，亲爱的。不过，我想她也需要这样的经历吧。 这些遗憾与内疚一直在她心中燃烧，现在她向你坦白自己的真实感受，反而能让这些情绪得到释放，而不是让这种紧张情绪最终爆发出来，被全世界看到。我真的很惊讶，你竟能如此轻易地相信自己这个世界中最强大的敌人所说的话。 为什么不假设只有她一个人潜入了那些活生生的神明之中呢？”她问道。
    
    我想，我就是这样的性格吧。对于一位知识女神来说，她似乎完全不擅长撒谎，甚至也不懂得如何隐瞒事情。所以，当她最终崩溃并倾诉心声时，她说出的肯定是实话。在真相被揭露之后，她也没有理由再编造那些谎言了，”你解释道。“那你呢？把这样的秘密藏在心里，肯定也不容易吧。
    
    哼，你可能想不到，得到爱与支持，甚至仅仅被原谅一次，就能如何有效地熄灭内疚的火焰。每个人应对问题的方式都是不同的。”

“这倒也是。那么你的‘觉醒’经历呢？你愿意谈谈吗？
    
    嗯，我对现在的自己的最初记忆，是在冬之城中跪着，怀抱着一对母女的身体——我几乎可以肯定，就在刚才，我还在吞噬他们的尸体。在他们的最后时刻，他们以为我是试图将他们从怪物手中救出来。”卢米娅说着，握紧了拳头，这些回忆重新唤起了她那些痛苦的情绪。 我知道我必须阻止那些跟随我进入城市的其他怪物，而他们所推崇的这位充满阳光、神圣的女神形象，似乎正是我应该采用的完美伪装。其他的那些幽灵根本没有任何机会，每当我消灭一个，我的力量就会随之增强。 我甚至能够按照自己的设计来改造那些原本由怨灵生成的生物。它们当然无法在前线作战，但当敌军遭到溃败时，它们就能成为在那些被怨灵影响过的军队中制造混乱的得力工具。 
    
    我真希望能为拯救阿瑟雷德的人们免受虚空污秽的侵害而做更多，但在那个时候，我所能做的也只有引导他们的冲动方向罢了，”卢米娅摇摇头，但随后又笑了起来，“我想他们中的一些人应该还活着，正在这座城市上方的冰冻平原上徘徊。或者至少他们的后代还活着，只是我不知道他们的寿命有多长。
    
    "[flags.WRAITH_CHIMERA_MET
        |等等，那些出现在裂隙中的生物其实是她制造的？ [flags.TODO_CHIMERA_PREGGED
            |嗯，她应该会很高兴知道，人们仍在以他们自己的方式纪念她……
            |把它们留在外面，不是有点危险吗？
        ]
        |它们现在还在外面吗？这样不是很危险吗？
    ]我很高兴有它们！它们能够抑制霜冻巨魔的破坏活动，而且足够聪明，能够与当地居民建立起一种特殊的和平关系。我的女儿们也会对那些走得太远的巨魔进行严厉的责备，到目前为止，这种方法确实防止了任何重大事故的发生。哈，你们俩似乎对这种讨论挺坦然的啊。难道不怕别人发现并利用这些信息来对付你们吗？当然，除了我这种偶尔会插嘴的人之外。”

“亲爱的，没有任何人能够把那些真相当作武器来对付我们，就连你也不例外。 你的盟友们更愿意相信，那个正在肆虐我们土地的恶魔女妖已经扰乱了你的心智。更何况，普通的凡人根本不可能达到那种地步。唯一会认为我们是骗子的人，就是那些在我们“降临”之前就已经这么认为的人。另一个合理的观点。我想这应该是我最后想直接询问的问题了，但如果我想到其他相关的内容，一定会再提问的，”你说道。

“只要提问和回答都不会带来任何问题，那就请随时尽管提问吧。 哦，如果我在你面前表现得不符合自己的性格，请一定要原谅我。我已经习惯了这样做，很难改掉这个习惯。

rows.original: "I know it would probably be better to ask specific valkyries about themselves when it comes to knowing more about them, but what about the valkyrie order as a whole?" you ask. "I figure it would be best to ask the person in charge when it comes to the whole organization." "You would probably be correct, but that depends on what questions you have. Ask away, dear, and I'll answer to the best of my ability," Lumia responds, awaiting you with a curious smile. "Well for starters in that case, what is the process of becoming a valkyrie actually like, irrespective of the circumstances that happen before they arrive here." "Anyone who wants to become one of my valkyries must spend some time in the palace first, getting to know the women who would become their battle-sisters. If they succeed in getting acquainted, then they must undergo an examination of my own. During the course of that examination, I determine whether they are worthy of becoming a valkyrie," she explains. "It sounds intimidating when I say it all at once like that, but it has largely been a successful endeavor. "The few people I've found unworthy of becoming valkyries have still gone on to become very devoted paladins, and I aim not to dash their hopes too hard when it happens. It's sad, but for some it's impossible. Don't think it's because of people who want my power for selfish reasons, either. Those people are weeded out long before the need for a test arises. No, the people who I deny receive such a judgment because they would come to regret the decision. Whether it be because of personal attachments or lingering desires for something more, I know in my heart that even what I consider to be fairly light shackles would rub them raw in time." "And they don't lash out? None of them get angry or try to push the issue?" "No. Like I said, that kind of attitude doesn't 'make it to the table', as it were. Deep down they know they wouldn't last, and they just need to hear it from me, to know that that doesn't make them lesser in my eyes," the goddess concludes. "That's good to hear, [pc.isDK |even if it sounds a bit weak on their part. Anyway, |if a little sad. ] I have something happier to ask about next. How exactly does the breeding duty work? I've heard it mentioned around here and figured I may as well ask." "Happier indeed! Some of my followers are, whether by cruel injury or crueler twist of fate, incapable of having children of their own. I took it upon myself to provide for them. It is not a requirement of any valkyrie, but those who share my sentiment are chosen in shifts to assist with such things when needed. They carry the child to term, and often deliver them to the new parent themselves. "I try to choose those I know can handle such a thing, and not suffer a change of heart mid-way through. Nonetheless if I choose poorly, and the transfer is particularly difficult for them, then they can be assigned to assist with childcare should the mother be amenable," she explains, and then her lips curl into a smile. "One of my girls joked that the babies are 'made to order', and that's not entirely wrong. "We don't keep a 'surplus stock' of children. Every baby in this keep is merely waiting to be taken to a parent. Depending on the mothers' circumstances, they stay here until they no longer need to be breastfed, and then are flown comfortably to meet and grow accustomed to their new parents. If time and distance allows, they are often brought sooner, and given even more time to interact. "That's actually how the myth of babies being carried to their mothers' arms by birds was started! At least I like to think it was. My girls all get so adorably embarrassed when I call them my little storks. I hear them smiling and talking excitedly about it when I'm not the one saying it, though. The joy on their faces when they return from those deliveries is a decadent thing that I soak in with delight." "I'm glad to hear it's such a happy occasion each time! And you don't have troubles with parents afterwards?" "I'm very good at picking which followers I grant this blessing, so no. Very rarely are there any problems at all, and the few that have existed in the past were because of unfortunate shifts in circumstance that are better left unspoken. Better that we remain positive, and cherish the good things we're able to accomplish." "You're right. I don't know if it's literally the case, but things seem much warmer here when it's happy." What else did you want to discuss?
rows.translation: 我知道，或许直接问出来会更好。 具体的 关于这些女武神自身的信息，她们可能都不太愿意多谈，但整个女武神组织的情况呢？”你问道，“我想，最好还是去询问负责这个组织的人吧。” “你这么说可能没错，但这也取决于你想要了解哪些具体信息。尽管提问吧，亲爱的，我会尽我所能为你解答的。”卢米娅带着一丝好奇的笑容回答道。 那么，首先，成为一名女武神到底需要经历什么过程呢？无论在来到这里之前发生了什么。” “任何想要成为我的女武神之一的人，都必须先在宫殿里待一段时间，去了解那些将来会成为她们战斗姐妹的女性们。 如果他们能够成功建立彼此之间的信任，那么他们还必须接受我的考验。在这个考验的过程中，我会判断他们是否具备成为女武神的资格，”她解释道。“把这一切一下子说出来，听起来确实有些令人生畏，但实际上，这一过程在很大程度上是成功的。 那些我认为不配成为女武神的人，后来也都成为了非常忠诚的圣骑士。因此，当这种情况发生时，我并不想过于打击他们的希望。虽然这很令人遗憾，但对某些人来说，这确实是不可能的。也请不要认为，这是那些出于自私目的想要获得我的力量的人造成的。 那些人在需要进行任何测试之前，就已经被淘汰掉了。不，那些被我拒绝给予这种评价的人，是因为他们会为自己的决定而后悔。无论是因为个人情感的牵绊，还是对某些东西仍存有的渴望，我内心深处明白，即使是我认为相当轻微的束缚，随着时间的推移，也会让他们感到痛苦不堪。" 他们也不会发怒吗？没有人会生气或试图强行推进这件事吗？” “不会。就像我说的，那种态度根本不会被提及。他们内心深处都知道，那样做是行不通的，他们只需要从我这里听到这个结论，就能明白在我眼中，这并不会让他们变得低人一等。”女神这样总结道。 听到这个消息真是太好了。 [pc.isDK |即使这样听起来他们有些软弱。不过，无论如何…… |有点伤感吧。 ] 接下来，我有件更令人高兴的事情想问。生育系统到底是如何运作的呢？我在这里听到过有人提到过这个话题，所以觉得不妨问问看。 “确实是一件令人高兴的事情！我的一些追随者，要么因为遭受了残酷的伤害，要么因为命运的残酷捉弄，根本无法生育自己的孩子。 我主动承担起了照顾他们的责任。这并不是任何一位女武神的职责，但那些与我有着相同想法的人会轮流在需要时提供帮助。她们会将孩子顺利生下，而且常常还会亲自将新生儿交给新的父母手中。 我会尽量挑选那些我知道能够胜任这类工作、并且不会在过程中改变主意的人。不过，如果我选错了人，而这次调动对他们来说确实太困难了，那么如果母亲同意的话，也可以安排他们帮忙照顾孩子，”她解释道，然后嘴角露出一丝微笑。“我的一个同事开玩笑说，这些宝宝简直是‘量身定制’的，这话也不完全错。 我们并不会储备多余的婴儿。这个养育中心里的每一个孩子都在等待被父母领走。根据母亲们的具体情况，这些孩子会在这里待到不再需要母乳喂养为止，之后就会被送往新的家庭，在那里他们可以逐渐适应新的父母。如果时间和距离允许，这些孩子通常会更早被送到新家庭，这样他们就有更多的时间与新的父母建立联系、相互适应。 其实，关于‘婴儿是由鸟儿送到母亲怀中的’这个传说，就是这么起源的！至少我是这么认为的。每当我称呼我的女儿们为‘小鹳鸟’时，她们都会露出非常可爱的尴尬表情。不过，当我没有这么说的时候，我总能听到她们兴奋地讨论这个话题，还能听到她们脸上洋溢着的喜悦。当她们完成‘送货’任务回来时，那种开心的表情真是让我感到无比愉悦。 听说每次都是这么欢乐的场合，我真为你们感到高兴！而且之后你们和父母之间也没有出现什么问题吧？” “我非常擅长挑选该把这份祝福赐予哪些人，所以没有问题。几乎从来都不会出现什么麻烦，而过去偶尔出现的一些问题，也是由于一些不幸的变故，这些事情最好就不要再提了。我们还是应该保持积极的态度，珍惜那些我们能够实现的美好事情吧。 你说得对。虽然我不知道这是否真的是事实，但当它处于快乐状态时，这里确实会显得温暖许多。” 你还想讨论些什么吗？

"Well for starters in that case, what is the process of becoming a valkyrie actually like, irrespective of the circumstances that happen before they arrive here." "Anyone who wants to become one of my valkyries must spend some time in the palace first, getting to know the women who would become their battle-sisters. If they succeed in getting acquainted, then they must undergo an examination of my own. During the course of that examination, I determine whether they are worthy of becoming a valkyrie," she explains. "It sounds intimidating when I say it all at once like that, but it has largely been a successful endeavor. "The few people I've found unworthy of becoming valkyries have still gone on to become very devoted paladins, and I aim not to dash their hopes too hard when it happens. It's sad, but for some it's impossible. Don't think it's because of people who want my power for selfish reasons, either. Those people are weeded out long before the need for a test arises. No, the people who I deny receive such a judgment because they would come to regret the decision. Whether it be because of personal attachments or lingering desires for something more, I know in my heart that even what I consider to be fairly light shackles would rub them raw in time." "And they don't lash out? None of them get angry or try to push the issue?" "No. Like I said, that kind of attitude doesn't 'make it to the table', as it were. Deep down they know they wouldn't last, and they just need to hear it from me, to know that that doesn't make them lesser in my eyes," the goddess concludes. "That's good to hear, [pc.isDK |even if it sounds a bit weak on their part. Anyway, |if a little sad. ] I have something happier to ask about next. How exactly does the breeding duty work? I've heard it mentioned around here and figured I may as well ask." "Happier indeed! Some of my followers are, whether by cruel injury or crueler twist of fate, incapable of having children of their own. I took it upon myself to provide for them. It is not a requirement of any valkyrie, but those who share my sentiment are chosen in shifts to assist with such things when needed. They carry the child to term, and often deliver them to the new parent themselves. "I try to choose those I know can handle such a thing, and not suffer a change of heart mid-way through. Nonetheless if I choose poorly, and the transfer is particularly difficult for them, then they can be assigned to assist with childcare should the mother be amenable," she explains, and then her lips curl into a smile. "One of my girls joked that the babies are 'made to order', and that's not entirely wrong. "We don't keep a 'surplus stock' of children. Every baby in this keep is merely waiting to be taken to a parent. Depending on the mothers' circumstances, they stay here until they no longer need to be breastfed, and then are flown comfortably to meet and grow accustomed to their new parents. If time and distance allows, they are often brought sooner, and given even more time to interact. "That's actually how the myth of babies being carried to their mothers' arms by birds was started! At least I like to think it was. My girls all get so adorably embarrassed when I call them my little storks. I hear them smiling and talking excitedly about it when I'm not the one saying it, though. The joy on their faces when they return from those deliveries is a decadent thing that I soak in with delight." "I'm glad to hear it's such a happy occasion each time! And you don't have troubles with parents afterwards?" "I'm very good at picking which followers I grant this blessing, so no. Very rarely are there any problems at all, and the few that have existed in the past were because of unfortunate shifts in circumstance that are better left unspoken. Better that we remain positive, and cherish the good things we're able to accomplish." "You're right. I don't know if it's literally the case, but things seem much warmer here when it's happy." What else did you want to discuss? "

        |her head held high
        |her eyes downcast
    ]. Lumia cocks an eyebrow, and the lavender elf looks back to you for one more boost of confidence before asking her question.

        |W-w
        |W
    ]hy? Why weren't you there?" [etheryn.highConfidence
        |Despite her best efforts, t
        |T
    ]ears well up in her eyes, and her breath hitches as she tries to continue. "My grand-sire, my grandmother, why did they have to suffer like that? Y-you were supposed to p-protect them!"
    
    She wipes those tears from her eyes, but they're coming much too fast to clear. By now she's fully sobbing, but she still manages to choke out her next words with forceful clarity.
    
    "M-my mom, why couldn't you save her? I-I thought I'd made my peace with these questions, but now that you're actually in front of me they just keep coming back."
    
    Lumia listens closely as she speaks. At first her face is a mask of pity, but as Etheryn continues to talk it melts into an empathic gloom that threatens to have her breaking into similar tears.
    
    "Oh, dearest girl," she begins, simply wreathing Ryn in a hug. The smaller woman doesn't fight, burying her face in Lumia's chest and crying. "I could say I was indisposed at the time, and that fighting the Wraiths took my full strength, but my weakness is no excuse for the tragedies that befell your family."
    
    "My battles with the Wraiths and their spawn took up all my time during the war, and I thought nothing of my passionate demand to the elvenqueen. In the end all I did was convince Atheldred that my love demanded absolute obedience. Worse, I convinced her beloved that I was more important than their union. Would that I could have talked to them, or their daughter, even just a little.

Were it not for you, your city and your people would still be under the rule of a tyrant, or worse!"
    
    "But that was [ryn.highConfidence
        |mostly
        |all
    ] [pc.name]!"
    
    "Please, dear. If our [pc.isDK
        |indomitable
        |virtuous
    ] hero had asked you to stay behind and safe, would you have done so?"
    
    "Well, no, but-"
    
    "Of course! And you never even thought to ask! Trusting in your allies doesn't make your accomplishments lesser. You won't see any of my fellow gods claiming I alone banished the Wraiths from the world. Just as I need each of them, [pc.name] needs you," Lumia says.

    "[ryn.lowConfidence
        |I-I
        |I
    ] thought I'd be scared talking to you, or that you'd be detached," Ryn says with a laugh, wiping more tears from her face.

    The [ryn.crowned
        |elvenqueen
        |elven regent
    ] thinks long and hard, searching for questions she's comfortable asking. She finds one, but still struggles to get the words out in more than a whisper.
    
    "[ryn.lowConfidence
        |C-c
        |C
    ]ould you... I mean, if you were there, could you have saved my mother?" she asks.
    
    "At the time? Maybe. If such a thing were to happen today? Definitely. It took me longer than I would like to arrive at that guarantee. I certainly would have tried with everything I have. That I never got to know your mother is a great regret. My girls tell me she was a wonderful queen," Lumia replies, crestfallen.
    
    "... Do you think I [ryn.crowned
        |[ryn.lowConfidence
            |w-
        ]will
        |[ryn.lowConfidence
            |c-
        ]could
    ] be a good Lumian queen?" Ryn asks, giving the goddess [ryn.lowConfidence
        |her best attempt at confidence
        |a determined look
    ]. "[ryn.lowConfidence
        |B-b
        |B
    ]e honest. I can handle it."
    
    Lumia stares wide-eyed for a moment before breaking into a fit of melodic giggles.
    
    "Be honest, you say! Dear, you have brought the light back to me with a single question! [ryn.crowned
        |You are already everything I could ever hope for, Lumian or no.
        |I'm sure you'll be better than you or I could ever dream of.
    ] Already, you are mending the wounds of zealotry that sprung from my careless remarks. Sunlight blesses your reign and it[ryn.crowned
        |'s barely begun
        | has yet to even begin
    ]!"
    
    Ryn's eyes go wide with shock, and she sits stunned for a moment before the tears come rushing right back. This time they're accompanied by a smile. She hugs her goddess as tightly as she can, cry-laughing till her eyes run dry.
    
    "Gods," she says, shaking her head. "It feels like I'll wake up from a dream at any moment."
    
    "If it were, I'd just visit you in reality when you woke," Lumia replies immediately.
    
    "O-oh! One more thing. My friend El-, um... My high priestess Elthara, suffered some of the demonic taint that afflicted much of my sister's court. Do you think... is there anything you could do to help her?" Ryn asks, 
    
    "I would need to see her in person. This new taint is elusive and hard to pin, but I would certainly try for someone so close to you. Perhaps I'll call in a favor from Nareva."
    
    "Thank you. Thank you for answering my questions, too. I never thought I'd get this far."
    
    "Good! Don't think about it as 'this far.' You got here, and that's all that matters. If you have any other questions, don't be afraid to ask. Seriously, I have enough problems getting my valkyries to talk with me regularly."

“我的女士，我只是……我只是想知道，这些年来，我心中一直燃烧着什么。 [etheryn.lowConfidence
        |呃……
        |W
    ]嘿？你怎么没在那里呢？ [etheryn.highConfidence

    ]她的耳朵都快贴到眼睛边了，呼吸也变得急促起来，她努力继续说道：“我的祖父、我的祖母，他们为什么要遭受那样的痛苦？你本应该保护他们的啊！”

她试图擦去眼中的泪水，但泪水来得太快，根本擦不完。此刻她已经完全哭了出来，但还是强忍着情绪，清晰而有力地说出了接下来的话。
    
    我、我妈妈，为什么你没能救她呢？我以为自己已经接受了这些事实，但现在你真的出现在我面前，这些疑问又重新涌上心头。”

卢米娅认真地听着她的话语。起初，她的脸上带着怜悯的表情，但随着埃瑟琳继续诉说，这种表情逐渐变成了充满同情的忧郁，甚至让她自己也差点哭出来。
    
    哦，我最亲爱的姑娘，”她开始说道，然后紧紧地将瑞恩拥入怀中。这个身材娇小的女人没有反抗，只是把脸埋在卢米娅的胸前哭泣着。“我可以说，当时我身体不适，与那些幽灵战斗让我耗尽了全部力气，但我的虚弱并不能成为你家人遭遇那些悲剧的借口。
    
    在战争期间，与那些幽灵及其巢穴的战斗占据了我所有的时间，因此我当时并没有太在意自己向精灵女王提出的那个迫切要求。最终，我所做的一切只是让阿瑟德雷德相信，我的爱要求她绝对服从我的命令。更糟糕的是，我还让她深爱的丈夫认为，我比他们的婚姻关系更为重要。要是当时我能和他们，或者他们的女儿，哪怕只是简单地谈上几句该多好啊……
    
    而你，亲爱的天使，根本不应该承受那场可怕事件所带来的所有痛苦。你值得被爱，也值得看到自己的梦想成真。虽然我无法违背自己的责任去拯救你的母亲，但看到你活了下来，我心中充满了喜悦。更重要的是，你为了纠正我犯下的错误而付出了如此多的努力！如果没有你，你的城市和你的人民现在仍然会处于暴君的统治之下，甚至可能会面临更糟的命运！
    
    但那只是…… [ryn.highConfidence
        |主要是
        |所有
    ] [pc.name]求你了，亲爱的。如果我们的…… [pc.isDK
        |不可战胜的
        |正直的
    ] 英雄曾经嘱咐你留在后方确保安全，你当时会照做吗？”

“嗯，其实不会，但是——”

“当然不会！而且你甚至都没有想过要问这个问题！信任你的盟友并不会削弱你的功绩。你也不会看到我的任何一位同伴会声称是我独自将那些邪灵从世界上驱逐出去的。正如我需要他们的帮助一样，他们也离不开我的支持。 [pc.name] 需要你，”卢米娅说道。

瑞恩没有再继续自我贬低，而是沉浸在女神充满爱意的怀抱中，直到她的哭泣声停止。然后，她抽泣着从怀抱中退了出来，她的眼中充满了困惑。[ryn.lowConfidence
        |我……
        |我
    ] 我本来以为和你交谈会让我感到害怕，或者你会显得很冷漠，”瑞恩笑着说，一边继续擦去脸上的泪水。

“我的女武神们刚来到这里时也常常会有同样的想法，但我永远都无法理解。如果我表现得冷漠疏远，那我算什么家庭女神呢？不，我绝对不会那样。你想问我任何问题，我都会尽我所能来回答。 [ryn.crowned
        |精灵女王
        |精灵摄政王
    ] 她深思熟虑，努力寻找那些自己能够自如提出的问题。终于想出了一个，但仍然难以用超过耳语的声音把它们说出来。[ryn.lowConfidence
        |C-c
        |C
    ]你能不能……我的意思是，如果你当时在场，能不能救救我的母亲？”她问道。

“在那个时候吗？也许吧。但如果这种事情发生在今天，我肯定会尽力去救。不过，我花了很长时间才下定这个决心。我肯定会用尽自己所有的一切去尝试。没能认识你的母亲，我感到非常遗憾。我的女儿们告诉我，她是一位非常了不起的女性。”卢米娅黯然地回答道。

“……你认为我…… [ryn.crowned
        |[ryn.lowConfidence
            |w-
        ]会
        |[ryn.lowConfidence
            |c-
        ]可以
    ] 怎样才能成为一名出色的卢米安女王呢？”瑞恩问道，同时向这位女神提出了这个问题。 [ryn.lowConfidence
        |她为展现自信所做出的最大努力
        |坚定的眼神
    ]. "[ryn.lowConfidence
        |呃……
        |B
    ]说真的，我完全能应付得来。”

卢米娅瞪大了眼睛，愣了一会儿，然后突然爆发出一阵银铃般的笑声。

“说真的啊！亲爱的，你 just 问了一个问题，就让我重新感受到了光明！ [ryn.crowned
        |无论你是不是 Lumian，你都已经是我所能期望的一切。
        |我相信你会变得比我们任何人想象的都要优秀。
    ] 你已经在努力弥补那些因我的疏忽之言而引发的狂热所带来的伤害了。阳光祝福着你的统治，也祝福着这一切。[ryn.crowned
        |才刚刚开始而已。
        | 甚至还没有开始呢
    ]瑞恩的眼睛因震惊而瞪得大大的，她愣住了好一会儿，随后泪水又一次夺眶而出。不过这一次，她的脸上还带着微笑。她紧紧地抱住自己的“女神”，边哭边笑，直到眼泪流干为止。
    
    天啊，”她摇着头说道，“感觉自己随时都会从梦中醒来。”

“如果真是这样，等你醒来的时候，我就会去现实世界中找你吧。”Lumia立刻回答道。

“哦……还有一件事。我的朋友埃尔……我的大祭司艾尔塔拉也受到了那种恶魔污染的影响，就像我姐姐的宫廷里许多人一样。你认为……有没有什么办法可以帮助她呢？”瑞恩问道。

“我需要亲自见见她。 这种新的污染源很难捉摸，也很难确定它的来源，但对于你这么亲近的人，我肯定会尽力帮忙的。也许我可以请纳雷瓦帮个忙。

“谢谢你，也谢谢你回答我的问题。我从来没想过自己能走到这一步。太好了！不要把这件事看作是‘已经达到这个阶段’而已。你能走到这里，这才是最重要的。如果你还有其他问题，随时都可以问。说真的，我自己的问题就已经够多了，还得想办法让我的女武神们能定期和我交流呢。"

rows.original: "I know all about the valkyries from stories and reports, but what is it like to actually live here? How do my subjects adapt to living with so many other races?" Ryn asks. "Remarkably well, dear. It may be simply because home is so close, but those among my girls who live in the Marches often get situated the quickest. They also do a wonderful job of helping those who come from afar feel at home. I hope to see more of them as we continue to fight off the nastiness invading our home," the goddess answers with a shudder. "I'm happy to hear it. That kind of leads into my next question as well. I don't have much experience with things outside my kingdom. How do other cities, or other countries even, treat the valkyries?" "Most places treat them the same as the Marches do, though none have quite the same zeal as your city and people. When there are no great conflicts, my girls help answer the prayers of my followers. Most often, that involves getting to know soon to be mothers, and ensuring their pregnancies are safe and comfortable. This often results in bonds that go beyond simple duty, and because of that most places in the world are more than warm to them." "That sounds wonderful! How far do they go?" "Oh, however far they're needed. Distance is no price for safety. Some have even gone to places no map here has ever marked." "[ryn.lowConfidence |B-b |B ]ut how do they stay in contact if they're so far away? Also what if they run into trouble. [ryn.lowConfidence |D-d |D ]o they ever find countries that shun them?" "I can feel them through our bond, no matter where they are. As for trouble, they're perfectly capable of handling themselves in such a situation. There are people's with whom communication is as of yet impossible, but all things come in time. As far as civilized countries go, the people of Kitsuhon are an unfortunate situation. Their mistrust of me is very old and very warranted, or at least it was warranted at the time. "But even there, things change. The emperor may encourage or demand my worship be quashed, but that doesn't stop the prayers. Sometimes they beseech me alongside Keros for a bountiful crop or a healthy baby; other times it's my name alone on their lips. I think that with enough time, even the great scar caused by those who wielded my name like snakes can be mended." "I hope so! If the issues between us and the druids can be, I'm sure you'll succeed. Speaking of, um, babies: how does that work? I know that the valkyries entrust their souls to you, but does that extend to their children?" "A fair question, but certainly not. Choice is the single most important part of a valkyrie's ascension, and I would not lay that obligation on a babe before it was born. I encourage any of my chosen to have children of their own when they find someone they love and trust. Should those children pursue the same honor as their mothers, I would greet them with the same enthusiasm I showed their parents." "[ryn.lowConfidence |R-r |R ]eally? I had no idea. The historical accounts don't really mention much about the home lives of the valkyries, so it's odd for me to hear that it seems so... normal. At least, compared to some of the other gods' chosen people." "Ah. Some, most, of my fellow deities do things differently, but I don't think their methods are so abnormal. Keros and Velun's chosen have children like anyone else, and a lack of soul doesn't make them lesser for it. Tira is much the same as me, though on a smaller scale, and Mallach and Sorra eschew chosen entirely. None of them are incapable of living perfectly mundane lives. Only Nareva's chosen, her Astrida, are born and bred for a purpose that precludes them living what I would call a full life, with family and children of their own. But still she cares for them as any mother would, though she'd never admit as much to anyone but me. And the Astrida embrace their noble fate one and all; it should be no surprise that the secretive serpents' followers value a different life than my dear valkyries do." "When you explain it like that I feel a bit silly for thinking the valkyries fought right until they dropped," Ryn admits, twiddling her fingers uncomfortably. "Don't feel down. Some in the order would like nothing less than to perish on the battlefield and have epic poems written about them for years to come, much to my chagrin. It does not surprise me in the least that those boisterous voices are heard the most outside our walls. I'm also glad to hear you ask about children," Lumia says, suddenly smiling[var0 | and offering a wink. "Rest assured that my valkyries are perfectly capable in that department |. "I hope to meet yours someday ]." Ryn mumbles something that sounds like "yeah", but is too [silly |close to bursting into flames |embarrassed ] to form a solid response. Lumia seems either blissfully ignorant or, more likely, proud of her teasing, so the next talking point is in your court.
rows.translation: 通过故事和报道，我对女武神们有了很多了解，但真正生活在这里是什么感觉呢？我的子民们是如何适应与这么多其他种族共同生活的呢？”瑞恩问道。 “他们适应得非常好，亲爱的。也许仅仅是因为家乡就在附近，所以那些住在边境地区的女武神们往往能最快地融入新的环境。 他们也为那些远道而来的人们提供了极大的帮助，让他们在这里感到宾至如归。我希望在我们继续抵御那些侵入我们家园的邪恶势力时，能看到他们发挥更多的作用。”女神颤抖着说道。 听到这个消息我很高兴。这也引出了我的下一个问题。我对王国以外的情况了解不多，其他城市或其他国家又是如何对待女武神的呢？” “大多数地方对待女武神的方式都和边境地区差不多，不过没有哪个地方能像你们的城市和人民那样充满热情。 在没有重大矛盾的情况下，我的女仆们会帮助回应我的追随者们所许的祷告。通常，这意味着要帮助那些即将成为母亲的女性，确保她们的孕期安全且舒适。这样的经历往往会让彼此建立起超越单纯职责范围的深厚情谊，正因如此，世界上大多数地方都对她们怀有无比的热情与接纳。" 那听起来太棒了！他们要去多远的地方呢？” “哦，只要有必要，他们就会去任何地方。为了安全，距离根本不是问题。有些地方甚至连地图上都没有标注。”[ryn.lowConfidence |呃…… |B ]如果他们相隔那么远，他们是怎么保持联系的呢？另外，如果他们遇到了麻烦，该怎么办呢？ [ryn.lowConfidence |D-d |D ]他们难道永远找不到那些拒绝与他们来往的国家吗？” “通过我们之间的联系，无论他们身在何处，我都能感受到他们的存在。至于遇到麻烦，他们完全有能力自己应对这种局面。确实有一些人目前还无法与我们取得联系，但一切都会等到时机成熟的时候。至于那些文明国家…… Kitsuhon的人们所处的处境确实很不幸。他们对我的不信任由来已久，而且这种不信任也是完全有道理的……至少是这么认为的。 是 但即便在那种情况下，情况也会发生变化。皇帝可能会鼓励或要求人们停止对我的崇拜，但这并不会阻止人们祈祷。有时候，他们会与凯罗斯一起祈求丰收或婴儿的健康；而有时候，他们口中只念着我的名字。 我相信，只要有足够的时间，那些滥用我的名字的人所造成的伤痕也一定能够被治愈。” “但愿如此！如果我们与德鲁伊们之间的矛盾能够得到解决，我相信你一定能够成功。说到孩子……这个事情到底是怎么运作的呢？ 我知道女武神们会将她们的灵魂托付给你，但这种信任是否也包括她们的孩子呢？” “这是一个合理的问题，但答案显然是否定的。选择权才是女武神升华过程中最为重要的因素，而我绝不会在一个婴儿还未出生之前就要求它承担这样的责任。 我鼓励我所挑选的这些人，在找到自己爱且信任的人之后，去生自己的孩子。如果这些孩子也选择追求与他们母亲一样的荣誉，我会以和对待他们父母时一样的热情来欢迎他们。" 蒂拉和我很相似，只不过她的经历规模要小一些；而马拉赫和索拉则完全放弃了被选中的命运。他们中的没有人无法过上平凡而美好的生活。只有纳雷瓦选中的那个人——她的阿斯特里达——生来就被赋予了特定的使命，这使得她们无法过上我所说的那种拥有家庭和孩子的完整生活。 rows.original: "[ryn.lowConfidence |So, um, you can deal with curses, right? |How do you deal with cursed people who come to your halls? ] Could you help me with a curse?" Etheryn asks. "That depends. I've seen such a variety of curses, and each had its own unique twist. Some are easier to disrupt than others, but I haven't found one I couldn't beat," Lumia replies, smirking proudly. "I'll need to know more about your curse before I know if I can help, though. Is it something you can talk about?" "[ryn.lowConfidence |Y-yes, I think so. It's a little embarrassing, but..." |Yes. It's not so embarrassing anymore," ] Ryn says, lifting her skirt to show off the enchanted cage that seals her sex. She blushes purple, but doesn't shy away when Lumia crouches to examine her more closely. Knelt before her, the goddess scrutinizes the metal without touching it. When she finally does reach out, it's to spin your elven companion around to get a look at it from different angles. Just before the amount of time spent can get awkward, she leaps to her feet and grips the smaller woman by her shoulders. "You're in luck! Cursed objects tend to be more of Nareva's forte, though I'm not entirely helpless in that regard, but this was forged using the curse-wielder's soul as leverage. That means that only they can open it, and no mundane methods or mortal magic can undo the curse." Ryn is momentarily crestfallen, but [pc.isCunning |you caught her meaning. |Lumia continues before she can droop too low. ] "So it's a good thing my power is anything but mortal," [pc.isCunning |Lumia |she ] says with a wink. Ryn's spirits lift so quickly that she bounces in place. "So you can remove it, then?" she asks, still suffering a modicum of doubt. "Of course I can! I can undo this pesky shrinking enchantment as well if you'd like. Was that an escape attempt of your own?" "Y-yes. I was able to find some ingredients for a potion and tried that. It didn't help." "You couldn't have known how intricate the curse was. All that matters is that you tried," Lumia assures her. "Hmm. There is an entirely different problem, however. Not with the removal, but with what comes after." "What do you mean? W-will there be something wrong with my dick?" Ryn asks. "No, no, quite the opposite actually. My power is all about life and creation. After I'm done you'll be so full of virile energy that you could fuck for a week and not run dry." Ryns eyes go wide, and her cheeks flush a delightful shade of purple. "Someone will need to be there to help vent at least some of that energy immediately after the curse is broken, or there could be some actual issues, but I would hope that's not a problem! [ryn.fucked|It could even be your companion here.|It doesn't have to be your friend here.] Just come see me when you've found someone!"

Now I think it knows, and wants to correct that mistake," Atugia asks. |"Hello, Lumia, ma'am. I know I'd probably be better off askin' Nareva about curses, but since you're here, do you have any idea what happened to me the other night? I had a horrible nightmare, and it feels like something changed. You see, I was attacked by a Wraith during the Godswar, and it swallowed up the people of my village. I don't know why I didn't die, but I think it knows that now, and wants to correct that mistake," Atugia asks. ] "Come closer," Lumia says, ushering Atugia closer and placing both hands on her neck. Her fingers trace slow lines on the starry expanse of flesh, and you swear you see brighter flashes of light in the dark. "Fascinating. [flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY|I should have noticed then. It wasn't exactly a camoflage after all.|If I'd only known sooner. This is no curse as you'd understand it.] "Dearest girl, I'm going to be very direct. I don't know how your soul is still intact. Or more accurately, I don't know how you're still you. You're packed with enough Wraith energy to turn a small company of soldiers into Wraith-spawn," the goddess explains. Atugia looks more than alarmed at the notion, but before she can do more than reach for her neck, the goddess begins speaking again. "Somehow, all that power is threaded neatly into your very being, and instead of tearing you apart, it's holding you together. It's no surprise that you've been alive since the Godswar. You've been kept in exactly the same state as you were then. What were you doing when this Wraith attacked you? I need to know the exact circumstances of its attack," she demands, moving her hands to Atugia's shoulders. "I... um..." "You're fine, dear. Tira isn't tapping on your hourglass or anything. My concern is purely with the details," Lumia says, massaging the shorter woman's shoulders in a calming gesture. "Thank the gods," Tui sighs in relief. "That night we were performing a ritual to bring our ancestor spirits to protect us. We'd heard about the trouble brewing in the empire proper from traders, and sought to protect ourselves in advance of a possible attack. When we opened ourselves to the spirits, it must have been like opening up the tastiest snack imaginable. It wasn't just our ancestors who answered the summons. That nightmare came too, and immediately devoured the gathered energy before turning to us for seconds. "Those it didn't eat were just chopped to pieces. The last thing I remember is it descending on me with what looked like a great pair of spectral shears. After that... there's nothing until I woke amidst the carnage days later. No one else was left, and I found... at least some of the rest of the bodies," she concludes, unable to bring herself to say more. "That's enough, dear. You don't need to tell the rest. Fortunately for you that Wraith was assuredly obliterated in the ensuing battles to the south. It's just a theory, but I think this creature's unthinking gluttony was your savior. In its mad rush to both eat and corrupt, it filled you with both its own otherworldly power, and that of your own ancestors. It's certainly an immensely unique circumstance that I doubt could be replicated, but it has resulted in your continued life. I think it would also explain why you haven't been torn apart. "Unfortunately, if this Wraith created other spawn then your condition may cause some unexpected problems. That power is emanating out from you like a beacon, one that I don't know if it's possible to stopper. It was masked to some degree by the Wraith in my sanctum, but with it gone there is nothing left to mask you. Should your ancient nightmare have created other spawn before it died, they may be drawn to the biggest piece of their former body." "That's... whoooooo, gosh. How will I know? What if they hurt people?" Atugia asks, idly rubbing her wrists. "It's most likely that some of them have already hurt people, but every Wraith produces different spawn. I can only guess, but getting closer to you may actually help with that problem. The nearer they come to you, the more focused they will become on finding you. This will hopefully have a double benefit of reducing collateral damage and making them painfully obvious for you to spot. "My best advice? Trust in [pc.name]! Whatever these things are, they are not only lesser than you, but certainly less than the monster [flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY|you|[pc.heShe]] destroyed. If worst comes to worst, and you absolutely cannot face them together, then lead them to me! I'll show them what happened to their former master," she finishes, balling her hand into a fist and punching it into her other palm. "Thank you, Lumia. I think I'll take that advice," Atugia replies, looking to you with a grin of confidence. "If some part of that monster does come after us, we'll send it to join the rest!" Hell yeah you will.

|嗯，卢米娅女士，我只是想问问，您是否对我身上发生的事情还有其他的想法。前几天晚上我做了一个非常可怕的噩梦，我觉得，也许正是您之前提到的那种‘伪装力量’的消失，让我遭遇了那些事情。我需要解释一下：在‘神战’期间，我曾被一个‘幽灵’袭击，那个怪物吞噬了我村庄里所有的居民。我不知道为什么，但我没有死。现在我想，那个‘幽灵’应该知道这个原因，它想要纠正这个‘错误’。”阿图吉亚问道。 |您好，卢米娅女士。我知道或许应该去问纳雷瓦关于诅咒的事情，但既然您在这里，您是否知道前几天晚上我发生了什么？我做了一个可怕的噩梦，感觉自己似乎发生了某些变化。您知道，在那场神战期间，有一个幽灵袭击了我，它吞噬了我村庄里的所有人。我不知道自己为什么没有死，但我想它现在知道了这一点，想要纠正这个‘错误’。”阿图吉亚问道。 ] 靠近一些，”卢米娅说道，将阿图吉亚拉近一些，然后双手放在她的脖子上。她的手指在那片肌肤上缓缓移动，仿佛在绘制着某种图案，而你仿佛能看到黑暗中闪烁着更加明亮的光芒。“真是太迷人了…… [flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY|我当时就应该注意到的。毕竟，那根本算不上是一种伪装。|要是我能早点知道该多好。这并不是你所理解的那种诅咒。] 最亲爱的女孩，我必须直说了。我真的不明白你的灵魂是怎么还保持完整的……或者更准确地说，我不明白你究竟是怎么做到的…… 你你的体内蕴含着足以将一小队士兵转化为怨灵的能量，”女神解释道。 阿图吉亚听到这个说法后显得非常惊慌，但她还没来得及做出任何反应，女神又继续说道： “某种原因，所有这些能量都被巧妙地融入了你的身体之中，而不是将你撕裂，反而让你的身体保持完整。难怪在神战之后你依然能够存活下来——因为这些能量一直在保护着你。 正是如此 还是和当时一样。当那个幽灵攻击你的时候，你在做什么？我需要知道它攻击你的具体经过，”她说道，同时将手放在阿图吉亚的肩上。 “我……呃……” “你没事的，亲爱的。蒂拉并没有在计算你的时间，也没有其他意思。我只是想了解一些细节而已，”卢米娅一边说，一边轻轻按摩着这位身材较矮的女人的肩膀，试图让她放松下来。 谢天谢地，”崔松了口气说道，“那天晚上我们正在进行一场仪式，目的是召唤祖先的灵魂来保护我们。我们从商人们那里听说帝国境内正在酝酿着一些麻烦，因此我们想提前采取措施，以防可能发生的攻击。 当我们向这些灵体敞开心扉时，那种感觉一定就像是在享用世界上最美味的小吃一样。回应我们召唤的不仅仅是我们的祖先，那个噩梦也出现了——它立刻吞噬了所有聚集起来的能量，随后又将目光转向了我们。 那些它没有吃掉的东西，都被撕成了碎片。我最后记得的，就是它用那把仿佛由幽灵打造的巨型剪刀般的东西朝我扑了过来。之后……就什么都不记得了，直到几天后我在一片废墟中醒来。已经没有其他人活着了，而我发现的……至少还有其他一些人的尸体。”她说道，实在无法继续说下去了。 够了，亲爱的。你不需要告诉其他人了。对你来说幸运的是，那个‘幽灵’在南方随后发生的战斗中肯定已经被消灭了。这只是个猜测，但我认为，这种生物那种毫无理智的贪吃行为反而救了你一命。 在这种疯狂的吞噬与腐蚀过程中，它将自身那超凡的力量，以及你祖先的力量，都注入了你的体内。这无疑是一种极其独特的情况，我认为这种现象很难被再次复制，但正是这种力量使你得以继续生存。 我想，这也能够解释为什么你还没有被撕成碎片。 不幸的是，如果这个‘幽灵’产生了其他衍生物，你的这种状态可能会引发一些意想不到的问题。那种力量正从你身上散发出来，就像一座信号灯一样，而我不知道是否有可能阻止它。在我的圣所里，那种力量在某种程度上被‘幽灵’所掩盖，但现在‘幽灵’消失了，再也没有什么可以掩盖你了。如果你的那个古老噩梦在消亡之前产生了其他衍生物，它们可能会被你那曾经属于它们的‘身体’的最大部分所吸引。 那……哇哦，天哪。我怎么知道呢？要是他们伤害了别人怎么办？”阿图吉亚边问边随意地揉着自己的手腕。 “很可能他们中已经有人伤害过别人了，但是每个‘幽灵’产生的生物都是不同的。我只能猜测而已，不过，靠近你可能会让我们有更多的线索。 帮助 有了那个问题，他们离你越近，就会越专注于寻找你。这样做的好处是双重的：既能减少附带伤害，也能让你更容易发现他们。 “我最好的建议是什么呢？那就是相信自己。 [pc.name]无论这些东西是什么，它们不仅比你弱小，而且肯定也比那个怪物弱小。 [flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY|你|[pc.heShe]] 把它们消灭掉。如果情况真的变得非常糟糕，你们实在无法共同面对那些怪物的话，就把它们带到我面前来！我会让它们亲眼看到它们的前主人遭遇了什么，”她说完，将拳头握紧，然后用力砸在另一只手掌上。 “谢谢你，Lumia。我想我会采纳这个建议的，”Atugia自信地笑着看着你，“如果那些怪物的任何一部分真的追上来，我们就把它们也送过去，让它们和其他怪物一起消失吧！” 没错，你们肯定会的。

Lumia与Arona

rows.original: Arona steps forward while you're considering what to ask. "Hey. While we're talking about stuff and not fucking, could you fix my sister's eyes? I think [flags.DHAWK_ARONA_PARTY |we have |[pc.name] has ] done more than enough for that kinda favor. She's been a faithful priestess for years, so I think she deserves it too," she says. "That's remarkably selfless of you, but it's not something that can be done so easily," the goddess replies. "I granted my blessing of foresight because I saw the good she could do with it. She led you to [pc.name], after all. Had I been able to grant her mundane sight in the same stroke, she would have it. It was no curse or malefic taint that took her sight, nor your niece's, but a quirk of blood long passed through your family. Perhaps, if she had become a valkyrie, things may have been different in that regard, but do you think such a fate would suit her?" Arona, who had looked ready to argue further, is stopped short by the question. "Hrmm. No. She's never been interested in the fighting and the conquering. I just, ya know, thought maybe it'd be cool if she could actually read those books she's always talking about." "Has her blindness slowed her in that regard so far?" "Well no, but... hmm. I guess it used to, but early on her teacher made sure she knew everything, and now her apprentice is always reading to her. You get what I mean though, right? I just..." "You just love her exactly as much as a sister should. I may not have been able to repair her sight, but the blessings I was able to give her helped the both of you to meet [pc.name], and to be here in the Marches to combat a grave threat to the world." "Ha. You're right. I don't know why I'm even asking for her. She probably wouldn't have even asked in the first place. Or maybe she would have, but she has done perfectly fine without being able to see. Thanks, Lumia. And uh, hey — you mentioned my niece?" The goddess nods. "And being a valkyrie, maybe you could do something for her? Cuz Hretha's [silly |a giant fuckin' nerd |a big soft brain ], but Aretha, she's like me: all fire and blood, just tiny and, like, twelve. I bet she'd make a good valkyrie." "Then send her to me, when she is of age," Lumia says. "But I would not wish her to bind her soul to me just for the gift of sight. A lifelong dedication to my ideals is not so lightly done." Arona opens her mouth, then clicks it shut, contemplating that a moment. A rare sight indeed. "Yeah, I guess. But I think she'd go for it anyway. She wants to fight. To protect the tribe, and make us all proud. Like she doesn't already. But still. [arona.isExiled |I guess I'll find some way to get a message to her, someday. Gotta at least let her and her dad know the offer's around. Never heard of a valk from the Sailgraves. |I'll talk it through with her next time I'm on the islands, let her know it's possible anyway. Hretha could guide her through all of the religious stuff. ]" Lumia smiles radiantly. "I look forward to hearing from young Aretha, then."
rows.translation: 就在你还在思考该问些什么的时候，阿罗娜走上前来。 “嘿，既然我们正在聊天，而不是在搞什么别的，你能不能帮我妹妹治好眼睛？我觉得…… [flags.DHAWK_ARONA_PARTY |我们有 |[pc.name] 拥有 ] 为了得到那样的帮助，她已经付出了远远超过应有的努力。多年来，她一直是一位忠诚的女祭司，因此我认为她确实值得得到这个奖励，”她说。 “你真是太无私了，但这样的事情并不是那么容易做到的，”女神回答道。“我赐予她‘预见之力’，是因为我看到了她能够用这份能力去做很多好事。她引导你们走向…… [pc.name]毕竟，如果我能一次性赋予她普通的视力，她现在就应该拥有它了。导致她失明的，并非什么诅咒或邪恶的力量，也不是你侄女的情况，而是你们家族世代相传的一种特殊体质。或许，如果她成为了女武神，这种情况会有所不同，但你觉得这样的命运真的适合她吗？阿罗娜本来似乎还想继续争论，但这个问题让她停住了。 “嗯……不。她从来对战斗和征服之类的东西不感兴趣。我只是觉得，如果她能参与其中的话，可能会很有趣吧。 其实 去读那些她总是提到的书吧。” “她的失明在这一点上是否给她带来了困扰？” “嗯，倒没有，但是……嗯，我想以前是有点影响的。不过在她刚开始学习的时候，她的老师就确保她能够掌握所有知识，而现在她的学徒也会经常给她读书。你明白我的意思吧？我只是……” “你只是像一个姐姐应该做的那样爱着她而已。虽然我没能恢复她的视力，但我能给予她的那些帮助，让你们俩能够相遇，这也已经是很幸运的事情了。 [pc.name]来到这里，来到这些边境地区，就是为了共同对抗这个对全世界构成严重威胁的敌人。” “哈，你说得对。我真不明白自己为什么要请求她的帮助。她可能一开始就不会愿意帮忙的。或者，也许她还是会愿意的，但是…… 拥有 即使看不见，也照样进行得非常顺利。多亏了Lumia。对了，你提到过我的侄女吧？” 女神点了点头。 “作为一位女武神，或许你能为她做些什么吧？因为Hretha…… [silly |一个十足的书呆子 |愚蠢至极 ]但是阿瑞莎，她和我很像：充满活力与热情，只是身材娇小一些，大概十二岁左右。我敢打赌，她一定会成为一名出色的女武神。” “等她长大后，就把她送到我身边吧，”卢米娅说，“不过我并不希望她仅仅为了获得视力这个礼物，就将自己的灵魂与我绑定在一起。 终生为自己的理想而奋斗，这绝非易事。” 阿罗娜张了张嘴，又立刻闭上了嘴，似乎在认真思考着什么。这样的情景确实很不常见。“嗯，我想也是。不过我觉得她无论如何都会选择这么做的。她就是想要战斗。 为了保护我们的部落，让所有人都能感到自豪。就像她现在所做的那样。不过，无论如何，这都是必要的。 [arona.isExiled |我想总有一天，我会想办法让她知道这个消息。至少得让她和她父亲知道有这个机会。我从来没听说过“Sailgraves”家族中有女武神。 |下次我去那些岛屿的时候，我会和她仔细商量这件事，告诉她这是完全可行的。赫蕾莎可以帮她处理所有与宗教相关的事情。 ]露米娅灿烂地笑了起来：“那么，我很期待能听到年轻的阿瑞莎的消息。

"In that case, could you make me more virile?" you ask.
    
    "Most definitely! Something like that is simple," Lumia laughs, tracing a small rune in the air.
    
    The resulting power stays at the tip of her fingers in a sparkling trail. Rather than touch it to you, the goddess brushes it over her lips. Then, before you have a chance to react, she sweeps you up into a deep smooch. Her golden lips tingle with divine power, and you can feel the warmth of magic wash over your body.
    
    That glorious feeling sinks and sinks till it finally settles in your loins.
    
    "Whoa..." you manage when she finally pulls away.
    
    "There. [var0
        |I also reversed the effects of those herbs that blocked your seed. It won't stop you from using them again, but that would defeat the purpose of the blessing
        |You should be fit to seed the toughest of fields. I hope this helps on your journeys
    ]," she says with a wink, giving you a knowing squeeze on your shoulder.

那样的话，你能让我变得更有男子气概吗？”你问道。

“当然可以！这种事情很简单。”Lumia笑着说，同时在空中画出一个小小的符文。

随之产生的力量凝聚在她的指尖，形成一道闪烁的光芒。 女神并没有将它触碰到你的身上，而是将其轻轻掠过自己的嘴唇。然后，在你还没来得及做出任何反应之前，她便紧紧拥住了你，献给了你一个深情的吻。她那金色的双唇散发着神圣的力量，你能感受到一股魔力正在你的身体里流淌。
    
    那种美妙的感觉会逐渐蔓延，最终沉淀在你的腰部。

rows.original:
"Could I just get a hug? [pc.dcb
        |This whole hero work business is rough,
        |I'm just feeling a little down right now,
        |I'm, like, just a little overwhelmed right now,
    ]" you say, letting out a shaky breath.
    
    "Oh, honey! Come here," Lumia replies, opening her arms for you to approach. "I'll make it better."
    
    You do as she says, and all the strength drains from your body once you're safe in her arms. It's all you can do to stay standing, but the goddess keeps you upright without effort. Even lifting your arms to hug her back is a colossal effort. Still, all that energy leaving your body is replaced by relief in equal parts.
    
    Lumia rubs a small circle on your back, letting you stand and breath till you're feeling a bit less overwhelmed. She [pc.swornGod keros nareva
        |brushes her fingers through the fur of your tails, smoothing out the fur in comb-like strokes. The motions also serve to brush the stress right out of you. With each one, you feel more and more invigorated.
        |gently strokes the inner and outer breadth of your ear-fins. After a minute or two of that, one of her hands transitions to brushing slowly along your smooth, [pc.scaleColor] scales, all the way to the [flags.TODO_AURORA_TAIL|scintillating aurora at the tip of your tail|flickering flames at the tip of your tail.]. Every touch scratches an itch you didn't know you had, and each one invigorates you further and further.
        |uses her free hand to hold the back of your head, gently rocking with you in her arms. Each short bob to and fro reinvigorates you just a little bit more. With every one, a little bit more of the stress you built up pours off the top.
    ]
    
    "[pc.swornGod keros nareva
        |You have such beautiful tails, dear. It's a shame that I don't get to enjoy this feeling with more of Lord Keros' subjects," she says after a few minutes of brushing. "You're always welcome here as well. No matter what."
        |"[flags.TODO_AURORA_TAIL|I must visit Tychris again, one of these days, the frostscales have a truly divine quality to them," she says, contemplating your aurora. "And you, dear, are a [pc.mascFem
            |piece of divine artwork.
            |truly divine beauty.
        ]|My my, the goddess of knowledge knows divine beauty. You're welcome to stick around here for as long as you want," she says, tracing a finger around your scales. "I'm glad she broke her tradition for such a fine champion."]
        |You've worked hard to get where you are, dear, but even heroes get tired sometimes. If you work yourself to death, then there will be no one left to save the day!" she laughs after a few minutes of rocking. "I'm glad you're able to understand your limits."
    ]
    
    "Yeah..." you reply, letting out a sigh of relief. "Thanks for being here to help me."
    
    "Always. 'Being there' is one of my favorite things to do for my people[pc.isValk||[pc.isSoulbound|, and for [pc.patron]'s people too]]."
    
    Another few minutes pass before either of you speak again. During that time you remain in her arms, letting her pamper you till the bad feelings have gone for good. At least for the moment, the sun has banished the darkness.
    
    "Is that better, dear?" she asks when you begin to shift in her arms. "Do you need anything else while you're here?"
rows.translation:
能让我抱你一下吗？ [pc.dcb
        |这个英雄系统的设定实在有点麻烦。
        |我现在只是觉得有点情绪低落而已。
        |我现在真的有点应接不暇了……
    ]你说得对，”你颤抖着说道。

“哦，亲爱的！过来吧，”Lumia张开双臂邀请你靠近，“我会让一切好起来的。”

你照她说的做了，一旦安全地落入她的怀抱，你身上的所有力气仿佛都被抽走了。 你只能竭尽全力才能保持站立，但女神却毫不费力地让你保持直立。就连抬起手臂去拥抱她的背部，也仿佛需要耗费巨大的力气。然而，所有这些从你身体中消耗的能量，都会被随之而来的解脱感所完全弥补。
    
    卢米亚在你的背上轻轻按摩着，帮助你站立起来，呼吸几次，直到你感觉压力稍微减轻了一些。她…… [pc.swornGod keros nareva
        |她的手指轻轻抚过你们尾巴上的毛发，用梳子般的动作将毛发梳理得平整光滑。这些动作同时也帮助你们缓解了压力，每一次这样的抚摸都会让你们感到愈发精神振奋。
        |她轻轻抚摸着你耳廓的内外两侧。这样持续了一两分钟后，她的一只手开始缓缓地沿着你光滑的耳廓滑动…… [pc.scaleColor] 逐步扩大，直至达到最高规模。 [flags.TODO_AURORA_TAIL|你尾巴尖端闪烁的极光|你尾巴尖端闪烁的火焰。]每一次触碰都能缓解你未曾察觉的痒意，每一次接触都会让你感到愈发充满活力。
        |她用空闲的那只手托着你的后脑，轻轻地将你抱在怀里摇晃。每一次这样的轻轻摇晃都会让你感到一丝振奋，而每一次这样的动作，你身上积压的压力也会随之减轻一些。
    ]
    
    "[pc.swornGod keros nareva
        |亲爱的，你的尾巴真是太漂亮了。可惜我没能让更多的凯罗斯领主的子民也能感受到这种美妙的感觉，”她一边梳理着尾巴，一边说道。“不过，你随时都可以来到这里。无论发生什么，这里永远为你敞开。
        |"[flags.TODO_AURORA_TAIL|总有一天，我一定要再去看看提克里斯，那些霜之鳞片真的有一种神圣的气息，”她凝视着你的极光说道，“而你，亲爱的，就是…… [pc.mascFem
            |一件真正的艺术杰作。
            |真正令人惊叹的美貌。
        ]|哎呀，知识女神果然拥有绝世的美貌。你随时都可以在这里停留，”她一边说，一边用手指轻轻抚过你的鳞片。“我很高兴她破例选择了这么一位出色的英雄。]
        |亲爱的，你为了达到现在的成就确实付出了很多努力，但就连英雄也会感到疲惫。如果你把自己累垮了，那就没有人能够来拯救局面了！”她摇着椅子说了一会儿，然后笑了起来。“我很高兴你能够认识到自己的极限。
    ]
    
    是啊……”你松了一口气，说道，“谢谢你来帮助我。”

“这是应该的。为我的人们提供帮助，是我最喜欢做的事情之一。[pc.isValk||[pc.isSoulbound|，也是为了…… [pc.patron]他们的人也是。]]又过了几分钟，你们俩才再次开口说话。在这段时间里，你一直躺在她的怀里，让她悉心照料你，直到那些不好的情绪彻底消失。至少在那一刻，阳光已经驱散了黑暗。

“这样好些了吗，亲爱的？”当你开始在她怀里动弹时，她问道，“你在这里还需要些什么吗？

rows.translation: 更多拥抱

rows.original: "Actually... Can I stay a little longer? I don't really feel that down anymore, but it'd be a shame if I didn't get to hug you at my best as well as at my worst," you tease, never letting go of her in the first place. "Silly [pc.boyGirl]. Of course you can stay. Till someone comes to interrupt us, if need be. Though at your best I expect you to hug me right back!" she shouts, gleefully re-tossing her arms around your shoulders. You [pc.mascFem |laugh |giggle ], wrapping your arms[pc.hasWings |under and wings over |under ] hers in a mutual embrace. Spinning on your feet, you turn the hug into a gentle half-dance. Twirling for one full rotation, you come to a stop in the same position as you started. By now you're both grinning ear to ear, and go for a brief but tight hug that results in [pc.heightRange 0 86 |you being hoisted off the ground under your arms. |the goddess being hoisted off the ground under her arms. ] Once back on the ground, you simply relax in her arms. "Now you're helping me get relaxed, dear. I love it. By the light, have I missed things just like this. I can never have enough of it," Lumia says. "Not with all the hugs in the world." "I don't know if I can match all the hugs in the world, but I'm glad you're content with the moment." "Am I ever." After that your hug is mostly a silent affair. It's interrupted by the occasional laugh as your rocking threatens to tip a little too far to one side, but there's never any real danger of falling. At least until you back close to the throne and Lumia falls to sit in it. You remain linked at your hands, fingers threaded together, and then slowly break away till the hug ends with an abrupt pop of emotional energy. "Please, don't hesitate to ask again. I'm always up for moments like this to brighten my day." "I'll be sure to keep that in mind." "It's good to know that [pc.isValk |my mortal hero |the champion of the Frost Marches ] keeps me in [pc.hisHer] mind. Is there anything else you'd like to keep me occupied with today?" Well? Is there?
rows.translation: 其实……还能再待一会儿吗？我现在已经不那么难过了，但如果不能在你我最糟糕的时候也能拥抱你，那就太遗憾了。”你这样说着，一边说着一边始终没有放开她。 “傻瓜。 [pc.boyGirl]当然你可以留下。等有人来打扰我们的话，我们再离开也不迟。不过，我真心希望你也能回抱我！”她高兴地叫道，再次将双臂环绕在你的肩上。 [pc.mascFem |笑 |轻声笑 ]环抱着你[pc.hasWings |在保护之下 |在……之下 ] 你们紧紧相拥。你突然转过身来，将这个拥抱变成了一支轻柔的半支舞。你们旋转了一整圈，最终又回到了最初的姿势。此时，你们都已经笑得合不拢嘴，然后又紧紧拥抱了一下，这一刻，一切仿佛都变得如此美好…… [pc.heightRange 0 86 |你的手臂被举到了空中。 |这位女神被举离地面，双臂高高举过头顶。 ] 一旦重新回到地面，你只需在她怀里放松下来。 “现在你可以帮忙了。 我 放松点，亲爱的。我太喜欢这样了。在灯光的照耀下，我是不是曾经错过过这样的时刻呢？我永远都想要这种感觉，”卢米娅说道，“就算世界上有再多的拥抱，也无法弥补这种感受。” “我不知道自己是否能够做到同样的事情…… 所有 世界上有那么多拥抱，但我很高兴你能够满足于当下的这一刻。” “我当然是满足的。” 从那以后，你们的拥抱大多都只是静静地相拥而已。偶尔会因为你的摇晃动作让拥抱有点偏向其中一侧而引发一阵笑声，但其实根本不存在真正会摔倒的危险。 至少在你重新回到王位旁边、让卢米娅坐上王位之前，你们的手依然是紧紧相连的，手指紧紧交织在一起。然后，这种联系才会慢慢被拉开，直到这个拥抱在一阵突如其来的情感冲击中结束。 请随时再次提问，我总是乐于这样的时刻，它们能让我的一天变得愉快。” “我一定会记住的。” “知道这一点真是太好了。 [pc.isValk |我那平凡的英雄 |冰原之地的冠军 ] 让我着迷 [pc.hisHer] 嗯，今天还有什么事想让我帮忙处理的吗？” “那么，还有吗？

rows.original:
"I'm sure. It being back in its rightful place would take a great deal of stress off my shoulders," you confirm with a nod.
        
        "Very well," Lumia replies, placing a hand on both ends of the hilt before seemingly scrunching it into nothingness.
        
        You watch as she swiftly rubs her hands together, and then reaches into the cloth folds of her dress. She pulls a ring from their depths, depositing it in their hands.
        
        "However, you cannot expect me to take without giving. Have this ring, instead. It's another of my artifacts, but one isn't picky about its ownership. I'm sure it will help you on your journeys."
        
        You take the ring she offers, staring at its intricate design before stowing it in your pocket.
        
        "Thank you, Lumia."
        
        "You are very welcome, and don't ever think that this makes you less worthy of my favor," she says, taking you in a big hug before letting you go. "Now, was there anything else you wanted to talk about?"

rows.original: As you walk into the throne room, you take immediate notice of Lumia. The goddess is seated cross-legged on her throne, but it's not her posture that catches your attention. No, it's the gravid roundness of her belly that draws your eyes. The goddess is very pregnant, larger than anyone could have any hope to hide. You try desperately not to gawk as you get closer. For her part, she just smiles and uncrosses her legs when she sees you approach. "[pc.name]! I'm glad to see you! To what do I owe the pleasure of your visit?" she asks, beaming even more brightly than usual. "I... Um, sorry, I'm just a little shocked. I never expected to see you like this," you admit, rubbing the back of your head sheepishly. [flags.ARCHWAY_BOTH_SAVED|Considering what you know, this must be impossible, but maybe this isn't the best time to broach that topic.|A lot of questions rush into your head, but for now maybe the basics are best.] "Like...? Oh! Like this?" she grins even wider as she swirls her hands over her pregnant belly. "I am no exception when it comes to the valkyries helping families in need. This little one, specifically, will be delivered to the Belharan Heartlands." "[lumia.fucked |Is... it mine?" you ask, still a little dumbstruck. "I didn't really think about the logistics of fucking a goddess." "Oh! Don't worry, dear. I would never do that without your permission. If you wanted to help with such things, however, your assistance would be very welcome." "I'll think about it," you say. "But if it's not me, then whose kid is this?" |If it's ok to ask, then whose kid is this?" ] "This seed was donated by one of my valkyries. This child belongs to a family who desperately needs him or her. It's as simple as that." The goddess's words have a sense of finality to them that belays further questioning. Perhaps you can ask more in depth questions later, but for now you've at least gotten over the shock.
