rows.original: You decide to pick one of the letters that's in the pile, settling on one that looks interesting. The envelope is thick and green, and addressed to a 'Yolihuali' who works in the kitchens. There's probably a lot of kitchen workers on staff, but it can't be difficult to find one with a name that unique. Taking the grass-colored letter in hand, you wander off toward the mess hall. Once you arrive, you make your way to the kitchens. An on duty cook greets you at the door to the back rooms, pausing to wait when she sees the letter in your hand. "Hi. I'm looking for Yolihuali. Do you know if she's here today?" you ask. "Oh! I should've known, she gets more letters than any of us. You can find her in the back stirring today's soup. It's yo-li-wa-li, though, just so you know," the cook says with a wink. She steps aside to let you through, and you pass through the entryway. The kitchens are separated into several rooms that are themselves divided into sections based on what kind of food is being prepared. You travel past the first room to the door she pointed to, and find the second room dominated by a large pot, and an inhabitant who draws your immediate attention. She's a harpy, but rather than the March harpies you've seen around, her skin is a rich caramel, and her feathers run the gamut of greens, reds, and blues. A shock of sparkly golden feathers intersperse with those, like bits of natural jewelry that accentuate her colors. As far as body types go, on the other hand, she's pretty similar to the locals of her kind. Her hips look qualified to birth eggs bigger than your head, and her breasts are big enough to match. The bright bird goes about her business with dutiful glee and a whistle on her lips, wearing nothing but an apron. While it covers her front with a surprising degree of modesty, you get a full view of her deep pink pussy when she leans over the pot. "Ahem, I have a delivery for Yolihuali, is that you?" you ask, [pc.dcb |taking in the view |unable to avert your eyes |your eyes glued to her bootylicious backside ]. The colorful cook spins in place and zeroes in on you with a wide smile. Her features are broad and beautiful as the rest of her, and her brown eyes glint with the same gold as her feathers. "Yes! That's me! Is it mail time!? Oh I love this! They can only send them once a month. Please, let me see," she says, grasping for the note. You hand it over, infected by her smile and grinning at the eagerness of it. She rips the top open with a claw, and begins to pull out several scraps of paper, some larger than others, that are covered in what look to you like nonsensical claw marks. It becomes very apparent why the envelope was so thick as she drops paper after paper onto a nearby countertop. Some of them have legible words, but the majority are like those first couple she plucked out. Seeing you staring, the harpy cook chuckles. "Most of them can't read or write, but all my sisters still want to participate when they see sister Firaley writing back home. I would send them food but even with the stuff that doesn't go bad there's no way I could fit enough for all of them," she says, her attention back to flipping through the shreds of notary. "Oh! Look! This one's from Amoztli! She may not get the words very well but she's trying harder than most of them, and she's really good at pictures." She flips one of the scraps around, showing you a crude but definitely discernible picture of several harpies near some thatched houses. Beneath the picture is inscribed "Yoli home happy" and several hearts. She's right about the words, but the sentiment is strong enough to make it worth it. You hand the paper back to her, and see her still drawing notes out of the stuffed envelope. How many siblings does she have!? "I have forty-six sisters back home! Four of them were in the same clutch as me, and most of the others have different fathers. Some of them have different mothers though! I was the only one who traveled up to live here, but a few of the others also follow the faith. Lady Lumia fit right in with our worship of the sun, so nothing much changed. Except the cold... I go down to visit once a year and each time it never gets easier to see the snow on my way back," she explains, shivering and rubbing her shoulders. "Anywho, I don't think I've seen you delivering mail before. Usually Eira hogs all the letter deliveries," she says, tapping her chin. "Yeah. Lumia wants her to relax some, so I'm trying to reduce her workload till the goddess finds someone else to assign to the delivery team. I'm [pc.name], by the way. I'm [pc.isDK |the one who helped get rid of the shadow monster. |new here. ] Delivering notes like this also helps me see the castle and meet new people," you reply. "Oh! You're [pc.himHer]! I was visiting home when you first showed up, and I didn't get to see your introduction. It's nice to meet you now. I wish you luck getting Eira out of her shell. She never stays and talks like this when delivering notes, and it's a nice change of pace," she says, giving you half a hug and a peck on the cheek. "Thanks for staying, and feel free to stay and chat next time as well if you wind up delivering again. I'm always back here in the kitchens." You leave the bright-feathered harpy to finish looking through her letters, feeling invigorated. On the way back to the main halls you can't help but wonder if Eira still gets that kind of happy feeling from delivering letters like that.
rows.translation: 你决定从那堆信件中挑选一封，最终选了一封看起来挺有意思的信。信封是厚厚的绿色，收件人是名叫“Yolihuali”的人，她在厨房工作。公司里可能有很多厨房工作人员，但找到一个名字这么独特的应该不会太难。拿着那封草绿色的信，你朝着食堂的方向走去。 你一到那里，就直接走向厨房。一位正在值班的厨师在通往后厨的门那里迎接了你，当她看到你手中的信时，停下了脚步。 “您好，我在找Yolihuali，您知道她今天在这里吗？”你问道。 哦！我早该猜到的，她收到的信比我们任何人都多。今天你可以在后面看到她正在搅拌汤料。对了，那种汤叫‘哟里哇里’，你可得记住这个名字哦，”厨师眨着眼睛说道。 她退到一边让你通过，你便走过了入口处。 厨房被划分成了几个独立的房间，而这些房间又根据正在准备的食物种类被进一步细分。你穿过第一个房间，来到她所指的那扇门，然后进入了第二个房间——那里有一个巨大的锅，还有一个立刻吸引了你注意力的“居民”。 她是一只女妖，但与你们平时见到的那些女妖不同，她的皮肤呈现出浓郁的焦糖色，羽毛则涵盖了绿色、红色和蓝色等多种颜色。其中还散布着一些闪闪发光的金色羽毛，这些金色羽毛就像天然的珠宝一样，为她的羽毛增添了更多的光彩。 就体型而言，她与同类的当地女性颇为相似。她的臀部看起来完全有能力孕育出比你的头还要大的胎儿，而她的胸部也足够丰满，与之相称。这只活泼的鸟儿总是兴高采烈地忙碌着，嘴唇上还挂着微笑，身上只围着一条围裙。 虽然她以一种出人意料的羞涩态度遮住了自己的上半身，但当她弯下身子去查看锅里的情况时，人们就能清楚地看到她那深粉色的阴部了。 咳，我有个包裹要送给Yolihuali，是您吗？”你问道。 [pc.dcb |考虑到这一点 |无法移开视线 |你的目光紧紧盯着她那迷人的臀部 ]那位身着色彩斑斓服装的厨师在原地转圈，脸上带着灿烂的笑容，将目光投向了你。她的五官同样宽厚而美丽，棕色的眼睛中闪烁着与她羽毛上相同的金色光芒。 “没错！就是我！ 是该收邮件的时间了吗！？哦，我太喜欢这个了！他们每个月只寄一次邮件。快让我看看吧，”她说着，迫不及待地伸出手来。你把邮件递给了她，也被她那兴奋的笑容所感染，不由得也露出了笑容。 她用手指把信封的封口撕开，然后开始抽出几张纸片，有些纸片比较大，上面布满了那些看起来像是一些莫名其妙的爪印的东西。 现在就再清楚不过了，为什么那个信封会那么厚——因为她把一张又一张纸扔到了附近的台面上。其中有些纸上写有清晰的文字，但大多数都和她最初拿出来的那几张一样。看到你在盯着看，那个长相像女妖的厨师忍不住笑了起来。 他们中的大多数既不识字也不会写字，但是…… 所有 我的姐妹们看到菲拉莱姐姐在老家写信，仍然都想参加。我想给她们寄些食物，但就算是那些不会变质的东西，我也实在没办法为所有人准备足够的量，”她一边说，一边继续翻阅那些公证文件的残页。“哦！看！这一封是阿莫兹特利写的！她的文字表达能力可能不太好，但她比大多数人都更加努力，而且她在画画方面真的很在行。 她把其中一张纸翻过来，给你看了一张虽然粗糙，但确实能辨认出来的画——画上几只鹰身女妖出现在一些茅草屋附近。画下面写着“Yoli的家，快乐的地方”，还有几颗心形图案。那些字确实是她写的，但这份心意已经足够珍贵了。你把纸还给她，看到她仍在从那个装满纸条的信封里取出来一些东西。她到底有多少兄弟姐妹啊！？ 我在家乡有四十六个姐妹！其中四个和我同父异母，其余的则大多有不同的父亲。不过，也有些姐妹的母亲不同！只有我一个人来到了这里生活，不过也有其他一些姐妹同样信奉这种信仰。露米娅女士也非常适合我们的太阳崇拜仪式，所以我们的生活并没有发生什么变化。除了天气太冷……我每年都会回家一次，但每次回来时，路上看到的积雪总是让我感到更加难受，”她边说边颤抖着，揉着肩膀。 不管怎样，我好像从来没见过你负责送信吧。通常都是艾拉负责所有的信件投递工作，”她一边说，一边轻敲着自己的下巴。 “是啊。卢米娅希望她能放松一下，所以我在尽力减少她的工作量，直到那位女神找到其他人来接替她负责投递工作为止。”我说。 [pc.name]顺便说一下，我是…… [pc.isDK |那个帮助我们消灭了阴影怪物的人。 |我是新来的。 ] 这样传递信息也能让我看到那座城堡，还能结识新朋友，”你回答道。 “哦！原来如此…… [pc.himHer]你第一次来的时候我正好在家，所以没能见到你。现在能认识你真是太好了。希望你能帮Eira克服她的害羞性格，让她变得更开朗一些。她平时送通知的时候从来不会像这样主动聊天，这次真是给了我们一个不一样的体验呢。”她说着，给了你半个拥抱，然后在你的脸颊上轻吻了一下。“谢谢你的陪伴，如果下次你再有需要送通知的任务，随时都可以再来聊聊天哦。 总是 就在这里的厨房里。” 你让那只羽毛鲜艳的哈比继续她的信件整理工作，自己则感到精神为之一振。在返回主厅的路上，你不禁想知道，艾拉在完成这样的信件递送工作后，是否也会感受到那种愉悦的心情。
rows.raw: " You decide to pick one of the letters that's in the pile, settling on one that looks interesting. The envelope is thick and green, and addressed to a 'Yolihuali' who works in the kitchens. There's probably a lot of kitchen workers on staff, but it can't be difficult to find one with a name that unique. Taking the grass-colored letter in hand, you wander off toward the mess hall. Once you arrive, you make your way to the kitchens. An on duty cook greets you at the door to the back rooms, pausing to wait when she sees the letter in your hand. "Hi. I'm looking for Yolihuali. Do you know if she's here today?" you ask. "Oh! I should've known, she gets more letters than any of us. You can find her in the back stirring today's soup. It's yo-li-wa-li, though, just so you know," the cook says with a wink. She steps aside to let you through, and you pass through the entryway. The kitchens are separated into several rooms that are themselves divided into sections based on what kind of food is being prepared. You travel past the first room to the door she pointed to, and find the second room dominated by a large pot, and an inhabitant who draws your immediate attention. She's a harpy, but rather than the March harpies you've seen around, her skin is a rich caramel, and her feathers run the gamut of greens, reds, and blues. A shock of sparkly golden feathers intersperse with those, like bits of natural jewelry that accentuate her colors. As far as body types go, on the other hand, she's pretty similar to the locals of her kind. Her hips look qualified to birth eggs bigger than your head, and her breasts are big enough to match. The bright bird goes about her business with dutiful glee and a whistle on her lips, wearing nothing but an apron. While it covers her front with a surprising degree of modesty, you get a full view of her deep pink pussy when she leans over the pot. "Ahem, I have a delivery for Yolihuali, is that you?" you ask, [pc.dcb |taking in the view |unable to avert your eyes |your eyes glued to her bootylicious backside ]. The colorful cook spins in place and zeroes in on you with a wide smile. Her features are broad and beautiful as the rest of her, and her brown eyes glint with the same gold as her feathers. "Yes! That's me! Is it mail time!? Oh I love this! They can only send them once a month. Please, let me see," she says, grasping for the note. You hand it over, infected by her smile and grinning at the eagerness of it. She rips the top open with a claw, and begins to pull out several scraps of paper, some larger than others, that are covered in what look to you like nonsensical claw marks. It becomes very apparent why the envelope was so thick as she drops paper after paper onto a nearby countertop. Some of them have legible words, but the majority are like those first couple she plucked out. Seeing you staring, the harpy cook chuckles. "Most of them can't read or write, but all my sisters still want to participate when they see sister Firaley writing back home. I would send them food but even with the stuff that doesn't go bad there's no way I could fit enough for all of them," she says, her attention back to flipping through the shreds of notary. "Oh! Look! This one's from Amoztli! She may not get the words very well but she's trying harder than most of them, and she's really good at pictures." She flips one of the scraps around, showing you a crude but definitely discernible picture of several harpies near some thatched houses. Beneath the picture is inscribed "Yoli home happy" and several hearts. She's right about the words, but the sentiment is strong enough to make it worth it. You hand the paper back to her, and see her still drawing notes out of the stuffed envelope. How many siblings does she have!? "I have forty-six sisters back home! Four of them were in the same clutch as me, and most of the others have different fathers. Some of them have different mothers though! I was the only one who traveled up to live here, but a few of the others also follow the faith. Lady Lumia fit right in with our worship of the sun, so nothing much changed. Except the cold... I go down to visit once a year and each time it never gets easier to see the snow on my way back," she explains, shivering and rubbing her shoulders. "Anywho, I don't think I've seen you delivering mail before. Usually Eira hogs all the letter deliveries," she says, tapping her chin. "Yeah. Lumia wants her to relax some, so I'm trying to reduce her workload till the goddess finds someone else to assign to the delivery team. I'm [pc.name], by the way. I'm [pc.isDK |the one who helped get rid of the shadow monster. |new here. ] Delivering notes like this also helps me see the castle and meet new people," you reply. "Oh! You're [pc.himHer]! I was visiting home when you first showed up, and I didn't get to see your introduction. It's nice to meet you now. I wish you luck getting Eira out of her shell. She never stays and talks like this when delivering notes, and it's a nice change of pace," she says, giving you half a hug and a peck on the cheek. "Thanks for staying, and feel free to stay and chat next time as well if you wind up delivering again. I'm always back here in the kitchens." You leave the bright-feathered harpy to finish looking through her letters, feeling invigorated. On the way back to the main halls you can't help but wonder if Eira still gets that kind of happy feeling from delivering letters like that. "

rows.original:
Deciding on a letter this time, you search for one that looks interesting. You settle on a plain looking envelope that has a rich and intricate wax seal over the opening. It looks like [pc.bg scholar
            |a high house of Yvennes, though one you aren't deeply familiar with.
            |a[silly
                |mogus
                | horned deer
            ]
        ], though the features are a little simple given the erosion of the wax. The letter is addressed to a "Hjörr." You [flags.HJORR_MET
            |know who that is! The minotaur combat instructor.
            |vaguely recall hearing that name. That was the minotaur who was at Annika's promotion ceremony.
        ] You don't know exactly where she is, but the training halls are probably a good place to start.
        
        The trip through the halls is uneventful, and fortunately you don't need to ask anyone where Hjörr is when you get there. The trainees are in the middle of a break period, and the shaggy minotaur is seated on a cushioned bench by a door to the main instruction halls. You approach, and the powerful woman gives you a curious look that turns into a smile when she sees the letter in your hands.
        
        "[flags.HJORR_MET
            |[pc.name]! Well met.
            |[pc.name], wasn't it?
        ] Are you delivering the mail now?" she asks, taking the letter from your outstretched hand.
        
        "Yeah, Lumia and I are trying to get Eira to relax, and we figured taking care of some of her mail duties would be a good first step," you say, taking the spot next to her on the seat. "I'm mostly just picking things that look interesting though, so I don't know how effective it'll be in the end."
        
        "A good plan, I think. That girl never has time to talk anymore, or train, or do anything really. I don't even know what she does when there isn't any mail to deliver except wait for more to arrive. Ah! This is from a former squadmate of mine!" she says, interrupting herself when she finally appraises her letter. She pops the wax seal open, and gingerly extracts a neat and clean letter. The paper looks no bigger than a tissue in her hand, but she flips it open and holds it with three fingers.
        
        "She took a long term assignment with a minor lord in Yvennes, to keep him and his wife safe after they received a death threat from her former lover. That was a few years ago, but it seems nothing has come of it since, and the couple have a young son and daughter now. Twins! Blessed be the goddess indeed," she laughs, leaning back.
        
        "Don't you miss her, after being separated that long?" 
        
        "Eugh, you sound like she's gone and died. I miss training with her, but I'll survive. So will she, she's better than any assassin they could throw at that man or his children. I have my own assignment to handle, keeping the recruits in line and knowledgeable about the ever shifting nature of threats. Besides, with the lack of trouble she may soon be able to return."
        
        "At least you should be able to start getting more of those new recruits, between the banishing of that shadow and the resolution of the mess in the Winter City."
        
        "Yes, and we have you to thank for both of those things. It's nice to be back here without the nightmares, and with fresh new faces looking at a brand new life," she says. She finishes reading the letter before speaking again. "You know, Eira could learn a few things from you. I'm glad you're trying to get past that closeted nature of hers, and I wish you the best of luck."
        
        You thank her as you stand, ready to head back to other issues at hand. Perhaps you'll deliver more mail, or maybe you have something else to do.
        
        "See you later, [pc.name]. My classes are just about back in session, anyway," Hjörr finishes, waving goodbye as she heads back into the academy hall and leaves you alone.
rows.translation:
这次你决定选用一封信的形式来表达自己的意思，于是开始寻找一个看起来既美观又吸引人的设计。最终，你选中的一封外观简约的信封，其封口处还盖有一个精致复杂的蜡封。看起来真是…… [pc.bg scholar
            |伊文尼斯的一座高大的宅邸，尽管你对它并不十分熟悉。
            |a[silly
                |莫古斯
                | 有角鹿
            ]
        ]虽然由于蜡层已经磨损，这些特征看起来有些简单，但这封信是寄给一个名叫“Hjörr”的人的。 [flags.HJORR_MET
            |你知道那是谁吗？那就是米诺陶洛斯战斗训练教官。
            |隐约记得听说过那个名字。就是那个在安妮卡晋升仪式上出现的米诺陶洛斯。
        ] 你并不清楚她具体在哪里，但训练厅应该是个不错的起点。

穿过那些训练厅的过程没有发生任何意外，幸运的是，当你到达那里时，你根本不需要向任何人询问赫约尔在哪里。 这些受训者们正在休息期间，那个毛发蓬乱的牛头人正坐在主教学厅门口的一张软垫长椅上。你走过去，那位强壮的女性用好奇的目光看着你，但当她看到你手中的信时，她的表情立刻变成了微笑。
        
        "[flags.HJORR_MET
            |[pc.name]很高兴见到你。
            |[pc.name]不是吗？
        ] 你现在是在去送邮件吗？”她问道，从你伸出的手中接过那封信。

“是的，Lumia和我在想办法让Eira放松一下，我们觉得帮她处理一些邮件工作会是个不错的开始，”你边说边在她旁边的座位上坐下。“不过我主要只是挑选那些看起来有意思的信件而已，所以还不确定这样做到底会有多大的效果。
        
        这个计划不错，我觉得。那个女孩现在根本没时间聊天，也没时间训练，更没时间做其他事情了。除了等待新的邮件到来，我甚至不知道她还在做些什么。啊！这是我的一位前队友寄来的！”她边说边终于拆开了那封信。她小心地撕开蜡封，取出了那封整洁干净的信。信纸的大小差不多和一张纸巾差不多，但她还是用三根手指把它摊开。
        
        几年前，她接受了一份长期任务，前往伊文尼斯地区为一位小领主服务，目的是在他的妻子收到前男友的死亡威胁后，保护他们一家的安全。不过看起来那件事后来并没有什么结果，如今这对夫妇已经有了一个双胞胎儿子和女儿。真是太幸运了……女神真是仁慈啊，”她笑着说，同时向后靠在椅子上。
        
        分开那么久，你不会想念她吧？”

“呃，你这么说的话，感觉她好像已经死了似的。我确实怀念和她一起训练的日子，但我会挺过去的。她也会的——她比他们派去对付那个男人和他孩子的任何刺客都要强。我也有自己的任务要完成，就是确保新兵们遵守纪律，并让他们了解那些不断变化的威胁。另外，如果没有什么麻烦发生，她可能很快就能回来吧。
        
        至少在驱散了那个阴影，以及解决了冬城里的混乱之后，你应该能够开始招募更多的新成员了。”

“没错，这两件事都要归功于你。 能够再次回到这里，不再受到那些噩梦的困扰，看到一群充满活力的人正在开始全新的生活，真是太好了，”她说。她读完信后，又继续说道：“你知道吗，艾拉其实可以从你身上学到很多东西。我很高兴你正在努力帮助她摆脱那种隐秘、封闭的性格，真心祝愿你一切顺利。"
        
        你向她道了谢，然后准备去处理其他手头的事情。也许你还需要去投递更多的邮件，或者还有其他事情要去做。

“回头见。 [pc.name]反正我的课程也快要重新开始了，”赫约尔说完，挥手道别后便回到了学院大厅，把你留在了那里。

rows.original: As you sift through the small stack of mail looking for interesting letters or packages, your hand brushes something that clinks against the table. Immediately, a brief pulse of reasonless sorrow comes over you. What was that? You carefully shift some packages aside, being careful about what you touch, and soon uncover a palm sized gemstone. It's a memory crystal, like the one from when you first spoke with Eira, but when you hold this one that same sadness returns. "Take me to Lady Lumia." The words just appear in your head, without any real voice to them, and are gone in the next second. Whatever this message is, you hesitate for a moment. Despite the sadness emanating from it, though, you get the impression that it isn't dangerous. This is probably something Lumia should see, though you don't know if that means she'll want to do so. You turn back toward her throne room, walking with purpose and holding the dull purple gem in your clenched fist. Every so often the non-speech repeats that sentence in your thoughts, begging to be taken to the goddess and hurrying your pace. When you arrive, she turns to see you with a smile. "Back already? Did something happen? Oh," she starts, the smile drooping when her gaze drops to the crystal in your palm. "Oh." "I don't know who this is from, but it wants you," you say, holding out your hand. The goddess takes it, and then takes a deep breath. Without another word, she shatters the gem with one hand. The pieces drop to the floor and dissolve into nothing, but the glowing light inside spreads until it covers the both of you. "Stay here for this, please," Lumia asks, holding out a hand. You take it as the growing light settles around you, and suddenly more words appear in your ears. They're accompanied by an actual voice this time, one that sounds like a young woman trying very hard to maintain her composure. There is a very present tinge of fear in her voice, but the purpose and conviction in her words overpower it by far. "Don't fret. I took them with me. I won't make it back, but neither will they. Let this be proof that my charge is safe. Thank you for giving me this opportunity, and accept my apologies and my love as I leave your service. Goodbye, Lady Lumia," the voice says. After that it cuts out, and the light dims till it's gone completely. Lumia looks grave. She's not crying, but you wouldn't be surprised if she started. You're [pc.dcb |looking for something to be mad at more than anything else. |feeling about the same, with tears threatening to emerge in the corners of your eyes. |already bawling, unable to contain your emotions at the touching display. ] Unwilling to let her suffer alone, you give the goddess a much-needed hug. You're worried it will be awkward, but she hugs you back right away, and the feeling of sadness pervading the room lessens a little. "The ones that thank me are the hardest to listen to, but I have to do it. I feel them go, every time, but sometimes I don't get their last words for months or years. This one was weeks, and I'm glad to be able to put a voice to it," she says. Her somber tone is full of love, but not regret. "I'm happy you were here to hear it this time. It's not easy to be alone with it every time. They deserve to be heard by more people than just me, but some of them don't have families to share the words with," she continues. "I'm happy to be here. Even a goddess shouldn't have to deal with loss alone" you reply. "Ha! If that was all it took to take me out I would've been vanquished from the start," she muses. rows.translation: 当你仔细翻阅那堆邮件，寻找那些有趣的信件或包裹时，你的手碰到了某个东西，那个东西在桌上发出叮当声。顿时，一种莫名的悲伤涌上心头。那是什么？你小心翼翼地将一些包裹放到一边，继续仔细地寻找，不久之后，你发现了一块巴掌大小的宝石。那是一块记忆水晶，和你第一次与艾拉交谈时使用的那块一样。但当你握住这块水晶时，那种同样的悲伤又一次袭来了。 带我去见卢米娅女士。” 这些话语只是突然出现在你的脑海中，没有任何实际的声音，转眼间就消失了。无论这条信息意味着什么，你都犹豫了片刻。不过，尽管其中透着一丝悲伤，你却觉得它并不危险。这可能是卢米娅应该看到的东西，不过你不确定她是否愿意去见她。 你转身朝她的王座室走去，步伐坚定，紧握着那颗暗紫色的宝石。不时地，那个无声的提示会在你的脑海中重复那句话，催促着你尽快将宝石交给女神。当你到达那里时，她微笑着转过身来迎接你。 已经回来了？发生什么事了吗？哦……”她开口说道，当她的目光落在你手掌中的那颗水晶上时，笑容瞬间消失了。“哦……” “我不知道这颗水晶是谁送来的，但它是在找你。”你伸出手说道。 女神接过了水晶，然后深深地吸了一口气。她没有说一句话，就用一只手将水晶击碎了。水晶碎片掉落在地上，瞬间消失得无影无踪，但水晶内部散发出的光芒却扩散开来，将你们两人都笼罩在了其中。 请在这里稍等片刻，”卢米娅伸出手说道。 当你接过她的手时，周围的光线逐渐变亮，突然间，更多的话语出现在你的耳边。这一次，这些话语伴随着一个真实的声音——那是一个年轻女子努力保持镇定的声音。她的声音中明显带着恐惧，但话语中表达出的目的与决心，远远超过了那种恐惧。 别担心，我把它们带在身上了。我可能回不来了，但它们也不会留下。就让这证明我的任务已经完成，我的使命已经完成。感谢你们给我这个机会，也请接受我的歉意和我的感激之情，因为我要离开你们的服务了。再见了，卢米娅女士。”电话那头说道。说完之后，电话就断了，灯光也逐渐暗淡，最终彻底消失了。卢米娅的表情十分严肃。她没有哭泣，但如果你看到她现在这个样子，也不会感到惊讶的。 你真是…… [pc.dcb |迫切地想要找些事情来发泄怒火。 |你也有同样的感受，泪水几乎要从眼角涌出来。 |看到这一幕如此感人，你已经忍不住放声大哭，再也无法控制自己的情绪了。 ] 你不忍心让她独自承受痛苦，于是给了这位女神一个她迫切需要的拥抱。你担心这样做会显得有些尴尬，但她立刻也回抱了你，于是弥漫在房间里的悲伤情绪也稍微减轻了一些。 “那些感谢我的人，往往是最难让人理解的，但我还是必须这么做。 每次我都能感觉到他们离开了，但有时候，我要好几个月甚至几年才能听到他们最后留下的话语。这一次，间隔了几个星期，能够将这些话语用声音表达出来，让我感到非常欣慰，”她说。她那忧郁的语气中充满了爱意，却没有丝毫遗憾。 我很高兴这次有你在场聆听这些话。每次独自面对这些事情确实并不容易。他们理应得到更多人的倾听，而不仅仅是我一个人；不过，其中有些人并没有家人可以倾诉这些心事。”她继续说道。 我很高兴能来到这里。就连女神也不应该独自面对失去吧。”你回答道。 “哈！如果仅仅是因为这个就能把我打败的话，那我早就被击倒了。”她沉思道，“如果你愿意的话，现在可以离开了。 我需要一些时间，在极光之光中找到她的碎片。” 卢米娅将你留在王座厅，你甩掉心中最后一丝忧伤，然后走回主厅。或许有些事情可以让你重新振作起来。 也许等她感觉状态好一些的时候，你可以去问她。 卢米娅的 也能激发人们的热情。

rows.original: "I don't really know if there's a better way to ask this, but how does one become a valkyrie?" you ask, as plainly as you can. "Why, dear," Lumia begins with a wide grin. "You've already found the answer, you ask!" "Really? Is it that simple? I figured there'd be, I dunno, challenges or quests or something." "Lights grace, no! You have already faced as many challenges as most of my girls have seen. Look at what you've done for the Winter City alone! You routed a despotic queen, and [ryn.crowned |put a wonderful one in her place. |are working to put a wonderful one in her place. ]" "I guess. That just felt like something that should be done. I couldn't just [pc.dcb |let that awful bitch ruin [ryn.fucked |my girl's life |the Marches ] |let [ryn.married |my future wife |Etheryn ] suffer like that. |let such an adorable elf get abused by that bitchy tyrant! ]" "Exactly! The fact that you don't consider it out of the ordinary is all the more reason that it matters. I don't want you to ever feel like you aren't a force of change in this world. I would be more than happy to help it be a change for the better." You think on that for a moment. It would certainly be something, being a part of such a grand confluence of power. To always have a thousand or more sisters to rely on if you get into trouble, and the means to be the best hero you can be. Only... "Would I need to give up my soul to make that kind of difference?" Lumia regards you with a smile that is suddenly much more tired than it seemed a moment ago. "Oh, hero. You don't need to change anything about yourself to make a difference. To become a valkyrie you would need to entrust your soul to me. [flags.LUMIA_TALK_CONV |A frightening proposition, I'm sure, but one I don't dare lie about! |I would hope you don't associate it with 'giving up'. ] I safeguard every soul I take in the Aurora Strand, and draw on their power just as they receive mine. I would not be anything close to the deity I am today without their influence." "Be that as it may, it's still... divesting ownership of my soul. Won't that have side effects?" "Ha! Perhaps a few. All of my chosen are women. I only accept those who know and become comfortable with that fact before joining me. The spark of feminine beauty will take hold and mold you in its image, but I've been told the feeling is overwhelmingly positive. If you're worried about negative side effects... hmm. At first you would normally need my assistance to have children, but I think I can make that work for you in the short term at least. "Each valkyrie receives an investiture of my sunflame that connects them to the Aurora Strand. Just enough to leave their physical and spiritual being mostly, if not completely, intact. I would hate to wipe away what made them worthy in the first place. The rest is essentially a 'ball' of soul-like essence that does the job for day-to-day living, but doesn't hold up for the important parts like creating life. If Nareva and I had our way, they would function exactly as souls do, but we haven't quite worked it out yet." "That sounds... surprisingly open," you reply. "Does anyone ever regret the decision?" "Maybe sometimes: in their nightmares, or in moments of great loss, but never forever. I would never expect them to face the terrors of the void without doubts, but I also know the girls upon whom I bestow my blessing. Not one of them would suffer in silence, letting those doubts eat away at them. Even those who fancy themselves loners fold to the welcoming relief of others who can truly understand their pain." "It sounds like having family who care about you." "It does, doesn't it? Mortals don't even need coercing to form those kinds of bonds. It just comes naturally." "Speaking of bonds and the valkyries as a whole, what would be required of me if I become a valkyrie?" you ask. It's definitely something to be concerned about, given the current state of things. "I don't know if I can commit to dropping everything to be called back here at a moment's notice." "Right now, at the very least, nothing would change for you at all. You would be assigned to protect the Frost Marches, and I would hope that nothing becomes drastically different. You would continue wherever your current goals take you. After that, assuming you're successful, you would... probably still be assigned to protect the Frost Marches," the goddess says with a laugh. "I'm not going to pry you away from the people you hold dear, and if you had any lingering debts you would be free to take care of them no matter where they took you. As long as you kept in touch with me, of course." "You make it seem like such a casual choice." "It's not a choice you're required to make now, dear, or ever if you don't feel like it. It's not even a choice you're required to make if you wish to serve me — anyone can do that. It would make you closer to me, but it would not make you more important to me. In that, you are already perfect. If you do wish to join my valkyries, come ask me anytime. I'll always be here to listen," she concludes. "Thank you, Lumia."
rows.translation: 我其实不太确定还有没有更好的方式来问这个问题，但究竟要怎样才能成为一名女武神呢？”你尽可能直截了当地问道。 “哎呀，亲爱的，”卢米娅咧开嘴笑道，“答案你其实已经找到了，只是自己没有意识到而已！” “真的吗？就这么简单吗？我原本以为会有一些挑战或者任务之类的东西呢。” “天哪，才不是呢！你经历的挑战已经比我的大多数女武神都要多了。看看你为冬之城做了多少事情吧！你击败了一位专横的女王，还…… [ryn.crowned |让她知道谁才是真正的强者。 |人们正在努力为她找到一个合适的人选来接替她。 ]我想是的。我觉得那确实是应该去做的事情。我不可能只是坐视不理。 [pc.dcb |就让她那个讨厌的家伙把一切都毁掉吧。 [ryn.fucked |我女朋友的日常生活 |边境地区 ] |让 [ryn.married |我未来的妻子 |埃瑟琳 ] 遭受那样的痛苦。 |让这样一个可爱的小精灵被那个恶毒的暴君欺负吧！ ]正是这样！你没有认为这件事有什么不寻常的地方，这一点反而更加说明了它的重要性。我绝不希望你觉得自己在这个世界上无法成为推动变革的力量。我非常乐意帮助你让这种变革朝着更好的方向发展。你仔细想一想吧。能够成为这样一场权力汇聚中的重要一员，无疑是一件非常了不起的事情。当你遇到麻烦时，总有上千位姐妹可以依靠；同时，你也拥有成为最优秀的英雄的一切条件。 难道我真的需要牺牲自己的灵魂才能带来那样的改变吗？” Lumia用一种笑容看着你，但那笑容中却蕴含着比刚才看起来更多的疲惫。 “哦，英雄……你并不需要那样做。 需要 为了做出改变，你必须先改变自己。要想成为一位女武神，你就必须将你的灵魂托付给我。 [flags.LUMIA_TALK_CONV |这确实是一个令人恐惧的提议，但我不敢对此撒谎！ |我希望你不要将这理解为“放弃”。 ] 在极光之滨，我会守护每一个接纳我的灵魂，并且他们会像我接受他们的力量一样，为我提供力量。如果没有他们的影响，我根本不可能成为今天的这个神明。” “无论如何，事实就是如此。……放弃自己灵魂的所有权。这样不会产生一些副作用吗？” “哈！也许会有一些吧。我选择的对象都是女性。只有那些了解这一事实并且能接受这一点的人，才会加入我。女性特有的美丽会感染你，塑造你，但据人们说，这种感觉绝对是积极的。 如果你担心…… 负面的 副作用……嗯，通常情况下，你需要我的帮助才能生育孩子，但我想至少在短期内，我可以帮你解决这个问题。 “每一位女武神都会获得我赐予的阳光之力，这种力量会将她们与极光之岸联系在一起。 这些力量足以让他们的物质存在与精神本质在很大程度上，甚至可以说是完全保持原状。我实在不愿意抹去那些最初让他们变得有价值的东西。剩下的部分，本质上只是一团类似灵魂的本质能量，它能够满足日常生活的需要，但在创造生命这样的关键环节中却无能为力。 如果纳雷瓦和我能如愿以偿的话，这些系统就会像灵魂那样运作了，不过我们目前还没有完全解决这个问题。 听起来……他们似乎相当坦诚啊，”你说道，“有没有人会后悔这个决定呢？” “也许有时候会：在噩梦中，或者在遭遇巨大失去的时候，但从来不会永远如此。我从未想过他们会毫无疑虑地面对那种虚无的恐惧，但我也很了解那些我赐予祝福的女孩们。她们中没有一个人会默默忍受，让那些疑虑慢慢侵蚀自己。即使那些自认为是独来独往的人，也会在遇到真正能理解她们痛苦的人时，感受到那种温暖的慰藉。 这听起来就像是拥有真正关心你的家人一样。” “确实如此，不是吗？对于人类来说，建立这样的感情纽带甚至不需要强迫，这一切都是自然而然发生的。” “说到感情纽带以及整个英灵族，如果我成为了英灵，需要承担什么责任呢？”你问道。考虑到目前的形势，这确实是一个值得考虑的问题。“我不知道自己是否能够放下一切，随时准备被召唤回来。 好的。 现在至少，对你来说什么都不会改变。你仍然会被派去守护霜冻边境，我希望一切都不会有太大的不同。你会继续沿着你目前的目标前进。 之后，假设你成功了，你……很可能仍然会被派去保护霜冻边境吧，”女神笑着说，“我不会把你从你珍视的人身边夺走。而且，如果你还有未偿还的债务，无论你被派到哪里，你都可以自由地去解决它们。 只要你保持与我联系，当然可以。” “你把这件事说得好像只是一个随性的决定而已。” “亲爱的，现在你并不一定非得做出这个决定，如果你不愿意的话，以后也完全不必这样做。其实，即使你想为我服务，这也并不是一个必须做出的选择——任何人都可以这么做。 那会让你…… 更近一些 对我来说是这样，但这对你来说并不会带来什么好处。 重要 对我来说，你已经足够完美了。如果你真的想加入我的女武神队伍，随时都可以来找我。我一定会在这里倾听你的决定，”她说道。 “谢谢你，Lumia。

"Each valkyrie receives an investiture of my sunflame that connects them to the Aurora Strand. Just enough to leave their physical and spiritual being mostly, if not completely, intact. I would hate to wipe away what made them worthy in the first place. The rest is essentially a 'ball' of soul-like essence that does the job for day-to-day living, but doesn't hold up for the important parts like creating life. If Nareva and I had our way, they would function exactly as souls do, but we haven't quite worked it out yet." "That sounds... surprisingly open," you reply. "Does anyone ever regret the decision?" "Maybe sometimes: in their nightmares, or in moments of great loss, but never forever. I would never expect them to face the terrors of the void without doubts, but I also know the girls upon whom I bestow my blessing. Not one of them would suffer in silence, letting those doubts eat away at them. Even those who fancy themselves loners fold to the welcoming relief of others who can truly understand their pain." "It sounds like having family who care about you." "It does, doesn't it? Mortals don't even need coercing to form those kinds of bonds. It just comes naturally." "Speaking of bonds and the valkyries as a whole, what would be required of me if I become a valkyrie?" you ask. It's definitely something to be concerned about, given the current state of things. "I don't know if I can commit to dropping everything to be called back here at a moment's notice." "Right now, at the very least, nothing would change for you at all. You would be assigned to protect the Frost Marches, and I would hope that nothing becomes drastically different. You would continue wherever your current goals take you. After that, assuming you're successful, you would... probably still be assigned to protect the Frost Marches," the goddess says with a laugh. "I'm not going to pry you away from the people you hold dear, and if you had any lingering debts you would be free to take care of them no matter where they took you. As long as you kept in touch with me, of course." "You make it seem like such a casual choice." "It's not a choice you're required to make now, dear, or ever if you don't feel like it. It's not even a choice you're required to make if you wish to serve me — anyone can do that. It would make you closer to me, but it would not make you more important to me. In that, you are already perfect. If you do wish to join my valkyries, come ask me anytime. I'll always be here to listen," she concludes. "Thank you, Lumia."'

rows.original: This choice is irreversible and could drastically impact the outcome of the game. Be sure you've fully considered this action before taking it. This transformation will turn you into a valkyrie permanently. While this transformation locks proportionately few body parts in comparison to the promises of other gods, other changes are more drastic. Your gender will be locked to female, and you will not be able to change it in the future. Transformations that fall into these categories, and sub-categories thereof, will be blocked or limited: wings, breasts. You will gain the Celestial Form ability. In addition to this, you may have the chance to train or acquire other abilities that are unique to valkyries. While the powers are flavorful and special, they will generally not be stronger than comparable powers that are acquirable by other means. You will gain the soulbound perk. This signifies that your soul is marked by the power of the sun. While the goddess' soul-like facsimile may work in the short term, others among the Seven will recognize her handiwork. You will not be able to double up in this type of offer in any fashion. You will become a valkyrie with all that entails. Lumia already welcomes you into her home, and supports you regardless of your decision. Know that you belong here, and none will look down on you for choosing to keep your soul. As a valkyrie, however, you would be directly linked to her and each of the other valkyries on a more personal level than you ever could be otherwise. As both a valkyrie and a champion, you would be her exemplar in the war against the demons. Knowing all of that, will you make that heavy a decision?

rows.original: "I've decided. I will become a valkyrie," you say, giving the goddess a confident nod. "I'm glad. Follow me," she says, holding out one of her hands. You take it, and she grins wide before turning to lead you down into her sanctum. "I won't do you the disservice of questioning whether you know you're ready. It tends to be obvious when someone is struggling with it, and that just isn't you," she says as you pass the entryway. The place looks the same as the last time you saw it, but somehow the rainbow of colors that make up the Aurora Strand look even more vibrant than usual. A warm glow extends from it, ringing the glass dome that serves as its container. The goddess leaves you to stare for a moment as she clears some equipment gathered around the base. At first you wonder if those things are required, but you begin to assume the opposite is true as she continues to move them away from the center of the chamber. "Yeah. I [pc.dcb |know what I want, and it's definitely this. |am definitely confident. I think I've been looking for this for a while. |just knew it in my heart! I tend to take what my heart feels real seriously. ] Do you, um, need any help with that?" "No, but you can come closer if you want. I just need enough space to not knock it over." You take another look at how wide a space she's making as she shifts things around. "Is there a lot of moving around?" "No. It's a stationary effort, but the energy expended can sometimes be wild. Queen Atheldred knocked several of her attending soldiers off their feet," she explains with a laugh. Then she quiets for a moment as one last notebook is transitioned to a desk along the wall. When she turns back to you, her countenance is more serious. "Before we begin, I do have one matter to bring up. You've interacted with several of my girls now. Beyond mere simple pleasantries, you've come to know something of their lives and motivations. You may have also noticed how... normal, if such a word could describe them, they are when compared to what you may have heard or seen of the chosen of other gods." "Honestly... I had noticed. There are so many different races comprising the valkyries! And they don't seem to feed like the kitsune, nor does their purpose seem as singular as the Astrida. I suppose I don't have the full story, but they really don't seem that much different from normal members of their races." "I've become very good, throughout the years, at mimicking the blessings that a soul grants. The nourishment of food, the warmth of emotion, and the essence of being who you are. That said, it is still nothing more than mimicry. Though they look no different from you, on the inside they are untenably different." "Does that matter? [pc.dcb |If it looks like a peach, and tastes like a peach, it's a peach. [silly |I might want it to be an apple or an orange, but it's a peach. ] |If what is inside is good, then they shouldn't be treated any different from normal people. |That's, like, way too complicated. If they're nice and huggable inside then they're nice and huggable and that's that! ] I'd gladly fight alongside or even just be there for any one of them." "That's what I needed to hear," she says, placing her fingers on your temples. "This won't hurt, or at least, it never has in the past." You tense up nonetheless, and steel yourself for what she's about to do. Your soul is ostensibly about to leave your body, and whether it hurts or not you can't imagine it will be as simple as getting a haircut. Your assumption proves correct moments later when the glow that pervades the chamber begins to intrude on your vision. Lumia blurs before you, and a blanket of halation covers her. The effect spreads till it's like looking at a painting bleached white by exposure to the sun. It doesn't hurt, but it does feel... odd. The feeling continues after your sight disappears, and it feels like you're floating. The world becomes unthinkably vast, and it's hard to focus on anything specific. Then two giant hands scoop you up, holding you safe and close. Even blind and floating, you can tell it's Lumia. The light inside you stretches out to touch the light in her, and then... You snap suddenly back to your body, and your vision returns. It's blurry and unfocused at first, as if you've just woken from a long slumber, but you're able to shake the grogginess away and lean against the glass for support. Cupped in Lumia's hands, a semi-spherical pool of what looks like liquid crystal swirls with all the colors you can imagine. Chiefmost among them, [pc.corruptionRange 0 25 75 |a radiant whorl of golden sunlight |a multicolored twist of mixed light |a covetous curl of crimson ] that encircles the other colors. Lumia places the ball to her chest, and you watch as the [silly |secret sauce |soul energy ] suffuses her body. All of the color in it, save for that most striking hue, washes over her like a prismatic waterfall. As you continue to watch, she holds tight to that last coil of soul, and holds it out and over your shoulder. You look back, noticing for the first time that huge cracks have formed in the glass containing the Aurora Strand. It's all the better, however, as the leftover piece of your soul slips through them and weaves itself among the shining lights. All at once, you feel... quite the same as you felt before, actually. You briefly recognize an emptiness that fades by the second, and as you slump to a seated position it feels at first as if nothing has changed. "How are you feeling?" the goddess asks, reaching over you to brush her fingers on the glass. Wherever she touches, the cracks disappear like they never existed in the first place. "Warm, and [pc.dcb |like my skin is itching. |a little bit like my skin doesn't fit right. |kinda weird and fuzzy all over. ] Is that normal?" you ask. That's not quite the correct way to describe the sensation growing in your body, but you can't find the right words for it. It feels like there's the potential for itchiness, sure, but you don't feel like scratching anything. Perhaps this is what everyone else felt when they became valkyries? You look around as your eyes continue to adjust, and see that despite her best efforts, your transformation has resulted in quite the mess of parchment and equipment. "Perfectly so. Your body doesn't quite know what to do with itself yet, but we can help it along," she says, reaching down to pull you into a standing position. Once you're up, she places a hand on each side of your chest. "To start off with, how big would you like these? [pc.cupRange flat A DD GG UU |I can leave them quite small if you'd like. There's nothing wrong with that. |Have you ever wanted them bigger? I can get that kickstarted if you'd like. |Have you ever wanted them bigger? Smaller? I could help either way if you want. |These are already quite sizeable, but if you wanted them bigger or smaller I would certainly oblige. |You already put the most motherly of valkyries to shame, but if you wanted to change them I would certainly oblige. ]"
rows.translation: 我决定了，我要成为一名女武神，”你坚定地说道，同时向那位女神点了点头。 “我很高兴。跟我来吧，”她伸出一只手说道。 你握住了她的手，她露出了灿烂的笑容，然后转身带你进入了她的圣所。 我不会再问你是否已经准备好了，因为当一个人真的还在为某事而挣扎时，这一点通常是显而易见的——而你显然不是这样的，”她在你经过入口时说道。 这个地方看起来和你上次见到它时一样，但那些构成极光大道的五彩斑斓的色彩，却显得比平时更加绚丽夺目。 一股温暖的光芒从它身上散发出来，照亮了作为其容器的玻璃圆顶。女神让你静静地注视着它片刻，同时她整理着那些聚集在底座周围的设备。起初你怀疑这些物品是否真的必不可少，但当她继续移动它们时，你开始认为恰恰相反——这些物品其实是必需的。 离开 从房间的中央开始。 “是的。我…… [pc.dcb |我知道自己想要什么，而它就是这个。 |我非常有信心。我觉得我一直在寻找这个东西，已经找了有一段时间了。 |我心里早就知道啦！我总是非常重视自己内心所认为真实的事物。 ] 你，嗯，需要我在这方面帮忙吗？” “不需要，但如果你想的话，可以靠近一点。我只是需要足够的空间，以免把东西弄倒。” 你再次观察她移动物品时所留出的空间宽度。 “需要经常移动这些物品吗？ 不，这是一种需要持续努力的动作，但消耗的能量有时会非常大。阿瑟尔德雷德女王曾经把几名侍卫撞得摔倒在地呢，”她笑着解释道。 然后她暂时安静下来，因为最后一本笔记本被放到了墙边的桌子上。当她再次转向你时，她的表情变得严肃起来。 在开始之前，我有件事需要提一下。你们已经与我的几位女角色进行了互动，除了简单的寒暄之外，你们也了解到了她们的一些生活经历和动机。你们可能也注意到了，与你们所听闻或见过的其他神明选中的角色相比，她们其实……相当普通，如果可以用这个词来形容她们的话。 说实话……我确实注意到了。这些女武神由许多不同的种族组成！而且它们的进食方式似乎与狐妖不同，它们的使命也似乎不像阿斯特里达那样单一。虽然我并不了解全部真相，但它们确实与自己种族中的普通成员并没有太大的区别。 这些年来，我已经变得非常擅长模仿灵魂所赋予的各种美好事物——食物的滋养、情感的温暖，以及做自己的本质。不过，这一切终究只是模仿而已。虽然它们外表上看与你毫无区别，但内在却存在着根本性的差异。 那有关系吗？ [pc.dcb |如果它看起来像桃子，尝起来也像桃子，那它就是桃子。 [silly |我本来希望它是一颗苹果或一个橙子，但实际上它是一颗桃子。 ] |如果……的话 是 如果他们的内心是善良的，那么就不应该被区别对待，应该和普通人一样。 |那未免太复杂了。如果它们内在本质上是友善且适合被拥抱的，那就说明它们确实是友善且适合被拥抱的，就是这样！ ] 我愿意与他们中的任何一个人并肩作战，甚至只是站在他们身边支持他们。” “这正是我需要听到的话，”她说着，将手指放在你的太阳穴上，“这个过程不会感到疼痛，至少过去从来都没有这种感觉。尽管如此，你还是紧张起来，做好了迎接她接下来要做的准备的。你的灵魂似乎即将离开你的身体，而无论这会不会带来痛苦，你都无法想象这个过程会像剪头发那样简单。 不久之后，你的猜测得到了验证——当那弥漫在整个房间中的光芒开始干扰你的视线时，Lumia的身影开始变得模糊不清，她的身体被一层光晕所笼罩。这种效果逐渐扩散，最终让你看到的景象就像是一幅被阳光晒得褪了色的画作。 虽然不会感到疼痛，但确实有点……奇怪。 当你的视线消失之后，这种感觉依然持续着，仿佛自己正在漂浮之中。整个世界显得如此浩瀚无边，以至于很难将注意力集中在任何具体的事物上。然后，两只巨大的手将你托起，紧紧地将你拥在怀中。即使身处黑暗之中、在空气中漂浮，你也能立刻意识到——那是Lumia。你体内的光芒延伸出去，与她体内的光芒相触，然后…… 你突然恢复了意识，视线也逐渐清晰起来。起初，视线还显得模糊不清，就像刚从长时间的沉睡中醒来一样，但你很快便摆脱了这种昏沉感，然后靠在玻璃上支撑身体。在Lumia的手中，有一个呈半球形的容器，里面充满了仿佛是由液晶构成的液体，那些液体正闪烁着你能想象到的所有颜色。其中最显眼的是…… [pc.corruptionRange 0 25 75 |一圈灿烂的金色阳光 |多种颜色交织而成的光芒 |一道令人垂涎的深红色卷发 ] 那种能够环绕其他颜色的光芒。Lumia将球放在胸前，而你则注视着这一幕…… [silly |独家秘方 |灵魂能量 ] 这种色彩弥漫着她的整个身体。除了那最为醒目的色调之外，所有其他的色彩都像一道五彩斑斓的瀑布般洒落在她的身上。 当你继续注视着她时，你会看到她紧紧地握着那最后一缕灵魂之光，将它伸向你的肩膀后方。 你回头望去，第一次注意到，那个盛放着极光之丝的玻璃上已经出现了巨大的裂缝。然而，这也正是好事——因为你残余的灵魂碎片正从这些裂缝中穿过，融入那些闪烁的光芒之中。 突然间，你发现自己……其实和之前感觉一模一样。你短暂地察觉到一种空虚感，但这种感觉很快就消失了。当你坐下来时，起初你会觉得一切都没有改变。 你感觉怎么样？”女神问道，她伸出手来，用手指轻轻触碰玻璃。她所触之处，那些裂缝都仿佛从未存在过一样消失了。 “温暖……而且…… [pc.dcb |简直让我痒得难受。 |就好像我的皮肤不太合身一样。 |感觉有点奇怪，而且全身都觉得痒痒的。 ] 这正常吗？”你问道。 其实，这种正在你体内逐渐产生的感觉，用这种方式来描述并不完全准确，但你确实找不到更合适的词语来表达它。这种感觉确实让人觉得有点痒，不过你却并没有想要去挠什么东西的冲动。 也许当其他人变成女武神时，也会有同样的感受吧？你环顾四周，眼睛还在适应周围的环境，然后发现，尽管她已经尽了最大努力，但你的变身还是把那些羊皮纸和装备弄得一片狼藉。 正是这样。你的身体还不知道该如何应对这些变化，但我们可以帮助它。”她说着，伸手将你拉了起来。当你站稳后，她在你的胸腔两侧各放了一只手。 首先，您希望这些物品的大小是多少呢？ [pc.cupRange flat A DD GG UU |如果你们愿意，我可以把它们的尺寸设置得小一些。这样做并没有任何问题。 |你有没有想过让它们变得更大一些？如果你愿意，我可以帮你发起一场众筹活动。 |你有没有想过把它们调大一些，或者调小一些？如果你有这样的需求，我都可以帮你实现。 |这些已经相当大了，但如果您希望它们更大或更小，我肯定可以帮您调整。 |你已经让那些最充满母性的女武神们都相形见绌了，但如果你想对它们进行修改，我当然会欣然照做。 ]"

If they're nice and huggable inside then they're nice and huggable and that's that! ] I'd gladly fight alongside or even just be there for any one of them." "That's what I needed to hear," she says, placing her fingers on your temples. "This won't hurt, or at least, it never has in the past." You tense up nonetheless, and steel yourself for what she's about to do. Your soul is ostensibly about to leave your body, and whether it hurts or not you can't imagine it will be as simple as getting a haircut. Your assumption proves correct moments later when the glow that pervades the chamber begins to intrude on your vision. Lumia blurs before you, and a blanket of halation covers her. The effect spreads till it's like looking at a painting bleached white by exposure to the sun. It doesn't hurt, but it does feel... odd. The feeling continues after your sight disappears, and it feels like you're floating. The world becomes unthinkably vast, and it's hard to focus on anything specific. Then two giant hands scoop you up, holding you safe and close. Even blind and floating, you can tell it's Lumia. The light inside you stretches out to touch the light in her, and then... You snap suddenly back to your body, and your vision returns. It's blurry and unfocused at first, as if you've just woken from a long slumber, but you're able to shake the grogginess away and lean against the glass for support. Cupped in Lumia's hands, a semi-spherical pool of what looks like liquid crystal swirls with all the colors you can imagine. Chiefmost among them, [pc.corruptionRange 0 25 75 |a radiant whorl of golden sunlight |a multicolored twist of mixed light |a covetous curl of crimson ] that encircles the other colors. Lumia places the ball to her chest, and you watch as the [silly |secret sauce |soul energy ] suffuses her body. All of the color in it, save for that most striking hue, washes over her like a prismatic waterfall. As you continue to watch, she holds tight to that last coil of soul, and holds it out and over your shoulder. You look back, noticing for the first time that huge cracks have formed in the glass containing the Aurora Strand. It's all the better, however, as the leftover piece of your soul slips through them and weaves itself among the shining lights. All at once, you feel... quite the same as you felt before, actually. You briefly recognize an emptiness that fades by the second, and as you slump to a seated position it feels at first as if nothing has changed. "How are you feeling?" the goddess asks, reaching over you to brush her fingers on the glass. Wherever she touches, the cracks disappear like they never existed in the first place. "Warm, and [pc.dcb |like my skin is itching. |a little bit like my skin doesn't fit right. |kinda weird and fuzzy all over. ] Is that normal?" you ask. That's not quite the correct way to describe the sensation growing in your body, but you can't find the right words for it. It feels like there's the potential for itchiness, sure, but you don't feel like scratching anything. Perhaps this is what everyone else felt when they became valkyries? You look around as your eyes continue to adjust, and see that despite her best efforts, your transformation has resulted in quite the mess of parchment and equipment. "Perfectly so. Your body doesn't quite know what to do with itself yet, but we can help it along," she says, reaching down to pull you into a standing position. Once you're up, she places a hand on each side of your chest. "To start off with, how big would you like these? [pc.cupRange flat A DD GG UU |I can leave them quite small if you'd like. There's nothing wrong with that. |Have you ever wanted them bigger? I can get that kickstarted if you'd like. |Have you ever wanted them bigger? Smaller? I could help either way if you want. |These are already quite sizeable, but if you wanted them bigger or smaller I would certainly oblige. |You already put the most motherly of valkyries to shame, but if you wanted to change them I would certainly oblige. ]""

rows.original: "Alright. I think that's all I need. Let me just make some final changes, and we should be good to go," she says with a smile, tracing her fingertips over your body like an artist's brush. You're surprised to see your clothing fade like nothing more than an illusion. It's still visible, but you can see through it. On top of that, her fingers can pass through it like nothing. You can feel the changes she's working, [pc.wingsVRN |and at least one of them is readily apparent in the stunning golden feathered wings that are growing out from your back. The rest |but can't quite place any of the feelings directly. They ] must be related to living as a valkyrie, but like before it's just a mishmash of ticklish giddiness that comes and goes depending on where she is at any given time. Those sensations fade as she finishes her work, and you're left with her reassuring hands on your shoulders. "Now then! There's also the question of what to call you! You're shaping up to be a champion like the world hasn't seen since the days of the Godswar. If you're going to be one of my valkyries as well, then you need a title befitting a champion with my personal endorsement. Atheldred was the Sunbringer, who brought my worship to the people of the Winter City. You need... something unique," the goddess explains, putting her fingers to her chin in thought. "I know just the thing. Shadows gather in the darkest places of the Frost Marches, and who better to banish the darkness than a Hero of Light." The title fills you with an electric sense of purpose, and your heart flutters as you think of the stories you'll make. With that last bit of busywork out of the way, the fuzzy feeling under your skin begins to fade away. "Didn't you need to fill me with soul facsimile?" "I already did, dear. Can't you feel it yet? Hmm, come back with me to the throne room. You might need to be a little closer at first," Lumia replies, tugging you toward the door with a childish pep in her step. She guides you back up to the throne, and along the way you suddenly become aware that there are other valkyries in the palace. It's an odd feeling, like an entirely new sense. Of course you knew there were other valkyries in the palace, but now you know that they are there. It's not direct, and you couldn't single out a place the feeling comes from. Nonetheless, you know they're there, and it feels good. "There it is," Lumia says with a loving smile. "Now then, my valkyrie, what will you do next?" Your soul has been linked to Lumia's Aurora Strand, and you've become a valkyrie. Depending on how you looked before, your appearance could be incredibly different, or it could be exactly the same! From here on out, your gender will be locked to female, your breasts will be locked to at least A-cups, and your wings will be locked to feathery if you choose to have them. You've acquired the %"Hero of Light" title. Speak with River in Hawkethorne to let the world know of your current and past and forthcoming exploits. The Celestial Form power is available to you. You may be able to learn other valkyrie themed powers from Annika in the Palace of Light. Finally, you have the Soulbound perk. You will not be able to become another gods chosen, nor will you be able to use your soul as leverage in any similar sort of deal.
rows.translation: 好了，我想这些应该就够了。我再做一些最后的调整，就应该可以开始了。”她微笑着说道，她的指尖像艺术家的画笔一样在你的身上轻轻滑动。 你惊讶地发现，自己的衣物仿佛只是虚幻一般消失了——它们依然存在，但你可以看到它们的背面；而且，她的手指也可以毫无阻碍地穿过那些衣物。你可以感受到她正在进行的那些细微调整。 [pc.wingsVRN |其中至少有一种特征，可以从你背后生长出来的那对令人惊叹的金色羽毛中明显看出来。至于其他的特征…… |但这些感受却难以被直接表达出来。他们…… ] 这些感觉肯定与作为女武神的生活有关，但和之前一样，它们只是一系列忽隐忽现的、令人兴奋的感觉，这些感觉会随着她当时所处的环境而变化。当她完成自己的工作后，这些感觉就会消失，留下的只有她那放在你肩膀上的、让人感到安心的手。 那么，还有一个问题需要解决——该给你起什么名字呢？你正在成长为一位自‘神战’时代以来世界上再未出现过的冠军。如果你也要成为我的女武神之一，那么你就需要一个能够体现这位冠军身份、并获得我亲自认可的称号。阿瑟德雷德被称为‘光明使者’，他让冬之城的人们开始崇拜我。你也需要……一个独一无二的称号，”女神一边说着，一边用手托着下巴陷入沉思。 我知道该怎么做。在霜冻边境最黑暗的地方，阴影总会聚集起来，而有什么人比一位光明英雄更适合驱散这些黑暗呢？” 这个称号让你充满了一种强烈的使命感，一想到自己即将创造出的那些故事，你的心就会激动得怦怦直跳。当最后这些琐事也都处理完毕之后，你皮肤下那种紧张的感觉也开始逐渐消退了。 你不是需要用灵魂复制品来填充我吗？” “我已经这么做了，亲爱的。你还没感觉到吗？嗯，跟我一起回到王座厅吧。一开始你可能需要再靠近一点才行。”卢米娅一边说，一边带着孩子般活泼的步伐拉着你朝门口走去。 她引领你重新回到王座旁，而在这一过程中，你突然意识到宫殿里还有其他女武神。这种感觉很奇妙，仿佛是一种全新的感知能力。当然，你本来就知道宫殿里还有其他女武神，但此刻…… 知道 就在那里。”Lumia带着充满爱意的微笑说道，“那么，我的女武神，你接下来打算做什么呢？ 你的灵魂已经与Lumia的Aurora Strand相连，因此你已经成为了一名女武神。根据你之前的外貌，你的新形象可能会发生巨大的变化，也有可能完全保持不变！从现在开始，你的性别将被设定为女性，你的胸围至少会被设定为A-cup，而如果你选择拥有翅膀的话，它们的质地也会被设定为羽毛状。 你已获得“光明英雄”的称号。请前往霍克索恩与里弗会面，让全世界都知道你过去、现在以及未来的辉煌事迹。 你现在可以使用“天界形态”这种能力了。或许你还可以在光之宫殿中向安妮卡学习其他与瓦尔基里相关的能力。 最终，你获得了“灵魂绑定”这一能力。你将无法再成为其他神明选中的子民，也无法将自己的灵魂作为筹码用于任何类似的交易中。

rows.original: As you step into the throne room, you see that Etheryn has already joined the goddess in conversation. You also notice that Lumia is holding some manner of holiday finery, and can intuit that she's in the process of talking Ryn into similar garb. Picking up your pace, you make the last few steps to allow you to get in range of the pairs discussion. "Ah, [pc.isValk |my hero |brave hero ], you're just in time. Don't you think the lady Var Ridell would look absolutely beautiful in this? It's festivus wear made for me by the boar'alvaran tailors, and wouldn't you know it? One of them received too small measurements from my go-between," the goddess says, clucking her tongue with obvious mock disapproval. "[ryn.lowCon |I-I don't know... Would I r-really look that pretty |I dunno... This isn't a trap, is it ]?" Ryn asks, looking between you and the goddess. "[ryn.lowCon |I think I have to agree, |If it is, I wasn't told, ]" you say. "[ryn.lowCon |You would, dearest, and then some, |I wouldn't do something like that to you. You deserve every bit of this outfit, ]" the goddess replies. "Be a dear, [pc.isValk |my |brave ] hero, and watch the door while we change." You nod, turning to watch the open crack of door in the audience chamber. As if by divine design, no one is coming to see the goddess. Because of that, you feel no guilt when you take the occasional turn to see the ladies in the midst of changing. It doesn't take Lumia any time at all to have shirked her godly silks, and she stands in resplendent nudity with her hands on her hips and her clothes in a pile around her ankles. Your elven partner spends a moment gawking at the deity's sudden nudity, but still manages just fine when it comes to stripping from her own garments. Her own pale form contrasts wonderfully with the dusky goddess. Her pretty purple package is momentarily flashed to you as she leans over to tug her undergarments over her feet, and the muscles on her back as she tugs the rest over her head. When both of them are equally nude, the goddess hands her one of the outfits from the pile beside her throne. The outfits are quite gaudily colored, and Ryn's even comes with a wreath of bells over her shoulders that jingle as she adjusts them to fit snugly. Lumia's own outfit is red and lined with the warmest-looking wool imaginable. It supports her mighty bust with authority, showing off every inch of cleavage and commanding the attention of every eye in the room. It's also sheer enough silk between the tufts of warm wool that you can see her nipples perfectly molded in ruby. Your eyes still manage to sneak a few looks at Ryn, whose own outfit comes with a lacey tie on the bust. It's shockingly modest, all things considered, but it hugs her athletic curves like a stocking. She also has stockings, white and peppermint, and both have long black gloves. Ryn gives both of you a sheepish smile, and then squeaks happily as the goddess pulls her into a boobful hug. "Aha! I just knew you'd look perfect in this!" she says. "It's very warm, and it does fit nice. [ryn.lowConfidence |Y-y |Y ]ou look amazing yourself, my lady!" Ryn replies. rows.original: The steps up to the large doorways still look as foreboding and impossible to reach as ever, but maybe there will be something different now that you've been invited? You begin trudging towards them. [party.Yall] make it right to the edge, taking your first steps and realizing just how icy the stairway is, before you hear a voice call out. "Hold for a moment, little one," the voice says, coming from the direction of the doors. Looking up, you see [party.sizeText] winged valkyries descending to meet you. They land moments later, not slipping at all on the ice, and the leader gives you a short salute. You can see Annika among the host as well. The valk in charge is an immense albino centauress. Wings of golden light extend from her equine back, folded neatly behind her now that she's landed. Hair so white it's nearly transparent falls down her back to the turning point between horse and woman. She smiles brightly, her shockingly pink eyes warm and inviting. Decorative armor provides modest coverage of her body, but there's far too much exposed to really protect from the elements. If she needs such protection, it's clearly provided in some other fashion. "The stair is mostly a show piece these days. No one has ascended that way in eons. We can, however, carry you safely to the gates," she says, offering a hand. [party.Yall] [p |each ]take a hand, and you hold tight as you feel yourself lift into the air alongside her. Her wings flap, but what's lifting you feels more magical than mundane. Higher and higher you go, until you're traveling sideways over the frozen pit of glacial ice that stands before the keep. You try not to think about falling while the valkyrie[party.solo | |s ] transport you to the gates. In the end your landing is quite comfortable, touching down just to the side of the larger gate, near a smaller door that looks quite a bit more used. Now that you see them up close, you're unsure if the large gates even can open. Thick black ice and crusty snow have built up a few feet at each side. While it hasn't quite been completely sealed at the middle, it looks well beyond being able to easily break away. The [silly |Gidoormous things |ginormous doors ] are covered top to bottom in beautiful designs of blue and gold. Images of wings, crowns, and rays of brilliant light dance across their surface, coated in icy frost but still proud in their display. The small door is etched with similar colors, but much less flashy. When it's closed, it looks like nothing more than a portion of wall with Lumia's crest on it. There are other similar patterns that trail along the outer wall, and each is slightly different, but this one opens outward when the lead valk runs her hand along the side. The door swings open without a noise, hardly disturbing the powder snow around it, and you allow yourself to be ushered in[party.som |. | with [companion1.name] close behind | with your allies close behind. ] "The throne room is straight ahead. Do not falter along the way. Our lady should be waiting within her inner sanctum," the albino pegasus gestures forward, pointing you deeper into the palace from behind. Just inside, the cold from outside struggles to penetrate the thick walls, and a dour mood pervades the very building itself. Your escorts look markedly less excited to be inside, stopping at the entrance to a grander hall. The place has color, and looks like it should be full of people, but now it stands empty. You catch the occasional movement, but it seems oddly difficult to focus on anything for longer than a few seconds. The pall of oppressive weight is even heavier here, and it feels... Wrong. [party.comp agni cait kiyoko |Agni flares her feathers almost instinctively, but can't seem to gather traction. The resulting fire is muted, and you can see the vibrant color draining from it as it appears. "Ugh, don't like that. The goddess of the sun lives here? How long do we have to stay?" she asks. [party.has atugia |"Huh? What do you mean? This place is plenty vibrant! There's even some tapestries over there," Atugia says. She points to a corner where you see some drab gray rugs hung from a wall. Agni looks at the dullahan like she's crazy, but trudges on with you. ] |"Wow. I kind of thought the palace of the sun goddess would be a little more... sunny. This place is sad. It feels like the light is being sucked out of it," Cait says, gripping tight to her staff. Even her cheery disposition seems to be drained by the haze of fading light in the halls. [party.has atugia |"Cait? What do you mean? This place is sunny! I'm just surprised there aren't more valkyries around. I guess they're all off doing other things," Atugia says. She gestures at several darkened corners you can barely see into. Cait gives her an odd look, but can't seem to bring herself to refute the claim. ] |You look over to see Kiyoko with her hands balled into fists at her sides. She eyes the darkened corners of the hall with narrowed eyes, trying to pierce the gloom by sheer force of will. You place a hand on her shoulder to try and give her some comfort. "Be careful, beloved. I do not know what, but there is something dangerous here. I cannot shake this feeling," she says. She stays alert, but relaxes slightly at your touch. ] Without a guide, it seems you've been left to your own devices. You've been told the throne room is deeper inside, and with things the way they are you don't really feel like exploring the palace in its current state. Perhaps this is what the goddess was talking about when she asked you to stop by.

[party.has atugia |凯特？你是什么意思？这个地方…… 是 天哪！我只是觉得周围怎么没有更多的女武神呢。大概她们都在去做其他事情吧，”阿图吉亚说道。她指向了几处昏暗的角落，那些地方几乎看不清里面有什么。凯特用一种奇怪的眼神看着她，但似乎也没办法反驳她的说法。 ] |你转头望去，看到清子双手紧握在身侧。她眯着眼睛注视着大厅里那些昏暗的角落，试图凭借坚强的意志力穿透那片黑暗。你把手放在她的肩上，想给她一些安慰。 “小心点，亲爱的。我不知道是什么，但这里确实有什么危险的东西。这种感觉挥之不去，”她说。她在你的触碰下稍微放松了一些，但仍保持着警惕。 ] 如果没有向导的话，看来你就只能自己摸索了。有人告诉你王座厅在更里面的地方，但考虑到目前的状况，你确实没有兴趣去探索这座宫殿了。也许女神当初让你去拜访，就是指这件事吧。
rows.raw: " The steps up to the large doorways still look as foreboding and impossible to reach as ever, but maybe there will be something different now that you've been invited? You begin trudging towards them. [party.Yall] make it right to the edge, taking your first steps and realizing just how icy the stairway is, before you hear a voice call out. "Hold for a moment, little one," the voice says, coming from the direction of the doors. Looking up, you see [party.sizeText] winged valkyries descending to meet you. They land moments later, not slipping at all on the ice, and the leader gives you a short salute. You can see Annika among the host as well. The valk in charge is an immense albino centauress. Wings of golden light extend from her equine back, folded neatly behind her now that she's landed. Hair so white it's nearly transparent falls down her back to the turning point between horse and woman. She smiles brightly, her shockingly pink eyes warm and inviting. Decorative armor provides modest coverage of her body, but there's far too much exposed to really protect from the elements. If she needs such protection, it's clearly provided in some other fashion. "The stair is mostly a show piece these days. No one has ascended that way in eons. We can, however, carry you safely to the gates," she says, offering a hand. [party.Yall] [p |each ]take a hand, and you hold tight as you feel yourself lift into the air alongside her. Her wings flap, but what's lifting you feels more magical than mundane. Higher and higher you go, until you're traveling sideways over the frozen pit of glacial ice that stands before the keep. You try not to think about falling while the valkyrie[party.solo | |s ] transport you to the gates. In the end your landing is quite comfortable, touching down just to the side of the larger gate, near a smaller door that looks quite a bit more used. Now that you see them up close, you're unsure if the large gates even can open. Thick black ice and crusty snow have built up a few feet at each side. While it hasn't quite been completely sealed at the middle, it looks well beyond being able to easily break away. The [silly |Gidoormous things |ginormous doors ] are covered top to bottom in beautiful designs of blue and gold. Images of wings, crowns, and rays of brilliant light dance across their surface, coated in icy frost but still proud in their display. The small door is etched with similar colors, but much less flashy. When it's closed, it looks like nothing more than a portion of wall with Lumia's crest on it. There are other similar patterns that trail along the outer wall, and each is slightly different, but this one opens outward when the lead valk runs her hand along the side. The door swings open without a noise, hardly disturbing the powder snow around it, and you allow yourself to be ushered in[party.som |. | with [companion1.name] close behind | with your allies close behind. ] "The throne room is straight ahead. Do not falter along the way. Our lady should be waiting within her inner sanctum," the albino pegasus gestures forward, pointing you deeper into the palace from behind. Just inside, the cold from outside struggles to penetrate the thick walls, and a dour mood pervades the very building itself. Your escorts look markedly less excited to be inside, stopping at the entrance to a grander hall. The place has color, and looks like it should be full of people, but now it stands empty. You catch the occasional movement, but it seems oddly difficult to focus on anything for longer than a few seconds. The pall of oppressive weight is even heavier here, and it feels... Wrong. [party.comp agni cait kiyoko |Agni flares her feathers almost instinctively, but can't seem to gather traction. The resulting fire is muted, and you can see the vibrant color draining from it as it appears. "Ugh, don't like that. The goddess of the sun lives here? How long do we have to stay?" she asks. [party.has atugia |"Huh? What do you mean? This place is plenty vibrant! There's even some tapestries over there," Atugia says. She points to a corner where you see some drab gray rugs hung from a wall. Agni looks at the dullahan like she's crazy, but trudges on with you. ] |"Wow. I kind of thought the palace of the sun goddess would be a little more... sunny. This place is sad. It feels like the light is being sucked out of it," Cait says, gripping tight to her staff. Even her cheery disposition seems to be drained by the haze of fading light in the halls. [party.has atugia |"Cait? What do you mean? This place is sunny! I'm just surprised there aren't more valkyries around. I guess they're all off doing other things," Atugia says. She gestures at several darkened corners you can barely see into. Cait gives her an odd look, but can't seem to bring herself to refute the claim. ] |You look over to see Kiyoko with her hands balled into fists at her sides. She eyes the darkened corners of the hall with narrowed eyes, trying to pierce the gloom by sheer force of will. You place a hand on her shoulder to try and give her some comfort. "Be careful, beloved. I do not know what, but there is something dangerous here. I cannot shake this feeling," she says. She stays alert, but relaxes slightly at your touch. ] Without a guide, it seems you've been left to your own devices. You've been told the throne room is deeper inside, and with things the way they are you don't really feel like exploring the palace in its current state. Perhaps this is what the goddess was talking about when she asked you to stop by. "

rows.original:
As you wander through the hall, a glint of unmistakable blue light catches your eye. You follow the shine till it leads you to a statue at one side of the hall. It's a work of art, carved from marble and etched through with what looks like streaks of gold. Shafts of solid sunlight wrap like heavenly wings around a large blue gemstone, immediately recognizable as one of the stones you use to enter the Ways Between. 

        Sure enough, when you raise your gem to meet it, it flares with inner light as the connection forms an opening. Looks like you won't need to climb the palace stairs anymore if you don't want to!
rows.translation:
当你漫步在走廊中时，一道醒目的蓝光吸引了你的目光。你顺着那道光芒走去，最终来到走廊一侧的一座雕像前。这是一件艺术品，由大理石雕刻而成，上面还刻有仿佛是金线般的纹路。 一道道炽热的阳光如同天上的翅膀，环绕着那颗巨大的蓝色宝石，人们立刻就能认出，这正是进入“通道之间”所需的宝石之一。

果然，当你将宝石举向阳光时，它内部的光芒会骤然闪耀，随着连接的建立，一道通道也随之出现了。 看来如果你不想爬那些宫殿的楼梯的话，就真的不需要再爬了！

rows.original: As you approach the Palace of Light, you feel a bizarre tug at the back of your mind. At first you struggle to think of where the feeling could be coming from, but again and again your thoughts are drawn to the corrupted blade [var0 |at your side |in your bag ]. Are the spirits within trying to communicate with you? Now that you think of it, bringing the corrupted blade before the goddess its original self was dedicated to might not be the smartest idea. Perhaps you should store it away before you enter the palace. Lumia will not abide the corrupt blade's presence. Keep it in storage if you do not wish for it to be cleansed.
rows.translation: 当你接近光明之宫时，你会感到脑海中有一种奇怪的牵引力。起初，你努力思考这种感觉究竟源自何处，但一次又一次，你的思绪都会被那把被腐蚀的剑所吸引。 [var0 |在你身边 |十拿九稳 ]那些存在于其中的灵魂是在试图与你交流吗？现在想来，将那把被腐蚀的剑带到女神面前——毕竟它最初就是为女神而打造的——或许并不是一个明智的决定。也许你在进入宫殿之前应该把它藏起来。 Lumia无法容忍那把被腐蚀的刀刃的存在。如果你不希望它被净化，那就把它收起来吧。

rows.original:
"Ah!" As soon as you enter Lumia's Keep, you're greeted not by any particular valkyries but by the sun goddess herself. "It's a pleasure to see you again, [pc.name]. I couldn't help but notice a familiar feeling as you arrived..."
    
    "[pc.isBimbo
        |Huh? What's tha— ooh!
        |Mmm? What's tha— oh.
    ]" Oh, of course! The Dawnsword. "[pc.isBimbo
        |This glowy swordy thing is yours, right?
        |Yeah, the Dawnsword.
    ] A demon kind of messed it up, and, uh, I wasn't able to fix it."
    
    She takes the blade and nods. "Thank you for rescuing it, then. I'd be happy to restore it to its original form."
    
    "Ah." You put on a relieved smile, "[pc.isBimbo
        |I didn't know you could do that! It just kinda stayed like this. Does making it normal again mean it's going to be all choosy and stuff?
        |Hmm. I know that it was originally kind of a, uh... picky? Weapon? What if you cleanse the corruption and it decides I'm not worthy anymore?
    ]"
    
    "That's a fair question[pc.swornGod keros nareva|, especially for a [pc.manWoman] who serves Keros|, especially for a [pc.manWoman] who serves Nareva]." Lumia's glowing eyes give you another once-over, and then she smiles. "Redemption isn't the sort of thing open to a select few. Anyone — and certainly anyone valiant enough to help save the world from the Wraith that once infested these halls — can gain the willpower to earn the blade's worth.[pc.swornGod keros nareva| Even a kitsune. It's far from unknown for paladins of one deity to wield the holy weapon of another, if fairly won... especially in times of crisis like these.| Even a member of the Order Astrida. It's far from unknown for paladins of one deity to wield the holy weapon of another, if fairly won... especially in times of crisis like these.]
    
    "But," she continues, "I would understand if you didn't feel up to the burden of being a true Sunbearer. It's not something for everyone. Of course, I wouldn't let you leave empty-handed; merely returning the blade to me is worthy of a reward. After all, you've enabled me to restore it to its rightful form."
    
    The tone of her voice, despite being warm and friendly, brooks little argument. You doubt very much that she'd be willing to let you keep the Dawnsword in its current corrupted form. If you get it back, you'll have to make sure you stay pure in order to use it... or you could take whatever she offers in trade. Either way, you're not likely to be able to use it as is — and arguing the point is likely to get you smited.
rows.translation:
啊！”当你走进卢米娅的城堡时，迎接你的并不是什么特定的女武神，而是太阳女神本人。“再次见到你真是太高兴了…… [pc.name]当你出现的时候，我不由得感受到一种熟悉的感觉……[pc.isBimbo
        |哈？那是什么——哦！
        |嗯？那是什么——哦，原来如此。
    ]哦，当然！那就是黎明之剑。[pc.isBimbo
        |这把发光的剑，是你的吧？
        |是的，就是黎明之剑。
    ] 有个恶魔把事情搞砸了，嗯，我没能把它修好。”

她接过那把刀，点了点头：“那还是谢谢你把它救回来。我很乐意把它恢复到原来的状态。”

“啊。”你露出了如释重负的笑容，[pc.isBimbo
        |我之前都不知道你可以这么做！它之前就是保持这个状态的。那么，如果把它恢复到正常状态，是不是意味着它会变得非常挑剔，会变得很难满足我们的要求呢？
        |嗯，我知道它原本应该是一种比较……挑剔的武器吧？要是你清除了它身上的污秽，但它却认为我不再配使用它了，那该怎么办呢？
    ]这是个合理的问题。[pc.swornGod keros nareva|尤其是对于……来说 [pc.manWoman] 谁为凯罗斯效力|尤其是对于……来说 [pc.manWoman] 谁为纳雷瓦效力]卢米娅那闪烁的眼神让你再次注视她，然后她笑了。‘救赎并不是只有少数人才能获得的。任何人——尤其是那些有勇气帮助世界摆脱曾经肆虐在这片大厅中的邪恶势力的人——都能获得足够的意志力，从而赢得这把剑应有的价值。[pc.swornGod keros nareva| 即使是狐妖也不例外。对于信仰同一位神的圣骑士们来说，如果通过正当手段获得的话，使用另一位神的圣器根本不是什么稀罕事……尤其是在像现在这样的危机时刻。| 即便是阿斯特里达教团的成员，对于那些信仰同一位神的圣骑士们来说，如果能够通过正当手段获得，使用另一位神的圣器也并非什么稀罕事……尤其是在像现在这样的危机时刻。]
    
    但是，”她继续说道，“如果你觉得承担‘真正的太阳守护者’这一责任太过沉重，我完全可以理解。这并不是每个人都能胜任的任务。当然，我也不会让你空手而归；仅仅把那把剑还给我，就已经值得得到一份奖励了。 毕竟，是你让我能够将它恢复到它应有的形态。”

她的语气虽然温暖而友好，但却不容置疑。你几乎可以肯定，她绝不会允许你将这把黎明之剑保持在其目前这种损坏的状态。 如果你找回了它，就必须确保自己保持纯洁才能使用它……否则，你也可以接受她提出的任何交换条件。无论如何，你很可能无法直接使用它——而争论这个话题很可能会让你受到惩罚。

rows.translation: 握紧利刃

rows.original: You nod quietly. "[pc.isBimbo |Weeell, I really like the sword. It's shiny and sexy and suuuper stabby. So could I keep it after you fix it up? Pleeeeeease? |All right. Then I guess I'll have to try and prove myself worthy of it. ]" Lumia inclines her head toward you gently. "[pc.isBimbo |You've earned the right to try to use it, at least. |You have it within you to try. ]" With one hand, she holds the hilt aloft; the other hovers above it. With a slight tensing of her muscles, the goddess seems to pull a gradually-growing ball of black oil out of the hilt, the crossguard, the blade-shard. As the goo sloughs off of the weapon, you see it slowly return to what must have been its original form, shedding droplet after droplet of the stuff until all that remains is pristine and perfect. The goddess narrows her eyes and gazes critically at the pink oil-ball hovering under her palm. It pulses inky black a few times, then returns to pink, roiling and angry but harmlessly contained by divine power. After several seconds of close examination, Lumia seems to have found all she needed. Her hand closes, and she snaps her fingers — and the ball erupts into blinding white flame. It shines with an actinic glare, burning off the oil and growing smaller and smaller until it fizzles into nothingness, and all that was left of the demon's corruption is completely gone. Briefly, the Dawnsword snaps into existence again, golden blade extended full length and suffusing this part of the already-well-lit hall with an even warmer glow. Lumia gently swings it through a few velocities, a satisfied smile growing on her face. Eventually, she murmurs, "There," deactivates the blade, and returns the hilt to you. "It should be protected against further corruption, too. As for you, [pc.name], you're welcome to speak to me or to my warriors about worthiness and heroism — and about removing any corruption inside you, should you wish. Some of your friends here have known the Sunbearers of years past, including your friend Riordan. They'll probably be anxious to help you join those warriors' ranks." "[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. More learning from sexy valky ladies? Hot. |I understand. ]" "Excellent." She opens her arms. "As ever, enjoy the Keep and the company of those within it. The world where you found the blade remains dark and troubled, but here, at least, things should remain restful." Then[party.hasCompanions |, with a nod to [party.compNames], ] the goddess turns and walks back to her inner sanctum.
rows.translation: 你静静地点了点头。[pc.isBimbo |嗯，我真的很喜欢这把剑。它闪闪发光，看起来非常酷，而且刺击起来也超级有力。所以等你修好它之后，能让我留着它吗？求求你啦？ |好吧，那我想我必须努力证明自己确实配得上这个机会。 ]蕾亚轻轻地将头偏向你。[pc.isBimbo |你至少已经获得了尝试使用它的权利。 |你完全有能力去尝试。 ]她一只手将剑柄高高举起，另一只手则悬在剑柄上方。随着她肌肉的微微紧张，这位女神仿佛…… 拉动 一股逐渐扩大的黑色油状物从武器的柄部、护手以及刀刃碎片中渗出。当这种黏稠物从武器上脱落时，你可以看到它正在慢慢恢复到它原本应有的形态——一滴一滴地脱落，直到最终只剩下完好无损、完美无缺的武器本身。 女神眯起眼睛，仔细观察着悬停在手掌下的粉色油球。那油球几次闪烁着漆黑的光芒，随后又恢复了粉色，不断翻滚着，显得十分活跃，但却被神力牢牢地控制着，没有任何危害。经过几秒钟的仔细观察，卢米娅似乎已经找到了她所需要的所有信息。 她的手一握，打了个响指——那颗球立刻迸发出刺目的白焰。那火焰散发着强烈的光芒，烧尽了那些油脂，球体逐渐缩小，最终化作虚无，恶魔带来的腐蚀之力也彻底消失了。 简而言之，黎明之剑再次显现了出来，它的金色刀刃完全展开，使得这个本来就已经灯火通明的大厅变得更加明亮。卢米娅轻轻挥动了几下，脸上露出了满意的笑容。 最终，她轻声说道：“在这里。”她关闭了刀刃，然后将刀柄交还给你。“这把刀也应该被保护起来，以免再次受到损坏。至于你…… [pc.name]如果你愿意，欢迎随时与我或我的战士们讨论关于价值与英雄主义的话题，也可以探讨如何消除你内心的邪恶与腐败。在座的一些朋友多年前就认识那些“太阳使者”，包括你的朋友里奥丹。他们肯定很乐意帮助你加入那些战士的行列。[pc.isBimbo |嘿嘿，还能从性感的瓦尔基里女郎们那里学到更多东西？真是太棒了。 |我明白了。 ]太好了。”她张开双臂说道，“像往常一样，好好享受这个城堡以及里面的人们吧。你在那里找到那把剑的那个世界依然充满了黑暗与纷扰，但至少在这里，一切都应该安宁祥和。”然后[party.hasCompanions |，同时借鉴了……的做法 [party.compNames], ] 女神转身走回了她的神圣殿堂。
rows.raw: ' You nod quietly. "[pc.isBimbo |Weeell, I really like the sword. It's shiny and sexy and suuuper stabby. So could I keep it after you fix it up? Pleeeeeease? |All right. Then I guess I'll have to try and prove myself worthy of it. ]" Lumia inclines her head toward you gently. "[pc.isBimbo |You've earned the right to try to use it, at least. |You have it within you to try. ]" With one hand, she holds the hilt aloft; the other hovers above it. With a slight tensing of her muscles, the goddess seems to pull a gradually-growing ball of black oil out of the hilt, the crossguard, the blade-shard. As the goo sloughs off of the weapon, you see it slowly return to what must have been its original form, shedding droplet after droplet of the stuff until all that remains is pristine and perfect. The goddess narrows her eyes and gazes critically at the pink oil-ball hovering under her palm. It pulses inky black a few times, then returns to pink, roiling and angry but harmlessly contained by divine power. After several seconds of close examination, Lumia seems to have found all she needed. Her hand closes, and she snaps her fingers — and the ball erupts into blinding white flame. It shines with an actinic glare, burning off the oil and growing smaller and smaller until it fizzles into nothingness, and all that was left of the demon's corruption is completely gone. Briefly, the Dawnsword snaps into existence again, golden blade extended full length and suffusing this part of the already-well-lit hall with an even warmer glow. Lumia gently swings it through a few velocities, a satisfied smile growing on her face. Eventually, she murmurs, "There," deactivates the blade, and returns the hilt to you. "It should be protected against further corruption, too. As for you, [pc.name], you're welcome to speak to me or to my warriors about worthiness and heroism — and about removing any corruption inside you, should you wish. Some of your friends here have known the Sunbearers of years past, including your friend Riordan. They'll probably be anxious to help you join those warriors' ranks." "[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. More learning from sexy valky ladies? Hot. |I understand. ]" "Excellent." She opens her arms. "As ever, enjoy the Keep and the company of those within it. The world where you found the blade remains dark and troubled, but here, at least, things should remain restful." Then[party.hasCompanions |, with a nod to [party.compNames], ] the goddess turns and walks back to her inner sanctum. '
