rows.original: [flags.LUMIA_PALACE_SANCTUM |You descend into the depths of the Palace of Light, relieved to find Lumia still pacing in the adjoining room. She looks equally happy to see you, trying her best to mask the strain that mars her godly charisma. "[pc.name]. Have you made your preparations? Are you ready to stop this monster once and for all?" |You get over the sense of gloom that pervades this portion of the palace and begin your way down the stairs. They don't end up being that long, and in fact you find it easier to move the further down the stairs you get. They open into a small but opulent waiting room, where you can see the sun goddess herself. She's clad toe to shoulder in resplendent armor that evokes the light that should be emanating from her. Her back is turned to you, and her head is against the ornate door that connects this room to the next part of the palace. Lumia turns to see you when she hears you stepping into the room, smiling weakly. Though the encroaching darkness is weaker here, and you feel many times better than before, you can see the effect this shadow is having on the goddess herself. Compared to the powerful woman you saw before, she now looks sickly and beaten down. Sweat pours down her face, and her shoulders slump limply. She staggers to a cushioned sofa at the room's edge and collapses into a sitting position. "Ha. Sorry for not being there to greet you at the door, and for greeting you in such a sorry state," she laughs, closing her gilden eyes and clenching them shut. "[pc.dcb |No offense, but you look like shit. What the hell is in there that's causing a literal goddess so much pain? |What is this? You look close to death! What is causing all of this? |[silly |Oh no! Cringe! Why do you look so grosso? What's making the goddess of pretty look like the goddess of shitty? |like, ohmigod! What's in there! Is something doing this to you?! ] ]" you ask, placing a hand on your weapon and stepping closer to the door. Lumia holds up a hand before you get too close, and you turn to her before stepping further. "Just a relic from the Godswar that's misbehaving. I had it perfectly under control, but [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS|that business in the Winter City made it bolder.|it's been getting stronger and stronger.] I feel like I'm being worn down now. My godly spark will only hold it back till it gets strong enough to drain what's left, and it's all I can do now to prevent that," she explains, her face set in grim determination. "And that's what you wanted my help with? No offense, but how am I supposed to help when this thing is wearing away a god herself?" you ask. "Hmph, you'd be surprised what a foreign mind can do to something with no concept of thought," she muses, standing again and placing both hands on your shoulders. "I don't expect you to do it alone. I will be there to help you the whole time. In addition, there is something in the city of Hawkethorne that I believe could make it even easier. This thing evades my senses, and I reason that anything powerful enough to be obscured from a god would be powerful enough to help. I haven't been able to go myself, since I can't go much farther than the Winter City without risking the monster's escape." "I don't know whether this thing is an object or a person, but I know it's somewhere in the vicinity of the baroness's castle. Sometimes it moves to the town proper, but I can't tell much more than that. I can only tell it's moving at all because when it's not there I can sense the places it's left behind. If you can find this thing, then maybe I can put this monster to rest for good." That's a good start, but if you want to search for this thing then you have no idea what you're going to look for when you get to Hawkethorne...[party.comp atugia | "Um, miss? I've lived in Castle Hawkstone almost my whole life, and I don't know anythin' about god objects. Sure there's some interestin' things in the cache, but nothin' like that and certainly nothin' that gets taken into Hawkethorne," Atugia says. She looks genuinely stumped, with a concerned frown on her face. The second she starts talking, Lumia's eyes go wide. She looks [pc.isCunning |in Tui's direction, but not directly at her. |at Tui with genuine surprise. ] "Amazing. So it was a person after all," she says. A profound awe is still blatant on her face, one she isn't even trying to hide. She reaches out[pc.isCunning | quite blindly ] and pokes Atugia's bicep. She gets more handsy after that, patting her shoulders and then all the way down to the sides of her legs. The previous pallor on her face is gone, replaced by a glowing confidence that pushes back the shadowy miasma. "U-um, wait. It's me?" Atugia asks. "Look, I'm strong I guess, but how can I fight somethin' that gives a god trouble? It'll tear me apart as soon as it sees me!" "That's just it! It can't see you! I can't explain it, but something about you is blocking its attempts to detect or even affect you. Can you even see it's miasma filling the palace? Or feel it sapping your essence?" the goddess refutes. "Well. I-I guess not. I was wonderin' why everybody seemed so down. Is that stuff really happenin'?" "It is, but by the sun it won't be for very much longer." Lumia turns to you once more, all grace and confidence and determination. "I'll be able to hold this thing off for a while longer. If there's anything you need, then feel free to prepare everything you've got. I can't offer much apart from my help, but if there's anything you need from me I can try my best to provide it. |[atugia.recruited | Maybe Atugia might know something. She would probably have a pretty good idea of important objects in the castle as a guard. She'd definitely know if the baroness has any personal effects that seem that powerful, at the very least. You can start with her and see where it goes from there. | There has to be someone at Castle Hawkstone you can ask for more information. Maybe you can catch a glimpse of this [silly |macguffin |object or being ] and ask about it personally. ] ] ]

当卢米娅听到你走进房间的声音时，她转过身来看着你，脸上带着一丝淡淡的微笑。虽然这里的黑暗还没有那么浓重，你的感觉也比之前好多了，但你可以清楚地看到，这种阴影正在对这位女神本身产生着影响。 与你之前看到的那个强大女子相比，她现在看起来病恹恹的，仿佛被彻底击垮了。汗水从她的脸上不停地流淌下来，肩膀也无力地耷拉着。她摇摇晃晃地走到房间角落的那张软垫沙发旁，然后瘫坐在那里。 哈，真抱歉没能去门口迎接你，而且还是以这样一副狼狈的样子来迎接你……”她笑着，闭上眼睛，紧紧地闭住了它们。[pc.dcb |无意冒犯，但你看起来糟透了。里面到底有什么东西，会让一位女神如此痛苦？ |这是什么？你看起来快不行了！到底是什么导致了这一切？ |[silly |哦不！太尴尬了！你怎么会变得这么难看呢？是什么让这位美丽的女神看起来像一位丑陋的女神呢？ |天啊！里面到底有什么东西！是不是有什么东西在影响你啊？！ ] ]你这么问，便把手放在武器上，然后朝门口走了过去。就在你快要靠近的时候，Lumia举手示意你停下来，于是你转过身来，没有再继续前进。 “那只是神战时期留下的一件遗物，现在有点不听使唤了。我本来已经把它控制得很好了，但是…… [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS|在冬城的那次经历让他们变得更加大胆了。|它的实力正在变得越来越强。] 我现在感觉自己快要支撑不下去了。我那股神圣的力量只能暂时延缓这一刻，直到它变得足够强大，能够彻底吸收剩余的能量。现在，我所能做的就是尽力阻止这种情况发生，”她解释道，脸上带着坚定的决心。 “原来这就是你想要我帮忙的原因？无意冒犯，但这样真的有用吗？ 我 当这个东西正在侵蚀一位神明本身时，它难道真的能起到帮助作用吗？”你问道。 “哼，你可能会惊讶于一个外来者的思维竟能对那些毫无思维概念的东西产生什么样的影响。”她沉思着，重新站起身来，将双手放在你的肩上。 我并不指望你独自完成这件事。我会一直在你身边帮助你。另外，在霍克索恩城里有某样东西，我相信它能让事情变得更加顺利。这个东西超出了我的感知范围，但我认为，任何强大到连神明都无法察觉的存在，必定也拥有帮助我们的力量。 我自己还没来得及去，因为一旦离开冬城太远，就有可能让那些怪物逃掉。” “我不知道这个东西是物体还是生物，但我知道它肯定在女男爵城堡的附近某个地方。 有时候它会移动到城镇里，但我也就知道这些而已。我之所以能察觉到它的移动，只是因为当它不在某个地方时，我能够感受到它留下的痕迹。如果你能找到这个东西，或许我就能彻底让这个怪物安息了。这是个不错的开始，但如果你想找到这个东西的话，当你真正来到霍克索恩的时候，你根本不知道该从哪里开始寻找……[party.comp atugia | 嗯，小姐？我几乎在卡斯尔霍克斯通住了整个人生，我对那些‘神物’一无所知。当然，缓存里确实有一些有趣的东西，但绝对没有那种东西，更不可能有什么会被带到霍克索恩去。”阿图吉亚说道。她看起来真的有些困惑，脸上带着担忧的表情。 而当她开始说话的那一刻，卢米娅的眼睛立刻瞪得大大的，她看起来…… [pc.isCunning |朝涂的方向走去，但并没有直接朝她走去。 |图伊脸上露出了真正的惊讶之情。 ] 太神奇了。原来真的是一个人啊，”她说道。她脸上依然流露出深深的敬畏之情，甚至没有试图掩饰。她伸出了手……[pc.isCunning | 相当盲目地 ] 然后她还戳了戳阿图吉亚的二头肌。从那以后，她的动作就变得更加大胆了——她开始拍拍她的肩膀，然后一路往下，直到她的腿部两侧。她脸上先前的苍白已经消失了，取而代之的是一种充满自信的神情，这种自信仿佛能够驱散那些阴郁的气息。 “呃，等等。这…… 我？”阿图吉亚问道，“听着，我虽然力气不小，但面对那种连神明都会感到困扰的怪物，我该怎么战斗呢？它一看到我，就会立刻把我撕成碎片！” “关键就在这里！它根本看不到你！我也说不清楚为什么，但你的某些特质正在阻碍它探测到你的存在，甚至阻止它对你产生任何影响。 你难道看不见那弥漫在整个宫殿中的阴霾吗？也感觉不到它正在侵蚀你的生命力吗？”女神反问道。 “嗯……我想是没有吧。我一直在想，为什么大家都看起来这么沮丧……这种事情真的在发生吗？是的，但以太阳现在的状况来看，这种情况不会持续太久了。” Lumia再次转向你，身上散发着优雅、自信与坚定的气息。 “我还能再坚持一段时间。 如果你需要什么帮助，尽管把你手头所有能用的资源都拿出来吧。除了我的帮助之外，我所能提供的并不多，但如果你有什么需要我做的事情，我会尽我最大的努力去帮助你。 |[atugia.recruited | 也许阿图吉亚会知道些什么。作为守卫，她应该对城堡里的重要物品非常熟悉。至少，她肯定知道女男爵是否拥有任何看起来如此强大的个人物品。你可以先从她入手，看看能得到什么线索。 | 在霍克斯通城堡，肯定有人能够为你提供更多信息。也许你还有机会一睹它的真容。 [silly |障眼法 |对象或实体 ] 亲自去询问相关事宜。 ] ] ]
rows.raw: " [flags.LUMIA_PALACE_SANCTUM |You descend into the depths of the Palace of Light, relieved to find Lumia still pacing in the adjoining room. She looks equally happy to see you, trying her best to mask the strain that mars her godly charisma. "[pc.name]. Have you made your preparations? Are you ready to stop this monster once and for all?" |You get over the sense of gloom that pervades this portion of the palace and begin your way down the stairs. They don't end up being that long, and in fact you find it easier to move the further down the stairs you get. They open into a small but opulent waiting room, where you can see the sun goddess herself. She's clad toe to shoulder in resplendent armor that evokes the light that should be emanating from her. Her back is turned to you, and her head is against the ornate door that connects this room to the next part of the palace. Lumia turns to see you when she hears you stepping into the room, smiling weakly. Though the encroaching darkness is weaker here, and you feel many times better than before, you can see the effect this shadow is having on the goddess herself. Compared to the powerful woman you saw before, she now looks sickly and beaten down. Sweat pours down her face, and her shoulders slump limply. She staggers to a cushioned sofa at the room's edge and collapses into a sitting position. "Ha. Sorry for not being there to greet you at the door, and for greeting you in such a sorry state," she laughs, closing her gilden eyes and clenching them shut. "[pc.dcb |No offense, but you look like shit. What the hell is in there that's causing a literal goddess so much pain? |What is this? You look close to death! What is causing all of this? |[silly |Oh no! Cringe! Why do you look so grosso? What's making the goddess of pretty look like the goddess of shitty? |like, ohmigod! What's in there! Is something doing this to you?! ] ]" you ask, placing a hand on your weapon and stepping closer to the door. Lumia holds up a hand before you get too close, and you turn to her before stepping further. "Just a relic from the Godswar that's misbehaving. I had it perfectly under control, but [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS|that business in the Winter City made it bolder.|it's been getting stronger and stronger.] I feel like I'm being worn down now. My godly spark will only hold it back till it gets strong enough to drain what's left, and it's all I can do now to prevent that," she explains, her face set in grim determination. "And that's what you wanted my help with? No offense, but how am I supposed to help when this thing is wearing away a god herself?" you ask. "Hmph, you'd be surprised what a foreign mind can do to something with no concept of thought," she muses, standing again and placing both hands on your shoulders. "I don't expect you to do it alone. I will be there to help you the whole time. In addition, there is something in the city of Hawkethorne that I believe could make it even easier. This thing evades my senses, and I reason that anything powerful enough to be obscured from a god would be powerful enough to help. I haven't been able to go myself, since I can't go much farther than the Winter City without risking the monster's escape." "I don't know whether this thing is an object or a person, but I know it's somewhere in the vicinity of the baroness's castle. Sometimes it moves to the town proper, but I can't tell much more than that. I can only tell it's moving at all because when it's not there I can sense the places it's left behind. If you can find this thing, then maybe I can put this monster to rest for good." That's a good start, but if you want to search for this thing then you have no idea what you're going to look for when you get to Hawkethorne...[party.comp atugia | "Um, miss? I've lived in Castle Hawkstone almost my whole life, and I don't know anythin' about god objects. Sure there's some interestin' things in the cache, but nothin' like that and certainly nothin' that gets taken into Hawkethorne," Atugia says. She looks genuinely stumped, with a concerned frown on her face. The second she starts talking, Lumia's eyes go wide. She looks [pc.isCunning |in Tui's direction, but not directly at her. |at Tui with genuine surprise. ] "Amazing. So it was a person after all," she says. A profound awe is still blatant on her face, one she isn't even trying to hide. She reaches out[pc.isCunning | quite blindly ] and pokes Atugia's bicep. She gets more handsy after that, patting her shoulders and then all the way down to the sides of her legs. The previous pallor on her face is gone, replaced by a glowing confidence that pushes back the shadowy miasma. "U-um, wait. It's me?" Atugia asks. "Look, I'm strong I guess, but how can I fight somethin' that gives a god trouble? It'll tear me apart as soon as it sees me!" "That's just it! It can't see you! I can't explain it, but something about you is blocking its attempts to detect or even affect you. Can you even see it's miasma filling the palace? Or feel it sapping your essence?" the goddess refutes. "Well. I-I guess not. I was wonderin' why everybody seemed so down. Is that stuff really happenin'?" "It is, but by the sun it won't be for very much longer." Lumia turns to you once more, all grace and confidence and determination. "I'll be able to hold this thing off for a while longer. If there's anything you need, then feel free to prepare everything you've got. I can't offer much apart from my help, but if there's anything you need from me I can try my best to provide it. |[atugia.recruited | Maybe Atugia might know something. She would probably have a pretty good idea of important objects in the castle as a guard. She'd definitely know if the baroness has any personal effects that seem that powerful, at the very least. You can start with her and see where it goes from there. | There has to be someone at Castle Hawkstone you can ask for more information. Maybe you can catch a glimpse of this [silly |macguffin |object or being ] and ask about it personally. ] ] ] "

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: You descend the steps once again, relieved to find the entryway to Lumia's inner sanctum as yet free of miasma. Lumia is still here, though looking quite haggard compared to your previous sighting. She looks relieved to see you, turning and leaning on her sword for support. "I brought someone from the castle. She didn't really know anything, but she had some questions," you explain. Lumia raises an eyebrow, and looks like she's about to speak when Tui talks first. "U-um, that's me, miss sun goddess. I've lived in Castle Hawkstone almost my full life, and I've never seen anythin' like what you were askin' about. Do you have any more specific information at all? I might be able to think of somethin' if I knew a little more," she says. The sun goddess' eyes shoot open in surprise, and she turns to [pc.isCunning |look toward your dullahan companion, but not directly at her |look toward your dullahan companion ]. "Fantastic! So it was a person after all!" she shouts, [pc.isCunning |blindly ]reaching out and patting her hands on Tui's shoulders. The harrowed pallor disappears from her face, replaced by an excited determination. She smiles confidently as she pats all the way down Atugia's sides and then back up to her shoulders. "U-um, wait. It's me?" Atugia asks. "Look, I'm strong I guess, but how can I fight somethin' that gives a god trouble? It'll tear me apart as soon as it sees me!" "That's just it! It can't see you! I can't explain it, but something about you is blocking its attempts to detect or even affect you. Can you even see it's miasma filling the palace? Or feel it sapping your essence?" the goddess refutes. "Miasma? I noticed [pc.name] looked a little sick, but I figured [pc.heShe] was just worried about the monster. Is that really what's happening?" "It is, but by the sun it won't be for long," Lumia replies. She turns to you again, all light and confidence once more. "If you need to prepare yourself, this is the time. I can hold it off longer now that we have the upper hand, but it's still not completely foolproof. Gather what you need and meet me here, if you've anything left to gather," she says.

rows.raw: " You descend the steps once again, relieved to find the entryway to Lumia's inner sanctum as yet free of miasma. Lumia is still here, though looking quite haggard compared to your previous sighting. She looks relieved to see you, turning and leaning on her sword for support. "I brought someone from the castle. She didn't really know anything, but she had some questions," you explain. Lumia raises an eyebrow, and looks like she's about to speak when Tui talks first. "U-um, that's me, miss sun goddess. I've lived in Castle Hawkstone almost my full life, and I've never seen anythin' like what you were askin' about. Do you have any more specific information at all? I might be able to think of somethin' if I knew a little more," she says. The sun goddess' eyes shoot open in surprise, and she turns to [pc.isCunning |look toward your dullahan companion, but not directly at her |look toward your dullahan companion ]. "Fantastic! So it was a person after all!" she shouts, [pc.isCunning |blindly ]reaching out and patting her hands on Tui's shoulders. The harrowed pallor disappears from her face, replaced by an excited determination. She smiles confidently as she pats all the way down Atugia's sides and then back up to her shoulders. "U-um, wait. It's me?" Atugia asks. "Look, I'm strong I guess, but how can I fight somethin' that gives a god trouble? It'll tear me apart as soon as it sees me!" "That's just it! It can't see you! I can't explain it, but something about you is blocking its attempts to detect or even affect you. Can you even see it's miasma filling the palace? Or feel it sapping your essence?" the goddess refutes. "Miasma? I noticed [pc.name] looked a little sick, but I figured [pc.heShe] was just worried about the monster. Is that really what's happening?" "It is, but by the sun it won't be for long," Lumia replies. She turns to you again, all light and confidence once more. "If you need to prepare yourself, this is the time. I can hold it off longer now that we have the upper hand, but it's still not completely foolproof. Gather what you need and meet me here, if you've anything left to gather," she says.\ "

rows.translation: 怪物

rows.original: "So what exactly is this thing we're fighting? Can you give us any more information?" you ask. "I can try," she says, thinking on it for a few moments. "Beyond this door is my inner sanctum. It's hard to describe the room without having seen it, but we will be descending a flight of stairs. Contained within is a Wraith, or at least part of one. We Seven destroyed most of the Wraiths during the Godswar, but some smaller ones slipped through the cracks. I have kept this one contained in the hopes that it might be possible to find a way to restore the souls it devoured and allow them to pass on." Her fists clench and a cloud of unease settles over her face. "I now fear this was a mistake," "I've found no such method since the end of the war, and this creature has grown more powerful in the intervening years. I cannot slay it alone, and I hesitate to call the rest of my brethren. If it were to feast on even one of us it might become too powerful for all of us. The very thought of a Wraith absorbing a godly spark shakes me to my core. No, it can only be with your help." "I cannot tell you exactly what you will experience once we get started, because I cannot know," she explains with a shake of her head. "It will still be a battle of some kind, but it may not be the kind you're used to. It could very well take the form of a battle from ancient history, but it could just as easily be an argument with an angered colleague, or a childhood game, or some vein of social gathering. Just know that whatever the form it takes, you must win. It is up to you to beat this thing in whatever guise it assumes. In that moment of shock, I can solidify its form long enough for the final blow to be dealt." That at least answers your question. If this sanctum is where the creature is contained, can you assume the miasma will be even stronger there? "It will, but once I link our minds you shouldn't need to worry about it. I can still repel it from within you. For the first few moments it will be heavier than anywhere else, but after that you will be free of it. Forever, with any luck."
rows.translation: 那么，我们究竟在对抗什么？你能告诉我们更多相关信息吗？”你问道。 “我可以试着解释，”她想了想后说道，“在这扇门的后面，是我的私人空间。如果不亲眼看到那个房间，确实很难描述它的样子，但我们需要先下一段楼梯才能到达那里。 其中封印着一只怨灵，或者至少是它的部分。在神战期间，我们七人摧毁了大部分怨灵，但有些较小的怨灵还是逃过了我们的追捕。我将这只怨灵封印起来，是希望能找到办法，让它吞食的那些灵魂得以重获自由，让它们得以安息。她的拳头紧握在手中，脸上浮现出一丝不安。“我现在担心，这可能是个错误。 自战争结束以来，我始终没有找到这样的方法，而在这几年里，这种生物的实力更是不断增强。我独自一人根本无法消灭它，也不愿意召集其他同伴前来帮忙。如果让它吞噬了我们中的任何一个人，它的力量可能会变得强大到让我们所有人都无法应对。一想到有这样的存在吞噬掉一位神圣的存在，我就感到不寒而栗。不，只有得到你的帮助，我们才有可能成功。 我无法确切地告诉你们，当我们开始行动之后会遇到什么，因为我也无从知晓，”她摇着头解释道，“这仍然会是一场战斗，但可能不是你们习惯的那种战斗。它可能会以古代历史中的战斗形式出现，但也可能只是一场与愤怒同事的争执，或者是一场童年游戏，又或者是一些社交活动。总之，无论它以何种形式出现，你们都必须…… 获胜能否击败这个怪物，完全取决于你——无论它以何种形态出现。在那一瞬间，我能够让它保持固定的形态，从而让你能够给予致命一击。” 这至少回答了你的问题。如果这个圣所就是关押这个怪物的地方，那么可以推测，那里的瘴气一定会更加浓烈吧？ 它会发生的，但一旦我将我们的意识连接起来，你就无需再为此担心了。我仍然可以从你的内心将其驱除。在最初的那一刻，这种感觉会比其他任何时候都要强烈，但之后你就会彻底摆脱它。只要运气好的话，这种状态会永远持续下去。"

rows.translation: 宫殿

rows.original:
Will you need to worry about the rest of the palace during the battle? It's not all going to come crashing down from the shock of destroying this thing, is it?
        
        "Ha! Heavens no. This castle's foundation is strong, and its walls are stronger. Even this strong of a monster can't bring it down. I'm not worried about that. Once the Wraith is gone, you can see the castle in it's true splendor. Right now it's a shadow of itself, drained to a sad state by the creature's miasma. In its prime the castle shines like the sun itself." 
        
        That's good to hear. You're glad you won't have to worry about a repeat of your encounter with the lureling.
rows.translation:
在战斗期间，你还需要担心宫殿的其他部分吗？破坏了这个东西，难道整个宫殿就会因此倒塌吗？

“哈！天哪，不可能。这座城堡的地基非常坚固，墙壁也更加结实。 就连这么强大的怪物也无法将它摧毁。我并不担心这个。一旦那个幽灵消失，你们就能看到这座城堡真正的辉煌模样。现在，它只不过是它过去的影子罢了——被那个生物释放出的瘴气侵蚀得变得凄惨不堪。 在它的鼎盛时期，这座城堡简直就像太阳一样闪耀。”

听到这个消息真是太好了。你肯定很高兴，因为再也不用担心会遇到那种诱人的怪物了。

rows.original: "[etheryn.lnhConfidence |U-um, It's probably kind of stupid to ask, b-but |This might be a dumb question, but |I'm sure it's on everyone's mind, but ] what makes us so special compared to your host of valkyries? Why are we the ones you need?" Ryn asks. "[etheryn.highConfidence |Then let me answer for everyone, |It's not stupid, and there's a very good answer, ]" Lumia says, reaching out to place a finger on the Elven [ryn.crowned |queen's |princess's ] chest, just above her heart. "Each of you has the kind of mortal fire that confounds a monster like this utterly. How do you think a being from beyond space reacts to a concept like 'A bad hair day'," the goddess continues, twirling a lock of Etheryn's hair between her fingers. "I'll tell you. It baffles them! The more they try to understand it the more solid they get, and that's when they're most vulnerable. Your mortality is your strongest weapon in this battle[party.has agni |. relatively speaking, of course, in some of your cases ]." "Really? Is it as simple as giving this thing a bad hair day?" Ryn asks, astounded. Lumia laughs, smiling at the thought. "Sadly it's not that simple. That was a rather basic example. My intention for you all is to show this thing what it means to lose, so that the concept of defeat is so understood that it becomes destructible. In that moment of hesitation, our combined efforts will destroy it for good," the sunlit lady answers. "O-oh! Of course. That actually sounds like it's going to work[etheryn.lowConfidence |, so long as we can beat it. |. ]" "[etheryn.lowConfidence |You can, and will, and y |Y ]es! It's going to work. We will see this castle restored to its full glory."

"[azzy.kdb
            |What about your valkyries? Why aren't they here to help?

            |But where are your valkyries!? Can't they come help us too?
        ]" Azzy asks.
        
        "A good question, but unfortunately it has grown difficult for them to even approach the castle anymore. The miasma affects them more than most, and weighs down on them so greatly that it would be impossible for them to make it this far, let alone into the sanctum.         ]"

rows.original:
"So why can't I just smash this thing into a pulp with my hammer? I get that it's probably pretty huge and this nasty gloom would probably make fightin' a bitch, but that's never stopped me before! I bet I could find its head, or maybe you all could find its head! Then I could take it out with one good hit if I was empowered with your godstuff," Arona grins. It's a surprisingly valid question, all things considered. Why not an empowered physical strike?
        
        "Unfortunately, it's not as easy as that in this case. That might actually work if this were a lesser wraith, but as of now this one is rapidly approaching my level of power. It would merely yield to your blow like the darkness itself. It would not be harmed, and it would likely return your blows with greater force," Lumia replies. "Even with my power, it would be like [silly
            |punching a boulder and expecting it to break
            |punching a mountain with your bare fist
        ]."
        
        "Shit... So that means this thing is like a ghost. Fuck it, we can do it your way then. I'm sure we can fuck it up from inside it's brain."
        
        "I like your attitude. After you're finished inside it will be quite satisfying to watch this thing burn away in the sun's light," Lumia finishes, clenching her fists in excitement. Arona nods, satisfied with the answer and looking ready to smash [silly
            |some metaphysical mumbo jumbo
            |a Wraith from the inside
        ].

“可惜，在这种情况下，事情并没有那么简单。 如果面对的是一个实力较弱的怨灵，这种方法或许确实有效，但眼下这个怨灵的实力正在迅速接近我的水平。它只会像黑暗本身一样，被你的攻击所击中，而不会受到任何伤害，甚至很可能会以更强的力量反击你的攻击，”卢米娅回答道。 即便拥有我的力量，也依然无济于事…… [silly

rows.original:
"I know this might not be the best time, but do you know anythin' about why I'm shrouded like this? I can't think of anythin' that I would have done to cause it. I was attacked by some kind of monster when I was younger, and at that time I thought it might be a Wraith since it was around the time of the Godswar, but it didn't look at all like how this thing sounds," Atugia asks, her voice steeped in curiosity.
        
        "Fascinating. Unfortunately I can't begin to tell you. To be honest if not for this greater threat it might disconcert me greatly. Perhaps if you ask again after this conflict is over, we can try to puzzle it out. Whatever this thing that did this to you is, I would very much like to know."
        
        "O-oh. I think I can do that. Do you have any idea what the extent of it is? Like how far can I go with it before this thing would notice me?"
        
        "Well, you're blotted out from my divine senses," Lumia says, waving a hand in front of her eyes. "But I can see you with this manifested body. Without this I think I would be completely blind to your presence. Any extraworldly being should be equally affected, and your immunity to the Wraiths miasma confirms this for me. As to your second question, I think you could do anything that doesn't involve direct touch. That shouldn't be a problem while it's occupied by our efforts. We'll do the hard work. You just focus on you, so you can come see me afterwards."
        
        "I see! Th-thank you! I will," Tui says, nodding furiously.
rows.translation:
我知道现在可能不是最好的时机，但你知道我为什么会变成这样的吗？我想不通自己究竟做了什么才会导致这种结果。在我年轻的时候，有某种怪物袭击了我，当时我觉得那可能是一只‘怨灵’，因为那正好发生在‘神战’期间，但它的样子和现在这个完全不一样啊……”阿图吉亚带着充满好奇的声音问道。
        
        真是太迷人了……可惜我现在还无法向你解释清楚。说实话，如果不是因为这个更大的威胁存在，这件事可能会让我感到非常不安。也许等这场冲突结束之后，如果你再问我一次，我们可以试着一起弄明白这个谜团。无论是什么东西对你做了这种事，我都非常想知道。
        
        哦……我想我应该能做到。你知道这个任务的难度大概有多大吗？也就是说，在它注意到我之前，我最多能推进到什么程度？”

“嗯，你的存在已经被我的神觉屏蔽掉了，”卢米娅一边说，一边在眼前挥了挥手。 但是有了这个具现化的身体，我才能看到你。如果没有它，我想我根本无法察觉到你的存在。任何来自外宇宙的存在都应该会受到同样的影响，而你对那些‘幽灵迷雾’的免疫力也证明了这一点。 至于你的第二个问题，我认为只要不涉及直接接触，你可以做任何事情。只要我们齐心协力，这应该不会成为问题。我们会承担所有的辛苦工作，你只需要专注于自己的事情，之后再来找我就可以了。"
        
        我明白了！谢谢您！我一定会做的，”涂伊激动地点了点头说道。

She sets herself stoically and reaches out to pat [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace|Atugia|you] on the shoulder. [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |"Uh, not to sound[atugia.isBimbo |, like, ] terrified or anything, but what do I do?[flags.LUMIA_SANCTUM_TALK_TUI | I kinda forgot to ask before, ]" the smaller woman asks, glancing nervously at the door. "First of all, banish that worry. You have the least to fear of any of us here. Beyond this door is the first portion of my inner sanctum. The monster was originally sealed deeper, and away from such places, but as it grew larger I required more space to contain it. Eventually this was the only place I had left. What I need you to do is to find the shattered pieces of the blade I tried to kill him with. It was the only way I could think to finish him off. The sword had a part in bringing low one of the mightiest Wraiths during the Godswar, so I thought it might be enough to finish this one off..." The goddess winces, trailing off mid sentence before gathering herself again. "He broke it before I had the chance to stab him. That's where you come in, you wonderful creature! Find the pieces of the sword, or even just the tip, and drive it into his form when we solidify it enough to do so. I'll take care of the rest," she says. Atugia still looks a little shaken, but she nods with more resolve than she had before. Lumia turns to you next. ] "A warning to [party.solo |you |the rest of you ]. Be safe. Take the utmost caution when dealing with anything in the dream realm. Only strike when you're sure you know what you'll hit. I don't know if it will be able to adapt in my world, but I shudder at the thought." With that final declaration, Lumia punches a fist into her free hand. It seems impossible to be ready for the task at hand, but you grip your [pc.weapon] and steel yourself. [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |[atugia.fucked |Atugia walks up next to you, lacing her fingers through yours and squeezing your hand, and [party.som |you squeeze right back. |[companion1.name] takes your other hand. |your companions surround you with supportive grips. ] |[party.som |Atugia walks up beside you, prepping herself as best she can. |[companion1.name] takes your hand in a show of solidarity. |your companions link hands with you in a show of solidarity. ] ] |[party.som |You prepare yourself alongside the goddess of light. |[companion1.name] takes your hand in a show of solidarity. |Your companions link hands with you in a show of solidarity. ] ] Whatever happens, you'll face this together. "Good! Let's kill a monster!" Lumia shouts, her face a mask of fiery determination. She strides to the edge and throws the door open with conviction. You brace immediately, but when nothing happens you follow her through the door. It takes a moment for your eyes to adjust to the miasmic darkness, but when you do, your fear is momentarily replaced with open mouthed awe. The door opens directly into a vast room decorated in exquisite marble and gold. Royal blue tapestries hang from every wall around a massive gold and glass sphere in the center. Within the glass, an impossibly bright strand of pure light coils and dances in a wavy line. A euphoric rainbow of colors condenses itself into the swirl, filling you with inner peace at a mere glance. Around the strand, three balls of an even brighter but infinitely more terrifying light dance erratically, fending off a cloud of utter darkness and unchecked malice that is trying its best to pierce the glass. Where the giant wisps touch it, the shade scatters with an otherworldly howl. You find it hard to focus on anything in the room except the light in the glass, and when you turn away from it the miasma of the beast threatens to drop you to the floor. [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |Atugia, luckily, doesn't seem to share this affliction. She stares horrified for a moment at the being of smoke and evil, but then glances around the room before her eyes alight on something on the floor. Over the din of humming glass, she raises her voice. "I see a shard of the sword! I think so anyway. Are you sure it's safe!?" she shouts. Lumia nods, and Tui takes a few tentative steps down one of two flights of stairs leading down from the balcony you've entered the room upon. When nothing happens, she dashes off deeper into the room, and the visual pollution renders you unable to focus on her. ] Lumia puts a hand on your shoulder, and offers a strained smile. "Worry not. We will succeed this day. We have to," she says, striding up to the edge of the balcony and pulling her sword from its sheath. The noise rings in the air, and you watch as the shadowy cloud that had been swarming around the glass sphere pauses. It's not as if it is simply at rest. Even creatures that stop consciously moving sway slightly or show other tells. This monster looks so still that it's as if time itself stops for a moment. And then two slitted eyes open on the side facing you, and two more, and more until the thing is covered in pricks of smoldering hate. You grit your teeth, and Lumia turns to say something to you. In that moment, the thing pounces. An impossible amount of darkness spreads from the cloud, and in the space of a blink you can no longer see Lumia or any of your friends. You feel cold, alone, and worried about whether this gamble was worth taking. And then, before you can sink too deep into that pit of despair, you hear something. A faint noise, somewhere between a heartbeat, a strange ticking, and the tinkle of sand in an hourglass. It's an oddly comforting noise, but you can't place a reason for it. Trying to follow the noise with your ears, you find your eyes adjusting to the nothingness. At least, that's the only way you can describe it at first. It feels more like what you're starting to see is coming into place around you. It starts off fuzzy, like your eyes are full of [silly |spooge |grime ], but then you feel a sudden lurch and everything just snaps into place.

The monster was originally sealed deeper, and away from such places, but as it grew larger I required more space to contain it. Eventually this was the only place I had left. What I need you to do is to find the shattered pieces of the blade I tried to kill him with. It was the only way I could think to finish him off. The sword had a part in bringing low one of the mightiest Wraiths during the Godswar, so I thought it might be enough to finish this one off..." The goddess winces, trailing off mid sentence before gathering herself again. "He broke it before I had the chance to stab him. That's where you come in, you wonderful creature! Find the pieces of the sword, or even just the tip, and drive it into his form when we solidify it enough to do so. I'll take care of the rest," she says. Atugia still looks a little shaken, but she nods with more resolve than she had before. Lumia turns to you next. ] "A warning to [party.solo |you |the rest of you ]. Be safe. Take the utmost caution when dealing with anything in the dream realm. Only strike when you're sure you know what you'll hit. I don't know if it will be able to adapt in my world, but I shudder at the thought." With that final declaration, Lumia punches a fist into her free hand. It seems impossible to be ready for the task at hand, but you grip your [pc.weapon] and steel yourself. [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |[atugia.fucked |Atugia walks up next to you, lacing her fingers through yours and squeezing your hand, and [party.som |you squeeze right back. |[companion1.name] takes your other hand. |your companions surround you with supportive grips. ] |[party.som |Atugia walks up beside you, prepping herself as best she can. |[companion1.name] takes your hand in a show of solidarity. |your companions link hands with you in a show of solidarity. ] ] |[party.som |You prepare yourself alongside the goddess of light. |[companion1.name] takes your hand in a show of solidarity. |Your companions link hands with you in a show of solidarity. ] ] Whatever happens, you'll face this together. "Good! Let's kill a monster!" Lumia shouts, her face a mask of fiery determination. She strides to the edge and throws the door open with conviction. You brace immediately, but when nothing happens you follow her through the door. It takes a moment for your eyes to adjust to the miasmic darkness, but when you do, your fear is momentarily replaced with open mouthed awe. The door opens directly into a vast room decorated in exquisite marble and gold. Royal blue tapestries hang from every wall around a massive gold and glass sphere in the center. Within the glass, an impossibly bright strand of pure light coils and dances in a wavy line. A euphoric rainbow of colors condenses itself into the swirl, filling you with inner peace at a mere glance. Around the strand, three balls of an even brighter but infinitely more terrifying light dance erratically, fending off a cloud of utter darkness and unchecked malice that is trying its best to pierce the glass. Where the giant wisps touch it, the shade scatters with an otherworldly howl. You find it hard to focus on anything in the room except the light in the glass, and when you turn away from it the miasma of the beast threatens to drop you to the floor. [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |Atugia, luckily, doesn't seem to share this affliction. She stares horrified for a moment at the being of smoke and evil, but then glances around the room before her eyes alight on something on the floor. Over the din of humming glass, she raises her voice. "I see a shard of the sword! I think so anyway. Are you sure it's safe!?" she shouts. Lumia nods, and Tui takes a few tentative steps down one of two flights of stairs leading down from the balcony you've entered the room upon. When nothing happens, she dashes off deeper into the room, and the visual pollution renders you unable to focus on her. ] Lumia puts a hand on your shoulder, and offers a strained smile. "Worry not. We will succeed this day. We have to," she says, striding up to the edge of the balcony and pulling her sword from its sheath. The noise rings in the air, and you watch as the shadowy cloud that had been swarming around the glass sphere pauses. It's not as if it is simply at rest. Even creatures that stop consciously moving sway slightly or show other tells. This monster looks so still that it's as if time itself stops for a moment. And then two slitted eyes open on the side facing you, and two more, and more until the thing is covered in pricks of smoldering hate. You grit your teeth, and Lumia turns to say something to you. In that moment, the thing pounces. An impossible amount of darkness spreads from the cloud, and in the space of a blink you can no longer see Lumia or any of your friends. You feel cold, alone, and worried about whether this gamble was worth taking. And then, before you can sink too deep into that pit of despair, you hear something. A faint noise, somewhere between a heartbeat, a strange ticking, and the tinkle of sand in an hourglass. It's an oddly comforting noise, but you can't place a reason for it. Trying to follow the noise with your ears, you find your eyes adjusting to the nothingness. At least, that's the only way you can describe it at first. It feels more like what you're starting to see is coming into place around you. It starts off fuzzy, like your eyes are full of [silly |spooge |grime ], but then you feel a sudden lurch and everything just snaps into place. "

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: You find yourself inside a carriage, or what looks like one, and you can feel it moving steadily forward. [party.som |You're completely alone, though the carriage looks like it would have room for four. |[companion1.name] is right across from you, looking about as groggy as you feel. |your companions are on the seat across from you, looking about as groggy as you feel. ] The windows are covered by beautifully patterned curtains, but pulling them aside only reveals a cold blackness that obscures everything. You let them fall back into place, trying to listen to the roll of the wheels to sense what the ground is like. [party.som |You |Both of you |All three of you ] wait in anticipation for something to change, and therefore manage to not be caught off guard when the carriage jerks to a stop. Before you have time to check the window again, the side door pops open, listing slowly till it bumps the side of the carriage. The space outside is still dark, but you can plainly see the stone and earth ground of a courtyard and the flickering lights of many torches. Gripping your weapon, you step out of the carriage[party.som |. | with [companion1.name] in tow. | with your friends in tow. ] Once outside, you can't help but drop your guard. You know this place... Rising above you, stark and alone against an otherwise pitch dark skyscape, are the towers and walls of Castle Hawkstone. A number of other carriages are rolling through the courtyard, though it looks like you're the last guests to be deposited. You see four or five other people making their way toward the castle, but you can't really make out a lot of specifics at this distance. Looking back to your carriage doesn't help much, as it's already begun rolling off toward the black expanse beyond the gates. You can't catch a good look at the driver at all. [party.comp agnimitra arona azyrran brint brienne cait etheryn kiyoko quin viviane |"What is this? I didn't think the goddess was being so literal when she said it could be anything. Isn't this that tower by Hawkethorne? What kind of conflict could take place here, a siege?" Agnimitra asks, staying guarded. You don't know, but you suppose you'll find out. |"Shit. This place is [silly |ghost central, hundo P. |definitely full of ghosts. ] This fight better be an exorcism," Arona grumbles. The people walking up to the castle don't exactly seem like the dangerous kind of ghost yet, but you're glad to have Arona to rely on should they turn violent. |"Is this not the place you live? Or at least the castle above the town? I don't like how dark it all looks, like seeing the place in a nightmare," Azzy says, rubbing her chitinous hands on her shoulders. At least from here it looks like things are a little less dark on the inside. You can see lights flickering in the windows and through the open main doors. |"If this is some kind of illusion, how can we be sure our weapons still work?" Brint asks, toying with the haft of his axe. You hope it doesn't come to that, but based on what Lumia said you refuse to assume the worst. |"I don't like this. It's like a dark reflection of what we know," Brienne says, toying with the haft of her axe and gripping your hand. You give it a brief squeeze. At least it looks like there's some light inside, if nothing else. Hopefully it's coming from something nice. |"[pc.name]! That's Castle Hawkstone! Did she recreate the whole thing with magic? Or is this a construct of the Wraiths? Can they do that? How would it even have this information?" Cait asks, gripping your arm as she looks about the castle grounds. You don't have an exact answer for any of those questions, but hopefully you can find at least something inside. |"[etheryn.lowConfidence |T-t |T ]hat's Castle Hawkstone! I've seen these walls, but how? It looks so real. Do you think the battle will be a social gathering after all? I think I see boreal elves in that procession, though. What could it be?" Ryn says, puzzling over the strange landscape. She does have a point, and hopefully you'll be able to find out sooner rather than later. |"This place is somewhat like my home, though perhaps on a larger scale. If the goddess is creating it I think we should focus on finding our target. The sooner we do, the sooner we get out of this dream world," Kiyoko says. Her matter-of-fact tone accompanies a brief smile and a narrow focused look toward the castle. She's right. The sooner you seek out that monster, the better. |"Do you think we're just standing still outside this illusion? If that's what it even is... Protecting the mind like this is definitely god level stuff," Quin says. That's an interesting point. What is going on out there? You wonder if it's like he hypothesized, or if Lumia is fighting what amounts to that shadow creature's physical form. |"This... This is powerful. There isn't even a hint of falsehood. I know we aren't really here, but even so it feels real right to my core," Viv says. She's right. Even if this is some sort of illusion, it feels like you've been transported to it wholesale rather than just in your mind. ] Not wanting to linger behind any longer, you join in at the end of the procession that's headed toward the castle gates. You're the last person in, and though there's no one at the gates, they still close behind you. The ominous courtyard and all its shadows are left behind once you've all moved inside the castle. You take a brief moment to look around before following the still moving end of the trail of visitors. From the inside, sconces of candles and lanterns illuminate the halls, still casting shadows but with much less ghastly an appearance. The place is certainly still creepy, and everything seems muted compared to the real world. At the same time, though, the castle looks immaculately maintained. There's not a tear in any of the fabrics, and not a speck of dust in the cracks on the floor or on the side tables. The short entryway leads into a larger room you can hear hushed conversations from. Just before you make it through the door, you spot a glint of metal in the grass beside it. You stretch down, carefully pushing the grass aside and picking up an oddly shaped shard of metal. One piece of it holds a sharpened edge, but the rest is just a broken chunk. Could this be a fragment of a sword? It seems oddly out of place here regardless, so you stow it in your pocket, and continue on your way. Following the last person inside, you emerge into an open dining hall, packed row to row with tables of food and drink both exotic and familiar. Bold lighting suffuses the room, bright enough for you to see a higher balcony that surrounds the room from above. Several hanging art pieces adorn the walls at the higher and lower portions of the room, and audacious statues of adventurers sit beside the doors. No one stops to look at you as you enter, but you finally get a good look at the people you've been following inside.
rows.translation: 你发现自己身处一辆马车上，或者至少看起来像是一辆马车，你能感觉到它正在稳定地向前行驶。 [party.som |你完全是独自一人，尽管这辆马车看起来似乎可以容纳四个人。 |[companion1.name] 它就就在你对面，看起来也和你一样昏昏沉沉的。 |你的同伴们就坐在你对面，他们的神情和你一样，显得昏昏沉沉的。 ] 窗户上挂着图案精美的窗帘，但当你将它们拉开时，映入眼帘的只有那片冰冷的黑暗，一切都隐藏在其中。你又将窗帘拉上，试图通过车轮滚动的声音来判断地面的状况。 [party.som |你 |你们两个 |你们三个 ] 你满心期待着某种变化会发生，因此当马车突然停住时，你并没有感到措手不及。还没等你有时间再次看向窗外，侧门就已经缓缓打开了，然后缓缓地滑到马车的一侧。外面的天仍然很黑，但你可以清楚地看到院子里铺着的石板和泥土，以及许多火把闪烁着微弱的光芒。你紧握着手中的武器，走出了马车。[party.som |. | 与……一起 [companion1.name] 一同前往。 | 带着你的朋友们一起。 ] 一旦走到外面，你就忍不住会放松警惕。 你熟悉这个地方…… 高耸在你头顶之上，孤独地矗立在漆黑的夜空中，那就是霍克斯通城堡的塔楼和城墙。 其他几辆马车也正在穿过庭院，不过看起来你们应该是最后一批被送到的客人了。你看到还有四五个人正朝着城堡的方向走去，不过在这个距离上，你实在无法看清他们的具体模样。 回头看你的马车已经没什么用了，因为它已经开始朝着大门外的茫茫黑暗地带滚去。你根本无法清楚地看到马车夫的样子。 [party.comp agnimitra arona azyrran brint brienne cait etheryn kiyoko quin viviane |这是什么？我没想到女神说‘可以是任何东西’时是认真的。这不就是霍克索恩那座塔吗？这里可能会发生什么样的冲突？难道是围攻战吗？”阿格尼米特拉警惕地问道。你现在还不知道，但你应该会弄清楚的。 |该死，这个地方…… [silly |幽灵中心，一百个P。 |这里肯定有鬼魂出没。 ] 这场战斗简直就像是在驱邪一样，”阿罗娜抱怨道。那些走向城堡的人看起来并不像那种危险的幽灵，但有了阿罗娜在身边，如果你们遇到危险，至少还有可以依靠的人。 |这里不是你住的地方吗？至少应该是镇子上方的那座城堡吧？我觉得这里太暗了，看起来就像是在噩梦中看到的场景。”阿齐一边说，一边用她那层甲壳质的手掌揉着自己的肩膀。至少从这里看，里面的情况似乎没那么黑暗了——你可以看到窗户里和敞开的门缝中闪烁着灯光。 |如果这是一种幻觉，我们怎么才能确定我们的武器仍然能够正常使用呢？”布林特一边说着，一边摆弄着他的斧头柄。你当然希望事情不会发展到那种地步，但根据卢米娅所说的话，你也不愿意往最坏的方向去想。 |我不喜欢这样。这简直是我们所认知事物的阴暗面反映，”布蕾妮说着，一边摆弄着手中的斧头柄，一边握住你的手。你轻轻握了握她的手。 “至少里面似乎还透着一些光，虽然别的什么都没有。希望那光是来自一些美好的东西。 |"[pc.name]那就是霍克斯通城堡！她是用魔法重新建造了这一切吗？还是说这是幽灵们的杰作？它们真的有能力做到这种事吗？而且，它们怎么会掌握这些信息呢？”凯特一边说着，一边紧紧抓住你的手臂，环顾着城堡周围的景色。 对于这些问题，你并没有确切的答案，但希望至少能在城堡里找到一些线索。 |"[etheryn.lowConfidence |T-t |T ]这是霍克斯通城堡吧！我以前见过这些城墙，但怎么会这样呢？它们看起来太真实了……难道这场战斗最终会变成一场社交聚会吗？不过，我在那支队伍里似乎看到了北方精灵……这到底是怎么回事呢？”瑞恩一边说着，一边困惑地打量着这片奇异的景象。 她的猜测确实有道理，希望你能尽快弄清楚真相。 |这个地方有点像我的家，只不过规模要大一些。如果这是女神创造的，那么我们就应该尽快找到目标。越快找到目标，我们就能越早离开这个梦境世界。”清子说道。她说话时语气很平静，脸上带着一丝微笑，目光紧紧地盯着那座城堡。 她说得对。越快找到那个怪物，就越好。 |你认为我们只是站在这个幻象之外静止不动吗？如果真的只是这样的话……以这样的方式保护意识，绝对可以说是神级的能力了，”奎因说道。 这确实是个有趣的问题。外面到底发生了什么？你会怀疑是否真的如他所假设的那样，还是说卢米娅正在与那种阴影生物的实体形态进行战斗。 |这……这是…… 强大的这里没有任何虚假的痕迹。我知道我们其实并不真的在这里，但即便如此，这种感觉依然真实得让我无法抗拒，”薇芙说道。 她说得对。即使这一切只是一种幻觉，但这种体验给人的感觉却像是真的被带到了那个地方，而不仅仅是在脑海中产生了这样的想象。 ] 你不再想落后于任何人，于是便加入了那支朝着城堡大门前进的队伍。你是最后一个进入城堡的人，尽管大门前空无一人，它们还是在你身后关上了。一旦你们都进入了城堡，那个阴森可怖的庭院以及它所有的阴影就被抛在了身后。 你花了一点时间环顾四周，然后跟随那些仍在移动的游客队伍继续前行。从内部看，烛台和灯笼为走廊带来了照明，虽然仍然投下阴影，但整体氛围已经不再那么阴森恐怖了。 这个地方确实仍然让人感到毛骨悚然，与现实世界相比，一切看起来都显得如此沉闷、静止。不过，与此同时，这座城堡却维护得一丝不苟——没有任何织物的破损，地板的裂缝或边桌上也看不到一丝灰尘。 那条狭窄的入口通向一个更大的房间，在那里你可以听到人们低声交谈的声音。 就在你即将穿过那扇门的时候，你注意到门旁的草丛中有一闪而过的金属光芒。你弯下腰，小心翼翼地将草拨开，捡起了一块形状怪异的金属碎片。其中有一部分边缘被磨得十分锋利，而其余部分则只是一块破碎的金属块。这会不会是一把剑的残片呢？不管怎样，这块金属在这里显得格格不入，于是你把它放进了口袋，继续向前走去。 跟在最后一个人进入之后，你来到了一间宽敞的餐厅。那里摆满了一张张餐桌，上面摆着各种既陌生又熟悉的美食和饮品。明亮的灯光照亮了整个房间，甚至让你能够看到上方环绕着这个餐厅的阳台。 房间的上下两侧的墙壁上挂着几件悬挂艺术作品，门边则摆放着一些大胆设计的冒险者雕像。当你走进去时，没有人会停下来看你，但终于，你有机会仔细观察那些你一直在跟踪的人。

I ambushed you after training and then followed you to a meal. [pc.isBimbo |Oh gosh. I'm just as bad as your fans, aren't I? |You did ask, but still ]. Maybe I'll take you up on that offer to talk." "Good! I'd like that. I don't get enough time to just talk to people I meet," she says with a final smile. You leave through the door with her behind you, and part ways in the mess hall. It'll be a bit before she's finished with her bath, but it's good to know you'll be able to meet her in the future.
rows.translation: 当你走进训练室去寻找卢米娅提到的那个半巨人格蕾塔时，你注意到其中一个较大的障碍训练场入口处有一阵喧闹。大约有十几名年轻的瓦尔基里围在入口处，争先恐后地想要往里面看。她们试图压低声音交谈，但显然根本无法让彼此听清对方在说什么。尽管你听不太清楚她们在说什么，但还是捕捉到了一些关键信息。 哇！”有人说道。 “你看到刚才那一幕了吗！？”另一个人问道。 “她太酷了！”第三个人插话道。 “真的，你确定看到刚才那一幕了吗！？” 如果那个房间里的其他人都在这么兴奋地讨论，那你不妨去看看发生了什么吧。 如果恰好就是你在寻找的那个人，那就再好不过了。队伍边缘的那些年轻实习生注意到了你，便稍微分开让路让你通过，尽管他们之前还表现得非常热情，但现在却向你表达了出人意料的尊重，同时也保持了一定的距离。 当然，一旦你通过了他们，他们又会开始为争夺更好的位置而争吵。你径直穿过他们因为害羞而不敢进入的那扇门，然后就来到了障碍赛道的起点平台。 这个课程结合了飞行与移动技巧的设计，设置了多种会让人绊倒的装置以及会摆动的木桶，无论参与者处于什么位置，都难以避开这些障碍。在飞行环节中，还会有一些横杆和经过打磨的木制障碍物，这些障碍物会让人误以为有足够的空间可以飞行通过。 [pc.hasWings |你知道，尽管看起来通道很宽，但实际上要沿着那样的路线前进其实相当困难。 |不过，你并没有实际的经验，所以也许这件事比看起来要困难得多。 ] 这个房间的宽度大概有五十英尺，沿着长度方向延伸大约四十英尺后开始弯曲，因此你无法看到它尽头的全部宽度。你能看到的是那些新手们正在目不转睛地观看的景象——在课程中那些以飞行训练为主的训练区域里，正有一个你之前在安妮卡的仪式上见过的巨型精灵女子，那就是瑟鲁德。 尽管她的体型庞大，但她却能轻松自如地穿过那些间隙。她那巨大而闪烁的翅膀灵活地展开与收起，使她能够毫无阻碍地穿过那些环状障碍，然后迅速落在地面的各个区域。 当她完成那个精彩的落地动作时，身后响起了一片轻声的欢呼与充满敬畏的惊叹声。她站立时的姿态同样令人印象深刻——她敏捷地穿过那些摇摆的木块，然后又翻滚着穿过那两根悬挂着的原木。 一种坚不可摧的决心指引着她迈出的每一步；那些障碍甚至连她的战斗服边缘都碰不到。她并非优雅地避开它们，而是将每一步都走得如同黑暗过后必然出现的阳光一般坚定而不可阻挡。 她反应迅速，轻松避开了每一个障碍，仿佛那些障碍根本不存在一样。 然后，她又重复了这个过程，这次是针对另一个飞行段落以及最后一个地面段落。最终，她略带喘息地走到了你所在的那个平台上。她花了一秒钟才注意到你，但当她看到你时，她的整个脸都绽放出了笑容。 啊！你就是那个参加安妮促销活动的人吧！就是你让我们的女神重新焕发了光彩！”她说道。 虽然你实际上只是和她短暂地见过面，但听到她还记得你，还是让人感到很高兴的。 “是的！”你回答道。 [pc.dcb |那就是我！ |不过，请你理解，我只是在做我认为正确的事情而已。 |[silly |他们叫我“让阳光重新绽放的人”！ |我也愿意再做这一千一百次！ ] ] 你总是这么受欢迎吗？”你边问边望着周围的人群。 瑟拉德顺着你的视线，看了看那些聚集在她周围、目瞪口呆的围观者——你发誓，现在这里的观众数量比你刚进来的时候还要多——她的笑容顿时变成了困惑的叹息。当那些围观者注意到她在看他们时，他们齐刷刷地…… 哎呀……随着他们散开，朝着几分钟前就应该去的方向走去，人们发出了“哎呀”等各种惊讶的声音。 “对此我感到很抱歉，但我实在不忍心让他们离开。毕竟他们终于有了一件让他们开心的事情。 顺便说一下，我叫Thrud！之前在祝贺Anni的时候，我竟然没有自我介绍，真是太不好意思了，”她说道。她语气中的如释重负显而易见，当她伸出手来与你握手时，你才真正仔细地打量起了她。 这位女武神在她的姐妹们中显得格外高挑和出众。 [pc.heightRange 0 86 |你也一样。 |事实上，他的身高仍然比你高很多。 ]她的个子至少有十英尺高，具体数值可能上下浮动几英寸，身上散发着强烈的力量感。她的每一处肌肉都在微微颤动，至少是那些没有被她穿着的训练装备遮盖起来的部位。当她脱掉那些额外的护具，将它们挂在门边那些用来悬挂类似服装的挂钩上时，你就能更清楚地看到她的体型了。 这套服装朴素无华，但却展现出一种出人意料的女性魅力，它的长度甚至能够遮盖她的胫部。 “你需要什么吗？我现在的训练已经结束了，”她说。她拿过一条毛巾，擦了擦脸，然后把毛巾扔进篮子里，同时摇晃着自己的黑发，让它们变得蓬松起来。 "[pc.dcb |其实并不是这样。我只是因为在之前见过你，所以想进一步了解你而已。 |没什么特别的。只是在安妮卡的仪式上见到你之后，我想更深入地了解你一些。 |哦不！我从来不会计划什么，我唯一想做的就是去关爱别人！在见到你之后，我只是想更好地了解你而已。 [silly |[annika.kissed |我的胡言乱语 |安妮卡的 ] |安妮卡的 ] 仪式。 ]你回复道。你选择没有提到是Lumia介绍你认识她的。 “哎呀！我真的很想更深入地了解你哦！我本来打算在去泡澡之前吃点东西，你愿意一起来吗？”她一边说，一边把一个包挂在肩上，那个包应该也能派上用场吧…… [pc.heightRange 0 69 |[silly |身体 |睡眠状态 ] 获得 |背包 ] 我觉得我记得食堂在哪儿，但不知道该坐在哪里。” “哈！别担心。你会比想象中更快适应这座宫殿的布局的。你来找我真是太好了，因为……”这位巨大的精灵尽可能谨慎地环顾四周，然后俯下身，用一只有你头那么大的手捂住你的耳朵，“我有一把私人餐厅的钥匙。[pc.dcb |是不是因为那些烦人的幼鸟一直跟着你到处跑？ |原来是这样，所以那些粉丝们都没有要求和你坐在一起吗？ |哈？你专门腾出一整个房间就为了和我一起吃饭！？你该不会是有什么超能力吧？ ]你问起来， [pc.isBimbo |兴奋地喘着气，蹦来跳去 |当你想象着她被那些大多身材比她矮小的同胞们围住的情景时，不禁会露出微笑。 ]. 特鲁德笑了，但随后摇了摇头。[pc.isBimbo |哈哈，才不是呢！我只是知道钥匙放在哪里而已。我在吃饭的时候喜欢安静的环境。 |不，哈哈，至少不是这样的。我只是喜欢在吃饭时享受宁静的环境，而私人房间确实能有效地隔绝大部分噪音。 ]你跟着她走出了训练室，穿过宽敞的主厅，一直来到杂物间厨房。其他一些女武神也停下来指指点点，但她的粉丝们并没有你想象中那么爱打扰别人。Thrud与其中一位厨师聊了一两分钟，然后带着你穿过那些摆满桌子的地方，来到一个墙壁上布满许多门的封闭式大厅。 她走到一扇高度足够让她无需弯腰就能通过的门前，从肩包里掏出一把厚实的金属钥匙，用它来打开门。门后是一个设计得很巧妙的房间，各种尺寸都考虑到了。 Thrud把几把椅子挪到一边，然后拉来一把较大的椅子，放在那把更适合你尺寸的椅子旁边。就在你们准备坐下的时候，门又开了。其中一位厨师拿进来了一整块烤野猪肉，还有几盘看起来像是煮熟的家禽。 片刻之后，另一人端着一份龙虾和煮蟹以及一小碗新鲜蔬菜走了进来。 Thrud立刻开始进食，她往自己的盘子里堆满了食物，但在实际进食时却总是拿非常少量的肉。她会仔细品尝每一口，然后再吃下一口。不过，对她来说，所谓的“少量”其实意味着整整一条龙虾尾。 你拿了一块家禽肉和一些蟹腿，把它们敲开，然后将热腾腾的肉蘸上盘子里附带的那碟黄油。一开始你还有些犹豫，但尝了一口之后，就忍不住想继续吃了。 [pc.bg noblescion |放下你那精致的礼仪，赶紧多吃点吧。 |把更多的东西塞进嘴里吧。 ]这些贝类就像面包一样吸收融化的黄油，它们的味道与黄油相得益彰。 “这些食物简直美味极了！女武神们平时也经常吃这样的东西吗？” “嗯……其实这些食材稍微加了点特别的调料，通常海鲜只是单纯的鱼而已。 我让他们给我准备个惊喜，因为我有客人来，但真没料到他们会准备鸭肉和海鲜。他们肯定是有多余的食材才准备的这些……不过我也不能抱怨！平时的食物也很不错！”她边说边吃着野猪肉，又用大叉子叉起一大份鸭肉。 你也尝了一小口，细细品味那味道，然后越吃越上瘾。 那个半巨女所说的噪音确实没错。在这个私人房间里，你只能听到 General Mess Hall 那边传来的隐隐约约的嘈杂声。 你安静地吃饭，等到食物全部吃完时，已经感到非常满足了。下次厨师们来查看你的情况时，他们会把盘子和餐具收回去清洗。于是，你又一次独自和Thrud待在一起，而她又一次向你露出了灿烂的笑容。 抱歉，我不太擅长聊天，”她边说边揉着后脑勺，“如果你以后想多聊聊天，我就在那个门上挂着狼头盾牌的房间里。” “没关系！训练结束后我故意埋伏了你，然后跟着你一起去吃了饭。 [pc.isBimbo |天啊，我其实和你的粉丝们一样糟糕，不是吗？ |你确实是问过了，但结果还是这样。 ]也许我会接受你的邀请，和你聊聊。” “太好了！我正希望如此。我平时根本没有足够的时间去和遇到的人聊天，”她最后微笑着说道。你跟着她走出了门，在食堂分道扬镳。虽然她还需要一段时间才能洗完澡，但知道未来还能再见到她，还是让人感到很高兴的。
rows.raw: " As you enter the training rooms to search for Thrud, the half-giantess Lumia mentioned, you spot a bit of commotion at the door to one of the larger obstacle courses. Ten-odd young valkyries are crowded around the entrance and trying to push past each other to see inside. They try to speak in what amounts to hushed tones, but the attempts fail spectacularly. You still can't catch much intelligible dialogue with them talking over each other, but you do catch a few things. "Whoa!" says one. "Did you see that!?" says another. "She's so cool!" chimes in a third. "No but really did you see that!?" If that room's occupant is causing such a fuss, you might as well check them out. On the odd chance it's who you're looking for then that's all the better. The young trainees at the edge of the group notice you and part a little bit to let you through, giving you surprisingly respectful nods and distance despite their previous fervor. Of course once you've passed they go back to bickering for better placement. You walk right on through the door they were too bashful to enter, and find yourself on the obstacle course's starting platform. This course is designed for a mix of flight and footwork, with several tripping contraptions and swinging barrels crafted to harry participants regardless of placement. The flying portions are interlaced with bars and polished wooden obstacles that give the appearance of having plenty of space to fly between. [pc.hasWings |You know it's a bit tougher than it looks to navigate like that, even if it looks wide. |You can't speak from experience, though, so perhaps it's harder than it looks. ] The room is maybe fifty feet wide, and curves around after about forty lengthwise so you can't see the full breadth of its end. What you can see is the spectacle the newbies are gawking at. Twisting and twirling through one of the flight-focused portions of the course is none other than the giant elf woman you saw at Annika's ceremony, Thrud. Despite her massive size, she's handling the gaps with deft ease. Her massive, shimmering wings appear and disappear fluidly, letting her drop untouched through the rings and hit the floor sections running. A chorus of quiet cheers and awe-inspired gasps rises behind you as she finishes a landing flourish. She's no less impressive on her feet, dashing through the swinging wood blocks and rolling through a pair of hanging logs. An impossibly stalwart determination guides her every step; the obstacles don't so much as graze the hem of her battle dress. Rather than dancing through them with grace, she makes every step like an inevitable ray of sun after a night of darkness. Without missing a beat, she avoids each obstacle like it isn't even there. She then repeats the process with another flight based section and one more ground section that ends with her stepping, slightly winded, onto the same platform you stand on. It takes her a second to notice you, but when she does her entire face lights up in a smile. "Ah! You're the one who was at Anni's promotion! The one who brought the sun back to our goddess's face!" she says. You'd only actually seen her briefly, but it's good to hear she remembers you. "Yes! [pc.dcb |That's me! |Please, though, I was just doing what felt right. |[silly |They call me the sun re-smilener! |I'd, like, do it a thousand hundred times again, too! ] ] Are you always this popular?" you reply, staring at the crowd. Thrud looks over your shoulder at the amassed gaggle of gawkers she's acquired (you swear there are more there now than when you walked in), and her smile turns to a bemused sigh. When they see her looking, the crowd offers a collective series of eep's and other surprised noises as they break up and head off to places they probably should've been minutes ago. "I'm sorry for that, but I can't bring myself to tell them to leave. Not since they finally have something to stay happy about. I'm Thrud, by the way! I never introduced myself when I was congratulating Anni, and I apologize," she says. The relief is evident in every facet of her manner, and as she holds out a hand to shake yours, you take a moment to actually look at her. The valkyrie towers over most of her sisters, and [pc.heightRange 0 86 |you for that matter |is still a fair bit taller than you for that matter ]. She's easily ten feet tall, give or take a few inches, and exudes raw power. Muscle ripples across every portion of her body, at least the parts left uncovered by the training gear she's wearing. You get an even better look as she removes the extra padding, placing it on a set of hooks near the door where similar outfits hang. Unadorned, the outfit that remains is a surprisingly feminine dress that provides coverage down to her shins. "Did you need something? I'm all done with training for now," she says. Taking a towel, she mops her face and deposits it in a basket, shaking her dark hair to ruffle it. "[pc.dcb |Not really. I just wanted to get to know you after seeing you before, |Nothing specific. I just wanted to get to know you better after seeing you at Annika's ceremony, |Oh no! I never plan anything except, like, loving people! I just wanted to get to know you after seeing you at [silly |[annika.kissed |my shnooky wookum's |Annika's ] |Annika's ] ceremony, ]" you reply. You elect not to mention Lumia sending you her way. "Aww! I'd love to get to know you better! I was about to grab a bite to eat before I hit the baths, would you care to join me?" she asks, hooking a satchel over her shoulder that would probably function as a [pc.heightRange 0 69 |[silly |body |sleeping ] bag |backpack ] for you. You'd love that as well, but she'll have to lead the way. "I think I remember where the mess hall is, but I have no idea where to sit." "Ha! Don't worry. You get used to the layout of the palace a lot faster than you would think. It's a good thing you came to me, because I..." The gigantic elf looks around as subtly as she can before leaning down and cupping your ear with a hand the size of your head, "have a key to one of the private dining rooms." "[pc.dcb |Is that because of all the annoying fledglings following you around? |Is that so the crowd of fans don't ask to sit with you? |Huh? You got a whole room just to eat with me!? Are you psychic? ]" you ask, [pc.isBimbo |gasping and bouncing excitedly |smirking as you think about her being swarmed by her mostly smaller compatriots ]. Thrud laughs, but shakes her head. "[pc.isBimbo |Haha nooo! I just know where the keys are kept. I like the peace and quiet while I'm eating. |No, haha. Not exactly, at least. I just like the peace and quiet while I eat, and the private rooms drown out most of the noise. ]" You follow her out of the training room, and through the vast stretch of the main hall that leads to the mess kitchen. Some of the other valkyries stop and point, but her fans are much less intrusive than you would have thought. Thrud speaks with one of the cooks for a minute or two, and then leads you through the spattering of tables to an enclosed hall with even more doors along its walls. She strides over to one that's tall enough for her to walk through without ducking, and fishes through her shoulder-bag to retrieve a thick metal key that she uses to unlock it. The door leads to a quaint chamber designed with all sizes in mind. Thrud slides several chairs out of the way to draw one of the larger ones up next to one that's more your size. Just as you take your seats, the door opens again. One of the cooks brings in an entire flank of roast boar and several plates of what look like cooked fowl. Moments later another enters with a platter of lobster and boiled crab, and a small bowl of fresh vegetables. Thrud digs in right away, heaping her plate with food but taking incredibly polite portions when it comes to actually eating. She savors each bite before taking the next. Still, a polite amount for her is an entire tail of lobster. You take a piece of fowl and some crab legs, cracking them open and dipping the hot meat in a saucer of butter that came with the platter. While you hesitate at first, after one bite you can't help but want to [pc.bg noblescion |eschew your refined etiquette in favor of shoveling more into your mouth |shovel so much more of it into your mouth ]. The shellfish soaks up the melted butter like bread, and it perfectly compliments the flavor. "They taste heavenly! Do the valkyries eat things like this all the time?" "Well. Umm. Hmm. This is slightly embellished, usually the seafood is just fish. I asked them to surprise me because I had a guest, but I didn't really expect duck and shellfish. They must have had extra to get rid of. I can't complain though! The normal food is also good!" she says, swallowing a bite of boar and picking up a large forkful of duck. You take a small bite of that as well, savoring the taste and eating more as you go. The half-giantess was right about the noise. Here in this private room you can only hear the noise of the general mess hall as a muffled din. You eat in peace, finishing the food and feeling quite full by the time it's all gone. The next time the cooks check in on you, they take the plates and cutlery back for cleaning. You're once again left alone with Thrud, and she gives you another robust smile. "Sorry I wasn't much for conversation," she says, rubbing the back of her head. "If you ever want to chat more, I'm in the room with the wolf's-head shields hanging on its doors." "It's fine! I ambushed you after training and then followed you to a meal. [pc.isBimbo |Oh gosh. I'm just as bad as your fans, aren't I? |You did ask, but still ]. Maybe I'll take you up on that offer to talk." "Good! I'd like that. I don't get enough time to just talk to people I meet," she says with a final smile. You leave through the door with her behind you, and part ways in the mess hall. It'll be a bit before she's finished with her bath, but it's good to know you'll be able to meet her in the future. "

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: [flags.THRUD_APPROACH |[var0 |You approach Thrud's room once more, knocking excitedly this time. There's a swift shuffle of footfalls on the other side, and the half-giant woman pulls open the door with a beaming grin. "You did it! You're one of us! Oh my god I, I... I'm sorry, I usually don't get this excited and I don't know what to say," she says, lifting you off the ground with a hug and straight up carrying you into her room. "Whoa! [pc.dcb |I know you're excited, but can you set me down? |That's alright, but could you set me down please? |I'm flying! Weee! Really though, would you set me down please? ] We can talk all about it." Thrud laughs, laying you gently upon the bed before taking a seat next to you. She opens her mouth to speak, but hesitates, trying to speak and think of questions at the same time. Finally, she settles for something simple. "How do you feel?" "Honestly? Not much different. I expected to feel myself change, but I still feel like me." "Of course! That's because you are still you! You became a valkyrie because of who you are, so of course that won't change." "Yeah. You're right," you say, grinning [pc.isDK |proudly |sheepishly ]. "I'm still really excited about it." "Me too! Really though I just like helping out the newbies. If you ever need help around the palace, please don't hesitate to ask. Is that all you came for, though? To tell me you joined us?" "That's not all! Let me think." rows.original:
"So what was it like growing up as a half-jotun? Were you raised more on the giant side or the elf side of things?"
    
    "The elf side, definitely. I should start off by saying that my mother stood staunchly with the druids, but tried to hide that fact to avoid exile. She wouldn't have approved of a relationship with my father, but that didn't stop her from having constant trysts. Those secret meetings eventually resulted in me. She tried to hide it at first, but I was so much bigger than any normal elf baby that there wasn't really any hope of it," she says with a somber laugh. "I didn't get to see my dad till I was fifteen. Mother explained her reasoning in detail: we weren't allowed to meet because he worshipped heathen powers and refused to see that the druidic faith was better for all of us. Even when I did see him it was only because I happened upon his hunting party while I was playing. 
    
    "I had no idea what he looked like before that, but half-jotunn children are actually quite rare in the city itself. More often than not the elf parents tend to stay with their jotun lovers, and I was an outlier in that regard. He recognized me by that alone, or at least saw that I could be the one. We met up a few times after that, and I learned a little bit about other spirits of nature. What my mother and most other druids decried as heretic, I only thought of as wonderful. I couldn't share those feelings, but I'm very good at keeping secrets."
    
    "[pc.isDK
        |Damn, Your mother sounds like quite the monster,
        |Did you resent your mother after that?
    ]" you [pc.isDK
        |say
        |ask
    ].
    
    "Oh no! That's not what I'm trying to say at all! My mother loved us both very much, but her devotion kept those feelings suppressed. She was always so happy when teaching me the ways of the wylder spirits and telling stories of how wonderful it was to see them in person. I was never able to meet them, but hearing her speak of them made me long for the chance. That's the version of her I choose to remember... not the bitterness and self-loathing.
    
    "None of that lasted, though. When I was around twenty, my mother slipped up and revealed her faith at a yearly Festivus party. The stupidity of it is something I'll always remember: a child offering her a plate of lumenkatter, and her snapping at the poor thing till they began to sob. The child's parents demanded an apology after the party was over, and Mother could not even give that simple a compromise. She packed her bags that night, muttering about how she should have gone to the exiles from the beginning and about the city being a 'hopeless cause.'"
    
    "What about you? It's pretty obvious which side you ended up on since you're here talking to me, but how did that come about?" you ask.
    
    "I don't think of it as picking a side, but I couldn't go with her. She saw it as the ultimate betrayal, but I wanted to prove to her that good things could come of the Lumian faith. So I joined the Order of the Argent Wing and trained my ass off. It was easy to stick out and impress people with my size, so I used that to my advantage. They fostered my talents and allowed me to thrive in a way that I never had before.
    
    "And then I became a valkyrie, and my whole world changed: a new family to take care of me, the opportunity to take care of others, and the openness I had been seeking. I wouldn't change my mind for all the electrum in the world, especially not nowadays," she concludes.
    
    "I'm glad you found your place, but that sounds like an awful split," you say, squeezing one of Thrud's shoulders in support.
    
    "It does, doesn't it? But I still saw both my parents after that. They're dead now, and I never got to fully reconcile with my mom, but she was begrudgingly happy when I came to visit her and never tried to talk me away from what I was doing. I think deep down she knew I was trying to be helpful in my own way. Father supported my choice from the start, and I even went hunting with him several times. He was gored by a Wraithslave on one such hunt, fifteen years after my wing-blessing. He didn't die right away — in fact he lived for another ten years — but it took him out of commission." 
    
    "This subject is more depressing than I thought..." she sighs. "Do you have anything else you wanna hear about?"

    后来我成为了一名女武神，我的整个世界都发生了变化：有了一个新的家庭来照顾我，也有了照顾他人的机会，还找到了我一直追求的自由与开放。就算世界上所有的 electrum 都给我，我也不会改变自己的选择，尤其是现在这个时刻。”她这样说道。

rows.original: You know that the goddess no longer shares the first valkyrie's absolute zealotry. Did she have anything to do with that change? "Heavens, no. It must have been a combination of things. It wasn't something that happened over a night or a year even. As the nightmare in the basement grew, I think she became more accepting of other things. I know she asked me about the old faith once, but I was regretfully too worried to give her anything more than a stuttering account of what my mother had told me. Gosh, I still have trouble talking to her openly. I don't know how people like Eira and Anni do it. I guess in Eira's case it's more the ability to brush her off in casual conversation just as easily as anyone else... "Nowadays, though, it's much easier. It's only one or two of them now, but some of the latest bunch of recruits are actually speaking with the druids! I was shocked, but it seems they hoped our Lady's power might aid them in being able to do something to start healing the old spirits. If we could come together on something like that, and on this new demon threat, then a greater peace has to be achievable." "Is something like that even possible?" "I have no idea, but that's what makes it so exciting. I was too tunnel visioned on people to even think about it. We're quite good at healing peoples' injuries with magic, so why shouldn't we be able to repair a spiritual wound? It might take longer, but it has to be possible." "Well. If you believe it so strongly, then there must be something that can be done!" "Thank you. That means a lot to me. It's funny, stabbing a monster with a spear is so easy, but finding solutions to the problems I actually want to solve seems so impossible. If only those problems could be solved with a spear as well." "If only." "Anything else you wanted to hear about? Maybe something that doesn't get our spirits down at the last second?" she asks with a smirk.
rows.translation: 你知道，那位女神已经不再拥有那位第一位女武神的那种极端狂热了。这种变化跟她有没有什么关系呢？ “天啊，不。肯定是一系列因素共同作用的结果。这种变化不可能是一夜之间或短短一年内发生的。 随着地下室里的噩梦不断加剧，我想她开始对其他事情更加坦然接受了。我知道她曾经问过我关于那个古老信仰的事情，但当时我实在太担心了，所以只能结结巴巴地告诉她我母亲告诉我的那些事情。 天啊，我和她坦诚地交谈仍然感到很困难。我不知道像艾拉和安妮这样的人是怎么做到的。我想，在艾拉的情况下，她能够像和别人一样轻松地在日常对话中忽略那些敏感的话题吧…… 不过现在，情况已经变得容易多了。虽然现在只有那么一两个人，但最近招募来的一些新成员竟然真的在和德鲁伊们交流！我当时真的很震惊，但看来他们希望我们女士的力量能够帮助他们，从而开始着手治愈那些古老的灵魂。 如果我们能够在这样的问题上，以及面对这一新的恶魔威胁时团结一致，那么就能实现更大的和平。 拥有 这样的目标真的能够实现吗？” “我也不知道，但正是这种不确定性才让它如此令人兴奋。我之前一直过于专注于其他方面，甚至没有考虑过这个问题。我们运用魔法治愈人们的伤势已经相当在行了，那么为什么不能尝试治愈那些精神上的创伤呢？ 虽然可能需要更长的时间，但这件事肯定是可行的。” “嗯，如果你这么坚信的话，那么肯定有办法可以解决这个问题！” “谢谢你，这对我来说意义重大。说来也奇怪，用长矛刺杀怪物其实很容易，但要想找到解决那些我真正想要解决的问题的方法，却似乎根本不可能。 要是可以用长矛来解决那些问题该多好啊。” “真希望如此。” “还有其他你想听的事情吗？也许是一些不会在最后一刻让我们心情低落的话题？”她带着一丝笑意问道。

rows.translation: 信仰

rows.original: "Do you have any particularly exciting war stories you like telling?" "As a matter of fact, I do have a favorite!" she begins. "For a little context, I received my blessing only fifteen or so years before the beginning of the Khushkan War. By then I had finished growing and... well, a ten-foot-tall giant who can wield a spear long enough to skewer a giant boar makes for a good mobile rallying point." "My favorite story is from the waning years of the conflict, six months into the barbarians' siege of Latrea. We'd been unable to find a good angle to break the siege without getting shredded by a spiny Wraithslave none of us had seen before. It was like a common porcupine that had been swollen to the size of a mammoth! It could launch clouds of jagged needles that were full of nasty poison, but the poor thing couldn't move beyond the cart they carried it around on." "[pc.dcb |Poor thing? That sounds like an atrocious beast, |So the Wraiths corrupted even simple wildlife? How dreadful, |Awww! That poor little spiny baby! It's not his fault the meany Wraith turned him into a weapon, ]" you say[pc.isBimbo |, slapping the bed emphatically. |. ] "[pc.isDK |The only atrocity lay in its creation and the monsters behind it, |Yes... It was such a horrible thing to see, ]" she says, clenching her fists in her lap. "But I didn't have to be there to witness its demise. When the city gates were on the verge of collapse, a great fog sprung up that covered the entire battlefield. We took our chances and managed to sneak two hundred warriors into the city right under the raiders' noses, even with their spike monster firing blind volleys into the sky. "We still lost some brave warriors taking the aerial route, but their army had no way of knowing how many of us made it through. So, when the gates were finally breached, the Kushkans rushed right on through. Instead of the half-starved guards they'd been expecting to massacre, they met a full troop of valkyries. The element of surprise was a help, but it wore off quickly in the face of such great numbers. Without enough defenders to clog the gates, there was no way to stop the horde from pouring into the city around us. The only things that saved us were how close they were to starvation and their desperation to pillage and eat," Thrud says, shuddering at the memory. "They easily outnumbered us six to one, but they were just throwing themselves onto our weapons in the hope of getting a lucky blow." "Did they have no commanders? How did they make it so far without eating each other?" you ask. "Don't mistake their desperation for lack of training. They had leaders, and the Khushkan fighters were incredibly well disciplined under normal circumstances. These soldiers, however, hadn't eaten in two days on top of not expecting a fight from within the fortifications. Because of that, we were able to thin their numbers till the only thing left to do was search the city for remnants. "It's hard for me to really get into heartlander homes since [silly |they're so tiny and cute |they aren't designed for ten-foot giants ], so I searched the stables and barns. Inside one of them, I found a disheveled half-orc man who had just finished killing a horse. He had his fingers around the neck of a young stablehand while he pulled the horse's guts out to feast on. "I don't think he even had time to see me before my spear plunged through his back. I pushed so hard that it took him clean off his feet, and I carried him to the wall before so much as a drop of his blood could stain the boy's clothes. The child staggered to the next stable over in shock and began to calm the other horses. He made it to two more stalls before his legs started wobbling, and I had to catch him before he fell. "Sobbing into my arms, the boy told me that he had been assisting the dead horse in its labor. So I carried him over and, in the greatest miracle that could ever come from that bloodshed, the baby horse was still alive! I got it the rest of the way out of its mother, and it needed a little healing magic, but it survived. I stayed with the boy and the foal until the village was clear, and his parents were able to reunite with him soon after. "The whole conflict ended about a year after that, and some time later I received a letter from that boy. He thanked me and told me that he was growing up strong enough to protect the horses all by himself! And that the horse I saved? It was growing up big enough to be his mount if he ever became a warrior. I still have that letter in the writing desk over there," she concludes, pointing to the desk. "It helps me whenever I'm feeling down about what we do." "Huh. I kind of expected something more like an epic battle, but [pc.dcb|I guess that was admirable.|that was something just as heroic.|that was so awesome! You saved the little boy and the little horsie!]" "I'm glad you think so, and I'm sorry. The more 'epic' confrontations don't really stick out to me. I'm sure Annika could regale you with a tale of how I bested some terrible beast if you really wanted to hear one. Is there anything else you wanted to hear from me, though?"
rows.translation: 你有没有什么特别精彩、喜欢分享的战争故事呢？” “其实，我确实有一个特别喜欢的故事！”她开始说道，“先简单介绍一下背景：在库什坎战争爆发前大约十五年，我才得到了我的祝福。 到那时，我的身体已经长成了……嗯，一个身高十英尺的巨人，能够挥舞一根长到足以刺穿一头巨野猪的长矛，这样的我自然会成为大家聚集和动员的理想对象。 我最喜欢的故事发生在那场冲突的最后阶段，当时野蛮人已经对拉特雷亚进行了六个月的围攻。 我们一直找不到一个合适的角度来突破包围，否则就会被那种我们从未见过的、长满尖刺的生物攻击致伤。那种生物看起来就像一只普通的豪猪，但它的体型却膨胀到了猛犸象的大小！它能够喷射出充满剧毒的尖刺，然而可怜的它却无法离开那些用来运送它的马车。" "[pc.dcb |可怜的东西？那听起来像是一头极其凶恶的野兽啊…… |所以那些幽灵甚至会腐蚀那些简单的野生动物？真是太可怕了…… |哎呀！那个可怜的小刺猬宝宝！那个坏心的幽灵把他变成武器，这真的不是他的错。 ]你是这么说的[pc.isBimbo |她用力拍打着床铺。 |. ] "[pc.isDK |唯一的恐怖之处在于它的诞生，以及背后那些怪物。 |是的……看到那一幕真是太可怕了。 ]她说着，双手在膝间紧握着。‘但我并不一定非得在场才能目睹它的灭亡。当城门即将倒塌的时候，一片浓雾突然出现，笼罩了整个战场。我们抓住机会，成功地将两百名战士偷偷送进了城市，而那些入侵者就在我们眼前——尽管他们的尖刺怪物还在向天空胡乱发射子弹。 尽管我们还是有一些勇敢的战士在通过空中路线时牺牲了，但他们的军队根本无从知道究竟有多少人成功突围。因此，当城门最终被攻破时，库什坎人直接冲了进去。他们原本期待遇到的是那些半饿不死的守卫，以便加以屠杀，然而迎接他们的却是一整支由女武神组成的军队。 出其不意确实起到了一定的作用，但在面对如此庞大的敌军时，这种优势很快就消失了。由于没有足够的防御力量来封锁城门，我们根本无法阻止那些敌人涌入我们所在的这座城市。唯一拯救我们的，就是那些敌人已经接近饿死边缘，他们迫切地想要抢夺食物来维持生存，”Thrud回忆起那些情景，不禁打了个寒颤。 他们的数量是我们的六倍，但他们只是盲目地冲向我们的武器，希望能侥幸命中我们。” “他们难道没有指挥官吗？在没有指挥的情况下，他们是怎么一路挺过来的？ 互相你可能会问，‘这是为什么呢？’” “不要把他们的绝望误解为缺乏训练。他们本来是有领导者的，而且在正常情况下，库什坎战士的纪律性也是非常强的。然而，这些士兵已经两天没有进食了，而且他们根本没预料到会在防御工事内部遭遇战斗。正因如此，我们才得以削弱他们的兵力，直到最后他们只能在大城中四处搜寻残余的敌人。” “对于我来说，真正走进那些大陆居民的家中，确实是一件很难的事…… [silly |它们太小了，而且非常可爱。 |它们并不是为十英尺高的巨兽设计的。 ]于是我搜查了马厩和谷仓。在其中一个地方，我发现了一个衣衫褴褛的半兽人男子，他刚刚杀完了一匹马。他双手抓住一个年轻马夫的脖子，正在把马的内脏拉出来吃掉。 我想在他被我的长矛刺中之前，他甚至没有时间看我一眼。我用力过猛，以至于他整个人都被刺飞了，而我甚至在他的一滴血弄脏那个男孩的衣服之前，就已经把他拖到了墙边。 那个孩子震惊地摇摇晃晃地走到旁边的马厩，开始安抚其他马匹。他一共去了两间马厩，直到双腿开始发软，我不得不在他摔倒之前扶住他。 那个男孩紧紧抱住我，告诉我他一直在帮助那匹快要生产的母马。于是我带着他去了那里，而在那场血腥事件中发生了最不可思议的事情——那匹小马竟然还活着！我帮它顺利地从母马体内出生，虽然它需要一些治愈魔法，但它最终活了下来。我在那个男孩和小马身边待到了村子恢复平静，不久之后，他的父母也终于与他重逢了。 那场冲突在大约一年后结束了，后来我收到了那个男孩写来的信。他在信里感谢我，还说自己已经长得足够强壮，可以独自保护那些马了！而那匹我救下的马呢？它也已经长得足够大，如果他将来成为一名战士，就可以骑它上战场了。那封信我现在还放在那边的写字台上呢，”她边说边指向那张写字台，“每当我对我们所做的一切感到沮丧时，看那封信就能让我重新振作起来。 哈，我本来还期待着会是一场宏大的战斗呢，不过…… [pc.dcb|我想，这种做法确实值得钦佩。|那同样是一种英勇的行为。|太棒了！你救了那个小男孩。 以及 那匹小马儿！]我很高兴你这么认为，同时也感到抱歉。那些所谓的‘史诗级’对决其实并没有给我留下太深的印象。如果你真的想听的话，我相信安妮卡可以给你讲讲我是怎么打败那些可怕怪物的。不过，你还有其他想从我这里了解的事情吗？
