rows.original:
"What is your relationship with Lumia like?"
    
    "My relationship... It's nice being able to talk with her again. I remember that fondly from when I first received the blessing. She always found the time to talk to everybody. I've never been fully possessed by her power, but she still found time to talk to me face to face when I needed it. It's weird to think she's an actual god at those times. It's nice, though, like I'm talking to my mom back when I was a kid."
    
    "How long did it take to get like that?"
    
    "That's the thing, it felt like that from the start! Since the first time I met her in person, it felt like I'd always known her. I'd met with other valkyries before that, and I guess it's impossible to know if one of them was her in disguise, but I don't think they were. I feel like I can tell her anything. Heck, these days I feel like I could tell her I want to worship Tira or Keros, and she'd see whatever reasoning with a bare minimum of disappointment."
    
    "That sounds a little weird for a goddess, wouldn't she want all the worshippers she can get?"
    
    "Ha. We get our power from her, not the other way around. If we all disappeared tomorrow, and the sorrow didn't slay her outright, she'd find a way to recover. I don't think she'd let that happen though. I believe her when she says she'd let the sun go dark before the Wraith's get their nasty... appendages into our brains. If we're fighting a lost cause, she's willing to go down with us."
    
    "Does Lumia ever[pc.isBimbo
        |, like,
    ] join you in the training arena?"
    
    Thrud rubs her chin as she thinks. "Kind of? But it's not like she's joining us to train. Anytime someone's having trouble, she'll help them get the hang of what they're doing. If that trouble is with combat maneuvers, then she'll join us in the halls till there's no more trouble. She helped me learn to work a field and deliver babies! Can you imagine it? I never thought I'd learn something like that before coming here." Thrud rubs her arms up and down, and for a moment looks much softer than her appearance would normally suggest.
    
    "That the goddess herself found the time to teach me was a marvel. It didn't matter that she did the same for everyone in some way. She made me feel like I could excel anywhere," she concludes with a smile.
rows.translation:
你和Lumia的关系是怎样的？”

“我们的关系……能够再次和她聊天真是太好了。我清楚地记得当初获得她的庇护时的那些时光。她总是会抽时间和大家交流。虽然我从未完全被她的力量所支配，但在我需要帮助的时候，她依然会找时间与我面对面交谈。想到她其实是一位真正的神明，这种感觉真是奇妙。不过，和她聊天也就像在和小时候的妈妈聊天一样，让人感到很温馨。
    
    花了多长时间才发展到这种程度？”

“关键就在于，从一开始就是这种感觉！自从第一次与她见面时，我就觉得仿佛已经认识她很久了。在此之前，我也见过其他女武神，不过我也想不明白，其中有没有人其实是她伪装而成的……但我觉得应该没有。我觉得我可以跟她倾诉任何事情。说真的，现在我觉得，就算我告诉她我想崇拜蒂拉或者凯罗斯，她也不会表现出太多的失望，反而会试着理解我的理由。
    
    对一位女神来说，这种说法似乎有点奇怪吧？她难道不希望拥有尽可能多的信徒吗？”

“哈。我们的力量来源于她，而不是相反。如果我们所有人明天都消失了，而这种悲伤也没有立刻杀死她，她还是会想办法恢复的。不过，我认为她不会让这种事情发生。我相信她说过，她宁愿让太阳陷入黑暗，也不愿让那些幽灵把它们那些可恶的……触手伸进我们的大脑。如果我们正在为一场必败之战而奋斗，她也愿意与我们一同赴死。
    
    Lumia有没有……[pc.isBimbo
        |就像，比如说……
    ] 也要和你一起参加训练吗？”

Thrud摸了摸下巴，思考道：“算是吧……不过她并不是来和我们一起训练的。每当有人遇到困难时，她都会帮助他们掌握该做的动作。如果问题是出在战斗技巧上，那么她就会陪我们在训练场里练习，直到问题得到解决为止。 她帮助我学会了如何在田地里劳作，也教会了我如何接生婴儿！你能想象吗？在我来到这里之前，我从没想过自己会学到这样的东西。”瑟拉德上下搓了搓手臂，有那么一瞬间，她显得比平时要温柔许多。
    
    就连女神本人都抽出时间来教导我，这实在是一件不可思议的事情。虽然她以同样的方式教导了每一个人，但这一点并不重要。她让我觉得，无论在什么领域，我都有可能取得成功。”她微笑着说道。
rows.raw:
"
    "What is your relationship with Lumia like?"
    
    "My relationship... It's nice being able to talk with her again. I remember that fondly from when I first received the blessing. She always found the time to talk to everybody. I've never been fully possessed by her power, but she still found time to talk to me face to face when I needed it. It's weird to think she's an actual god at those times. It's nice, though, like I'm talking to my mom back when I was a kid."
    
    "How long did it take to get like that?"
    
    "That's the thing, it felt like that from the start! Since the first time I met her in person, it felt like I'd always known her. I'd met with other valkyries before that, and I guess it's impossible to know if one of them was her in disguise, but I don't think they were. I feel like I can tell her anything. Heck, these days I feel like I could tell her I want to worship Tira or Keros, and she'd see whatever reasoning with a bare minimum of disappointment."
    
    "That sounds a little weird for a goddess, wouldn't she want all the worshippers she can get?"
    
    "Ha. We get our power from her, not the other way around. If we all disappeared tomorrow, and the sorrow didn't slay her outright, she'd find a way to recover. I don't think she'd let that happen though. I believe her when she says she'd let the sun go dark before the Wraith's get their nasty... appendages into our brains. If we're fighting a lost cause, she's willing to go down with us."
    
    "Does Lumia ever[pc.isBimbo
        |, like,
    ] join you in the training arena?"
    
    Thrud rubs her chin as she thinks. "Kind of? But it's not like she's joining us to train. Anytime someone's having trouble, she'll help them get the hang of what they're doing. If that trouble is with combat maneuvers, then she'll join us in the halls till there's no more trouble. She helped me learn to work a field and deliver babies! Can you imagine it? I never thought I'd learn something like that before coming here." Thrud rubs her arms up and down, and for a moment looks much softer than her appearance would normally suggest.
    
    "That the goddess herself found the time to teach me was a marvel. It didn't matter that she did the same for everyone in some way. She made me feel like I could excel anywhere," she concludes with a smile.
    "

Even though she took large towels, the biggest ones available weren't enough to provide much coverage for the massive woman you're sitting with. If she flexed, the towel around her body would probably tear right in two or instantly pop open. The thing barely reaches her hips, and if she spread her legs her crotch would be on full display. [thrud.fucked
        |She does just that when she sees you glance down, crossing her legs in an exaggerated fashion that gives you a nice view of her purple delta and fuzzy black bush.
    ]
    
    You sit for [thrud.isPregnant
        |long enough to get nice and toasty without overheating, and leave before Thrud gets too overwhelmed.
        |only fifteen minutes or so, long enough to reach a comfortable heat and feel nice and relaxed right to your core.
    ] Then the two of you head back into the main bathing area, and get ready to leave.
    "

rows.translation: 去他的
再见

rows.original:
"I had a good time. Maybe we can do this again later," you say, hugging your arms [pc.heightRange 0 70|as far around her as you can reach|around her torso].

        "Yeah. It's nice getting to relax. We don't get enough of that these days," she agrees, hugging you back. You wave goodbye as you part ways, staying in the hall while she walks back to her room.
rows.translation: 我玩得很开心，也许以后我们还可以再一起做这件事，”你一边说，一边双臂交叉抱在胸前。 [pc.heightRange 0 70|在她周围，你能触及的任何地方|围绕她的躯干]是啊，能够放松一下真是太好了。现在这样的机会实在太少了，”她一边说，一边也回抱了你。你们道别后各自离去，你留在走廊里，而她则走回了自己的房间。
rows.raw:
'
        "I had a good time. Maybe we can do this again later," you say, hugging your arms [pc.heightRange 0 70|as far around her as you can reach|around her torso].

        "Yeah. It's nice getting to relax. We don't get enough of that these days," she agrees, hugging you back. You wave goodbye as you part ways, staying in the hall while she walks back to her room.
        '

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original:
"[silly
        |What about the droid attack on those jublies?
        |[pc.dcb
            |What about those obstacle courses? I'd love to take you on!
            |What about the obstacle courses? I'd love to take you on for some practice,
            |What about those runny dodgy rooms you were practicing in? Do they have one of those for, like, cheering? We could practice together either way!
        ]"
    ] you [silly
        |ask, flickering like a blue hologram. Thrud flickers too, before the timeline is replaced with something more normal.
        |ask, thinking about the room you met her in.
    ]
    
    "You're on! [pc.hasWings
        |We can even try out one of the aerial courses if you're up to it,
        |I'll refrain from using my wings and just flying over you,
    ]" she says, agreeing to your challenge.
    
    The two of you leave Thrud's room and head off toward the academy halls. Once there, you see a few empty rooms that are labeled [pc.hasWings
        |'Flight accessible'
        |'ground course'
    ] in several languages. There are also signs over each door depicting the difficulty level of the courses. A golden wing with between one and five feathers denotes the level of challenge, and you pick one emblazoned with three feathers. With that decided, you change into training gear and enter.
    
    You stretch your legs, preparing for the ground course before you actually get started. The warm-up exercise gives you a chance to survey the obstacles. [pc.isBimbo
        |When you stare at the curving slopes and inclines, you just keep thinking of nice round hips and shapely bottoms. There's no way you're gonna be able to have an advantage here... Unless you cheat!
        |[pc.isAgile
            |Your natural athletic nature lets you intuit what you think is a solid path through the course. Keeping up with Thrud shouldn't be that big a deal, and maybe you can even pull ahead.
            |You don't really have the kind of training to get through with raw intuition, but maybe if you can stay with her there might be a chance to slip ahead.
        ]
    ]
    
    "Are you ready?" she asks, smiling in your direction as the two of you head toward the starting line. "[flags.THRUD_TRAINING
        |You've done this already, and it only gets easier the more you do it.
        |The course should be pretty easy to follow. It's all marked and this one is a pretty straight shot to the other end of the hall.
    ]"
    
    The course is designed for a full squad to run simultaneously, so you have no trouble lining up with plenty of space between you. You do a few more stretches to prepare, making sure you feel limber before you find your place
    
    "[pc.isBimbo
        |How do we, like, know when to start?
        |So when do we start?
    ]" you ask.
    
    "I'll do a countdown. 3. 2. 1. Go!" she shouts, and the both of you jump into action.
    
    You begin at a dead sprint, and Thrud swiftly outpaces you in the first few seconds. By the time you catch up, one of the obstacles dominates your view. This one consists of several raised rings colored with rich gold and thick as gigantic donuts. The obvious intention is for this to test your agility and endurance as you step through the circles one at a time, but if you go faster you can probably get a bit of a lead early on.
rows.translation:
"[silly
        |那些机器人对那些欢乐人群发动的攻击是怎么回事？
        |[pc.dcb
            |那些障碍赛道怎么样？我非常愿意和你一起挑战它们！
            |那些障碍赛道怎么样？我很想和你一起练习一下。
            |你们之前练习用的那些奇怪房间怎么样？里面有没有适合用来加油助威的地方吗？不管怎样，我们都可以一起练习啊！
        ]"
    ] 你 [silly
        |那个光点像蓝色的全息影像一样闪烁着。“Thrud”也在闪烁，随后时间线被替换成了更为正常的内容。
        |想着你们在那个房间里相遇的情景，他问道。
    ]
    
    你被选中啦！ [pc.hasWings
        |如果你有兴趣的话，我们甚至可以尝试其中一项空中课程。
        |我就不使用我的翅膀从你上方飞过了。
    ]她说，同意接受你的挑战。”

你们俩离开瑟鲁德的房间，朝着学院大厅的方向走去。到了那里，你们看到有几间标有标识的空房间。 [pc.hasWings
        |可飞行
        |基础课程
    ] 这些指示用多种语言书写。每扇门上还都有标志，标明 해당课程的难度等级。带有1到5根羽毛的金色翅膀象征着挑战的难度级别，而你选择了带有3根羽毛的标志。确定好选择后，你换上训练装备，然后进入场地。

在真正开始训练之前，你先活动了一下双腿，为接下来的基础训练做准备。这个热身运动让你有机会观察场地的各种障碍物。 [pc.isBimbo
        |当你凝视那些蜿蜒曲折的斜坡和坡度时，你脑海中总会浮现出那些圆润的臀部与线条分明的曲线。在这种情况下，你根本不可能取得任何优势……除非你作弊！
        |[pc.isAgile
            |你与生俱来的运动天赋使你能够直觉地判断出在这段路程中哪条路线才是最可靠的。跟上Thrud的速度应该不会太难，甚至你还有可能反超他。
            |你其实并没有接受过相应的训练，因此仅凭直觉是很难顺利完成任务的，但如果你能继续和她在一起，或许就有机会取得进步。
        ]
    ]
    
    你准备好了吗？”她微笑着问你，此时你们正朝着起跑线走去。[flags.THRUD_TRAINING
        |你已经做过这件事了，而且做得次数越多，它就会变得越容易。
        |这个流程应该很容易遵循。所有的步骤都已经标明了，只要按照这些指示走，就能直接到达目的地点。
    ]该课程是为整个小队同时进行而设计的，因此你们在排列队形时完全不会有任何问题，彼此之间也有足够的空间。在找到自己的位置之前，先做一些伸展运动，确保自己的身体处于灵活状态。[pc.isBimbo
        |我们到底该怎么知道什么时候该开始呢？
        |那么，我们什么时候开始呢？
    ]你问吧。

“我来倒计时。3、2、1，开始！”她喊道，于是你们俩立刻行动起来。

你以最快的速度冲了出去，但在最初的几秒钟里，Thrud很快就超过了你。当你终于追上她时，某个障碍物已经挡住了你的视线。 这个障碍物由几个用浓金色染成的凸起圆环组成，这些圆环厚得就像巨大的甜甜圈一样。其目的显然在于考验你的敏捷性和耐力——因为你必须一个一个地穿过这些圆环。不过，如果你动作更快，或许就能在初期取得一些优势。

rows.translation: 稳定

rows.original:
You decide to take a more practical pace when it comes to the raised donuts, stepping through each one with quick but measured steps. Thrud does the same, and despite her immense size she still handles the short steps like an expert. [var0
            |Stepping through the holes one after the other, you keep a perfect pace the whole time. In the end you come out right alongside Thrud, matching the valkyrie veteran foot for foot.
            |At least you move at about the same speed until your foot catches on the edge of one of the loops. You don't fall, but you do have to pause for a moment to regain your footing. That's all it takes for the veteran valkyrie to slip ahead. By the time you exit the stretch of rings, she's passed you! It's not much of a lead, though, and you still have plenty of chances to catch up.
        ]
rows.translation:
在处理那些被抬高的甜甜圈时，你决定采取更为谨慎、稳妥的方式，脚步快速而稳重地逐一走过每一个甜甜圈。Thrud也采取了同样的方法，尽管她体型庞大，但她依然能够像专家一样轻松地完成这些小步伐。 [var0
            |你一个接一个地穿过那些洞穴，自始至终都保持着完美的节奏。最终，你与Thrud并肩而出，与这位经验丰富的女武神步伐完全一致。
            |至少，在你的脚触到其中一道环的边缘之前，你的移动速度是保持不变的。你不会掉下来，但确实需要暂停片刻来重新站稳脚跟。而正是这个短暂的瞬间，让那位经验丰富的女武神抢先了一步。当你走出那段由环组成的路段时，她已经超过了你！不过，她的领先优势并不大，你仍然有很多机会赶上她。
        ]
rows.raw:
"
        You decide to take a more practical pace when it comes to the raised donuts, stepping through each one with quick but measured steps. Thrud does the same, and despite her immense size she still handles the short steps like an expert. [var0
            |Stepping through the holes one after the other, you keep a perfect pace the whole time. In the end you come out right alongside Thrud, matching the valkyrie veteran foot for foot.
            |At least you move at about the same speed until your foot catches on the edge of one of the loops. You don't fall, but you do have to pause for a moment to regain your footing. That's all it takes for the veteran valkyrie to slip ahead. By the time you exit the stretch of rings, she's passed you! It's not much of a lead, though, and you still have plenty of chances to catch up.
        ]
        "

rows.original: Take the course at a pace you know you can keep. No sense tripping up this early.
rows.translation: 按照你自己能够坚持的速度来学习这个课程吧。没必要这么早就遇到困难。
rows.raw: "Take the course at a pace you know you can keep. No sense tripping up this early."

rows.translation: 迅速的

rows.original:
You decide to tackle the ground rings as swiftly as you can. It's a risk, for sure, but you'll have a huge advantage if you make it. Bolting into the first hurdle of the course, you step two or three rings at a time. In your haste to jump between them, you don't even pause to check where your feet are going. You're leaving the whole thing up to your instincts and the sheer strength of your body, and hoping they can get you through it. [var0
            |Through sheer physicality, you power through the obstacle with everything you have. Though it leaves you a little winded, you exit the obstacle several lengths ahead of Thrud!
            |Unfortunately, you don't quite meet those standards you hoped for. Three rings in, your foot hits the edge rather than the center and sends you careening towards the floor. It's easy enough to break your fall and avoid real injury, but it takes you several seconds to right yourself and then several more to get back into the right frame of movement. By the time you finish, Thrud is several lengths ahead of you.
        ]
rows.translation:
你决定尽快克服这些地面障碍。这无疑是个冒险，但如果你成功了，将会获得巨大的优势。你冲向赛道上的第一个障碍，一次跳过两三个障碍物。由于太过匆忙，你甚至没有停下来确认自己的脚步会落在哪里。你完全依靠自己的直觉和身体的力量来应对这一切，只希望它们能帮助你顺利通过这个难关。 [var0
            |凭借纯粹的体力，你用尽全力冲过了那个障碍。虽然这让你有些气喘吁吁，但最终你还是比Thrud提前几步走过了那个障碍！
            |不幸的是，你的表现并没有达到你期望的标准。在第三环的时候，你的脚踩在了边缘而不是中心，导致你猛地向地面冲去。虽然你很容易就能缓冲跌落的力量，避免受到真正的伤害，但你需要几秒钟才能重新站稳身体，再过几秒钟才能恢复到正确的运动姿势。等到你完成这个动作时，Thrud已经远远地领先在你前面了。
        ]
rows.raw:
"
        You decide to tackle the ground rings as swiftly as you can. It's a risk, for sure, but you'll have a huge advantage if you make it. Bolting into the first hurdle of the course, you step two or three rings at a time. In your haste to jump between them, you don't even pause to check where your feet are going. You're leaving the whole thing up to your instincts and the sheer strength of your body, and hoping they can get you through it. [var0
            |Through sheer physicality, you power through the obstacle with everything you have. Though it leaves you a little winded, you exit the obstacle several lengths ahead of Thrud!
            |Unfortunately, you don't quite meet those standards you hoped for. Three rings in, your foot hits the edge rather than the center and sends you careening towards the floor. It's easy enough to break your fall and avoid real injury, but it takes you several seconds to right yourself and then several more to get back into the right frame of movement. By the time you finish, Thrud is several lengths ahead of you.
        ]
        "

rows.original: Take the more risky approach to the course. You might end up behind, but you could pull ahead as well.
rows.translation: 选择这条更具风险的道路吧。你可能会落后，但也有可能因此取得领先。
rows.raw: "Take the more risky approach to the course. You might end up behind, but you could pull ahead as well."

rows.original: There's a little bit of space before the next obstacle, but not enough to do much more than get a glimpse of your surroundings. [thrud.BAS |Thrud is behind you for now, but she could catch up if you aren't careful. |Besides, Thrud is ahead of you and you need to focus on catching up. |You're lined up right next to Thrud now, going into the middle section right beside each other. ] Speaking of, you're approaching the next part of the course right now! A large wooden wall rises up from the ground ahead, blocking your view of the remainder of the room. Myriad thick ropes hang down from the ceiling, allowing the wall to be climbed without footholds. You're approaching fast, and you see a couple ways to go about scaling it. One option is to take the obvious path, using the rope to climb up and over. On the other hand, the wall isn't that high; You could try to run up in one swift motion if you get enough momentum.
rows.translation: 在下一个障碍物之前，还有那么一点空间，但空间太小了，你只能勉强瞥见周围的环境而已。 [thrud.BAS |目前Thrud还落后于你，但如果你不小心的话，她很快就会追上来的。 |此外，Thrud已经走在你前面了，你需要集中精力去追赶他。 |你现在和Thrud并排站在同一位置，将一起进入中间区域。 ] 说起来，你现在正好即将进入课程的下一部分了！ 前方有一面高大的木墙从地面竖立起来，挡住了你看向房间其他部分的视线。天花板上悬挂着无数粗绳，这些绳子使得人们无需任何支撑点就能攀爬这面墙。你正迅速接近这面墙，发现有几种方法可以攀上去。一种方法是选择最显而易见的路径，利用那些绳子来攀爬过去；而另一种方法则是……这面墙其实并没有…… 那个 高；如果你有足够的动力，可以尝试用一个迅速的动作跑上去。
rows.raw: " There's a little bit of space before the next obstacle, but not enough to do much more than get a glimpse of your surroundings. [thrud.BAS |Thrud is behind you for now, but she could catch up if you aren't careful. |Besides, Thrud is ahead of you and you need to focus on catching up. |You're lined up right next to Thrud now, going into the middle section right beside each other. ] Speaking of, you're approaching the next part of the course right now! A large wooden wall rises up from the ground ahead, blocking your view of the remainder of the room. Myriad thick ropes hang down from the ceiling, allowing the wall to be climbed without footholds. You're approaching fast, and you see a couple ways to go about scaling it. One option is to take the obvious path, using the rope to climb up and over. On the other hand, the wall isn't that high; You could try to run up in one swift motion if you get enough momentum. "

rows.translation: 安全

rows.raw:
"
        You reach the wall and grab the rope, beginning to climb and pull your way to the top. [var0
            |It's actually a lot easier than you thought it would be! It's a real exercise pulling yourself up, but the angle isn't nearly as unforgiving as it looks, and you're able to reach the top with [pc.isStrong
                |little effort
                |some work
            ].
            |The rope is actually pretty easy to climb once you start, but your feet keep slipping on the wall and forcing you to readjust. You still make it to the top after some scrambling, pulling yourself up [pc.isStrong
                |almost solely with your arms.
                |after finding your footing.
            ]
        ]
        "

rows.original: Climb the intended way, using the rope.
rows.translation: 沿着指定的路线，使用绳子进行攀爬。
rows.raw: "Climb the intended way, using the rope."

rows.translation: 风险

rows.original:
You reach the wall at a run, bracing yourself preemptively for the climb. Avoiding the ropes entirely, you scramble up the wall with hand and foot. [var0
            |It feels rough for a second, but you're able to find purchase on the cracks between the boards used to make the tower. Straining so hard makes your fingers burn, but it's worth it to reach the top in seconds.
            |For a second you think you'll make it, but about halfway up you suddenly stop finding what miniscule holds you'd found before. You're forced to reach out and catch yourself on one of the ropes, hanging against the wall for a moment before you gather enough strength to finish climbing and reach the top.
        ]
rows.translation:
你飞奔着撞上了墙壁，立刻做好了攀爬的准备。你完全不使用绳子，而是用手和脚在墙上攀爬起来。 [var0
            |有那么一瞬间，这种感觉会让人觉得有些吃力，但你可以利用搭建塔架所用的木板之间的缝隙来抓住支撑物。用力过猛会让手指感到刺痛，但只要能在几秒钟内到达顶端，这一切都是值得的。
            |有那么一瞬间，你以为自己一定能成功，但当爬到一半的时候，你突然发现那些之前帮助你抓住的细小支撑物已经不见了。你不得不伸手去抓住墙面上的一些绳子，暂时悬在半空中，直到积蓄足够的力气，才能继续攀爬并最终到达顶端。
        ]
rows.raw:
"
        You reach the wall at a run, bracing yourself preemptively for the climb. Avoiding the ropes entirely, you scramble up the wall with hand and foot. [var0
            |It feels rough for a second, but you're able to find purchase on the cracks between the boards used to make the tower. Straining so hard makes your fingers burn, but it's worth it to reach the top in seconds.
            |For a second you think you'll make it, but about halfway up you suddenly stop finding what miniscule holds you'd found before. You're forced to reach out and catch yourself on one of the ropes, hanging against the wall for a moment before you gather enough strength to finish climbing and reach the top.
        ]
        "

rows.original: Attempt a fast climb with only your legs and hands.
rows.translation: 仅使用你的双手和双腿尝试快速攀爬。
rows.raw: "Attempt a fast climb with only your legs and hands."

rows.original:
From the top of the wall, you can see all the way to the end of the course, and you can see the final obstacle that's between it and you! It's a simulated crawl [flags.THRUD_TRAINING
        |that you know goes beneath a false set of spikes
        |of some sort
    ]. You slide down and head toward the final stop, checking your place while you move. [thrud.BAS
        |Thrud is just cresting the wall as you get close.
        |Thrud is jogging ahead of you, almost reaching the crawl.
        |Thrud is jogging right beside you, panting from slight exertion.
    ] If you wanted to talk, you have a little time now before you reach the end.
rows.translation:
从墙的顶部望去，你可以看到整个赛道的全貌，从而也能看到位于终点线前的最后一道障碍！那其实是一个模拟的爬行障碍。 [flags.THRUD_TRAINING
        |你知道的，那些东西其实隐藏在虚假的尖刺之下。
        |某种形式
    ]你滑行而下，朝着最终的目的地前进，在移动的过程中不断确认自己的位置。 [thrud.BAS
        |当你靠近时，Thrud正好爬到了墙顶。
        |Thrud正在你前面慢跑，几乎已经快跑到爬行的速度了。
        |Thrud正慢跑在你身旁，由于轻微的运动而微微喘着气。
    ] 如果你想聊天的话，现在还有点时间，因为在到达终点之前还有段时间。
rows.raw:
"
    From the top of the wall, you can see all the way to the end of the course, and you can see the final obstacle that's between it and you! It's a simulated crawl [flags.THRUD_TRAINING
        |that you know goes beneath a false set of spikes
        |of some sort
    ]. You slide down and head toward the final stop, checking your place while you move. [thrud.BAS
        |Thrud is just cresting the wall as you get close.
        |Thrud is jogging ahead of you, almost reaching the crawl.
        |Thrud is jogging right beside you, panting from slight exertion.
    ] If you wanted to talk, you have a little time now before you reach the end.
    "

rows.translation: 调情

rows.original:
"[pc.isBimbo
            |I love running with you like this! Watching your tiddies bounce like that makes it all worth it. If you ran any harder they'd, like, bounce right out of your top!
            |You look really cute when you're in your element, you know that? I'm glad to be here with you to see it,
        ]" you [pc.isBimbo
            |giggle
            |say
        ], smiling at the taller woman as you run.
        
        "D-don't bring that up while we're here! How am I supposed to respond to something like that right now?" she says, blushing and slowing to a softer pace.
        
        "It doesn't have to be now. Maybe when we're done here you'll have strength left to carry me back to your room for some fun!" you reply.
        
        "Don't tempt me! I don't tire as easily as you'd think!" she shouts back.
        
        When you reach the final obstacle, [thrud.BAS
            |you've overtaken her completely! As long as you don't mess up now, you're sure to reach the finish first.
            |you're still behind her, but now there's a chance for you to get ahead, now matter how slim.
            |you've caught up with her, and it's up to you whether you want to finish with her, or try to beat her.
        ]

rows.original: Coming up to the base of the final obstacle, you can see the long stretch of a makeshift tunnel you need to crawl through on your belly. There are a variety of tunnels that ensure all shapes and sizes can enjoy —or suffer through— the same experience. In the largest hole you might even be able to get on your hands and knees, but the correctly sized ones give you no room for anything but the intended path. You could still probably squeeze out some speed if you squiggled your hardest, but it would be safer to just take a comfortable pace and make sure you get through.
rows.translation: 当你接近最后一个障碍物的底部时，你会看到一段长长的临时隧道，你必须趴着爬过去。这些隧道有各种各样的设计，以确保各种体型和身材的人都能体验到同样的过程——或者说是同样的“挑战”。 在那些最大的洞穴里，你或许还能用手和膝盖爬过去，但那些尺寸恰到好处的洞穴却根本不会给你留下任何其他移动的空间，你只能沿着预定的路线前进。如果你拼命地蠕动，或许还能加快一点速度，但相对来说，保持稳定的速度、确保自己能够顺利通过，才是更安全的选择。
rows.raw: "\n    Coming up to the base of the final obstacle, you can see the long stretch of a makeshift tunnel you need to crawl through on your belly. There are a variety of tunnels that ensure all shapes and sizes can enjoy —or suffer through— the same experience. In the largest hole you might even be able to get on your hands and knees, but the correctly sized ones give you no room for anything but the intended path. You could still probably squeeze out some speed if you squiggled your hardest, but it would be safer to just take a comfortable pace and make sure you get through.\n    "

rows.translation: 爬行

rows.raw:
"
        You crawl into the tunnel, scooting with your knees and elbows as best you can. [var0
            |There isn't much difficulty to the crawl, but it does feel like forever when you don't have any good way of judging the distance. Eventually, though, your upper body comes back into the open air, and you pull yourself up onto the final platform with a relieved huff.
            |There isn't much difficulty to the crawl, but [silly
                |[pc.cupRange 0 5
                    |[pc.assRange 0 4
                        |you just plum get stuck on things.
                        |your gigantic dump-truck bubble butt keeps getting in the way!
                    ]
                    |your gosh darn slobberknocker milk-truck tiddies keep getting in the way!
                ]
                |you keep getting caught on little things and it slows you down.
            ] There's no good way to judge the distance, so you can't know whether you're losing a lot or a little bit of time. Still, you eventually find yourself in the open air again, and drag yourself up onto the final platform.
        ]
        "

rows.original: Don't risk it. You'll get through nice and easy.
rows.translation: 别冒险，你会顺利通过的。
rows.raw: "Don't risk it. You'll get through nice and easy."

rows.translation: 小蜗牛

rows.original:
You dive into the tunnel, intent to get through the enclosed final portion of the course as swiftly as possible. [var0
            |Without pausing to do anything but see where you're going, you shuffle like your life depends on it. Pressing on, you feel how fast you're going despite not truly having much of a way to judge it via surroundings. When you finally hit air again, you pull yourself up onto the final platform and roll over onto your back to catch your breath.
            |Without pausing to see where you're going, you push through and shuffle like you won't get another chance. Suddenly the walls begin to close in, and you look up to find that you've somehow worked yourself sideways. A little more squirming gets you situated, allowing you to wiggle forth with purpose. There's no way of knowing how much time that lost you, but you still wind up pulling up and out in what feels like a few moments. You flop over onto the final platform to catch your breath, happy you made it through.
        ]
rows.translation:
你冲进隧道，决心尽快穿过这段封闭的最后路段。 [var0
            |你没有停下来思考其他事情，只是专注于看清前方的路况，慌忙地向前移动，仿佛性命攸关。继续前进的过程中，你虽然无法通过周围的环境来准确判断自己的移动速度，但依然能感受到自己前进得有多快。当终于再次接触到地面时，你用力将自己拉上最后一个平台，然后仰面躺下，喘着粗气。
            |你没有停下来看看自己正在往哪里移动，只是拼命地挤过去，动作急促得仿佛再也没有第二次机会。突然间，四周的墙壁开始向你挤压过来，你抬头一看，发现自己不知怎么地已经偏离了原来的方向。又费了些力气才调整好姿势，然后你终于能够有方向地向前移动了。虽然不知道这样耽误了你多少时间，但最终你还是在短短几秒钟内爬到了最后一个平台上，气喘吁吁地躺下来，为自己成功通过了这一关而感到庆幸。
        ]

rows.original: "[silly |What about the droid attack on those jublies? |[pc.dcb |What about those obstacle courses? I'd love to take you on! |What about the obstacle courses? I'd love to take you on for some practice, |What about those runny dodgy rooms you were practicing in? Do they have one of those for, like, cheering? We could practice together either way!" ]" ] you [silly |ask, flickering like a blue hologram. Thrud flickers too, before the timeline is replaced with something more normal. |ask, thinking about the room you met her in. ] "You're on! [pc.hasWings |We can even try out one of the aerial courses if you're up to it, |I'll refrain from using my wings and just flying over you, ]" she says, agreeing to your challenge. The two of you leave Thrud's room and head off toward the academy halls. Once there, you see a few empty rooms that are labeled [pc.hasWings |'Flight accessible' |'ground course' ] in several languages. There are also signs over each door depicting the difficulty level of the courses. A golden wing with between one and five feathers denotes the level of challenge, and you pick one emblazoned with three feathers. With that decided, you change into training gear and enter. You stretch your wings, extending them to the furthest distance they can reach before letting them relax. It's not often you get the chance to test their full limits, so it's going to be nice to get some exercise in the air. To that end, you try to plot out a route ahead of time from what you can see of the course. [pc.isBimbo |No matter how hard you try, you can't stop thinking of flying in pretty loop-the-loops and twirling about like a dancer in the air. It's okay though, you're sure you can think of a way to cheat. |[pc.isAgile |It looks simple enough to make it through, but actually winning depends on how well she knows the course. |It's tough to plot a solely visual route between some of the twists and turns, however, and as a whole you think you'll be running blind. ] ] "Are you ready? [flags.THRUD_TRAINING |It should get easier the more you do it, but sometimes these things can surprise you even with years of practice. |You just have to follow the course markers, and reach the end without getting knocked down. ] If you need any help, be sure to call for me," she concludes with a wink. The course is designed for up to six, so you have plenty of space to arrange yourselves at the starting line. "[pc.isBimbo |So, like, when do we go? |So when do we start? ]" you ask, primed and ready to begin. "I'll do a countdown. 3. 2. 1. [silly |Hang ten. Let 'er rip! |Go! ]" she shouts, and both of you leap into the air. The experienced flyer easily pulls ahead in the first few seconds, but has to pause at the first obstacle. Before you is a large ring with several wooden rods that stick out at awkward angles. The entire ring spins softly so that it's impossible to gauge an entirely consistent path. You can see Thrud scanning for a good opportunity to get through, and you know that that's probably the smart thing to do in this case. However, if you were able to burst through it could get you a little bit of a lead.
rows.translation: "[silly |那些机器人对那些欢乐人群发动的攻击是怎么回事？ |[pc.dcb |那些障碍赛道怎么样？我很乐意和你一起挑战它们！ |那些障碍赛道怎么样？我很乐意和你一起练习一番。 |你之前练习用的那些昏暗、阴森的房间怎么样？里面有没有适合用来加油助威的地方呢？不管怎样，我们都可以一起练习啊！ ]" ] 你 [silly |那个光点像蓝色的全息影像一样闪烁着。“Thrud”也在闪烁，随后时间线被替换成了更为正常的内容。 |想着你们在那个房间里相遇的情景，他问道。 ] 你被选中啦！ [pc.hasWings |如果你有兴趣的话，我们甚至可以尝试其中一项空中课程。 |我就不使用我的翅膀从你上方飞过了。 ]她说，同意接受你的挑战。” 你们俩离开瑟拉德的房间，朝着学院大厅的方向走去。到了那里，你们看到有几间标有标签的空房间。 [pc.hasWings |可进行飞行操作 |基础课程 ] 这些标识用多种语言书写。每扇门上还都有标志，用来说明 해당课程的难度等级。带有1到5根羽毛的金色翅膀象征着挑战的难度级别，而你选择的是那扇上面标有3根羽毛的标志。 决定好之后，你换上训练装备，然后进入训练场地。 你展开双翼，将它们伸展到最远的范围，然后再放松下来。这样的机会并不多见，因此能在空中好好锻炼一下，确实是一件很愉快的事情。 为此，你会根据自己所看到的赛道情况，提前规划好行进路线。 [pc.isBimbo |无论你如何努力，都无法停止想象自己在空中做出漂亮的环形动作，像舞者一样旋转飞舞。不过没关系，你肯定能想出办法来作弊的。 |[pc.isAgile |看起来这任务挺简单的，应该能够完成，但实际上能否获胜，还是取决于完成得有多好。 她 熟悉路线。 |然而，在某些曲折的路径中，要仅仅依靠视觉来寻找路线确实非常困难，总体来说，你会觉得自己在盲目地奔跑。 ] ] 你准备好了吗？ [flags.THRUD_TRAINING |做得越多，应该会越容易，但有时候，即使经过多年的练习，这些事情仍然会让你感到意外。 |你只需要沿着路标前进，就能到达终点，而不会被撞倒。 ] 如果需要任何帮助，一定要来找我哦，”她眨着眼睛说道。这条赛道最多可以容纳六个人参加，所以大家在起跑线处有足够的空间来安排自己的位置。[pc.isBimbo |那么，我们什么时候出发呢？ |那么，我们什么时候开始呢？ ]你问吧，我已经准备好了，随时可以开始。 “我来倒计时：3、2、1。 [silly |加油！冲啊！ |开始吧！ ]她大喊一声，你们俩立刻跳向空中。 经验丰富的飞行者在最初的几秒钟里轻松地领先着，但在遇到第一个障碍物时不得不停下来。在你面前有一个大圆环，上面有几根木棍以奇怪的角度伸了出来。 整个圆环会缓缓旋转，因此根本无法预测它的运动轨迹是否始终如一。你可以看到Thrud正在寻找一个合适的时机穿过这个圆环，而你也知道，在这种情况下，这样做才是最明智的选择。 然而，如果你能够突破这一障碍，那么你就可能会获得一些优势。
rows.raw: " "[silly |What about the droid attack on those jublies? |[pc.dcb |What about those obstacle courses? I'd love to take you on! |What about the obstacle courses? I'd love to take you on for some practice, |What about those runny dodgy rooms you were practicing in? Do they have one of those for, like, cheering? We could practice together either way!" ]" ] you [silly |ask, flickering like a blue hologram. Thrud flickers too, before the timeline is replaced with something more normal. |ask, thinking about the room you met her in. ] "You're on! [pc.hasWings |We can even try out one of the aerial courses if you're up to it, |I'll refrain from using my wings and just flying over you, ]" she says, agreeing to your challenge. The two of you leave Thrud's room and head off toward the academy halls. Once there, you see a few empty rooms that are labeled [pc.hasWings |'Flight accessible' |'ground course' ] in several languages. There are also signs over each door depicting the difficulty level of the courses. A golden wing with between one and five feathers denotes the level of challenge, and you pick one emblazoned with three feathers. With that decided, you change into training gear and enter. You stretch your wings, extending them to the furthest distance they can reach before letting them relax. It's not often you get the chance to test their full limits, so it's going to be nice to get some exercise in the air. To that end, you try to plot out a route ahead of time from what you can see of the course. [pc.isBimbo |No matter how hard you try, you can't stop thinking of flying in pretty loop-the-loops and twirling about like a dancer in the air. It's okay though, you're sure you can think of a way to cheat. |[pc.isAgile |It looks simple enough to make it through, but actually winning depends on how well she knows the course. |It's tough to plot a solely visual route between some of the twists and turns, however, and as a whole you think you'll be running blind. ] ] "Are you ready? [flags.THRUD_TRAINING |It should get easier the more you do it, but sometimes these things can surprise you even with years of practice. |You just have to follow the course markers, and reach the end without getting knocked down. ] If you need any help, be sure to call for me," she concludes with a wink. The course is designed for up to six, so you have plenty of space to arrange yourselves at the starting line. "[pc.isBimbo |So, like, when do we go? |So when do we start? ]" you ask, primed and ready to begin. "I'll do a countdown. 3. 2. 1. [silly |Hang ten. Let 'er rip! |Go! ]" she shouts, and both of you leap into the air. The experienced flyer easily pulls ahead in the first few seconds, but has to pause at the first obstacle. Before you is a large ring with several wooden rods that stick out at awkward angles. The entire ring spins softly so that it's impossible to gauge an entirely consistent path. You can see Thrud scanning for a good opportunity to get through, and you know that that's probably the smart thing to do in this case. However, if you were able to burst through it could get you a little bit of a lead. "

rows.translation: 看。

rows.original:
You join the veteran valkyrie in looking for a safe spot, watching the bars twist and turn and flying in just after her when you think you've seen a spot. [var0
            |Relying on momentum, you easily fly through in the same smooth motion she does. In the end you come out right beside her through a different set of rods. You've wound up in exactly the same position as you were before.
            |As you fly through, you bump one of the rods accidentally despite your careful approach. It still doesn't cause that big of a problem, but it does cost you a little time. You've fallen a bit behind, but it's not an impossible gap to close.
        ]
rows.translation:
你与这位经验丰富的女武神一起寻找安全的降落地点。当你们认为已经找到了合适的地点时，那些金属杆突然开始扭曲变形，紧接着在她之后飞了进来。 [var0
            |借助这股势头，你也能像她一样轻松地以流畅的动作飞过。最终，你通过另一组杆状物，与她并肩抵达终点。你重新回到了最初的位置。
            |当你飞过这些障碍物时，尽管你非常小心，还是不小心撞到了一根杆子。虽然这并没有造成太大的麻烦，但还是让你浪费了一些时间。你现在落后了一些，但这个差距并不是无法弥补的。
        ]

            |Relying on momentum, you easily fly through in the same smooth motion she does. In the end you come out right beside her through a different set of rods. You've wound up in exactly the same position as you were before.

        ]
        "

rows.original: You might not gain a lead, but it'll be safer.
rows.translation: 你可能不会因此获得优势，但这样会更安全。
rows.raw: "You might not gain a lead, but it'll be safer."

rows.translation: 冲刺

rows.original: You can make it! You know it! You just have to zip through fast enough to avoid the bars movement entirely. [var0|For a brief moment you worry, but with an acrobatic twirl you fly through the spinning bars with the grace of a natural. You look back to see a surprised Thrud give you an impressed smile before curling through behind you. That leaves you ahead, and hopefully you can keep it that way.|For a moment you think you're going to make it, and then your midsection hooks on a bar and you have to hang there for a second till your breath comes back. Thrud flies through as you slide lower on the ring, and you flutter up and after to try and catch up. The misstep brought you into the rear, but you can still catch up.]
rows.translation: 你一定能够做到的！你心里清楚这一点！只要动作足够快，就能完全避开那些障碍物的移动。 [var0|有那么一瞬间，你感到有些担忧，但凭借一个巧妙的转身，你像一个天生的舞者一样优雅地穿过了那些旋转的金属杆。当你回头望去时，看到那个名叫Thrud的家伙露出了惊讶的表情，随后也迅速跟了上来。现在你又领先了，希望这次能够保持这个优势。|有那么一瞬间，你以为自己能够成功完成动作，但紧接着你的腰部却卡在了横杆上，不得不在那一刻悬在那里，直到呼吸恢复正常。当你继续向下滑动时，身体会剧烈地晃动，你必须立刻挣扎着向上爬升，试图赶上前面的节奏。这次失误确实让你落在了后面，但只要你继续努力，还是有机会赶上的。]
rows.raw: "\n        You can make it! You know it! You just have to zip through fast enough to avoid the bars movement entirely. [var0|For a brief moment you worry, but with an acrobatic twirl you fly through the spinning bars with the grace of a natural. You look back to see a surprised Thrud give you an impressed smile before curling through behind you. That leaves you ahead, and hopefully you can keep it that way.|For a moment you think you're going to make it, and then your midsection hooks on a bar and you have to hang there for a second till your breath comes back. Thrud flies through as you slide lower on the ring, and you flutter up and after to try and catch up. The misstep brought you into the rear, but you can still catch up.]\n        "

rows.original: You might not gain a lead, but it'll be safer.
rows.translation: 你可能不会因此获得优势，但这样会更安全。
rows.raw: "You might not gain a lead, but it'll be safer."

rows.original: There's a moment of open gliding before the next bit of the course, but not really enough to talk. [thrud.BAS|You wouldn't want to waste your lead anyway.|You can't afford to chat anyway if you want to catch up.|You take solace in the fact that you're able to keep up with her, at the very least.] The next obstacle looks to be a more narrow section of beams, designed to test sudden turns and changes in elevation. This one tests responsiveness more than anything.
rows.translation: 在进入下一段赛道之前，会有那么一段短暂的滑行时间，不过这段时间其实还不够用来聊天。 [thrud.BAS|你肯定不会想浪费自己的领先优势的。|如果你想赶上进度，的话，根本没时间闲聊。|你至少能够跟上她的节奏，这个事实让你感到些许安慰。] 下一个障碍似乎是一段更为狭窄的横梁区域，设计目的是用来测试玩家在突然转向或遇到高度变化时的反应能力。这一环节主要考验的是玩家的应变能力。
rows.raw: "\n    There's a moment of open gliding before the next bit of the course, but not really enough to talk. [thrud.BAS|You wouldn't want to waste your lead anyway.|You can't afford to chat anyway if you want to catch up.|You take solace in the fact that you're able to keep up with her, at the very least.] The next obstacle looks to be a more narrow section of beams, designed to test sudden turns and changes in elevation. This one tests responsiveness more than anything.\n    "

rows.translation: 滑行

rows.original:
You decide to take it slow through the beams, gliding smoothly and letting the momentum you've built up do all the work. [var0
            |It's easy to make it through the whole section without faltering, and you sway and rise with the turning path till it spits you back out into the open air. Thrud is still [thrud.BAS
                |behind
                |ahead of
                |alongside
            ] you, in about the same place she was before.
            |This section is simple for the most part, but some of the guiding lines brush against your wings as you take a few turns too sharply. It's not enough to knock you down, but you do come out a little slower than you could have. Thrud [thrud.BAS
                |is still behind you, though she's catching up.
                |has gotten a little farther ahead of you now.
                |is back at your side after your brief lead.
            ]
        ]
rows.translation:
你决定缓缓穿过那些横梁，平稳地滑行，让之前积累起来的动量来完成所有的动作。 [var0
            |轻松地穿过整个路段而不会遇到任何困难，你会随着路线的转弯而上下起伏，最终再次来到露天环境中。Thrud依然在那里…… [thrud.BAS
                |在后面
                |领先于
                |与……一同
            ] 你，也处于和她之前相同的境地。
            |这一部分的内容总体来说比较简单，但在转弯时如果角度过于急骤，会有一些引导线轻轻触碰到你的机翼。这些触碰虽然不足以让你坠落，但确实会让你前进的速度变慢一些。真是麻烦啊…… [thrud.BAS
                |她虽然正在追赶，但仍然落后于你。
                |现在它已经稍微领先于你了。
                |在你短暂取得领先优势之后，它又回到了你的身边。
            ]
        ]

"
        You decide to take it slow through the beams, gliding smoothly and letting the momentum you've built up do all the work. [var0
            |It's easy to make it through the whole section without faltering, and you sway and rise with the turning path till it spits you back out into the open air. Thrud is still [thrud.BAS

            ]
        ]
        "

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: Use the momentum you've already built up to weave through the beams.
rows.translation: 利用你已经积累起来的动力，穿过那些横梁吧。
rows.raw: "Use the momentum you've already built up to weave through the beams."

rows.original:
There's no sense in not giving your all! You slip into the curving paths with nothing but speed on your mind, determined to let your instincts and natural grace do the work. [var0
            |Your gambit pays off big time! Moving like a falcon, you dip and turn on a dime to run between the guides. With wings aching from the intensity, you finally break free through the end of the path. [thrud.BAS
                |Thrud is behind you now, though she's trying her best to catch up.
                |Thrud is still ahead of you, but you're closing the gap.
                |Thrud is alongside you now, but you know you can get ahead.
            ]
            |It doesn't quite turn out the way you wanted. The path markers are much thinner than you thought, and you have to slow down significantly to avoid clipping the tips of your wings as you wobble. You make it through, but it ends up taking a lot longer than it would have if you'd kept a steady pace. When you finally make it, you heave a sigh of relief and spread your wings wide. [thrud.BAS
                |Thrud is still behind you now, though only by a little bit.
                |Thrud is still ahead of you, and she's gaining even more of a lead.
                |Thrud is alongside you now, but you know you can get ahead.
            ]
        ]
rows.translation:
全力以赴才是唯一的出路！你全速驶入那些蜿蜒的小路，一心只想着速度，决心让自己的直觉与与生俱来的优雅来发挥作用。 [var0
            |你的这一招果然取得了巨大的成功！你像猎鹰一样灵活地穿梭在那些引导物之间，急速转向、急停急转。尽管翅膀因为剧烈的运动而感到疼痛，但你最终还是突破了障碍，跑到了路的尽头。 [thrud.BAS
                |现在Thrud已经在你身后了，不过她正在竭尽全力想要追上你。
                |Thrud仍然领先于你，但你的差距正在缩小。
                |现在，Thrud与你并肩作战，但你知道，你自己也能够取得成功。
            ]
            |结果并没有完全如你所愿。那些路径标记比你想象中要细得多，因此你在行走时必须大幅减速，才能避免翅膀的尖端被障碍物碰伤。虽然你最终还是成功通过了，但所花费的时间却比保持稳定速度时要长得多。当你终于到达终点时，你长舒一口气，然后用力展开双翼。 [thrud.BAS
                |虽然只落后一点点，但Thrud现在仍然紧跟在你身后。
                |Thrud仍然领先于你，而且她的优势还在进一步扩大。
                |现在，Thrud与你并肩作战，但你知道，你自己也能够取得成功。
            ]
        ]

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: Give it all you've got to speed through the beams.
rows.translation: 全力以赴，尽快穿过那些光束吧。
rows.raw: "Give it all you've got to speed through the beams."

rows.original: This time, there's a bit more open space before the final trial. You have a little time to call out to Thrud if you want. But what would you want to say?
rows.translation: 这一次，在最终考验之前，有更多的时间可以用来准备。如果你想的话，也可以花些时间去向Thrud倾诉心声。不过，你究竟想对她说些什么呢？
rows.raw: "\n    This time, there's a bit more open space before the final trial. You have a little time to call out to Thrud if you want. But what would you want to say?\n    "

rows.translation: 调情

rows.original:
"[pc.isBimbo
            |[flags.THRUD_TRAINING
                |It's really nice flying with you, Thrud. Like, when I'm in front I get to see your tiddies bounce, and when I'm behind I get to stare at your ass! When we're together I can do both!
                |Wow Thrud, the way you fly makes your titties bounce in, like, just the right way!
            ]
            |You look really beautiful when you fly, you know that? No matter where I'm looking at you from, it's a treat,
        ]" you say with a coy smile.
        
        "Huh? Don't bring that up now!" she replies, faltering in her flight as she flushes. It's not enough to ground her, but it is a significant delay. 
        
        "Maybe after this, you'll still have the strength to carry me back to your room for some fun!" you taunt as you spring forward.
        
        "Don't tempt me, maybe I'll do just that!" she shouts, recovering her pace.
rows.translation:
"[pc.isBimbo
            |[flags.THRUD_TRAINING
                |和你一起飞行真是太棒了，Thrud。当我走在你前面时，就能看到你的胸部随着飞行而晃动；而当我跟在你后面时，就可以尽情欣赏你的臀部了！当我们在一起的时候，这两种乐趣都可以同时享受哦！
                |哇，瑟拉德，你飞行的方式让你的胸部以最完美的方式晃动啊！
            ]
            |你知道吗，当你飞起来的时候，你看起来真的非常美丽。无论我从哪个角度看着你，都是一种享受。
        ]你带着一丝调皮的微笑说道。

“哈？现在可别提这个！”她回答道，说话时声音有些颤抖，脸上也泛起了红晕。这个举动虽然没能让她停下来，但确实让她暂时陷入了迟疑。

“也许等这一切结束后，你还有力气带我去你的房间继续玩闹一番吧！”你一边说着，一边向前冲去。

“别诱惑我，不然我真的可能会那么做的！”她喊道，同时加快了脚步。

rows.translation: 你并没有产生浪漫的兴趣。
训练

rows.original:
"This isn't so bad! I think we're doing pretty good," you say, swaying back and forth as you glide through the air.

rows.original: [var0 |"So. You've said you wanted to be on maternity duty. What if I offered to help? I'm sure Lumia would listen if it's what we both want. I have a nice nursery in Hawkethorne where the baby could be taken care of till I settle down. If they don't have space here, I mean," you say. Thrud's mouth drops comically wide, and she stares till you wave a hand in front of her face. "Y-you'd do that with me!? I-I mean yes! We can- I can- I mean-" she replies, blushing a deep purple as she flusters with her words. "Let's go ask. I'm sure you're right." Thrud stands, brimming with excitement as she waits for you. It's visibly difficult for her not to walk ahead of you as you head out and toward the throne room together. The whole way, she holds tight to your hand and positively glows with confidence. Other valkyries see you and wave, but your giant partner has a one-track mind. She does not stop until the two of you are approaching the throne room. When you finally do reach the doors, she slows down and gives you a plaintive look. "You can go first," she says, furrowing her brow when you laugh in response. "H-hey! You're better at talking to her, and you know it. Jeeze." That's true. You just think it's cute when she's awkward. It'd be a little unnerving if it were anyone but her. It's your turn to drag Thrud as the two of you approach the goddess, and she does a little curtsy as you get close enough to speak. "What a happy surprise! I'm going to hazard a guess that you two are here for something more exciting than a training report or a stock of the keep's supplies. What is it specifically, though?" she asks, looking between you with vexed curiosity. "Well... would trying to make a baby qualify as more exciting?" you ask, giving Thrud's hand a squeeze. "Than reports? Sun's grace it would, and then some!" she exclaims, turning to Thrud with a laugh. "I'm glad to have you out of your shell. The goddess sounds completely sincere, but Thrud still looks like she could go for a good hiding place as she weathers the praise. Still, she squeezes your hand right back, and nods. She can't quite meet her goddess's casual gaze, but she at least looks in her general direction as she responds. "Yeah. I've always wanted to do it at least once, and [pc.name] is the one who convinced me I shouldn't hide that." "I can't think of a better partner for you. Do you know how it works, dear?" the goddess asks before turning back to you. "I know you do, but I never assume." "Yes. Once you've gotten started, the anxious excitement returns in full force, and she again has to stop herself from dragging you behind her much longer gait. "Hello again, Thrud, [pc.name]. To what do I owe the pleasure?" "W-well, my lady, I just wanted to make sure other less fortunate mothers could share my experience, and was wondering if I could take part in maternity duty. "Follow me, dears!" ] She leads you to the stairs that go down to her inner sanctum and then stops you. "Wait here just a moment. There's something at its center, but it's too bright to make out. She holds it gingerly, keeping it steady as possible while she comes to a stop in front of Thrud. The little orb wobbles a bit, and wisps of smoky light drip through her fingers as she moves. "Here we go. Just hold still for a second," Lumia says, more to the orb than to Thrud. "Do you think we'd get in trouble if we did it here? I could fit on the throne." "We should get you back to your room first. rows.original: [var0 |Thrud's room is devoid of light, and there's no response when you knock on the door. You think briefly about where she could be, and then it hits you. The nursery! Could she have had her child already? Backing out of the personal portion of the quarters, you limit yourself to a brisk walking pace as you head toward the nursery. Luckily, it doesn't take long at all to get there, and you find a nearby door guard with ease. Upon recognizing you, the woman smiles and leads you to a section of the hall that's done up like a peaceful little garden. Several mothers, both expecting and carrying very small children, sit among the plants on exquisitely crafted benches. Among them, you spot a familiar face. She's seated facing away from you, and you get a look at the cloth-wrapped bundle in her arms before you can get her attention. Swaddled tightly up to the face is a sleeping infant that can only be hers and yours. A mess of thick, dark hair is visible even from afar, but you can't catch much else before Thrud turns to see you. She grins, looking every bit the warm and gentle mother, and turns in her seat to give you a better look at your child. "This is little Siv. I'd meant to ask you what you felt about a name, but it came to me while she was being born. I hope you like it," she says, hoisting her up into your arms. This close, you can see little hands peeking out of the cloth as well as her face. You had thought the baby was sleeping, but it turns out her cheeks are just chubby enough to half-close her eyes! She regards you with faint disinterest at first, wondering where mom went, but as you [pc.dcb |[pc.isMage |roll your eyes and toss some sparks from your fingers |cover your face with your hand and jump out with a toothy smile ] |[pc.isMage |draw a swirly line of glowy magic through the air |waggle your fingers in front of her face ] |[pc.isMage |blow some fizzy magical bubbles from between your finger and thumb |smile and make happy baby noises ] ], her entire face scrunches into the happiest little grin you've ever seen. There's a contented huff as she turns bashfully into the wrappings, and she's big enough that you have to adjust your hold to her squirming. "I love it, and I love her, and I love you," you say, planting a smooch on the suddenly smiley baby's forehead before handing her back to her mother, who also gets a smooch. You take a seat next to her on the bench. "So how will things work now?" "Lady Lumia got some things shifted around, and more of my duties will be focused around the maternity wing now! I even get some time helping the nurses directly. I didn't want to fully leave the people who look up to me in the lurch, so I still have a couple days a week doing training sessions in the obstacle course halls, but it feels good to be doing what I want," she explains. "And this way we can visit Siv whenever we come down to visit in the maternity ward. I'm already planning to come during my off hours." "I'm glad to see you so happy." "Thank you for making it happen. I'll need to stay for a day or two just to get her acclimated to, well, existing, but after that the wetnurses will be able to ease that burden a little. I was feeding her just before you came, so she should be ready for a nap. It's probably why she's been so calm, too," she laughs. Siv truly does fall asleep after a little longer, and you stay the whole time to see it. You let the wholesome half-giant continue to rock her, standing and giving her a good-bye kiss as you head back to the valkyrie sleeping quarters. Thrud's going to be busy for a few days, but after that you should be able to visit her again, and visit Siv with her any time you want! |You meander on over to Thrud's room and give the door a knock. There's a bit of shuffling movement inside, and then the giant valkyrie is there to welcome you. She pulls you inside, and immediately lifts you off the ground in a huge hug. "[pc.name]! Welcome back. You'll be happy to know that the life we created has made someone very happy. Eira delivered the baby to the Winter City, and brought me back a thank you letter from the new mother. I haven't quite finished writing her welcome letter, but I'm going to send it out as soon as it's done. Gosh, I just get warm fuzzies every time I think about it," she says, finally remembering to set you down after she finishes speaking. "[pc.dcb |Good to know, |I'm glad to hear it turned out so well, |That's, like, super duper! ]" you reply, wobbling a little as she puts you back on your feet. I'd definitely be willing to do that again if it's going to feel like this every time," she says with a violet flush. "But what are you here for in the meantime?" The two of you hop up onto her bed together. What did you have planned for today? ]

She's alone in one of the back kitchens, [rand |Chopping vegetables in preparation for boiling. |scooping chopped vegetables and cubes of meat into a slow-cooking stew-pot. |peeling and crushing cloves of garlic into a fine paste. |making a charcuterie of meats, veggies, and fruits. ] A smile brightens her face as she turns to see who's there, and she momentarily sets aside her work to hop over and greet you. Her choice of outfit is the same as that first time you met her. That is, not a single article of clothing save the thick apron that protects her front from food detritus. [yoli.pregStage 0 1 3 | |She's not showing obviously yet, but she still carries herself differently now that there's a fertilized egg inside her. |Now that she's round and full with an egg, the cloth hardly covers her belly, and her tits constantly fall out the sides when she makes too swift of movements. ] [flags.YOLI_EGG_ANN |"Hi [pc.name]! Our egg's been laid!" "[pc.dcb |Oh? |That's wonderful! |Yay! ] How did it go?" "Pretty easy, same as always. I've laid a ton of eggs so it's all easy nowadays. The new mom came to pick it up, and we chatted for a bit. She's a real sweetie." "I'm glad. I hope they turn out ok." "The locals are very protective of their chicks, and besides, [first YOLI_EGG |I've laid eggs for this particular mama before. She's a [silly |good birb |dedicated lady ]. Technically I've laid at least one egg for all the sterile mama's around here, but that's beside the point. If you see her again tell her I said hi and give all those lil chicks a smooch from me. |If you do, tell her I said hi and give all those little chicks a smooch from me. ]" "Will do," you say with a chuckle. "I'm sure she wouldn't say no to another egg, too, if that's what you're here for," Yoli continues, teasing the side of her apron. Well? Is it? |[first YOLI_APP |"Oh hey! I recognize you! rows.translation: 我只是来看看这次你是否需要在厨房里得到一些帮助。” “正好！我…… 总是 需要帮忙吗？我这里也总是有人帮忙的，不过在这里，帮忙永远都不会嫌多。你能去把那个柜台上的鸡蛋拿一个过来吗？” 你顺着她指的方向走去，从那个小布帘的上方取下了两个鸡蛋，它们正好填满了你的双手。 你小心翼翼地拿着它，等待进一步的指示。 “没必要这么小心，”她笑着说，“这些还没有受精，而且它们也没那么脆弱。” “好吧，”你笑着回答道。 今天我们要制作什么呢？ [rand |还有一个大馅饼可以带走哦。 [var0 |早餐 |午餐 |晚餐 ]超级简单的，只要跟着我做就行了。” 你跟着她来到其中一个边角操作台前，那里有一个大平底锅，里面铺着看起来松软的派皮。还有一些预先切好的食材也被整齐地放在碗和杯子里。尤莉把平底锅和一个空碗推到了操作台边缘。 好吧，先把这个鸡蛋敲破，然后再去拿一个来，”她指着那个碗说道。 你敲破了鸡蛋，然后去拿另一个。当你回来时，发现Yoli正在把之前敲破的鸡蛋与牛奶、盐和胡椒搅拌在一起。她稍微往旁边站了站，让你把第二个鸡蛋也倒入混合物中，然后继续搅拌。 好的，把装火腿的碗、装奶酪的碗以及装青葱的碗都拿过来，把它们都摊开放在面饼盘里！”她一边说，一边继续搅拌着。 你把肉、奶酪和蔬菜都铺在面饼上，然后退到一边，让Yoli把那些液态食材倒进去。 然后，她在食物表面再撒上一层奶酪，接着拿起做好的食物，将其送到另一个房间。在那里，有一位身材魁梧的女性正在操作几台烤箱。她把食物交给那位女性，之后又带你回到了准备食物的房间。 我们真是太幸运了，有这么多牛头人为我们提供牛奶和奶酪，”她一边说，一边把另一个平底锅放到桌上。“好了，现在我们只需要再重复这个动作十次左右就可以了！[first YOLI_QUICHE |十个！？”你略带难以置信地问道，尽管厨房里正在忙碌着准备食物。 “没错，就是十个！大家都喜欢鸡蛋，你难道不知道我们要喂多少人吗？” “确实是这样……不过亲眼看到这么多鸡蛋还是挺让人吃惊的。” “哈哈，如果这让你感到惊讶的话，那你最好远离那些节日盛宴吧。”她笑着说。 |好的，我们走吧？” “确实应该走了，”她笑着说，“对这一群人来说，这些应该已经足够了。 ] 你拿起盘子和饼皮，帮助这位色彩斑斓的“女妖”完成了另外十份蛋奶酥的制作。当你准备好剩余的所有食材时，第一批成品已经出炉了。尤莉从派里切下了两片厚厚的饼皮，你也礼貌地接受了一片。 它们需要几分钟的时间才能冷却到可以食用的程度，但当它们冷却后，你会发现它们的味道浓郁且带有奶油般的口感。肉类与洋葱和奶酪相结合，营造出一种美味无比的混合风味，让你忍不住一直吃下去，直到吃完为止。 这种蛋饼口感松软，易于食用，同时又充满营养，能够带来十足的饱腹感。你还没来得及表达自己的感激之情，Yoli就已经贴心地为你准备了一小瓶牛奶搭配食用。你们一起享用这顿美餐，结果在其他的蛋饼还远远没有煮好的时候，你们就已经吃完了。 虽然你前两段时间都留了下来，但毕竟还有其他事情需要处理，于是约莉在你离开前轻吻了你的脸颊，表示感谢，然后你就回到了食堂。 |晚餐搭配一些肉馅派吧！我们家里还有很多剩鸡肉，所以就用这些鸡肉再加上一些蔬菜来制作这些派。你能从那堆盒子中拿一些小盒子过来吗？” “当然可以，”你说道，然后走过去从储物桌上拿了一小堆派盒。 Yoli已经开始将预先切好的面包皮分切成小块，然后在你把容器摆好的瞬间，立刻把它们放进去。当这些面包块开始在桌子上占据太多空间时，她就会停下来，然后迅速跑到另一个房间，不一会儿就回来，端着一碗满满的剩鸡肉。接着，她又去了两次，拿来了几碗混合蔬菜——有青豆、胡萝卜片，还有一些四季豆。 你帮她将蔬菜和鸡肉搅拌成适合每份馅料使用的量，当你们做好了大概十份馅料后，另一位女武神厨师走了过来，带来了一种浓稠的酱料，让你们将其加入这些固体食材中。你们将这种酱料倒入准备好的馅饼皮中，充分搅拌均匀，直到所有材料完全混合在一起。之后，你再帮她把这些馅饼盒送到烤箱那里，将其中一些放入烤箱进行烘烤。 暂时这样应该够用了，”当你回到桌子旁时，约莉伸开双臂，让她的羽毛全都蓬松起来，说道，“剩下的可以根据需要再制作。” 剩下的派被存放在其中一个温度较低的储藏室里，然后你帮忙清理了现场。完成后，约莉在你的脸颊上亲了一下，脸上洋溢着自豪的笑容。 谢谢， [pc.name]我平时很少有这样的时间来放松，所以有个人能一起做饭真是太好了。” “很乐意帮忙。这里总是很忙，但你看起来从来都不着急。你在这里工作得还好吗？” “哦，当然没问题！当我找到合适的节奏后，几乎都不会注意到时间在流逝。虽然工作并不困难，但有个人帮忙还是挺不错的。” 你又帮忙了一会儿，然后和她道别拥抱了一下，才回到食堂继续工作。 ]
rows.raw: ' "I'm just here to see if you needed some help in the kitchen this time." "Just as well! I always need help there. I also always have help, but you can never really get too much help around here. Would you mind grabbing an egg from that counter there?" You turn to where she's indicated, and pluck an egg that fills both your palms from the top of a small cloth. You carry it over, holding it gently and awaiting further instruction. "You don't need to be so careful," she laughs. "They aren't fertilized, and they aren't that fragile besides." "Ok," you reply with a chuckle. "What are we making today?" [rand |"A big ol' quiche to go with [var0 |breakfast |lunch |dinner ]! It's super easy just follow my lead." You follow her over to one of the side counters where a large pan is lined with fluffy-looking pie crust. A number of other pre-chopped ingredients are lined up as well in bowls and cups. Yoli scoots the pan closer to the edge of the counter along with an empty bowl. "Ok, crack the egg in this one, and then go grab one more," she says, indicating the bowl. You crack the egg, and then go to get another. When you return, you find Yoli whisking the previous egg together with milk, salt, and pepper. She stands aside slightly for you to crack the second egg into the mixture, and then resumes whisking. "Ok, grab that bowl with the ham, the one with the cheese, and the one with the green onion. Spread all those out in the crust pan!" she says, pointing while she continues whisking. You spread the meat, cheese, and veggies over the crust, and then move aside so Yoli can pour the liquid ingredients in. Then, she sprinkles another layer of cheese over the top, and picks up the finished pan to carry it to another room where a stout salamander woman is manning several ovens. She hands it off and then brings you back to the prep room. "We're very lucky to have so many minotaurs around for milk and cheese," she says, hefting another pan up onto the table. "Ok, now we just gotta do that ten more times or so!" "[first YOLI_QUICHE |Ten!?" you ask, slightly incredulous despite the size of the kitchen operation. "Yes ten! Everybody loves eggs! Don't you know how many people we feed?" "Fair enough. It's just a lot to actually see it." "Uh huh. If that shocks you, you should steer clear of the festival feasts," she says with a laugh. |Right. Shall we?" "We shall indeed," she says with a laugh. "That should be enough for this crew." ] You grab pans and crusts, and assist the colorful harpy through ten more pans of quiche. By the time you've finished prepping the remainder of the batch, the first bunch are coming out of the oven. Yoli cuts two thick slices from the pie, and you graciously accept one. It takes a few minutes for them to cool down enough to eat, but when they do you find them to be rich and buttery. The meat mixes with the onions and cheese to create a medley of savory goodness that you can't stop eating till it's gone. The egg is fluffy and soft enough to be easy to eat, but hearty enough to be wonderfully filling. You don't have time to profess a desire before Yoli additionally supplies you with a small carafe of milk to go with it. You enjoy the meal together, and finish long before the rest of the quiches finish cooking. Though you stay for the first two, you do have business to be getting back to, and so Yoli gives you a thank-you peck on the cheek before letting you return to the mess hall. |"A bunch of pot pies to go with dinner! We have a ton of leftover chicken, so we'll be making them with that and some veggies. Could you grab a bunch of those little tins from the stack?" "Sure," you say, walking over and grabbing a small stack of pie tins from the storage table. Yoli is already cutting sections of pre-rolled crust, and immediately places them within the containers as you set them out. She stops when they start taking up too much space on the table, and swiftly hops to one of the other rooms before returning with a heaping bowl of leftover chicken. Then she makes two extra trips to grab a couple bowls of mixed veggies. March peas and sliced carrots, as well as some string beans. You help her mix the veggies and chicken into portions fitting for each crust, and after you've got maybe ten portions in, another valkyrie cook wanders in and drops off a hearty sauce to mix in with the solid ingredients. The both of you pour the sauce into your stuffed pie-shells, and mix it together till it's all settled. Then, you help her carry each tin to the oven room, and load some of them in for cooking. "That should be enough for now," Yoli says when you get back to the table, stretching her arms till her feathers poof out. "The rest can get cooked up as needed." The rest of the pies get stored in one of the colder storage rooms, and then you help clean up. You get a big ol' smooch on the cheek from Yoli once you've finished, and she smiles proudly. "Thanks, [pc.name]. I don't normally get much time to relax like this, so it's nice having a cooking partner." "Glad to help. It's always so busy, but you never seem all that rushed. Are you ok back here?" "Oh yeah for sure! When I get a nice rhythm going I hardly even notice the time passing. It's not like I struggle, but it's still nice having help." You stay and help out for a little while longer, and then give her a hug goodbye before returning to the mess hall. ] '

rows.original: "You look about ready to pop! How about you let me handle the stew for a while," you say, walking close enough to give the pretty parrot a hug. "Oh gosh, you're so sweet! I would love the help. I'm getting close to laying, and that always leaves me feeling plenty antsy." She waddles her way over to the counter, taking a seat on a cleared stool and cradling her gravid belly. The strain of carrying the weight of life within her is obvious, but she looks no less exuberant for it. Her feathers are in disarray, and she's breathing heavy from the exertion of simply doing her job. Still, though, when she smiles at you with grateful relief on her face, it stirs your [pc.dcb |cold heart to something resembling warmth. |heart to action. |full heart to a tizzy. ] It's not so tough, as she's already done most of the work herself. Still, you add a couple extra pre-prepared veggies to the pot and stir them alongside the rest. This is a hearty stew, designed to simmer for hours as the patrols return from missions in day and night. The pot doesn't require much more than babysitting, but babysit you do. As an added bonus, it means you get to enjoy the developing scent of meat, veggies, and spices as the time passes and the flavors mix and meld. It takes about a half an hour for the stew to progress enough to be servable, at which point several other members of the cookstaff come to begin preparing portions to take to the most recent arrivals. You help with the dishing out, coordinating bowls and utensils to the incoming teams, and organizing the continued effort that goes into feeding an entire fortress. By the time the current pot has been drained, several other cooks have come to relieve you of your temporarily-handled duties. Happy for the relief, you turn back to Yoli and find her still watching you with the same pride. There's an extra hunger to her gaze now, though, that makes your heart pound. As you get closer, you notice a bit more tension in her body, and how heavy her breath has grown. You quicken your step to close the last few paces of distance, reaching her as swiftly as you can manage. "You alright?" "Fuck, you're hot when you know what you're doing like that. I want you to put me on a table and show me the same dedication you showed that pot..." she says, and then closes her eyes in a moment of strain. "This egg is definitely ready to come out, though. Would you mind helping me to the baths?" "[pc.dcb |Snake's tits... You should have told me sooner," |You could have interrupted me! This is more important!" |Oh gosh! You should've interrupted me! ]" you say, helping her up. Despite the weight of her egg, she's still plenty easy to lift and carry out of the kitchens. By the time you've made it to the baths, she's covered in a sheen of sweat and struggling to stop from pushing early. A valkyrie attendant directs you to a small private bathing room, with a tub of clean water and a pile of towels. At Yoli's direction, you gather the towels into a comfy-looking pile, and help the gravid harpy to sit-squat at the edge of the warm nest of dry softness. "N-now, I'm probably gonna need some help, cause this -hhhgh- this one is pretty big," she says, spreading her legs and gripping the towels beneath her. "Sure. [flags.YOLI_EGG_HELP |Same as last time? |What do you need? ]" you ask. "[flags.YOLI_EGG_HELP |Yeah. Just like last time, if you can. That was so amazing. Easiest egg I ever laid, |I'm going to need you to help me get all tense and then relaxed, and there's a really easy way to do that that I think you know, ]" she replies. [flags.YOLI_EGG_HELP |That's something you know you can do. Exact promises are debatable, but you remember how to help her lay nice and easy. |Oh! Right, that is what you came for in the first place. You'd almost forgot with all the cooking and bustle. ] Scooting closer so that you're knelt right at the edge of the ring next to her, you help brace the beautiful birdy and caress her inner thigh with one hand. As soon as your fingertips brush her clit, she gasps and then tightens with the force of an immense push. Her breath pauses, and her eyes scrunch shut as she tries with all her might. Close as you are, you can feel the egg shift inside her. It's far too huge to get through in that initial motion, however, and you feel it shift back into place as she hooks an arm around your shoulders and puts her head against yours. "Hahh, almost. Gonna need more help," she says between gasping huffs of air. "Then more help will come," you reply, leaning in to kiss her neck. You begin slowly swirling your fingers around her slit, dipping them inside her entrance and feeling her try to clench around them even as she spreads further in preparation of laying. She relaxes in your arms, panting and catching her breath and leaning against the top of your head as you nuzzle her neck. Holding her tight, you help her feel safe and comfortable as possible as she prepares for the next push. It's easy to tell when she's gearing up to try, and you pull your fingers back to clear the way and massage her love buzzer. This time she holds her breath and pushes even harder. You feel the egg shift once more, and slow-swirl your fingers around her entrance till you feel it spread wide by the oncoming egg. You can feel the shell, and it's a lot of egg. The size of it is such that she can't get it out in one go. It's too far now to slip back into her womb, but she huffs and gasps as she tries to recover the strength for another push. Her thighs quiver, and her knees threaten to buckle at any moment, but your support helps her remain steadfast. "Just a little more. One more good push," you say, holding her tight and giving one of her tits a squeeze. "Can you give me one more good push?" She's straining too hard to talk, but you get a weak nod as she leans heavily into you and sucks in a deep breath of air. The first time she pushes, it's obvious that she's not going to have enough force to free the egg. The bulbous bottom still refuses to fit, and she whimpers softly as it slips back into her slit. After that, she leans against you and just breathes for a while, accepting all the gentle and relaxing squeezes you have to offer. When she finally gears up to try again, she squeezes you tight and pushes with all her might. "You can do it. Push!" you say, and she pushes even harder. You feel her hips spread momentarily wider than you could imagine, and hear the wet plop of egg onto towel. She wobbles once, and then her knees really do buckle as she falls back onto her butt. With you there to help, the impact isn't anything more than a gentle 'plap', but with that separation you can see just how exhausted she looks. Helping to mop up some of the sweat, you get the egg to a place where it can rest against her body and keep warm. It takes a while before she recovers enough to talk, and when she does her voice is hoarse. "There it is. We made that. Isn't it wonderful?" she asks, feebly wiping the sides of the shell with one of the towels. "Beautiful," you say, helping her move and get situated till you can rest comfortably alongside each other. She's content to rest for at least an hour, just recovering and getting stronger till she can start peppering you with kisses to make up for lost time. "Thank you. It's nice having some help." "Any time, Yoli." "Now, then," she says, standing on wobbly legs. "I've gotta get this little one ready for traveling before anything happens to them. If you're still on maternity duty, I hope you come by again soon, [pc.name]. Even if you aren't, I hope you come by so I can watch you cook more." "I'm sure I'll find some time eventually," you say, making sure she's recovered enough to actually walk before letting her hop off in the direction of the nursery ward. In the meantime, you head back to the main hall and prepare to get back on your way.
rows.translation: 你看起来都快忍不住要‘爆发’了吧？让我来帮你处理一下这个‘麻烦’吧，”你说着，走得足够近，以便能够拥抱那只漂亮的鹦鹉。 “哦，天哪，你真是太好了！我真的很愿意…… 爱 帮帮我吧。我快要生孩子了，每次想到这个就会变得非常焦虑。” 她摇摇摆摆地走到柜台旁，在一个空出来的凳子上坐下，然后把怀孕的肚子抱在怀里。显然，承载着新生命的重量让她感到有些吃力，但她看起来依然充满活力。她的羽毛有些凌乱，因为工作而呼吸也有些急促，但当她脸上带着感激和宽慰的笑容看着你时，你还是会感到一阵温暖。 [pc.dcb |对本该充满温情的事物却表现得冷漠无情。 |付诸行动。 |满心欢喜，激动不已。 ] 其实并没有那么难，因为她已经完成了大部分工作。不过，你还是可以在锅里再加入一些事先准备好的蔬菜，然后把它们和其他食材一起翻炒一下。这道菜需要慢慢炖煮几个小时，这样当巡逻队白天或晚上完成任务回来时，这道浓汤就已经炖好了。照顾这个锅其实并不需要花费太多精力，但你需要时刻关注它的烹饪过程。另外，还有一个额外的好处：随着时间的推移，肉、蔬菜和香料的味道会慢慢融合在一起，你会逐渐享受到这种美妙的香气。 这道炖菜需要大约半个小时的时间才能烹饪完成并可以端上桌。这时，其他几位厨师也会过来帮忙，开始为刚到的新成员准备食物。你需要协助分发食物，为前来领取食物的团队提供碗筷等用品，并协调整个厨房的工作，以确保整个堡垒的居民都能得到食物。等到当前这一锅炖菜被分完之后，还会有其他厨师来接替你暂时承担的这些职责。 看到她终于松了口气，你转身看向约莉，发现她依然以那种充满自豪的眼神注视着你。不过，此刻她的眼神中多了一种令人心悸的渴望。当你慢慢靠近时，你注意到她的身体变得愈发紧张，呼吸也变得急促起来。你加快脚步，尽快缩短与她的距离，尽自己所能迅速地来到她身边。 你没事吧？” “天啊，当你那样做的时候，真的太性感了……我希望你能把我放在桌子上，然后像对待那个‘大麻烟卷’一样，用同样的热情来对待我……”她说着，然后因为有些紧张而闭上了眼睛。“不过，这个‘蛋’已经准备‘破壳而出’了……你能帮我去浴室吗？ "[pc.dcb |蛇奶……你早该告诉我的。 |你本可以打断我的！这件事可比那重要得多！ |天啊！你当时真该打断我！ ]你说得对，帮她站起来吧。” 尽管她的蛋很重，但把她抱起来并搬出厨房其实并不困难。等到你把她送到浴室的时候，她已经满身是汗了，而且迫不及待地想要开始生产了。 一位女武神侍者将你引向一间小巧的私人浴室，那里有一盆干净的清水和一堆毛巾。在约莉的指示下，你把毛巾整理成整齐的一叠，然后帮助这位怀孕的哈比坐在这个由干爽柔软的毛巾堆构成的温暖“窝”中。
